title: Personal Care Attendant
description:
Join the Team Voted Best Place to Work in North County!

Why Work for Gary and Mary West PACE?

Because you're looking for more than just a job - you want work/life balance and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the lives of North County seniors and their families.

At Gary and Mary West PACE, we support your personal and professional well-being with:

  • Generous pay and a comprehensive benefits package focused on your health and wellness
  • 11 paid holidays, 13 days of PTO, and 5 days of sick time
  • A 5% employer match to our 403(b) retirement plan
  • No on-call time – because your time matters

We invest in our team with an annual education allowance and a commitment to professional growth, helping you expand your skills and advance your career.

You'll thrive in a supportive, mission-driven culture where collaboration feels like family. As part of our multi-disciplinary team, your voice is heard, and your work is truly valued.

Join us and do your best work-because here, your contribution matters.

About PACE

Philanthropists Gary and Mary West founded West Health with the mission of enabling seniors to successfully age in place with access to high-quality, affordable health and support services that preserve and protect their dignity, quality of life, and independence. The Gary and Mary West PACE (Program of All-inclusive Care for the Elderly), affiliated with West Health (www.westhealth.org), is a non-profit that delivers medical, social, and behavioral services to the frail elderly to the North County of San Diego. This PACE center is entrepreneurial in nature and focuses on innovations and bringing new processes to the traditional PACE environment.

We're looking for passionate healthcare providers who want to be part of a team dedicated to enable seniors to live in their communities as independently as possible by providing compassionate, comprehensive health and supportive care.

One Team One Mission

Under supervision of the Center Manager, the PACE Physician provides assessment, planning, primary care, and continuous medical coverage to PACE participants in an interdisciplinary team environment and in accordance with Gary and Mary West PACE standards.

Position Summary:

Under the supervision of the Center Manager, the personal care worker is responsible for providing various care services necessary for attending to the personal needs, support, and health status of participants in both the center and home setting.

Essential Functions:

  • Participate as a member of the interdisciplinary team in ongoing participant assessment and monitoring. Report on personal care services provided and the self-care abilities of participant, including changes noted in participant's condition.
  • Provide personal care and hygiene assistance including toileting, showering, eating, oral care and grooming. Assist in the maintenance of physical activity, exercise, and walking.
  • Provide personal care as assigned in a safe manner, consistent with the policies and procedures of the center.
  • Responsible for participant safety, identify safety hazards and emergency situations, and initiate corrective action as able.
  • Provide behavioral supervision or support for participants, such as reality orientation, reminder to follow through with nursing and medication instruction, diet restrictions, and emotional reassurance.
  • Assist with general activities such as conversing with participants, recreation activities, meal and snack serving, and routine cleaning tasks ensuring cleanliness and comfort..
  • Assist in identifying signs and symptoms indicating physical, emotional, or behavioral change in participants and reporting these signs to the center staff and/or supervisor, including but not limited to, any changes in skin integrity, bowel and bladder status, food/fluid intake, or changes in ambulation.
  • Assure compliance with infection control, personal protection equipment, blood-borne pathogens, hazardous material handling, and fire safety standards.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of all participant information.
  • Escort participants to medical, dental, optometry, rehabilitation, and other appointments as necessary.
  • Attend staff meetings and participant care planning on a regular basis.
  • Maintain current written records, indicating ongoing documentation of services provided, reassessments of changing needs, and participant's expressed wishes.
  • Prepare and submit timely written reports as required.
  • Maintain confidentiality of participant information.

Non-Essential Job Functions:

  • Attend and participate in staff meetings, in-services, projects, and committees as assigned.
  • Adhere to and support the center's policies, practices, and procedures.
  • Provide support to other departments or team members as needed to ensure smooth and efficient operations.
  • Accept assigned duties in a cooperative manner; and perform all other related duties as assigned.
  • Be flexible in schedule of hours worked.
  • Will require use of personal vehicle.

Education and Certification:

  • Must possess, as a minimum, a GED or high school diploma.
  • CPR/BLS certification required.
  • Original valid driver license with proof of auto insurance.
  • Clean driving record.

Skills and Experience:

  • Knowledge of the principles and techniques involved in relating to frail elderly persons.
  • Skill in communicating with participants, their families, and other staff members; ability to establish a helping, trusting relationship with participants.
  • Demonstrates sensitivity to the needs of older adults as evidenced by a caring approach, patience in providing care, and responsiveness to participant requests.
  • Ability to follow directions, verbal and written instructions, and adapt work schedule under supervision.
  • Ability to follow through with instructions and directions provided by supervisor, RN, QAPI coordinator, primary care physician, and/or medical director.
  • Ability to utilize appropriate safety measures when providing care.
  • Ability to relate to the public and governmental agencies in a pleasant, patient, and professional manner
  • Ability to work effectively and harmoniously as part of an interdisciplinary team, the elderly, providers of services, and peers in particular.
  • Well organized, dependable, flexible, and resourceful.
  • Original valid driver's license with proof of auto insurance.

Medical Clearance:

Employees must have medical clearance for communicable diseases and up-to-date immunizations before having direct participant contact.

Job offers are contingent upon a successful pre-employment drug screen, background check, and physical assessment.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Summary:
The Senior Cloud Engineer will mentor the Junior Cloud Engineer, establish sustainable technical standards, serve as the escalation point for advanced cloud and endpoint issues, and assume long-term platform ownership following the planned SharePoint re-architecture engagement.
The role will also establish and maintain recovery capabilities for Microsoft cloud services, including backup architecture, documented recovery procedures, restore validation, and coordination of resilience testing.
Key Responsibilities:
Microsoft cloud platform ownership:
  • Serve as the senior technical owner for Microsoft 365 and related cloud services.
  • Design and maintain platform standards, governance controls, documentation, roadmaps, and configuration baselines.
  • Lead complex troubleshooting, major changes, platform improvements, and Tier 3 escalations.
  • Reduce reliance on MSPs and outside vendors by building sustainable internal capability and documented operating practices.
Identity, access, and endpoint management:
  • Architect and administer Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, identity governance, privileged access controls, and identity lifecycle standards.
  • Own Intune and Windows Autopilot architecture, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment standards, and endpoint-management governance.
  • Improve endpoint lifecycle, security posture, reporting, provisioning reliability, and operational consistency.
Collaboration and information management:
  • Assume long-term technical ownership of SharePoint Online after the initial consulting engagement.
  • Implement and maintain SharePoint governance, permissions, site lifecycle, ownership, and information architecture standards.
  • Support Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, OneDrive, Purview, retention, and collaboration governance.
Cloud resilience, backup, and recovery:
  • Define and maintain recovery architecture for Microsoft 365 and related cloud services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID, Intune, and applicable Azure-hosted workloads.
  • Evaluate, implement, and govern third-party backup and recovery platforms for Microsoft cloud services.
  • Document Microsoft, vendor, and internal recovery responsibilities, service dependencies, recovery procedures, and escalation paths.
  • Establish and maintain recovery runbooks, service-recovery requirements, restore procedures, and evidence of recovery readiness.
  • Plan and execute recurring restore tests and participate in broader disaster-recovery and business-continuity exercises.
  • Partner with the Senior Security and Network Engineer, system owners, vendors, and IT leadership to validate end-to-end recovery capabilities.
  • Identify recovery gaps and recommend technical, procedural, or vendor changes to improve resilience.
Security, automation, and modernization:
  • Partner with the Senior Security and Network Engineer on Microsoft Defender, identity security, audit remediation, and Zero Trust initiatives.
  • Develop PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, and workflow automation that reduces manual administration and repetitive support work.
  • Evaluate and govern Power Platform, Microsoft Copilot, and emerging Microsoft cloud capabilities.
  • Support secure and supportable integration patterns across Microsoft cloud services and business platforms.
Mentorship and operational partnership:
  • Mentor the Junior Cloud Engineer and assist the VP, Information Systems in establishing a practical development path.
  • Provide technical guidance to the Service Desk and improve escalation procedures, troubleshooting documentation, and knowledge articles.
  • Coordinate with business stakeholders, consultants, vendors, and IT leadership on cloud projects, priorities, service changes, and recovery requirements.
  • Create and maintain clear SOPs, architecture decisions, runbooks, and operating documentation as part of normal delivery.
Qualifications:
Required:
  • Five or more years of progressively responsible Microsoft 365 administration and engineering experience, including senior-level design, implementation, and troubleshooting.
  • Advanced experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Windows Autopilot.
  • Experience administering Azure services relevant to identity, automation, monitoring, application integrations, backup, recovery, and Microsoft cloud operations, together with strong PowerShell automation skills.
  • Experience designing, documenting, and testing backup, restoration, and recovery capabilities for Microsoft 365 or comparable enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business and recovery requirements into scalable, secure, supportable, and operationally sustainable technical solutions.
  • Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, troubleshooting, mentoring, and vendor-management skills.
  • Experience supporting multi-site organizations; manufacturing experience is preferred.
Preferred:
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender, Purview, Power Platform governance, Copilot readiness, and Zero Trust architecture.
  • Experience leading SharePoint Online governance or information architecture initiatives.
  • Experience evaluating or administering Microsoft 365 backup platforms such as Barracuda, Veeam, Rubrik, Commvault, AvePoint, or comparable enterprise cloud backup solutions.
  • Experience developing recovery runbooks and participating in disaster-recovery or business-continuity exercises.
  • Working knowledge of recovery point objectives, recovery time objectives, service dependencies, restore validation, and recovery-testing evidence.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator, Identity and Access Administrator, Endpoint Administrator, or Azure Solutions Architect.
  • Experience supporting the Microsoft platform, identity, integration, security, or operational dependencies surrounding Dynamics 365 is a plus.
Core Competencies:
  • Microsoft Cloud Platform Leadership
  • Identity & Endpoint Management
  • Cloud Resilience & Disaster Recovery
  • Security, Risk Management & Governance
  • Automation & Continuous Improvement
  • Technical Mentorship & Stakeholder Partnership

title: Data Analyst
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL

You? A curious, tenacious, hands-on analyst who turns complex marketplace data into product decisions and scalable measurement foundations.

Role? Data Analyst in the Core Insights team, focused primarily on Product analysis, but you can expect to get a varied diet of insights questions and the opportunity to shape it

Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it's a new sofa, a new home, a car, or a career opportunity.

Why us? We support the product teams that build the common components in our marketplaces. We help enable safe and secure deals, better matching between buyers and sellers, and more. Based on rich and big data, you'll provide the insight that will play a key role in how these products could be improved.

You will also consult on how the teams can collect data in order to understand our users even better. You will get the possibility to create the insights that will move the needle for these products, and varied workdays covering the full span of how to measure, how to find out, and how to build insights that last over time.

Sound like your cup of tea? ☕ Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?

  • Strong analytical skills and hands-on experience with tools like Tableau, Amplitude, Google Analytics, Data Studio, or similar. Our tool stack includes Snowflake (SQL), Tableau, Amplitude, and Claude Code.
  • Skills in web tracking, A/B testing, Python, Machine Learning and AI, Kafka, and Data Mesh principles will also be a plus.
  • A track record of working across the product lifecycle from discovery to delivery, partnering closely with PMs, UXers, developers, marketers, and fellow analysts.
  • A collaborative mindset; you understand that great products are built through shared goals. You value collective success and holistic product growth over solo stardom.
  • Strong communication skills, not only in presenting clear, actionable insights but also in shaping the right questions and defining what data is needed to get to the answers.
  • Problem-solver with a hands-on mindset, ready to dive into experiments, impact analyses, or marketplace KPIs. You habitually dive into the deep end to extract new insights proactively. You don’t give up until you have gotten to the bottom of the question you want to answer
  • A natural curiosity! You actively test hypotheses, measure impact, and help teams make smarter, faster decisions. You're excited about where analytics is heading - including AI-augmented workflows and modern data tooling.
  • An interest in how data is made, not only used. You will get to work with data end-to-end, including how frontend data is captured. Sometimes we will need to measure something we don’t measure yet to get to the answers we need.You will partner with teammates to design effective tracking strategies for gathering fresh user data., and discuss with your colleagues and test your ideas on how to get there

WHAT'S THE JOB LIKE?

Day-to-day work & projects cooking

As a Data Analyst in Core Insights, you help the product teams in Core Marketplace Platforms build the right features faster and learn from them reliably.

You work closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Developers, and fellow Analysts to:

  • Design and interpret measurements of product development efforts that connect product changes to commercial outcomes
  • Support a culture where we ask the right questions, rather than delivering numbers on demand
  • Define success metrics and guardrails for product initiatives, including AI-driven features where measurement discipline is crucial.
  • Create clear dashboards and reports that inform both day-to-day decisions and strategic direction.

Our team consists of 6 members plus our team lead, and has a broad range of expertise across business analytics, data management, augmented analytics, and strategy. We combine deep product work with cross-team collaboration, knowledge sharing, and increasingly, AI-augmented tooling.

Success after 6 months? You've built strong relationships with your product teams, contributed to tangible and measurable improvement for key product components, and delivered analyses that moved decisions forward.

Success after 1 year? You're a trusted analytical partner for the product teams, armed with reusable models and frameworks that increase the leverage of the entire team. You feel confident taking the lead in analytic projects and advising product stakeholders.

This is a great time to be joining us!

Your first task will be to support the product teams in Core Marketplace Platforms, pairing up with an experienced analyst and flying solo on projects quickly. Core Marketplace Platform is itself a new constellation of teams, and you have the opportunity to make a difference quickly: your work shapes how we learn, make decisions, and grow across millions of users and four countries.

You also will be joining us at a time when augmented analytics is changing what it means to be an analyst, and you will be a part of the team that will be one of the driving forces of that change.

Last but not least: you will join a team of people who are good at what they do, are passionate about data and analytics, like to learn and share, and like to contribute to the success of others and of other teams.

A few words from Torgeir Drabløs, Head of Insights and Data Management:

"Hi, I'm Torgeir! It is my privilege to lead a team consisting of passionate and tenacious people whose expertise complements each other - and will complement and appreciate what you bring to the table. What makes us different is that we don't just answer questions: we are opinionated about what the question should be, we serve a very wide span of stakeholders from product developers to the Executive Management team, and we work end-to-end with data, from when it is captured to when it informs a real-world decision.

If you're the kind of analyst who likes to challenge what the question to be answered should be, if you don’t like giving up until you get to the bottom of it, and if you are excited about changing how analytics works, we'd love to hear from you."

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!

Make sure to apply by the 11th of October; we’re looking forward to hearing from you!

Torgeir Drabløs, Head of Insights and Data Management in PTX Core, is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role. (torgeir.drablos@vend.com)

For questions around the recruitment process, please contact Senior TA Partner, Cecilia Bergerståhl. Contact information is found at the bottom of the ad.

This role combines strong business systems analysis, consulting, relationship management, solution deployment, and delivery execution skills with practical knowledge of omics research workflows and data concepts such as genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and/or metabolomics. Specifically, the Senior Business Systems Analyst, Omics is responsible for eliciting and documenting business requirements, creating functional requirements, performing data and process modeling, managing any change communications, and coordinating or leading testing, verification, and validation activities with involvement from appropriate stakeholders from the business, data, and technology teams to ensure compliance and alignment with AbbVie internal standards and security controls.

Responsibilities:

Business Relationship Management

  • Partner closely with Discovery business stakeholders, dossier management, Regulatory Affairs, and IT to understand strategic objectives, operational needs, pain points, and opportunities to support omics process improvement.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships across business, data, technology, and digital teams.
  • Support creation of value assessments, business cases, and prioritization recommendations.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned to support the broader team and organizational objectives.

Requirements Management

  • Elicit, analyze, document, and manage business, functional, and non-functional requirements.
  • Translate business and scientific needs into actionable user stories, process flows, business requirements documents, and acceptance criteria.
  • Facilitate alignment among business stakeholders, data/engineering/AI teams, and IT partners to ensure requirements are complete, clear, and delivery ready.
  • Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies and procedures.

Omics Program and Project Support

  • Take ownership of systems within the Omics area, ensuring they are well-maintained, optimized, and compliant.
  • Engage with vendors to facilitate system enhancements and troubleshoot issues, ensuring that external partnerships align with business needs and objectives.
  • Operate with a high degree of independence, exercising sound business judgment to evaluate problems, recommend solutions, make informed technical and process decisions within scope, and deliver results that meet business and project objectives.
  • Exercise latitude in problem solving and solution recommendations, balancing scientific, business, technical, compliance, and resource considerations to deliver outcomes that minimize project delays, rework, and unnecessary expenditure of resources.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Genomics, Bioinformatics, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, or related discipline, OR Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or related discipline with life science research/experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree with 5 years of experience OR Master’s Degree with 4 years of experience.
  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience in business systems analysis, business systems consulting, product ownership, project delivery, technology consulting, or related discipline.
  • Foundational understanding of omics research workflows and data concepts (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics).
  • Experience eliciting, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements.
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder discussions and translating business/scientific needs into technology solutions.
  • Experience supporting enterprise software delivery initiatives; understanding of SDLC methodologies, Agile practices, and modern product delivery approaches.
  • Working understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), generative AI, and traditional AI/ML concepts, and how to apply and select them for best fit.
  • Strong analytical, communication, project-management, and relationship-management skills; a demonstrated work ethic emphasizing customer focus, quality, and continuous improvement.

Preferred:

  • Previous wet lab experience is highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting AI, analytics, digital transformation, or automation initiatives.
  • Experience with omics informatics platforms, laboratory/research data platforms, data visualization or analytics tools, or cloud-based environments.
  • Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, manufacturing, or other regulated-industry experience.
  • Experience supporting change management and technology adoption activities.

title: Integrated Campaign Strategist
description:
How will you make a difference to PMI?
PMI is looking for an Integrated Growth Marketing Strategist to own the end-to-end, cross-channel activation strategy, bringing email, web, social, paid media, and content together into one cohesive approach rather than separate channel plans.
This role maintains a strong understanding of business performance, customer behavior, lifecycle trends, market dynamics, and seasonal opportunities to proactively identify and recommend initiatives that drive growth. The Strategist defines how audiences are reached and activated across the full channel mix, how channels and formats work together to achieve campaign objectives, and how performance is measured and optimized holistically.
With a deep understanding of both B2B and B2C audiences, the Strategist translates business and growth objectives into integrated activation strategies and provides clear direction to channel owners and agency partners for execution.
This is a senior individual-contributor role with direct accountability for growth and activation performance. The Strategist works closely across Marketing and other key functions to connect campaign performance to measurable business outcomes across the full customer funnel.
What you’ll bring to the role:
Campaign Activation Strategy & Channel Design

Own the end-to-end, cross-channel activation strategy for integrated campaigns — treating paid media, email, web, social, and content as one holistic system rather than separate channel plans.
Translate campaign and lifecycle objectives directly into a single, integrated activation plan — defining channel mix, format investment, and audience segmentation across channels, rather than aggregating plans built independently by channel owners.
Direct channel owners and the agency in executing against the strategy; incorporate their channel-specific expertise and ideas into the strategy without ceding ownership of it.
Identify opportunities for personalization, segmentation, and audience relevance across the full activation plan.

Paid Media Strategy & Agency Oversight

Set paid media strategy and activation design — platform selection, format strategy, targeting approach — for campaigns executed by the agency.
Review and approve agency media plans against activation strategy and growth goals; provide strategic direction and briefs, not just timeline coordination.
Hold the agency accountable to performance and strategic fit, partnering on in-flight optimization and test-and-learn/new-channel pilots.

Growth & Performance Goal Ownership

Maintain a strong pulse on overall business performance, audience behavior, market dynamics, and seasonal or cultural moments to identify and recommend campaign initiatives and optimizations that can drive growth, engagement, conversion, or lifecycle impact.
Set and own performance goals for campaign activation and growth marketing — conversion, funnel/pipeline impact, channel efficiency (e.g., CAC, ROAS, cost-per-conversion), and lifecycle impact.
Proactively track and report on activation and growth performance; drive optimization recommendations rather than only summarizing results after the fact.
Partner with Product Marketing, which owns product performance and usage metrics, to maintain a shared view of business impact from awareness/activation through product adoption.

Cross-Functional & Executive Coordination

Serve as the central strategic lead across dependencies, roles, and timelines for integrated campaigns.
Facilitate campaign kickoffs, checkpoints, and retrospectives; represent activation strategy and growth performance directly to senior stakeholders, including CMO/VP-level review of media plans and channel investment.
Partner with Regional Marketing to align global and regional execution requirements.

Operational Excellence & Process Leadership

Define and evolve the operating model, templates, and workflows for activation strategy and growth performance — not only apply existing ones.
Ensure campaign documentation is clear, accurate, and consistently maintained across a broader and more complex set of workstreams.
Identify and lead process improvements that reduce friction between strategy, channel owners, and agency execution.

Role Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
8–10 years of experience in integrated marketing, growth marketing, or performance marketing, including direct ownership of paid media strategy and planning (not solely coordinating with a paid media function).
Proven track record of driving strong campaign performance across the end-to-end customer lifecycle, directly contributing to business performance and growth.Demonstrated experience setting and being accountable to growth/performance targets, not only reporting on channel activity.
Experience managing agency relationships at a strategic level — briefing, directing, and holding agencies accountable to performance — rather than coordinating deliverables and timelines.
Comfortable working in a matrixed, cross-functional environment with senior stakeholder visibility.
Familiarity with marketing automation platforms, CRM systems, analytics/performance dashboards, and project management tools.
Activation Strategy Ownership: Designs channel-agnostic activation strategy — not just coordination — across paid, owned, and earned channels.
Business & Customer Acumen: Demonstrates strong curiosity about broader business performance, customer behavior, and audience needs, understanding how to build effective growth strategies across both B2B and B2C contexts.
Paid Media & Performance Marketing Acumen: Deep fluency in paid channel formats, targeting, platforms, and performance metrics (CAC, ROAS, conversion).
Growth Goal Ownership: Sets, owns, and is accountable for growth/activation performance targets.
Agency Strategic Management: Directs and holds agency partners accountable at a strategy level, not only an execution level.
Cross-Channel Judgment: Understands how channels work together and makes format/investment tradeoffs across them.
Executive Communication: Clearly represents strategy and performance to senior stakeholders, including CMO/VP-level review.
Analytics Literacy: Interprets performance dashboards and translates data into optimization decisions.
Content & Messaging Awareness: Ensures narrative consistency across all campaign components.
Adaptability: Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic environments with shifting priorities.
Proficiency in PMI's business language (English).
Some travel, possibly up to 15%, conditions permitting. Requirements include ability to travel nationally and globally and may occur over weekends or holidays.

title: Control Systems Specialist (SBSC) | South Brunswick
description:
OnTrac is hiring a Control Systems Specialist in South Brunswick!

Are you eager to join a dynamic and expanding company where you can both learn and make a meaningful impact? If you possess a strong sense of empathy, enjoy assisting others, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and excel at problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today to connect with a recruiter!

OnTrac LTSC
2270 US Highway 130
South Brunswick, NJ 08810

Compensation:
The expected starting base pay range for this position is $115,280 to $144,100 per year, with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $115,280 to $172,920 per year. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors.

Schedule:
Monday through Friday from 2:00pm to 10:00pm
(Hours subject to change depending on business needs)

Employment Logistics:
The Control Systems Specialist supports the reliability, functionality, and uptime of OnTrac’s automated parcel handling systems by developing, maintaining, and optimizing PLC and WCS (Warehouse Control System) programs. This role provides real-time troubleshooting, supports controls design standards, and implements improvements that enhance throughput, fault recovery, and automation stability. This role works closely with Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, and OEM partners to help maintain a resilient, standardized, and scalable controls environment across the network.

Unpacking the Benefits:
Employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, which may include:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Life and short- and long-term disability coverage
401(k) retirement savings plan with company match

Two (2) floating holidays per year
Paid sick leave*
Six (6) paid company holidays
Two (2) weeks paid pregnancy disability leave, four (4) weeks paid parental bonding leave
Additional wellness and employee assistance programs

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of applicable benefit plans, Company policies, and governing law.

The Must-Haves:

Bachelor’s Degree in related technical discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience.
At least 4 years of experience in automation and controls for facilities, conveyor systems, automated material handling, or sortation equipment.
Proficiency with PLCs (Allen-Bradley/Rockwell), HMIs, SCADA systems, and safety interlocks.
Ability to travel up to 50%

Your Mission in Motion:
A summary of the key responsibilities for this role is outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business and operational needs.

Keep automation running at peak reliability: Support, troubleshoot, and optimize PLC and WCS systems for conveyor lines, sortation equipment, dimensioners, and other automated systems to improve uptime and stability.
Build and maintain robust PLC logic: Develop and maintain PLC programs (primarily Allen‑Bradley/Rockwell) that ensure reliable operation and strong fault recovery behavior.
Implement improvements with engineering and OEM partners: Collaborate on controls revisions and software updates that improve throughput, recovery performance, and system consistency.
Support commissioning and integration: Assist with commissioning, controls validation, and integration testing for new automation deployments and retrofits.
Keep controls documentation accurate and current: Maintain IO lists, electrical schematics, network diagrams, and control panel layouts to support standardized operation and troubleshooting.
Enable frontline success and safe operation: Work with site technicians to resolve complex faults, train on basic troubleshooting, and ensure compliance with safety and operational standards (e‑stops, lockout/tagout logic, interlocks).

Paving your way to your success:

You stay calm and methodical during downtime or fault situations and work problems through to a stable resolution.
You are detail-oriented in code structure, documentation, and system updates, keeping changes disciplined and traceable.
You build trust with local maintenance teams through hands-on support, clear coaching, and practical troubleshooting guidance.
You collaborate effectively across Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, and OEM partners to drive consistent controls improvements.
You uphold safety and operational standards in controls design and troubleshooting, ensuring interlocks and emergency functions work as intended.

title: Settlement Casework Specialist
description:

You will be responsible for providing DFV settlement casework support to newly arrived people, especially Humanitarian Entrants and Refugees, who have arrived in Australia within the last five years (or more depending on circumstances) and ensure contractual obligations under the relevant funding programs are met. You will facilitate engagement, conduct risk assessments, provide safety planning & DFV related casework support and facilitate referral pathways to ensure refugee and migrant clients are adequately supported around their DFV and settlement needs.
Please reach out to us for the full Position Description to review the Key Responsibilities and Measures of success.
Essential Criteria
You bring proven experience delivering culturally responsive DFV casework, including CRASF Level 1 risk assessment, supported by at least three years’ relevant experience and/or a tertiary qualification in Social Work, Human Services, or a related field. You have strong knowledge of the DFV and multicultural sectors and experience providing high-quality support to CALD communities. You communicate effectively, navigate complex situations with confidence, and build client capacity and engagement. Strong written, interpersonal, and computer skills are essential, and lived experience of forceful displacement and migration is highly valued.
About Us
Settlement Services International (SSI Group) is a community-based organisation and social business that supports newcomers and Australians to achieve their full potential. Taking an integrated approach how everyone can thrive within the community in which they live and the wider Australian society, we support children, young people and families; people living with disability; and asylum seekers, refugees and migrants. Our programs include facilitating employment, multicultural foster care, creating community engagement, advocacy, and influencing government and international affairs and provide though leadership within our sector nationally and globally.

We ensure children and young people’s safety, and wellbeing is embedded in the everyday thinking and practice of everyone at SSI, whether they interact directly or indirectly with children and young people. All employees will undergo a National Police Clearance and a Working with Children Check as a condition of employment. All staff who work on, support, or manage Queensland child-related work must hold a Blue Card, even if they are not based in Queensland.
Our commitment to Diversity
SSI strives to be an inclusive workplace for all people. We recognise that we operate in a diverse community and welcome and encourage applications from all ages and genders, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, culturally and linguistically diverse groups, the LGBTIQ+ community, veterans, refugees and people with disability.

title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
description:
Embedded Firmware Engineer

Miami, FL · On-site

About Hextronics

Hex is building the infrastructure for on-demand aerial data. We design and manufacture drone-in-a-box systems that automate repetitive drone operations, taking humans out of the loop so the people who depend on aerial data can move faster. We're a small, agile team, we move fast, take on extreme ownership, and build products in months, not years.

The Role

As an Embedded Firmware Engineer, you'll own the firmware that makes Hex hardware work. You'll write code for resource-constrained microcontrollers, bring up new boards, and debug your own firmware against real hardware with a scope in hand. Because you understand both the code and the circuit it runs on, you'll be the person who resolves the problems that fall between them. This is a hands-on role on a small team, and your firmware ships to systems operating in the field within months.

Responsibilities

  • Own firmware development for Hex's drone and dock platforms across bare metal and RTOS environments

  • Bring up new hardware: board power-on, peripheral validation, and debug against schematic and layout

  • Diagnose firmware and hardware interaction issues independently using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other bench instrumentation

  • Read schematics, board layouts, and datasheets directly, and account for electrical and physical constraints in your code

  • Write and execute test and validation procedures for development and production firmware

  • Serve as the first point of contact for the software and hardware teams on integration and testing of the firmware you build

  • Drive root cause analysis on firmware and hardware-interaction issues

  • Contribute to architecture decisions where the firmware, electrical, and software boundaries meet

Requirements

  • Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Professional experience writing firmware for resource-constrained targets: bare metal and RTOS environments, anything more constrained than Linux. We're targeting 2 to 5 years, and we'll consider earlier-career candidates who show exceptional promise.

  • Proficiency in C and C++ for embedded development

  • Hands-on experience with STM32 or comparable microcontrollers: peripheral configuration, clock and power management, and debugging

  • Literacy in circuit analysis. You can read a schematic, a board layout, and a datasheet without hand-holding, and you understand the electrical consequences of your code.

  • Independent use of electrical test equipment to diagnose bring-up and integration problems

  • Evidence of hands-on building outside formal work: side projects, competition teams, or self-taught depth

  • Based in Miami or willing to relocate. This role is on-site.

Nice to Have

  • Firmware on a product that shipped to customers, not only development boards

  • Experience with low-power, long-range protocols like LoRa and Wi-Fi HaLow

  • Hardware-in-the-loop or automated test rig development

  • Motor control or power electronics firmware

  • Exposure to FCC and equivalent international regulatory testing from the firmware side

  • Comfort reading Altium schematics and layouts

  • UAV, robotics, aerospace, or defense industry background

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive and highly subsidized medical, dental, and vision benefits for our team and their families

  • Write firmware that controls physical systems in the field

  • A small, technical team where your work ships and matters

Hex is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and to applicants and employees as required by applicable law.

title: Threat Intelligence Reseacher
description:
At WithSecure™, we protect businesses all over the world. Our SaaS solutions safeguard against modern cyber threats, and our innovative Co-security approach reflects our belief that true protection requires collaboration and shared expertise. No one can solve every cyber security problem alone. Our vision is to become Europe’s flagship in cyber security. Every day, our talented teams work to prevent cyber extortion, secure critical infrastructure, and prevent misuse of sensitive data. At WithSecure, it’s our people who make us exceptional – a diverse community that values passion, purpose, and a commitment to workplace well-being. If you’re ready to make an impact with a company that’s transforming cybersecurity, we’d love to hear from you.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Threat Intelligence Reseacher to join our Threat intelligence and response team and help improve our clients’ security posture and cyber resilience.


This is a hands-on specialist role focused on threat research, intelligence production, and translating complex threat activity into practical guidance. You will investigate threat actors, campaigns, intrusion techniques, malware, and significant cyber events, turning your findings into intelligence that customers and our internal teams can act on.


You will work directly with customers, presenting threat assessments and helping them understand how changes in the threat landscape relate to their industry, technology, and exposure. You will also develop and deliver internal training, strengthen our threat-intelligence capabilities, and share your expertise across the organization.


This is primarily a content and subject-matter-expert role. Customer communication is an important part of delivering that expertise, while account ownership and commercial relationship management remain with the relevant Customer Success and commercial teams.


What You’ll Do


Research threat actors, campaigns, malware, adversary infrastructure, vulnerabilities, intrusion techniques, and significant cyber events.

Produce sector threat landscapes, campaign assessments, threat-actor profiles, flash advisories, executive briefings, and technical intelligence reports.

Combine intelligence from open sources, incident-response investigations, MDR observations, security telemetry, and other relevant sources.

Assess which threats are genuinely relevant to customers based on their industry, geography, technology, and known exposure.

Translate technical findings into clear and actionable recommendations for security teams, CISOs, business leaders, and executive audiences.

Map adversary activity to MITRE ATT&CK techniques, attack paths, indicators of compromise, and detection opportunities.

Support threat-led detection engineering by identifying emerging techniques, telemetry requirements, detection gaps, and opportunities for proactive threat hunting.

Work closely with Incident Response, MDR, Exposure Management, Detection Engineering, and Consulting specialists.

Deliver customer briefings, workshops, and threat-intelligence sessions.

Design and deliver internal training for consultants, analysts, Customer Success teams, and other relevant stakeholders.

Maintain reusable intelligence content, research methodologies, and recommendation libraries.

Peer-review intelligence products and help maintain a consistently high analytical standard.

Contribute to blog posts, research publications, webinars, and other thought-leadership activities.


How the Role Can Develop


We want this role to provide a genuine path towards deeper and more visible threat research.

As you demonstrate strong analytical quality, initiative, and customer impact, you can take increasing ownership of:


Conducting original research into threat actors, campaigns, malware, and emerging attacker techniques.

Analyzing our exposure management service

Longer-term threat-research projects based on observations from our customer environments, MDR operations, and incident-response engagements.

Authoring detailed threat-intelligence reports and public research publications.

Developing new research methods and shaping the direction of our threat-intelligence capability.

Representing WithSecure through webinars, industry events, media briefings, and cyber security conferences.

Mentoring other analysts and helping develop the next generation of threat-intelligence specialists.

Conference presentations and public research would not be separate from the role—they would be a natural extension of high-quality work produced within it.


What We’re Expecting From You


At least three years of relevant professional experience in threat intelligence, threat research, incident response, malware analysis, threat hunting, detection engineering, SOC, or MDR environments.

Demonstrated experience investigating threat actors, campaigns, intrusion activity, or significant cyber events.

The ability to produce well-supported intelligence assessments rather than simply aggregate or summarize threat news.

A solid understanding of attacker tradecraft, intrusion lifecycles, common malware capabilities, command-and-control infrastructure, and adversary techniques.

Experience evaluating source reliability, distinguishing established facts from analytical judgments, and communicating confidence levels and intelligence gaps.

The ability to connect threat intelligence with customer-specific risk, exposure, and defensive priorities.

Strong analytical writing skills and the ability to produce clear, concise, and defensible reports.

Confidence presenting complex technical subjects to technical specialists, business leaders, and executive audiences.

The interpersonal skills to work directly with customers as a trusted subject-matter expert.

The ability and motivation to create training material, facilitate internal sessions, and mentor colleagues.

Intellectual curiosity and the persistence required to investigate incomplete or conflicting information.

Proficiency in English.

The ability to work independently while actively collaborating and sharing knowledge with others.

Being an awesome colleague!


Bonus Points For


Experience working with EDR, SIEM, MDR, threat-intelligence platforms, or large-scale security telemetry.

Practical experience in incident investigation, threat hunting, or detection development.

Experience with malware analysis, adversary infrastructure tracking, or advanced open-source intelligence techniques.

Familiarity with analytical frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, the Cyber Kill Chain, or structured analytical techniques.

Knowledge of cloud, identity, SaaS, and hybrid-environment threats.

Experience producing intelligence for industries such as finance, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, or the public sector.

Scripting or query-language skills that support research and analysis.

Previous experience publishing security research, writing technical reports, speaking at events, or contributing to the cyber security community.

Relevant certifications such as GCTI, GCFA, GREM, CISSP, or equivalent practical expertise.

Understanding of how threat intelligence supports NIS2, DORA, executive decision-making, and broader cyber-risk management.


Why You’ll Love Us


Meaningful research: You will investigate real threat activity and turn your findings into intelligence that directly improves customer security.

A path into original threat research: Strong performance can lead to ownership of research projects, authored reports, public publications, and conference presentations.

Frontline insight: You will collaborate with specialists working in MDR, Incident Response, Exposure Management, Detection Engineering, and other security disciplines.

Dedicated research time: You will have time to investigate topics that matter, develop original findings, and collaborate with experienced researchers.

Support for visibility: We will support you in writing research reports, publishing blog posts, developing presentations, and speaking at relevant industry events.

Continuous learning: We invest in relevant training, conferences, and certifications. You will also learn from colleagues through regular knowledge-sharing sessions.

Real customer impact: Your intelligence will help customers understand who may target them, how those attacks could happen, and what they should prioritize.

A top-notch team: You will work alongside experienced cyber security specialists who challenge one another, share their expertise, and continuously raise the bar.

If you enjoy uncovering the story behind cyber activity—and can turn that story into clear, defensible, and actionable intelligence—we would love to hear from you.


Ready to research the threats that matter and help customers prepare for them? Apply now and help us make the digital world safer.

title: Research, Mid Training
description:
About Thinking Machines

The mission of Thinking Machines is to build AI that extends human will and judgment. We are training frontier models with Inkling, developing Tinker to let people make models their own, and crafting interfaces that broaden human-AI communication. We believe the future worth building is human, and we're hiring people who want to build it.

About the Role

Mid-training is a step between pre-training and post-training, where we take a base model and train it into the foundation for reasoning. This role owns the late-stage training responsibility that shape what our models are fundamentally capable of, including things like synthetic data strategies, the data mix, quality uplift, context extension and capabilities across coding, math, reasoning, and so on.

This role blends fundamental research and practical engineering, as we do not distinguish between the two internally. It's an excellent fit for someone comfortable working across the boundary of pre-training and post-training, and who wants to shape what our models can do at their core.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the data. Decide what the model needs to see for each capability and each area of knowledge, then source, curate, and synthesize it. Build the pipelines that filter, deduplicate, verify, and rewrite raw material into training-grade datasets. You'll be responsible for producing data that actually moves the model, and for making sure it reflects how people really use these models, not just clean benchmark-style tasks.

  • Improve what the model knows. Design and measure interventions that increase knowledge: targeted corpora, synthetic rephrasings and QA over source documents, knowledge-dense mixes. Characterize how knowledge scales with data and when it is retained through post-training versus forgotten.

  • Instill behaviors and set the prior. Introduce new behaviors during mid-training and measure them the right way: not just whether an eval goes up, but whether post-training becomes easier, more sample-efficient, and more stable as a result. Work closely with the post-training team to decide which behaviors belong in mid-training and which belong in RL.

  • Build the quality pipeline. Own the automatic filtering and scoring stack: train and calibrate quality classifiers and LLM-based judges, build verifiers for synthetic data, and use them to raise the quality bar of the mix by a lot, not a little. Give the team fine-grained control over data attributes (difficulty, domain, format, style, correctness) and measure the effect of each.

  • Develop and tune the recipe. Iterate on mid-training recipes: the collection of datasets, training stages, annealing schedules, and hyperparameters. Measure how recipe choices affect metrics, including downstream of post-training.

  • Iterate on evals. Mid-training involves a never-ending loop of defining a set of evaluations, optimizing them, and then realizing your existing evals don't capture what matters. You'll be responsible for both making numbers go up and making sure the numbers are meaningful.

  • Debug and understand. While tuning the details of a training configuration, we often observe results that don't quite make sense. You'll be responsible for both getting things to work and developing a deeper understanding we can bring to the next problem.

  • Scale and explore. Mid-training will involve a combination of scaling existing methodologies and developing new ones. We'll want to both measure how performance scales with dataset size and explore using completely different kinds of training data.

Skills and Qualifications

Required qualifications:

  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX). Comfort debugging distributed training and writing code that scales.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Physics, Mathematics, or a related discipline with strong theoretical and empirical grounding.

  • Clarity in communication, an ability to explain complex technical concepts in writing.

Preferred qualifications (we encourage you to apply if you meet some but not all of these):

  • A strong grasp of probability, statistics, and ML fundamentals. You can look at experimental data and distinguish between real effects, noise, and bugs.

  • Experience building or owning training datasets for large models, including both synthetic data pipelines and real user data (collection, curation, filtering, or mixture design).

  • Experience with knowledge injection, continued pre-training, or domain adaptation of large models, and with measuring what a model knows.

  • Experience building model-based data quality systems: quality classifiers, LLM judges, or verification and rewriting pipelines operating at the scale of billions of tokens.

  • Experience generating synthetic data and understanding its failure modes (diversity collapse, contamination, teacher artifacts).

  • Research or engineering contributions in alignment, data-centric AI, or human-AI collaboration.

Logistics

  • This is an IC role within Thinking Machines’ Research Team. You will report directly to our Head of Research, and work most closely with our small group of post-training researchers.

  • Location: This role is based in San Francisco, California.

  • Compensation: Depending on background, skills and experience, the expected annual salary range for this position is $350,000-475,000 USD.

  • Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas. While we can't guarantee success for every candidate or role, if you're the right fit, we're committed to working through the visa process together.

  • Benefits: Thinking Machines offers generous health, dental, and vision benefits, unlimited PTO, paid parental leave, and relocation support as needed.

As set forth in Thinking Machines' Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

title: Hoofd Risk, Compliance & Audit (RCA)
description:
Als strategisch partner en lid van het MT van de RDW help je de RDW verantwoord risico’s te nemen, zodat de organisatie zich kan blijven inzetten voor veiligheid, duurzaamheid en rechtszekerheid voor weggebruikers en de samenleving en tegelijkertijd aantoonbaar in control blijft.

Als Hoofd Risk, Compliance & (interne) Audit (RCA) geef je leiding aan een afdeling met een sleutelrol in het vertrouwen in de RDW. Je brengt risicomanagement, compliance en audit verder in samenhang, zonder afbreuk te doen aan de onafhankelijke en objectieve positie van de interne auditfunctie. Daarmee zorg je dat de RDW weet waar risico’s liggen en ook hoe daar effectief, proportioneel en toekomstgericht op kan worden gestuurd.
Je zorgt voor heldere kaders, scherpe toetsing en bruikbare adviezen op het gebied van risicomanagement, data- en informatiemanagement, privacy en informatiebeveiliging. Compliance is binnen RCA gericht op de horizontale wetgeving voor data, informatie- en archiefbeheer, privacy en informatiebeveiliging, waaronder de Archiefwet 2026, de AVG en de NIS2/Cyberbeveiligingswet. Jouw afdeling helpt de RDW aantoonbaar in control te zijn én te blijven, met nadrukkelijke aandacht voor ICT, data en strategische ontwikkelingen. Zo lever je een directe bijdrage aan maatschappelijk vertrouwen, bestuurlijke kwaliteit en een integere bedrijfsvoering.

Interessant aan deze baan volgens Hoofd RCA a.i. Bert-Jan

Bijna alles wat de RDW doet, raakt iemands dagelijks leven: een kenteken, een rijbewijs, een keuring. ‘In control zijn’ is hier dus geen papieren exercitie. Als Hoofd RCA zorg je dat we als organisatie scherp blijven op wat er echt toe doet — en dat we durven te benoemen wat beter moet.

Lees de verhalen van andere RDW’ers >

Werken aan de mobiliteit van morgen

De RDW heeft een unieke maatschappelijke positie. Van toelating en registratie van voertuigen tot toezicht op de voertuigbranche, tolheffing en de ontwikkeling van zelfrijdende mobiliteit: de RDW werkt aan onderwerpen die iedere dag impact hebben op burgers, bedrijven en overheid. Daarbij loopt de organisatie in Europa voorop.
Informatie, data en digitale weerbaarheid zijn daarbij cruciaal. Als Hoofd RCA maak jij zichtbaar of de RDW zijn risico’s beheerst, wet- en regelgeving naleeft en voorbereid is op nieuwe ontwikkelingen. Je bewaakt en versterkt het three lines-besturingsmodel, maakt verantwoordelijkheden helder en zorgt dat interne monitoring en toezicht daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen. Waar nodig initieer je aanvullende audits of onderzoeken en breng je risico’s terug naar bestuurbare keuzes.

Dit is jouw thuisbasis

Je geeft leiding aan de stafafdeling RCA, bestaande uit de teams Risk & Compliance en (interne) Audit. Samen met de Manager Risk & Compliance en de Manager Audit vorm je het MT van RCA. In totaal bestaat de afdeling uit 22 collega’s met veel inhoudelijke expertise en betrokkenheid.
Je werkt op het snijvlak van beleid, uitvoering, toezicht en bestuur. Als Hoofd RCA maak je deel uit van het MT van de RDW. Je bent een onafhankelijke, kritische en oplossingsgerichte gesprekspartner voor directie, jouw collega-MT-leden, het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, externe auditors en ketenpartners. De vaste standplaats is Zoetermeer; daarnaast ben je regelmatig zichtbaar op andere RDW-locaties, zoals de kantoren in Veendam en Groningen. Hybride werken is hierbij vanzelfsprekend.
Binnen het CIO-stelsel van de RDW geef je op strategisch en bestuurlijk niveau richting aan de samenhang tussen informatievoorziening, digitalisering en digitale weerbaarheid. Je vertegenwoordigt de RDW in relevante overleggen binnen het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en de Manifestgroep.

Zo helpen wij jou graag op weg

Bij de RDW werk je met ruim 2.000 collega’s aan veilige en duurzame mobiliteit in Nederland en daarbuiten. Hier sta je vooraan bij slimme oplossingen en technologische innovaties in de automotive. Daardoor is óók jouw werk voortdurend in beweging. Om dat zo goed mogelijk en met plezier te doen, geven we je ruim baan voor jouw ontwikkeling. Bijvoorbeeld met interne stages en toegang tot ons leerplein. Daarnaast helpen we je vooruit met de volgende arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Salaris tussen € 6.548,- en € 9.544,- bruto per maand (op basis van fulltime).
  • 8% vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% over het in dat jaar genoten salaris.
  • Goede werk-privébalans: 36 uur is fulltime en je kunt deels thuis en 4 x 9 uur werken. Je krijgt een budget om een thuiswerkplek in te richten en een thuiswerkvergoeding.
  • Een fijne werkomgeving waarin je je eigen route mag uitstippelen en collega’s met je meedenken.
  • Pensioenregeling via het ABP: wij betalen 70% van de premie.
  • 6 weken verlof per jaar.
  • Leaseauto.
  • Telefoon en laptop.

title: Teamleider Den Bosch
description:
Dit ga je doen

Als teamleider ben jij de motor achter een succesvolle afdeling in de winkel – of dit nu mode, hardware of food is. Jij zorgt samen met de filiaalmanager en andere teamleiders dat alles op rolletjes loopt, neemt elkaars taken over bij afwezigheid, en staat klaar om te helpen waar nodig. Jouw taak? Het informeren, coachen en begeleiden van jouw team, zodat ze elke dag met plezier aan de slag gaan. Je maakt jouw afdeling tot een succes door duidelijke doelen te stellen, zowel op commercieel vlak als in de persoonlijke ontwikkeling van je teamleden. Denk aan het delen van de commerciële kalender, nieuwe productinformatie en dagelijkse targets, maar ook aan het ontwikkelen van talenten binnen jouw team. Je hebt een dynamische rol waarin je stuurt op KPI’s, organiseert, activiteiten plant, nieuwe collega’s inwerkt en samen met jouw team de klant een geweldige ervaring biedt.

dit bieden wij

Bij HEMA werk je in een omgeving waar mensen écht samenwerken. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, wordt goed begeleid en krijgt feedback waar je écht iets aan hebt. Of je nu net begint of al ervaring hebt: bij ons ben je welkom. Daarnaast krijg je bij HEMA:
  • 💸Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de 2644 tot 3420 euro, op basis van 38 uur werken per week
  • 🌴 182,4 vakantieuren (obv 38 uur) en 8% vakantiegeld, zodat je op tijd bij kunt tanken.
  • 🎯 Een variabele beloning tot 2,2% van je jaarsalaris – afhankelijk van het gezamenlijke resultaat.
  • 🛍️ 15% personeelskorting op al je HEMA-favorieten – van tompoucen tot handdoeken en notitieboeken.
  • 🧓 Een goede pensioenregeling, zodat je ook later goed zit.
  • 🚗 Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer (vanaf 10 km enkele reis tot max. 30 km)
  • 🎡 Toegang tot het 'benefits at work'-platform, met korting op topmerken, dagjes uit en andere extra's die het leven leuker maken.

dit breng je mee

  • Ervaring in leidinggeven: Je hebt al aantoonbare werkervaring in een leidinggevende of senior medewerker rol in de retail, supermarkt, horeca of een vergelijkbare omgeving en bent klaar voor je volgende stap.
  • Ondernemend denken: Jij hebt ideeën over hoe dingen beter kunnen. Kom maar op, want wij willen leren van jouw frisse blik!
  • Gastvrijheid: Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands (minimaal niveau B2); dit is essentieel voor het begeleiden van je HEMA-winkelteam én voor het bieden van goede service aan onze klanten.
  • Denken én Doen: Van plannen maken tot uitvoeren, jij doet het allebei moeiteloos.
  • Ontwikkelmentaliteit: Niet alleen jij, maar ook jouw team groeit onder jouw leiding.

jij maakt HEMA echt


Bij HEMA werken we met ruim 17.000 collega’s aan een beter alledaags leven in een mooiere wereld. Met producten die praktischer, mooier, beter zijn en ook nog eens langer meegaan. Én met kleurrijke winkels in dorpen, steden en online. We zijn trots op hoe ver we zijn gekomen, maar we zijn nog niet tevreden. HEMA is weer écht HEMA en klaar voor de volgende stap. Onze ambitie? Koploper worden in een uitdagende markt. Dat doen we samen, als één team, met trotse collega’s, ondernemers en partners. Door te spelen om te winnen. Dat betekent dat je nieuwsgierig bent, kansen grijpt, met plezier samenwerkt en altijd gaat voor het beste resultaat. Je durft jezelf uit te spreken en anderen uit te dagen om samen beter te worden. Jij kunt met jouw unieke bijdrage meebouwen aan het HEMA van morgen. Jij maakt HEMA echt. Doe je mee?

title: Senior Software Engineer, Tooling
description:
(This role is US based remote and all candidates must be able to work in the US now and in the future without restriction)

What we believe

Technology is no longer just an enabler of business strategy. It is the business strategy. And with AI reshaping how companies operate, compete and grow — while rapidly accelerating the pace of change — the stakes have never been higher.

Our role

We’re focused on helping private equity investors and portfolio company leaders drive value creation through technology. In a world where investors deploy trillions annually into software and tech-enabled businesses, we're the team that makes sure the underlying technology actually delivers.

Our approach

The expert judgment of our experienced practitioners is complemented by proven frameworks, tech-enabled solutions, and objective data to help organizations navigate critical technology decisions across diligence, transformation, growth, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution.

What we value

Everything we do is grounded in five core values: Service. Curiosity. Credibility. Commitment. Creativity.

If you're energized by solving complex technology challenges and helping others succeed in critical moments, you'llfit right in.

Job Role

    We’re building small, highly capable engineering pods (2–3 engineers) that own problems end-to-end and move quickly from idea to production. This role is for engineers who are comfortable operating across the full stack and using modern AI-enabled workflows to accelerate delivery.

    This role is part of our Tooling team, focused on rapidly building lightweight internal tools that improve how Crosslake teams work. These tools are typically narrow in scope and designed to be created, tested, and deployed quickly. The emphasis is on speed, usefulness, and iteration over long-term productization.

    You’ll be expected to design, build, and ship software with minimal handoffs—working across frontend, backend, and infrastructure as needed. This role prioritizes speed and iteration, with a focus on delivering immediate value.

    How we work

  • Small teams, high ownership, minimal handoffs
  • Fast, iterative delivery over heavy process
  • Pragmatic decision-making over over-engineering
  • Engineers are expected to operate across the stack, not within silos
  • Many tools are short-lived or heavily iterated—impact matters more than longevity

Key Responsibilities

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong full-stack capability (frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure)
  • Comfortable stepping into an architectural role when needed
  • Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Solid understanding of the full SDLC
  • Deep experience with (i.e., daily usage of) AI coding tools

Requirements

    • Design and build small, high-impact full-stack tools from concept to deployment
    • Own the full SDLC: design, development, testing, deployment, and iteration
    • Work within a small pod to deliver quickly with a high degree of autonomy
    • Rapidly prototype and validate solutions with internal stakeholders
    • Integrate with third-party tools, APIs, and internal systems
    • Make pragmatic technical decisions appropriate for fast-moving tools
    • Use AI tools to accelerate development, testing, and code quality
    • Continuously refine, replace, or retire tools based on usage and feedback

    AI-Native Development

    • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools beyond basic code generation
    • Ability to leverage AI across the workflow (e.g., prototyping, debugging, test generation, QA, code review, security analysis)
    • Experience combining AI with automation/orchestration to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort
    • Familiarity with modern AI-enabled development environments and practices

Preferred Experience

    • Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
    • CI/CD and modern DevOps practices
    • Experience with workflow automation/orchestration tools (e.g., n8n, Zapier, Temporal, Airflow)
    • Experience integrating SaaS tools and APIs (Slack, Notion, Jira, etc.)
    • Comfort building lightweight internal UIs (dashboards, admin panels, etc.)
    • Experience with one or more of the following languages: Python, TypeScript, Golang, Rust
    • Basic understanding of data engineering principles

What success looks like

    • You ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks
    • You identify inefficiencies and ship tools to address them
    • You deliver simple solutions that meaningfully improve team productivity
    • You avoid overbuilding and focus on practical outcomes
    • You effectively use AI tools to increase speed and output

title: Bid Coordinator
description:
Bid Coordinator

  • Work Type: Full-time.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized Bid Coordinator to manage the administrative front-end of the estimating pipeline for our domestic estimating team. Serving as the central hub for incoming bid invitations, document management, and deadline tracking, this role allows estimators to focus strictly on technical scope and pricing.   • Compliance & Documentation: Request bid bonds, insurance certificates, and compile comprehensive pre-qualification packages required for bid submissions.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: 1–3 years of experience in an administrative or project coordination role.

  • Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with standard construction documents and bidding portals (e.g., BuildingConnected, Procore, ISqFt).

  • Core Competencies: High attention to detail, accuracy, and rigorous documentation practices. Strong organizational and time management skills, combined with effective written and verbal communication abilities. Must be able to pass a pre-employment screening.

  • Remote Infrastructure: Must have a dedicated, noise-free home office setup equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a backup power source.

Preferred Qualifications (Bonus):

  • Prior administrative or coordination experience specifically within the construction industry.

Benefits of Working for Hyre

  • Performance-based raises.

  • Minimum 5 days off annually (paid or unpaid based on client terms).

  • Annual cost-of-living adjustments at your one-year anniversary.

title: Command Duty Officer - Emergency Management Communications
description:
Command Duty Officer (CDO) Full-Time (Formally EMS Communicator EMSCOM-Paramedic Base)
Office of Emergency Management
Hourly Pay Rate: $28.50 - $42.73

Available to work 2nd shift, holidays, weekends and mandated scheduled and unscheduled overtime is required

Closing Date: October 05, 2026, or sooner upon receipt of the first 50 application submissions

The Office of Emergency Management (OEM) is in the business of urban resiliency, the protection of lives and property through exacting communications to decision-makers and through the total coordination of resources, on-location and on-time. OEM strives for a 'whole community' approach, meaning collaborative stewardship in government and in private entities, thereby allowing civic society to bounce back from the shocks of our increasingly complex culture.

Job Summary: The Command Duty Officer (CDO) formally EMS Communicator duties will include receiving and notifying hospitals of incoming patients, mass casualty incident management, EMResource; Monitor field unit devices; notify PSAPs of OEM scene responders; CAD entries; EMS transports for OEM Special Events; monitor dept dashboards/situational awareness expert; Dispatcher Assisted CPR, HERC Hotline; roll-calls; tornado siren system; overall County welfare and state of readiness; leadership notifications

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Relaying patient information between the EMS field provider and the receiving hospital, including countywide triage capabilities. Transmit ECGs to receiving hospitals when necessary. Alert field providers of hospital limited diversions and capabilities.
Triaging all trauma patient reports per the Trauma Activation Protocol, out-of-county and private ambulance companies and alerting hospital teams. Sophisticated communication maintaining contact with emergency responders, rescue units and hospitals.
Coordinates communications systems between Paramedic Field Providers and MCW Physicians to facilitate online medical control
Answering and handling all Dispatcher Assisted CPR calls for cardiac arrest patients transferred from municipal PSAPS and entering case information into the database. Participate in mock call trainings.
Maintain Countywide situational awareness by monitoring the CAD fusion platform [CAD2CAD] and data dashboard, FirstWatch. Disseminate emergency alerts via EverBridge. Make notifications to internal, external agencies, to include senior leadership.
Serve as the Southeast Wisconsin Healthcare Emergency Readiness Coalition (HERC) Hotline Representative by answering calls receiving on the HERC line 24/7 and providing prompt notification to HERC staff in the event of an emergency and/or request.
During a Mass Casualty or Emergency/Disaster, notify Medical Director and OEM Leadership of events. Notify area Emergency Departments of events using WITRAC and provide status updates, request and process ED bed polls, support on-scene triage/transportation officers.
Establish and maintain relationships with County dispatch centers to include MCSO LEAD, MCTS, Highway, Airport, FMD CityWorks. Track and monitor activities to create an overall "state of welfare and readiness in Milwaukee County properties, assets and jurisdiction.
Monitor adjacent public safety units and radio systems: WI Interoperable System for Communications, statewide public safety radio; OpenSky, a City of Milwaukee Fire/EMS/Police radio system; NOAA national weather safety radio. 100% participation in roll calls and ad-hoc calls
Monitor the National Weather Service for tornado alerts and activate the Milwaukee County tornado sirens, when necessary, via the NexGen tornado siren system. Perform monthly tests of the system, utilize the UHF radio system, and log results..

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Current Wisconsin resident at time of application
High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent is required
Current drivers licensed maintained throughout employment
Must be able to pass a criminal background, including fingerprinting, and an employment verification check
One year of experience with radio communication and working as an EMT/Paramedic
EMT/Paramedic certification is required
Lift/Carry and Push/Pull up to 30lbs
Must be able work any assigned shift including weekends and holidays as required. Position is subject to mandated schedules and unscheduled overtime
Basic knowledge of all related computer and software applications, such as word processing and spreadsheets

Preferred Experience

Prior dispatching experience
At least 6 months of Emergency Medical Service, Emergency Room, Fire Department, and/or Ambulance Service experience.

Note: All appointees must successfully complete the Transaction Information Management Enforcement (TIME) system training within six (6) months of hire date AND must be Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) compliant within six months of hire date.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Knowledge of radio communications procedure; knowledge of basic Emergency Medical terminology; knowledge of common Emergency Medical Services forms and reports; skill in receiving and transmitting calls accurately; oral and written communication skills; ability to operate a radio network; ability to enter and retrieve data from a personal computer; ability to handle emergency calls quickly and efficiently; ability to work under pressure; ability to perform mathematical computation; ability to work in a confined area for extended periods of time; ability to sit for long periods of time; ability to work effectively and harmoniously with physicians, nurses and allied health personnel. Work requires frequent, substantive contacts with people in highly stressful situations; delicacy and unpredictability of contacts routinely creates considerable strain or heavy stress regularly. Ability to push/pull/lift/carry up to 30lbs as needed.

NOTE: This ORIGINAL APPLICATION is open to qualified residents of the State of Wisconsin at the time of application. Candidates need to submit a full account of their training and experience (i.e., by submitting an up-to-date resume or by fully completing the application) during the application process and may also be asked to take additional written or performance tests as part of the selection process.

CANDIDATES MUST POSSESS THE MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AT TIME OF FILING APPLICATION
