title: Adult Day Program Assistant
description:
About Twin Lakes

Twin Lakes Community is a leader in senior services, offering Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing on one campus. We also provide a primary care clinic, on-site therapy, EMT responders, home care, and adult day services. Serving 850 residents and supported by 450 employees, TLC is recognized among the nation’s most successful nonprofit Continuing Care Retirement Communities (CCRC).


Our team delivers person-centered care in a supportive, engaging environment where connection, dignity, and wellness matter. Every role contributes to vibrant living, engaging experiences for residents across campus. TLC offers continuing education, career growth, and flexible scheduling to support work-life balance. Full time employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. Be a part of something meaningful - join our team.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Program Assistant provides essential personal and recreational services to the participants of the Adult Day Program to help meet their needs while enabling them to function at their highest possible level.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Will provide reminders and cueing as needed regarding participants’ toileting, dining, mobility, psychosocial and safety needs.

2. Follows universal precautions, proper infection control, sanitation and safety standards of practice in all work and activities.

3. Observes participants closely, identifying changing needs and conditions at first indication, and communicates with supervisor.

4. Actively participates in the individualized care planning of all participants.

5. Continually seeks opportunities to meet participant’s psychosocial needs through both scheduled and spontaneous activities that support participant choice.

6. Continually seeks opportunities to promote and improve the social needs of all participants through supporting and encouraging, friendships and kindness to one another.

7. Is active in the planning and organizing of large and small group activities and one-on-one with individuals, making any necessary changes to assure successful results for all.

8. Leads and participates in learning circles for staff and participants.

9. Maintains all supplies including equipment and games used in supporting participants individual choice and for group activities.

10. Assists in maintaining a clean, safe environment within the center including restrooms and common areas.

11. Supports all aspects of the program and the environment, including pets, plants, children, visitors, and volunteers.

12. Assists in program record-keeping and updating required documentation.

13. Must be willing to complete the following training classes: Dementia Specific Training, and Montessori Philosophies & Techniques

14. May be required to perform other duties in keeping with the nature of this position which will not significantly alter the job requirements.

15. Possess the ability to make independent decisions when circumstances warrant it using good judgement and ethical conduct. Able to perform job duties and work independently with frequent interruptions.

16. Able to organize, prioritize, and manage time, multiple tasks and projects.

17. Able to meet the physical demands and working environment of the position.

18. Able to follow procedures.

Education and/or Experience

  • One or more years of experience working with older individuals.
  • High school graduate or GED required.
  • Bachelor degree preferred but not required.

Certificates/Licenses Required

  • NCAPA – NC Activity Professional Association certification preferred but not required.
  • Must be CPR & First Aid Certified
  • Will attend ongoing training classes as scheduled.

Twin Lakes Community is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to administering all employment activities without discrimination and to considering qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion (including pregnancy and related conditions), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran or military status, political affiliation, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law; we provide reasonable accommodations for religious practices and for individuals with disabilities and foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are respected and all individuals feel secure, welcome, and heard.

title: RF Design Engineer I
description:
Mini-Circuits designs, manufactures and distributes integrated circuits, modules, and sub-systems for high-performance radio frequency (RF) and microwave applications. With design, sales and manufacturing locations in over 30 countries, Mini-Circuits’ products are used in a range of wired and wireless communications applications. Our products are also used in detection, measurement and imaging applications, including military communication, guidance and electronic countermeasure systems, commercial, scientific, military land, sea and aircraft, automotive systems, medical systems, and industrial test equipment.

Mini-Circuits’ sells its products to over 20,000 customers globally through our direct sales force, applications engineering staff, sales representatives, as well as through our extensive website.

Position Summary:

RF Design Engineer I (DE I) is an entry-level engineering position responsible for supporting the design, modeling, simulation, characterization, validation, verification and design-related documentation of ceramic-based RF and millimeter-wave single function passive components, packages and multi-function modules.

This role is ideal for recent graduates with strong RF fundamentals, curiosity to learn, and a proactive mindset. The DE I works under close guidance from a Senior Engineer while gaining hands-on experience with RF simulation tools, laboratory measurements, and Mini-Circuits’ product development processes.

Salary Range: $90,000 - $98,000 per year

Job Function:
  • Support RF design and development activities for passive RF, millimeter-wave components, packages and multi-function modules under the guidance of a Senior Engineer.
  • Execute EM and circuit-level simulations using tools such as Ansys HFSS, Genesys, ADS, or CST.
  • Model designs and run simulation sweeps, parametric studies, and optimizations as directed; analyze and summarize results.
  • Assist with RF measurements and characterization using laboratory equipment such as Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs), Power Supplies, Spectrum Analyzers, Oscilloscopes, and others.
  • Collect, organize, and analyze measured and simulated data to support design reviews, reports and design-related decisions.
  • Prepare the necessary documentation to support Mini-Circuits’ Product Generation Process (PGP).
  • Support product characterization, qualification, and test development activities in collaboration with Product, Manufacturing, Quality and Test Engineers.
  • Work with the Project Management team to plan and execute assigned tasks within the committed timelines and budget.
  • Support engineering organization in ISO Audits and Management reviews and participate in internal and external audits.
  • Assist senior engineer in drafting company procedures and processes to ensure the highest level of design and manufacturing standards are achieved and maintained.
  • Collaborate with peers in the creation of Intellectual Property (IP) to maintain technical relevance in materials and processes, circuital topologies, design methodologies/techniques, simulation software and modeling techniques, device characterization techniques and novel production testing strategies.
  • Create scripts and execute simulation runs to optimize the performance of passive RF, Microwave and Millimeter-Wave components.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) with 0 - 1 year of experience, specializing in RF design, including relevant RF coursework, RF/microwave circuit design experience through industry exposure, or RF-related academic capstone projects.
  • Strong academic foundation including relevant coursework in RF and microwave engineering principles.
  • Theoretical and basic practical knowledge in the design of common RF circuits such as filters, couplers, power dividers, and baluns.
  • Relevant experience in the design of active components (i.e. Low Noise Amplifiers, Power Amplifiers, etc.), RF systems/modules, is a plus.
  • Familiarity with EM simulation tools based on Method of Moments (MoM) and Finite Element Method (FEM) is required.
  • Demonstrated experience in the employment of RF measurement test equipment.
  • Must be proficient in scripting and data analysis using employing coding languages such as Python, MATLAB or other.
  • Academical publications in the RF domain are to be considered a competitive advantage.
  • Professional and positive approach, self-motivated, strong in building relationships, team player, dynamic, creative with a strong sense of discipline.
  • Strong sense of accountability and ownership of assigned tasks.
  • Strong relationship management, project management, problem-solving skills.
  • Proactive and takes initiative — seeks clarification, asks questions, and follows up on action items.
  • Demonstrates curiosity and eagerness to learn, especially in RF design.
  • Focused on learning, execution, and technical skill development rather than independent ownership of designs.
  • Solid problem-solving ability, with willingness to break down technical problems methodically.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and capable of producing clear technical documentation.
  • Positive, team-oriented, and able to work effectively with engineers, technicians, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with multiple parallel tasks and deadlines.
Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, sit and use hands to operate a computer keyboard. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, and ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Cultural Focus

  • Displays enthusiasm and Passion for their work
  • Works to the standard of Uncompromising Quality by meeting or exceeding stated objectives and embracing continuous improvement
  • Exercises sound Business Judgement, ensuring that efforts are on track with the Company’s goals
  • Operates with the mindset of Customer Obsession – by meeting or exceeding expectations to both internal and external customers
  • Takes Accountability by taking ownership and accepting responsibility for their conduct and contributions
  • Demonstrates a strong sense of urgency and accomplishes tasks with Speed and attention to detail
  • Cooperates, collaborates and contributes to shared goals with a strong sense of Teamwork
  • Conducts themselves with Honesty & Integrity and treats all members with Trust & Respect

Additional Requirements/Skills

  • Comply, understand, and support corporate safety initiatives to ensure a safe work environment
  • Ability and willingness to abide by Company’s Code of Conduct

Disclaimer: The listed qualifications and requirements for each position are intended as guidelines. Mini-Circuits reserves the right to hire outside of these guidelines at Management’s discretion.

title: Informatiespecialist infra informatie
description:
Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor assetinformatie die we binnen en buiten ProRail inwinnen, verrijken en publiceren.

Werk om trots op te zijn

Als je hoort over “digital twin” en “data gedreven werken” dan weet je welke gevolgen dat heeft voor de informatievoorziening. Het vraagt niet alleen om veel data, maar vooral om de juiste data. Als informatiespecialist infra-informatie verzorg, beheer en bewaak je het gehele informatieproces. Je signaleert ontwikkelingen en trends en komt met verbetervoorstellen. Daarnaast houd jij je bezig met:

  • Proactief benaderen en tijdig afstemmen met verbindingsofficieren, techniek, aannemers, ingenieursbureaus en bouwmanagement, zodat de gevraagde gegevens volledig, juist en op tijd van het project aangeleverd wordt.
  • Het onderhouden van de data in ons ERP-systeem.
  • Het verwerken, vrijgeven en onderhouden van de objectenlijsten en project specifieke basisgegevens.
  • Het verwerken, vrijgeven en onderhouden van de locatie gebonden technische documentatie.
  • Het verwerken, onderhouden en vrijgeven van de data die door de proces aannemers zijn aangeboden.
  • De gegevens verwerken, onderhouden en vrijgeven conform bestaande procedures en handleidingen.

Jouw plek

We bieden graag ruimte aan iedereen. Daarbij zien we talent als basis en diversiteit als kracht om samen betere resultaten te behalen. Voor jou als informatiespecialist infra-informatie is er plek in ons team binnen Configuratiedata. Deze afdeling is verantwoordelijk voor alle geografische, schematische en administratieve data van de infra binnen ProRail. Data over onze spoorassets, in allemaal verschillende vormen, waarmee wij de branche helpen beter te presteren. We kijken daarbij ook hoe we nog slimmer kunnen worden, we onderzoeken kansen en mogelijkheden om onze producten en diensten nog beter te maken. Die implementeren we dan weer projectmatig om zodoende een betere prestatie op het spoor te realiseren.

Er werken bij de afdeling ongeveer 100 mensen.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.121,- en € 5.671,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week, schaal 7.
  • Daarbovenop 13,61% van jouw bruto salaris in de vorm van een Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Dit budget is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag en 3,25% decemberuitkering.
  • Direct een vast contract. Wij hebben vertrouwen in jou.
  • 170 vakantie-uren én de optie om tot 185 extra vakantie-uren bij te kopen vanuit jouw IKB.
  • Een NS-Business Card met Treinvrij (en een NS-Businesscard Daluren voor directe gezinsleden). Of een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km onbelast bij maximaal 120 kilometer per dag.
  • Een goed pensioen bij Rail & OV: een sterk fonds dat vooroploopt in duurzaam beleggen. Zit je nu in een ander fonds? Houd er rekening mee dat Rail & OV op 1 januari 2026 al overstapte op het nieuwe pensioenstelsel.

Wij kozen voor een kleine selectie uit onze arbeidsvoorwaarden. Maar we bieden je meer. Voor alle arbeidsvoorwaarden en onze CAO klik op deze link.

Jouw inbreng

Bij ProRail vinden wij het belangrijk dat jij gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Daarom zijn wij benieuwd naar wie jij bent. Voor deze functie breng je sowieso mee:

  • Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en werkervaring met plannen in een complexe omgeving.
  • Je bent bekend met analyses uitvoeren op data en het opstellen van- en adviseren over managementrapportages of vindt het leuk om je hier verder in te verdiepen.
  • Je hebt goede kennis van MS-Office en ERP-systemen, met SAP is een pre.
  • Initiatief: Je herkent kansen en speelt er snel en doeltreffend op in.
  • Oplossingsgerichtheid: Je herkent problemen en kansen en speelt hier goed op in.

Jouw sollicitatie

Wil je als informatiespecialist infra-informatie werken aan de toekomst van Nederland én aan die van jezelf? Solliciteer vóór 5 oktober. Bij voldoende reacties is het mogelijk dat de vacature eerder wordt gesloten dan 5 oktober. Toch eerst nog een vraag? Stel deze gerust aan Steven de Jong via steven.dejong@prorail.nl. Voor inhoudelijke vragen kun je contact opnemen met Jan Driesse via jan.driesse@prorail.nl.

Binnen 5 dagen na de sluitingsdatum krijg je onze reactie. De gesprekken vinden plaats in de week van 12 oktober. Een referentiecheck is ook onderdeel van deze procedure.

Word jij onze nieuwe collega? Dan hoort het aanvragen van een VOG tot de indiensttredingsprocedure. De kosten voor de VOG krijg je terug nadat je bent gestart.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager - Equipment
Tommy’s is looking for a Project Manager to support customer-facing roles with a sense of urgency, reliability, and car wash equipment knowledge while executing at the highest level. As a Project Manager you will work closely with the TCWS Sales team to assist in project management as it relates to equipment-only sales. This role requires following standard operating procedures while also allowing the individual to put their own creative spin on processes as they see fit, with a high level of execution, attention to detail, proactivity, and cross-departmental collaboration.
What can Tommy's offer you?

Base pay and eligibility for annual profit-sharing bonus
Full insurance package including Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Employee Assistance
Dependent Care FSA with on-site Daycare options
401k match and complimentary financial planning services
Paid time off and paid holidays
Opportunity for continued education and tuition assistance
Valuable learning and development program
Significant ability to grow internally for motivated and strong performing team members
Fun, energetic, family-oriented work culture with an emphasis on team member morale
Growing nationwide brand / presence

Position Responsibilities:

Independently manage assigned projects from drawing review through equipment startup, serving as the accountable point of contact for all parties including the sales team, GC, trades, architects, and customer.
Exercise discretion and independent judgment in reviewing sales orders, financial proformas, and change orders to ensure accuracy, compliance, and alignment with contractual and operational standards; own the change order process from initiation through communication to all stakeholders.
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve equipment documentation, knowledge bases, cutsheets, TCWS deliverables, and internal resources to support consistent execution and decision-making across projects.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Purchasing, Engineering, Fulfillment, Installation, and Startup teams to align project priorities, coordinate resources and schedules, resolve issues, and ensure successful project execution from order inception through site commissioning.
Other duties as assigned; duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

General Contractor & Trades Coordination:
This role regularly interfaces with general contractors and trade subcontractors — primarily electrical and plumbing — to ensure equipment installations proceed on schedule and within specification. The Project Manager is expected to answer field questions accurately and escalate technical issues as needed in coordination with the TCWS Engineering team.
Electrical Scope:

Serve as the primary point of contact for the GC and electrical contractors on equipment power requirements, panel schedules, and circuit layouts as they relate to items provided by TCWS.
Coordinate delivery of Guardian controls documentation and wiring diagrams to electrical subcontractors ahead of rough-in.
Review and communicate TCWS electrical specifications, including voltage (low and high), amperage, and disconnect requirements for tunnel equipment, while leveraging the expertise of the Tommy Engineering team to ensure accurate planning, compliance, and project execution.
Confirm conduit routing, junction box placement, and panel location align with equipment layout drawings.
Field first-level questions from electricians regarding equipment power connections, control panel interfaces, and sensor wiring; escalate complex or out-of-spec conditions to TCWS Engineering.
Track open electrical RFIs and coordinate responses between the GC, electrical sub, and internal engineering/fulfillment teams.
Verify pre-startup electrical checklist completion prior to equipment commissioning.

Plumbing Scope:

Serve as the primary point of contact for the GC and plumbing contractors on water supply, drain, and chemical feed requirements.
Communicate TCWS plumbing specifications, including water line sizing, pressure requirements, and reclaim system tie-ins.
Coordinate delivery of plumbing rough-in drawings and equipment room layouts to plumbing subcontractors prior to slab pour or wall framing.
Confirm floor slope, trench drain dimensions, and vacuum/reclaim pit locations against current equipment layout drawings.

Note: The Project Manager is not a licensed electrician or plumber and does not provide engineering design services. The role is to communicate documented TCWS specifications, coordinate information flow, and escalate non-standard conditions through proper internal channels.

Position Qualifications & Candidate Attributes:

2+ years of experience in project coordination, construction administration, or equipment-based sales support preferred.
Demonstrated ability to read and interpret construction drawings, mechanical/electrical layouts, and equipment specifications.
Familiarity with commercial electrical and plumbing systems at a coordination level (ability to read plans, communicate specs, and identify scope gaps).
Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.
Proficiency with ERP systems and standard business software.
Self-starter capable of working independently while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.
Core competencies: Execution & Accountability; Attention to Detail; Proactive Communication; Cross-Functional Collaboration; Customer Orientation; and Adaptability & Continuous Improvement.
Process-oriented and strong collaborator with ability to communicate and manage well at all levels of the organization and across various departments
Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to multitask and prioritize workload
Highly adaptable with strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills; ability to exercise good judgment and make sound data-backed decisions
High level of integrity and dependability with a strong sense of urgency and results-orientation
Views customer care as high priority; exhibits a positive can-do attitude
Displays a strong initiative and drive to identify gaps and fill them

Work Environment and Physical Demands:
This job operates in a professional office environment with periodic visits to active construction and equipment installation sites. Office hours are Monday through Friday from 8:00am - 5:00pm. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets, and may travel to project sites as needed.
To successfully perform the essential functions of this job, team member must be able to:

Work and commute in all weather conditions
Able to effectively communicate, listen, detect, converse with, discern, convey, express oneself and exchange information
Able to walk, bend, twist, turn, stoop, climb steps, reach with hands, use hands to fingers
Work in a fast-paced environment where they will often be multitasking
Move about inside the office to access standard office equipment
Constantly operate a computer and other office productivity machinery such as keyboard, copy machine and printer
Remain in a stationary position 50%+ of the time, alternating between sitting and standing
Ability to move and lift up to 30 pounds
Periodically navigate active construction and equipment installation sites, including uneven surfaces and all weather conditions
Drive between company locations, vendors, and project sites as needed while on the job

Overview of Tommy Enterprises Companies:
Tommy's Express is an international franchise for outstanding car washes and car care services. Powered by industry leading technology and decades of experience and planning, Tommy's Express car washes deliver a cutting-edge car wash experience unlike anything you've encountered before. Our fully automatic washes feature advances including the easy-loading car wash dual belt conveyor, wide open car wash bay for natural lighting, advanced presoak and sealer services, and free high-power self-serve vacuums on site.

Tommy’s Express Operations consists of a number of corporately owned Tommy’s Express car wash locations across the country. This is a quickly growing operation with intentions to open or acquire several new locations per year through the launch of Tommy’s Express Capital, a new private fund strategy.

Tommy Car Wash Systems (“TCWS”) is the power behind our Tommy’s Express equipment. TCWS is a team of passionate car wash professionals working to create opportunities for our partners to become the best car wash operators they can be. We provide modular building designs, robust stainless-steel car wash equipment, an advanced Wash Club license plate reader system, the Tommy Transporter belt, high performance wash detergents, and an industry-leading franchise opportunity. title: Part Time | Bellperson
description:

Maintain bell carts via cleaning and routine maintenance, working with Engineering when needed.

Use friendly and appropriate expressions when engaging guests.

Supervising the bell staff and ensure they perform their duties efficiently.

title: Sundhedsfaglig medarbejder til donortapning i Nykøbing F.
description:
Vi søger sundhedsfagligt personale til en fast stilling i vores bloddonortapning i Nykøbing Falster, samt vores mobile tappeenhed. Stillingen er på gennemsnitligt 32-37 timer om ugen til besættelse pr. 01. 12. 2026 eller efter aftale.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et afvekslende arbejdsområde med opgaver i forbindelse med bloddonation, herunder indkaldelse, booking og godkendelse af donorer, modtagelse og interview samt tapning af både fuldblods- og plasmadonorer. Derudover indgår bestilling og modtagelse af varer.
  • Et arbejde, der foregår både i Blodbanken i Nykøbing F. og i den mobile tappeenhed, når den holder i Nakskov og Vordingborg.
  • Et omfattende oplæringsprogram, som gør dig tryg, inden du skal arbejde selvstændigt.
  • En stillingen med skiftende arbejdstider, mandag til torsdag enten kl. 07.30 til 15.00 eller 13.00 til 20.30. Fredage kl. 07.30 til 16.00
  • Rare motiverede, engagerede og humørfyldte kollegaer, bestående af Bioanalytikere, sygeplejersker og laboranter, som prioriterer at have det godt sammen.
  • En arbejdsplads med meget gående og stående arbejde.
  • Et team, hvor kvalitet, ansvarlighed, overblik, fleksibilitet, samarbejde, kommunikation, vægtes højt
  • Et højt fagligt niveau


Vi ønsker

  • Ansøgere med en sundhedsfaglig uddannelse.
  • At du er udadvendt, positiv, har et godt humør og bidrager positivt til arbejdsmiljøet
  • At du er fleksibel i forhold til både arbejdstider og skift mellem opgaver
  • At du er serviceminded og møder både donorer og kolleger med imødekommenhed og overskud, uanset travlhed.
  • At du forstår at give donorerne en professionel og god oplevelse, så donorerne føler sig velkomne og værdifulde.
  • At du kan have mange bolde i luften og samtidig arbejde fokuseret gennem hele din vagt, også når tempoet er højt.
  • At du er åben for op til flere aftenvagter pr. uge, dog senest til kl. 20.30.
  • At du er fysisk robust, da der er meget gående og stående arbejde.
  • At du bevarer roen og overblikket, når der er travlt eller der opstår uforudsete situationer
  • At du ser oplæring af nye kollegaer og studerende, som en spændende og naturlig arbejdsopgave.
  • At du taler, skriver, læser og forstår dansk.
  • At du har flair for IT og er vant til pc’en som et dagligt arbejdsredskab, da dette er en stor del af det daglige arbejde.


Vi er en organisation med ca. 170 ansatte. Vi er en regional afdeling med hovedafdeling på Næstved. Denne flyttes til Køge, når den nye laboratoriebygning står klar i 2026. Vi betjener alle regionens sygehuse og har afsnit på regionens sygehuse i Slagelse, Holbæk, Nykøbing Falster og Roskilde. På disse afsnit udføres donortapning og patientnære analyser. I Køge ligger vores erytrocytserologiske referencelaboratorie. I Næstved udføres, udover donortapning og patientnære analyser, al komponentproduktion, virusanalyser og immunologiske udredninger. Der udføres også donortapning i Køge og i vores mobile enhed. Vi høster stamceller i Roskilde. Disse forarbejdes og opbevares i Næstved.

Afdelingen er akkrediteret af DANAK efter DS/ISO 15189 og inspiceres derudover af nationale kompetente myndigheder i forhold til blod-, vævs- og lægemiddelloven.

Vi er en uddannelsesaktiv afdeling med bioanalytiker-, speciale- og phd-studerende. Endvidere har afdelingen forskningsaktivitet, fortrinsvis indenfor Det Danske Bloddonorstudie, psoriasis, gigt, biomarkører for tidlig cancer og stamceller.

I afsnittet i Nykøbing er der 18 ansatte. Medarbejdergruppen består af bioanalytikere, laboranter og sygeplejersker.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen og funktionsbeskrivelse fås ved henvendelse til Overbioanalytiker Thanja Izabella Poulsen 21701726



Ansøgningsfrist 12. oktober 2026

Samtaler gennemføres løbende

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

title: Purchasing Agent
description:
M&M Industries is a U.S.-based manufacturer of plastic pails and packaging solutions. We operate in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where effective purchasing, inventory management, and supplier coordination are essential to supporting production operations.
The Purchasing Coordinator performs duties related to purchase order entry and post-entry supply chain tracking. This role interacts with domestic and international suppliers to maintain pricing and delivery schedules and serves as a liaison between Plant Production and suppliers. The Purchasing Coordinator procures required materials by verifying, preparing, and forwarding purchase orders to approved vendors.
Key Responsibilities

  • Verifies purchase requisitions by comparing requested raw materials to the master list and clarifying unclear items• Recommends alternatives for out-of-stock MRO items requested by Production• Forwards available inventory items by verifying stock and scheduling delivery• Verifies part numbers, specifications, and item pricing prior to releasing purchase orders to vendors; obtains recommendations from suppliers for substitute items and verifies appropriate approval levels based on requisition spend amount• Obtains purchased items by forwarding orders to suppliers, notifying requesting personnel of purchases, and monitoring and expediting orders as needed• Verifies receipt of items utilizing the ERP system to compare items received to items ordered and resolves shipment discrepancies with suppliers• Maintains accessible electronic copies of proof of purchase and information related to orders• Provides purchasing planning and control information by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends using prescribed Excel spreadsheets for reporting to the Plant Manager weekly or more frequently as needed• Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities as available• Supports purchasing and organizational objectives by completing related activities in a timely manner• Participates in cycle counts of raw materials on a weekly and/or daily basis as needed• Utilizes company ERP system(s) to track raw material purchases and inventory levels, resolve outstanding/open purchase orders, and perform other data analysis as needed

Qualifications
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office with a strong emphasis on Excel and Word• Strong Excel skills, including the ability to export information from ERP systems to spreadsheets and create and link spreadsheets• Strong analytical skills• Knowledge of MRP required• Knowledge of rail service

Education

  • Business degree or equivalent experience required

Experience

  • One (1) to two (2) years of purchasing experience in a manufacturing environment preferred• Experience with MRP preferred• Experience with rail service preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Good hand-eye coordination• Ability to occasionally lift and handle 45–50 pounds repetitively• Ability to perform work from a standing and/or sitting position as required• Ability to work in a manufacturing environment that may be hot or cold• Ability to wear required PPE while on the production floor (safety glasses, hearing protection, etc.)

What We Offer
M&M Industries offers a competitive benefits package designed to support our employees and reward the work that drives our success. Full-time employees may elect medical, dental and vision coverage effective on their first day of employment. We also offer paid vacation and discretionary time off (DTO), with the amount and timing based on position and tenure; paid company holidays after 90 days; and a 401(k) with company match beginning on the first day of the month following 90 days of employment. Educational reimbursement is available after one year of employment. Eligible employees may also participate in quarterly profit sharing when company performance thresholds are met. Hourly employees who work on a recognized holiday receive time-and-a-half for all hours worked. Benefits and eligibility are subject to applicable plan documents and company policies.

title: Tandsköterska sökes till Tandvårdsteamet Helsingborg
description:
Information om arbetsplatsen

I hjärtat av Helsingborg finns vi: Tandvårdsteamet Helsingborg. Kliniken består av två team; Mathias och Mario. Tandvårdsteamet söker en glad och driven tandsköterska som vill bli en del av vårt team!

Tandvårdsteamet Helsingborg är en mycket trevlig, modern och välfungerande klinik med totalt sex medarbetare, 2 tandläkare, 3 tandsköterskor och en tandhygienist. Vi erbjuder komplett allmäntandvård för vuxna och barn.

Arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker dig som har stort patientfokus, är lösningsorienterad och ansvarstagande. Du ska kunna jobba noggrant och självständigt med egna initiativ men även ha stark teamkänsla för dina kollegor. Hos oss finns stora möjligheter till utveckling och vi lägger stor vikt i att du på ett bra sätt kommer in i teamet och arbetet. Vår investering i dig är långsiktig.

Du assisterar tandläkaren vid behov, jobbar självständigt med delegerad patientbehandling, sterilarbete och förberedelse av behandlingsrum, profylaxvård samt receptionsarbete. Inköp. Tillsammans med tandläkaren planerar vi arbetsdagen och tidboken.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har tandsköterskeutbildning samt flytande i tal och skrift i svenska språket. Grundläggande datorkunskap. Meriterande är IT, erfarenhet av Frenda, tidigare delegerat arbete.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid att du är serviceorienterad, lugn och trygg i mötet med våra patienter. Som person är du engagerad, har helhetstänk, kommunikativ och lätt för att samarbeta. Du är motiverad att utvecklas inom yrket och bidrar till en trevlig och positiv miljö för såväl patienter som kollegor.

Övrig information

Intervjuer sker löpande och tillsättning av tjänsten kan ske snarast.

Tillträde januari 2027 eller enl överenskommelse. 75- 100 % med fast månadslön.

Tillsvidare med provanställning 6 månader.

Är du den ansvarsfulla, drivna och positiva kollegan vi söker?

Välkommen med din ansökan önskar tandläkare Mathias Selléus och Mario Batinic

Om Praktikertjänst

Praktikertjänst startade för över 65 år sedan och är en av Sveriges största vårdgivare. Vi har 750 mottagningar, från Vittangi i norr till Ystad i söder, som drivs av praktiker som tillsammans äger hela Praktikertjänst. Vi är övertygade om att det skapar engagemang, delaktighet, fokus på kvalitet, kontinuitet samt kompetensutveckling - och är en viktig anledning till att vi varje år hamnar i topp vad gäller både nöjda patienter och medarbetare. Hos oss får du en trygg anställning med fina förmåner och goda möjligheter till både personlig och professionell utveckling. Vi vet att våra medarbetares välbefinnande är grunden till nöjda patienter och i det långa loppet, ett mer välmående samhälle.

title: Senior Advisor, Workforce Planning & Organizational Effectiveness
description:
Position Overview:
The Senior Advisor, Workforce Planning & Organizational Effectiveness develops the tools, tracking, and strategies needed to ensure WestJet has the right indirect (non-operational) resources, and that work and teams are organized to use those resources effectively. This role supports the design, governance, and advancement of workforce planning across WestJet Group’s indirect workforce, using data, forecasting, and business insights to align workforce supply and demand with financial and operational priorities. It also establishes organizational effectiveness practices that strengthen accountability, leadership structures, and delivery models.

Reporting to the Director, Planning & Analytics, the Senior Advisor works across Finance, Corporate Planning, HR Business Partners, Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, People Analytics, Total Rewards, Procurement, and enterprise leaders to support integrated workforce and organizational decisions.

Key Responsibilities include:
Workforce Planning

Lead the run-rate workforce process, including position tracking, contractor visibility in partnership with Procurement, approvals, and reconciliation against approved plans.
Embed workforce planning in the annual budget and business planning processes, working with Finance, Corporate Planning, HR Business Partners, and leaders to align resources with priorities.
Develop workforce strategies that identify future demand, available supply, capability gaps, and build, buy, or borrow options.
Partner with direct workforce planning teams to align direct workforce planning approaches, assumptions, and insights with broader enterprise workforce plans.

Organizational Effectiveness

Establish practical organizational design standards, including decision rights, spans and layers, leadership structure, and delivery model choices.
Review organizational structures, identify risks and exceptions, and recommend changes that improve accountability, efficiency, and agility.
Maintain simple, consistent processes for workforce planning and organizational structure decisions

Governance, Analytics & Decision Support

Develop planning tools, dashboards, and reporting that provide clear visibility into workforce mix, cost, demand, organizational structure, and risk
Provide leaders with clear insights, options, and recommendations for workforce and organizational decisions, including HR resource planning
Maintain common workforce definitions, data standards, and reporting practices with People, Finance, and Procurement

Experience and Qualifications:

Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

7+ years of experience in workforce planning, organizational effectiveness or design, HR strategy, or business planning in a complex organization
Strong strategic thinking and business acumen, with the ability to connect people strategies to broader business objectives
Demonstrated experience building or improving enterprise workforce planning processes, forecasting approaches, tools, or governance frameworks
Experience applying organizational design principles, including decision rights, spans and layers, leadership structures, and delivery models
Strong data and analytical acumen with experience using workforce data, financial information, forecasting models, and HR systems
Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to present clear options and recommendations to senior leaders

Organizational design and effectiveness
Process design, governance, and disciplined execution
Financial and workforce planning integration
Executive communication and storytelling
Collaboration, influence, and stakeholder management
Change leadership and transformation mindset

Wainfleet Road, Boston, Lincs, PE21 9RW

title: Puheterapeutti, Kuntoutuspalvelut, Jyväskylä
description:
Me keskitymme työssämme olennaiseen, terveyteen. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Etsimme nyt osaavaan ja motivoituneeseen joukkoomme Puheterapeuttia Jyväskylään. Tutustu tehtävään ja hae!

Mitä puheterapeutin työ pitää sisällään?

Me Terveystalon Kuntoutuspalveluissa haluamme olla valituin ja vaikuttavin kuntoutuksen toimija Suomessa. Tämä näkyy intohimonamme jakaa osaamistamme ja oppia uteliaasti uutta. Meille on tärkeää tukea terapeuttiemme ammatillista kasvua ja olla mukana kehittämässä vaikuttavuusperusteista kuntoutusta. Terveystalon Kuntoutuspalveluissa keskiössä on asiakkaan toimintakyky - sen arviointi ja kuntoutus. Kuntoutuspalveluihin kuuluvat neuropsykologian, puhe- ja toimintaterapian sekä neurologisen fysioterapian palvelut ja moniammatillinen kuntoutus. Palvelemme kaikkia ikäryhmiä usealla eri paikkakunnalla.

Puheterapeuttina Terveystalon Kuntoutuspalveluissa pääset tekemään monipuolisia kuntoutuksen tehtäviä sekä hyödyntämään ja kasvattamaan osaamistasi laajan asiakaskunnan parissa. Työtehtävät koostuvat pääosin yksilökuntoutuksesta Kelan ja Hyvinvointialueen maksusitoumuksilla.

Pyrimme aina huomioimaan ammattilaisten elämäntilanteet ja toiveet sekä tarjoamaan monipuolista tukea itsenäisen asiantuntijatyön rinnalle. Lähiesihenkilönäsi toimii puheterapeutti, joka huolehtii siitä, että työn arki on sujuvaa, jolloin sinä voit keskittyä asiakastyöhön. Samalla tuemme myös aktiivisesti jokaisen tekijän ammatillista kehittymistä, pohjana toimii yhdessä räätälöity ammatillisen kehittymisen suunnitelma. Panostamme kuntoutustyön jatkuvaan kehittämiseen johtavan puheterapeutin johdossa ja yhteistyössä ammattilaistemme kanssa. Osaajamme pitävät tiiviisti yhteyttä ja kokoontuvat säännöllisiin tapaamisiin jakamaan osaamistaan ja kehittämään työtään. Lisäksi apunasi on koko valtakunnallinen moniammatillinen työyhteisömme, joka tukee ja konsultoi sinua asiakastyössäsi.

Meillä voit työskennellä ammatinharjoittajana tai vakituisesti työsuhteisena osa- tai kokoaikaisesti toiveidesi mukaan. Voit itse suunnitella työpäiväsi ja -viikkosi, myös etätyömahdollisuus on käytettävissäsi.

Lue lisää Terveystalon Kuntoutuspalveluissa työskentelystä täältä.

Miksi meille töihin?

Terveystalo on työntekopaikka, jossa sinä voit keskittyä olennaiseen. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Hyvän ja arvostavan työntekopaikan sekä laadukkaan perehdytyksen ja innostavien tehtävien lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Paikan yhteiskunnallisesti vaikuttavan kuntoutuksen toteuttajana terveysalan moniosaajajoukossa.
  • Suuren talon vakauden ja pienen työyhteisön lämpimän tunnelman.
  • Mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun ja kehittymiseen mentoroinnin, kouluttautumisen ja työnohjauksen turvin.
  • Mahdollisuuden työskennellä joustavasti ja vapauden suunnitella omaa arkeasi, mm. liukuvaa työaikaa hyödyntäen.
  • Ammattitaitoisen ja sitoutuneen moniammatillisen työyhteisön, laajan kollegaverkoston sekä yksilöllisen tuen.
  • Kilpailukykyinen palkkaus; hyvän kiinteän peruspalkan lisäksi tulospalkkaosuus.
  • Ison konsernin toimivat työkäytännöt ja monipuoliset edut, kuten lounas- ja virike-edun, kumppanialennukset ja kattavan työterveyshuollon, joka sisältää peruspalveluiden lisäksi muun muassa lähetteelliset erikoislääkärikäynnit ja lyhytpsykoterapian.
  • Työssä tarvittavat nykyaikaiset tilat, välineet, kuntoutusmateriaalit ja -testit.
  • Mahdollisuuden keskittyä työssäsi olennaiseen, siihen missä olet hyvä ja missä haluat vielä kasvaa.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Edellytämme, että olet laillistettu puheterapeutti ja kiinnostunut kuntoutuksen sovellusalasta. Voit olla urasi alkuvaiheessa tai kokeneempi osaaja. Työtehtävässä menestymistäsi tukevat itseohjautuvuus, ennakoiva ja suunnitelmallinen työskentelytapa sekä valmius liikkuvaan työhön. Työssä tarvitset ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja halukkuutta toimia moniammatillisessa tiimissä.

Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6§:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelyä varten.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Jätä yhteystietosi hakulomakkeen kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä. Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Mahdollisiin kysymyksiin vastaa mielellään ura-asiantuntija Milja Rastas (milja.rastas@terveystalo.com).

Tervetuloa Kuntoutuspalveluihin! Tervetuloa Terveystaloon!

title: Chiropractic Assistant
description:
About Us

Born in 1993, Excelsia Injury Care’s mission is to restore quality of life through patient-centric care and support for those injured in motor vehicle or work-related accidents. With over 100 patient care centers across the Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, and Mountain West regions, our vision is to be the leading provider of injury care, setting the standard for excellence in every community we serve and expanding access to high-quality care nationwide.

At Excelsia, we deliver the full continuum of outpatient care within one seamless, connected system. Our diverse team of medical specialists offers a wide range of treatment services, covering medical, orthopedics, neurology, rehabilitation, diagnostic, and surgical. We are committed to supporting patients through personalized support, detailed documentation, and outcome-oriented care coordination to make the recovery process easier. With Excelsia, patients are never far from the care they need—with the compassion they deserve.

Founded on the values of respect and trustworthiness, we are committed to delivering services that adhere to the highest legal, regulatory, and ethical standards. As responsible corporate citizens, we integrate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) considerations into our business practices, ensuring that we positively impact the healthcare companies we serve, our employees, and the communities we reach.

Job Duties

  • Assist patients pre and post care by the D.C.
  • Take vital signs of patients
  • Perform physical therapy modalities as directed by the D.C.
  • Accurately and legibly document modalities performed and subjective patient comments on progress notes
  • Maintain cleanliness of exam and treatment rooms at all times
  • Monitor controls on physical therapy equipment
  • Launder towels, gowns, heat pack covers, etc. as required
  • Maintain inventory and order supplies
  • Assist in general office operations as needed including filing, prepping charts, answering phones, patient registration, posting charges, scanning, cleaning, etc.

    respective region as needed for coverage

Motor Vehicle Report Monitoring

In the event Employee does not maintain the insurance coverage required under this Policy & Procedure, and/or does not maintain a valid license to operate a motor vehicle, that Employee shall not be eligible for mileage reimbursement and is barred from operating any motor vehicle in furtherance of Company business. Operating a motor vehicle in furtherance of Company business without a valid state-issued driver’s license to do so and/or maintain insurance of the type and amounts set forth herein shall subject the Employee to immediate disciplinary action up to and including termination.


Minimum Requirements

High school diploma or GED equivalent

Additional Skills/Competencies

  • Tact and skill in patient management

Physical/Mental Requirements

Sitting, standing, walking, reaching above shoulder length, working with body bent over at waist, working in kneeling position, crawling, climbing stairs, climbing ladders, working with arms extended at shoulder length, lifting maximum of 20 lbs.


Diversity Statement

Excelsia Injury Care is an equal opportunity employer. We commit to a policy of nondiscrimination and equal opportunity for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, pregnancy or related medical conditions, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic predisposition, marital, civil union or partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: SDK/Platform Engineer
description:
About Our Work

We are neuroscientists who build ground-breaking technology for the spatial computing era. We stimulate nerves to create artificial tactile sensations, creating new, more meaningful connections to the user for notifications, 3D digital content, physical AI, health information, and beyond. Our first products will be mobile, wearable devices that stream haptic data from multiple digital sources to create meaningful sensations of touch.

What You'll Be Doing

The SDK Platform Developer is responsible for leading the design, development, testing, and troubleshooting of software and SDK solutions, including integration with firmware. This role works independently on complex technical objectives, provides technical leadership and problem-solving expertise, and collaborates with software, development, leadership, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable solutions aligned with product and business goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software and SDK platforms, including integration and interfacing with firmware.

  • Provide technical leadership for software and SDK initiatives that support product development and organizational strategy.

  • Work independently on complex technical objectives with guidance from the Director of Software.

  • Develop robust software and SDK architectures and solutions aligned with company and product goals.

  • Collaborate with software, development, firmware, and cross-functional teams to define technical requirements, priorities, deliverables, and timelines.

  • Troubleshoot complex software, SDK, and firmware integration issues and drive issues through root-cause analysis and resolution.

  • Develop, implement, and improve software and SDK testing protocols, validation procedures, and troubleshooting methodologies.

  • Partner with the Director of Software to identify appropriate test strategies and provide technical guidance on test protocols.

  • Evaluate technical approaches, tools, technologies, and vendors; support vendor evaluation and selection as needed.

  • Translate technical findings and development results into clear recommendations for technical and business stakeholders. Identify technical risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies to protect product quality, performance, cost, and schedule.

  • Maintain a high level of technical quality, documentation, accuracy, and attention to detail throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to other software and development team members as appropriate.

  • Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure technical execution remains aligned with department objectives and broader business goals.

  • Help establish and maintain development practices that promote scalability, reliability, maintainability, and high-quality SDK deliverables.

  • Other duties as assigned

What You'll Need for This Position

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in software development, firmware development, SDK development, embedded systems, or a closely related technology domain.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and supporting software development kits (SDKs), software platforms, APIs, libraries, or developer-facing tools.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, development methodologies, testing, debugging, and troubleshooting.

  • Experience working at the software/firmware interface, including diagnosing and resolving integration issues.

  • Strong programming and software development skills in one or more relevant languages such as C, C++, Python, Java, or similar, depending on the product environment.

  • Experience developing and executing software testing and validation protocols. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate complex technical issues and determine practical solutions.

  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of complex technical objectives and drive them through execution.

  • Ability to provide technical leadership and influence development decisions without necessarily having direct people-management responsibility.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with software, firmware, development, engineering, leadership, and external vendors.

  • Excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to software quality, reliability, and performance.

  • Ability to assess technical risks and understand the potential impact of engineering decisions on product schedules, costs, system performance, and business objectives.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience evaluating technologies, development approaches, tools, or external vendors is highly desirable.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment where technical decisions can have a significant impact on product development timelines and business outcomes.

What's in It for You

Work closely with cutting-edge technology. You'll be hands-on with novel neural haptic technology that's defining the future of spatial computing and immersive experiences.

Work in a close-knit, startup environment. We strive to create an intellectually stimulating and collegial working environment. Our energy for inventing, creating, and learning spans work and play: we have regular happy hours, plan field trips, play games, play music, and generally have a good time.

An early employee experience. We are an early-stage deep tech startup company that requires all members to contribute across the entire business. On any given day, there will be new challenges and new demands to propel the business forward. We expect all employees to be able to dive into any new challenges that present themselves, even if they are beyond the job description above. If your are driven by the desire to see success and to create new tech not seen by the world previously, you will fit right in to the team's culture.

Compensation & Benefits

Afference is committed to providing the sense of touch for the evolution of the human connection to technology and the future of the digital experience. We are leading this effort through deep science and technology, which provides unique experiences compared to classical haptic technologies. Our lean team of experts demands a high level of excellence but can compensate with the commensurate upside potential of an early-growth startup in a high-growth sector of extended reality.

Compensation offers depend on skills, qualifications, and experience, and range between:

$147,000 to $165,000 per year at 100% FTE

Benefits include:

  • Medical, dental vision, life, STD, FSA, additional company perks

  • Equity incentive

  • Self-managed PTO

Location: On-site; Cleveland, OH office

title: Trolley Adminstrator
description:
JOB TITLE:Trolley Administrator

FLSA: Salaried Exempt (?)

DEPARTMENT:Trolley Administration

RESPONSIBLE TO: Director of Trolley Operations and Maintenance

PAYRATE:$75,000

JOB FUNCTIONS: Responsible for the day-to-day management of Trolley’s established quality

management systems; for developing and implementing new quality assurance processes where necessary

or expanding on existing processes and for actively supporting Trolley management to ensure that all

products, services, processes, procedures, and documentation meet Trolley's quality requirements.

Responsible for managing and delivering widely diverse projects of varying size and complexity. Identifies,

leads, and manages high priority strategic initiatives that cross organizational lines and have MATA-wide

impact. This position advises and consults with District staff and leaders to develop and advance

organizational strategic initiatives that ensure continuous improvement toward the Trolley Department

long-term goals.

Collects, analyzes, documents and communicates performance measure results internally. Conducts root

cause analysis, drafts recommendations for managers and prepares visualizations that clarify results.

Facilitates business plan, manages development at the department and office level and interacts regularly

with managers to inform about internal performance measurement reporting.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. General Quality Management: In addition to the duties specified below, manage the day-to-day implementation of the quality assurance processes established by the Trolley Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QAQC) Plan; support the Safety and Security Officer Rail (SSOR), Director of Trolley Operations and Maintenance (DTOM), and other MTM staff in the implementation of quality processes under their purview; develop, expand, implement, and monitor processes for ensuring rail operations and maintenance quality; act as an ambassador for quality, compliance, and continual improvement.
  2. Document Control: Document review and development of SOPs, programs and policies. Maintain Trolley’s document control system according to internal procedures and regulatory requirements; ensure the accuracy and integrity of controlled documents through proper versioning, storage, and distribution; and monitor the flow and storage of forms and other records pertaining to rail operations and maintenance.
  3. Audit Support: Assist the Safety Department with internal and regulatory audits; at the request of the Safety Department, conduct interviews, review documents and records, produce checklists, reports, or other materials, and communicate with regulators as needed.
  4. QAQC Support for Rail Capital Projects: In cooperation with the Safety Department, other agency personnel, vendors/contractors, and project managers, support the implementation of a documented quality system for rail capital projects according to Trolley’s QAQC Plan, as well as other agency, regulatory, or project requirements; maintain complete and accurate records of all required quality documentation; as necessary and appropriate, assist in the development and monitoring of quality processes throughout the life of the project.
  1. Configuration Management: Facilitate change control processes according to Trolley configuration management policies; support the Safety Department as needed.
  2. Asset Management: Actively support the implementation and expansion of the agency’s asset management plan for the Trolley Division, particularly as it relates to lifecycle management of trolley assets, including inventory management, condition assessment, and performance monitoring; in support of these processes, manage the production and flow of documentation and support the implementation and expansion of information technology.
  3. Special Projects: Manages special assignments on a short-term basis and provides effective intervention in complex situations, initiates and leads interdepartmental teams in analyzing specific issues or problems and in developing strategies and recommendations to effectively address them.

TRAINING AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT:

  1. “Designated Personnel” Training: Within 36 months of hiring or appointment, complete all requirements for “designated personnel” as defined by 49 CFR Part 672, “Public Transportation Safety Certification Training Program.”
  2. Additional Professional Development: In addition to the requirements above, pursue professional development in QAQC and related disciplines through training programs provided by reputable and qualified institutions (including online programs that are appropriately rigorous).

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Public/Business Administration, Planning, Engineering, Finance,

Management, Political Science, Economics, or related field.

Other:

  1. A minimum of four (4) years of experience involving professional experience in managing and implementing projects of progressively greater complexity in business strategy and development, including varying degrees of quantitative analysis, analytical problem solving, and data visualization.
  2. Minimum 4 years of progressive experience in QAQC, Document Control, Asset Management (Trapeze), Configuration Management, experience in Streetcar environment.
  3. Experience in an FTA regulated environment preferred.
  4. Should be able to communicate effectively both orally and in writing and comprehend, communicate and respond to instructions, orders, signs, notices, inquiries, etc. in English.
  5. Ability to interact constructively and establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with external stakeholders and employees at all levels of the organization.
  6. Must be able to exercise discretion, maintain utmost confidentiality and exhibit the highest standard of professionalism.
  7. Proficiency in software applications required for analyzing data and preparing correspondence, reports and presentations as well as in Trapeze.
  8. Requires the ability to handle numerous activities at one time and must be able to work and meet deadlines with limited supervision.
  9. Should possess strong organizational skills.
  10. Must be able to operate office equipment including personal computer equipment, facsimile machine, and photocopier.
  11. Must be willing to comply with the company’s Drug and Alcohol Policy.
  12. Must always comply with safety and COVID protocols. Ensures a commitment to safety through consistent and professional behaviors in performance of job requirements that demonstrates safety is a fundamental value that guides all aspects of work.
  13. Regular and consistent attendance is required.
  14. Should be able to understand a labor agreement.
  15. Must possess and maintain a valid Tennessee driver’s license.

Environment:

1. Extensive sitting is required while using office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, or fax machines.

2. Some standing and walking during a normal workday will also be required as well as bending, stooping, kneeling, and crouching.

3. Most work will be performed in inside working conditions but should be able to tolerate changes

in building environments such as with or without air conditioning or heating.

4. May be required occasionally to move up to 20 pounds by lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling or otherwise repositioning objects.

5. Fingering and repetitive motions will be required for data entry, while picking items up or while filing.

6. Able to express or exchange ideas with others accurately and at an easily audible volume through

the use of spoken words. Able to receive detailed information through oral communication or by phone at usual speaking levels and differentiate between sounds in the environment.

7. Close visual acuity to perform detail-oriented activities as well as acuity to perform activities at or within arm’s reach with skill, control and accuracy such as preparing and analyzing data, viewing a computer screen or for significant reading of documents and other materials.

The above description is intended to describe the general content, identify the essential functions, and set forth the requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

title: Medical Radiation Technologist, Computed Tomography (CT)
description:
Are you seeking a dynamic role as a Medical Radiation Technologist, Computed Tomography (CT)? We value your commitment to patient care and technical proficiency. Join us for a chance to work with a diverse range of technologies and procedures.
Our hospital provides opportunities for training and collaboration between esteemed health care institutions. Don't miss out on supporting prominent specialties such as Orthopedics, Maternity, and Inflammatory Bowel Disease.

Is this you?
You are a registered technologist with CMRITO and are seeking a role that offers both personal and professional growth. Whether you're a recent graduate or an experienced technologist, your technical and patient care skills will allow you to thrive in our close-knit team.
You value a supportive structure that offers you opportunities to develop your skills. This team is part of the Joint Department of Medical Imaging (JDMI), a partnership between the University Health Network, Mount Sinai Hospital and Women’s College Hospital. We are also fully-affiliated with the University of Toronto. This allows for high levels of interdepartmental support along with plenty of training opportunities that you won’t experience anywhere else.
Highly adaptable and well-organized, you enjoy a fast-paced medical imaging environment. Your caring and compassionate nature, combined with excellent interpersonal skills, make you an integral part the team. Collaborating with X-ray and Interventional Radiology teams, your workday will involve performing outpatient scans and providing coverage for the Emergency Department and Inpatients.
You can efficiently operate and troubleshoot medical imaging equipment, ensuring optimal performance. As an independent and resourceful technologist, you find fulfillment in performing a variety of exams, including Enterography and Colonography, with shared protocols and Radiologists across multiple sites. Furthermore, this role offers the opportunity to contribute to the development of Michener MRT students, enhancing your leadership skills.
About the Medical Imaging Department
Mount Sinai Hospital’s Medical Imaging Department provides a state-of-the-art environment for leading edge clinical practice, teaching, and research programs in Radiography. An international leader in medical imaging, we conduct a large volume of various types of Radiography exams for patient populations from the Emergency department to Outpatients and Inpatients.

In this role you will:

Perform medical imaging procedures
Operate, troubleshoot and ensure medical imaging and ancillary equipment are performing in an effective and efficient manner
Prepare written and electronic reports required documenting all procedures and test results
Participate in teaching, educational, research, safety and quality improvement programs/activities
Perform other related patient care responsibilities to facilitate the provision of optimal patient care
Perform other duties consistent with the job classification as required

Job Requirements
Mandatory

Completion of an accredited degree/post diploma Radiological Technology program, or recognized equivalent

Consideration for hire may also be given to applicants currently enrolled in an accredited degree/post diploma Radiological Technology program – as a condition of hire the Radiological Technology program must be successfully completed within six (6) months of hire

Certificate of registration in the specialty of Radiography from the Canadian Association of Medical Radiation Technologists (CAMRT)
Currently registered and in good standing with the College of Medical Radiation and Imaging Technologists of Ontario (CMRITO)
Completion of a Basic Cardiac Life Support (BCLS) program, Level II: Basic Rescuer certification

Preferred

Level 2 and 3 CT
Membership with the CAMRT

Skills and Knowledge

Ability to perform peripheral IV insertions
Demonstrated excellent critical thinking, decision making and problem solving skills
Ability to multi-task and work effectively as a team member and work effectively and efficiently in a fast paced environment.

If this sounds like you and you’re ready to build your career within Medical Imaging, apply via the button below and let us know why you would be a great addition to our team.

description:

Maintains a safe working environment and helps to improve overall safety culture at Jamco
Drives compliance to all safety & Quality programs
Attend and participate in all scheduled meeting

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI
location: Sydney NSW, Australia; Melbourne VIC, Australia
description:
As a Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

  • Serve as a developer for AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol [MCP] servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
  • Build evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
  • Be able to co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.
  • Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP).
  • Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
  • Experience managing technical discovery sessions.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Knowledge of Large Language Model (LLM) native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

title: Event & activatiemarketeer Xpert Clinics
description:

Het is belangrijk dat je als Event & activatiemarketeer energie krijgt van het managen van veel verschillende projecten in een zeer uitvoerende rol. Je houdt van organiseren, bent planmatig sterk en houdt alle bordjes als een ware circusartiest draaiende! Daarnaast ben je altijd op zoek naar hoe het de volgende keer nóg beter kan.


Wat ga je doen?

  • Organiseren en coördineren van nascholingen voor zorgprofessionals en patiëntavonden, zowel fysiek als online.
  • Opzetten en beheren van (online) webinars, inclusief planning, communicatie en technische coördinatie.

  • Beheren van (sport)sponsor- en activatieprojecten, waaronder contact met externe partijen, budgetbewaking en rapportage.
  • Zorgen voor een administratief correcte afhandeling en evaluatie van alle evenementen (aanmeldingen, evaluaties, facturen, etc.).
  • Ondersteunen van de marketingafdeling bij de promotie en communicatie rondom events en nascholingen.
  • Evalueren van evenementen en meedenken over verbeteringen voor toekomstige edities.

Ons marketingteam bestaat uit zo’n 10 gepassioneerde en creatieve professionals die stuk voor stuk een positieve bijdrage leveren aan ons gezamenlijke doel. We werken hybride, wat betekent dat we deels op ons hoofdkantoor, deels vanuit de klinieken en ook vanuit huis werken. Een gezonde werk-privébalans staat bij ons hoog in het vaandel. We zijn een hecht team, waarin hard werken en resultaat voorop staan, maar er ook volop ruimte is voor gezelligheid en een lolletje. We zijn een diverse groep qua leeftijd, achtergrond en persoonlijkheid, maar juist deze mix zorgt voor de perfecte balans en samenwerking.

Binnen ons team en jouw functie ervaar je veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng en verantwoordelijkheid. We rekenen dan ook op jou om jouw ideeën tot leven te brengen.

Ben jij flexibel en kun je snel schakelen, dan voel jij je ongetwijfeld snel thuis in ons team!

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt een mbo 4 of hbo-opleiding afgerond, bijvoorbeeld in marketing, communicatie of eventmanagement.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het organiseren van (online) events of activaties, bij voorkeur binnen een commerciële of zorggerelateerde omgeving.
  • Je bent gestructureerd, zelfstandig en communicatief sterk. Je schakelt moeiteloos met verschillende belanghebbenden. Van artsen tot externe leveranciers.

  • Je hebt een flexibele werkhouding. Evenementen vinden regelmatig plaats in de avonden en af en toe in het weekend.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Salaris volgens de cao ZKN schaal 55 (€4.043,- tot €6.058,- obv 40 uur en afhankelijk van jouw ervaring
  • Een contract voor 12 maanden, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

  • Belastingvoordeel op o.a. elektronica, fietsen, je sportschool abonnement of aankopen in winkels via ons Fiscfree” programma
  • De mogelijkheid om op een laagdrempelige manier met een externe coach in gesprek te gaan over jouw welzijn, gewoon omdat wij dit belangrijk vinden.
