title: Complaint Processing Analyst I
description:
These roles are responsible for handling inbound and outbound interactions (phone, email and other channels) from patients, HCPs and customers, while accurately identifying, documenting and routing product quality complaints and related safety information. This role ensures excellent customer experience, compliant intake of information, and timely communication with internal quality and safety teams. Key Responsibilities Customer Contact & Case Intake

  • Handle inbound and outbound contacts from patients, caregivers, HCPs, pharmacies and other customers through phone and additional channels.
  • Provide professional, empathetic and clear customer service, following approved scripts, FAQs and product information.
  • Accurately identify when a contact involves a product complaint, an adverse event, or both, and follow the appropriate intake and reporting process.

Product Complaints Documentation

  • Collect all required details for product complaints (e.g., product name, lot/batch number, expiration date, description of the issue, contact data, sample availability, event outcome).
  • Create and update complaint records in the designated systems, ensuring complete, timely and compliant data entry according to SOPs and work instructions.
  • Exchange and record case reference numbers when transferring or coordinating with other internal teams (e.g., Product Quality, Safety, Medical Information).

Follow‑up & Communication

  • Perform required follow‑up call attempts to obtain missing information (e.g., lot number, additional event details), documenting all attempts and outcomes.
  • When needed, coordinate with pharmacies, clinics or other third parties to gather additional complaint information.
  • Provide clear status updates to callers when appropriate, while respecting internal processes and confidentiality requirements.

Compliance & Quality

  • Adhere to all applicable global and local procedures related to product quality complaints, safety reporting, data privacy and call handling standards.
  • Escalate complex, sensitive, or unusual cases to senior analysts, quality or safety teams according to defined escalation paths.
  • Participate in training related to new products, complaint handling, systems and SOP updates, and apply learning consistently in daily work.

  • Previous experience in a Contact Center, customer service, healthcare support, pharmacovigilance, or quality complaints environment preferred.

  • Bachelor’s Degree is required; preferably in the life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, or other scientific background

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to follow scripts while adapting to customer needs.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and documentation.

  • Ability to stay calm and professional when dealing with sensitive or emotional calls.

  • Comfort using multiple systems simultaneously (CRM, complaint systems, call platforms).

  • Advanced English level (B2+/C1) and local language proficiency, both written and spoken.

At AbbVie, we are committed to cultivating a workplace culture that promotes inclusion, diversity, and personal growth. We recognize that our collective success is based on the individual well-being of our employees, which is why we have designed a benefits package that considers every aspect of their lives.

  • Enhanced Health and Wellness Coverage: Our administrative staff enjoys comprehensive medical and dental insurance, ensuring peace of mind for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible Hybrid Work Model: For eligible positions within our administrative staff, we have adopted a hybrid work scheme allowing the convenience of working from home two days a week.
  • Life Insurance: Secure your family’s future with our life insurance policy.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access professional support with our comprehensive EAP, offering psychological, legal, and financial counseling.
  • On-Site Health Services: Benefit from the convenience of having a company doctor and physical therapy services, demonstrating our commitment to your health and well-being.
  • Community and Social Engagement: Make a difference with a paid volunteer day, allowing you to contribute to the community during company working hours.
  • Special Leave Benefits: Celebrate your life achievements with extra leave days for marriage and enjoy your birthday with a day off.
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan: Participate in our company's success by purchasing shares at a special price exclusive to employees.
  • Transportation and Meals subsidized.
  • Solidary Association: Join a community focused on mutual help and enjoy the benefits that come with being a member.

title: Ondersteunend begeleider Judith van Swethuis (32 uur)
description:
Jouw rol
Contact maken met een ander en aanpakken zijn jouw kwaliteiten!
In deze afwisselende functie ondersteun je onze cliënten bij hun dagelijkse activiteiten. Denk hierbij aan koken voor en met bewoners, ondersteunen bij schoonmaak en corveetaken. Ook ondersteuning bij douchen en persoonlijke verzorging hoort hierbij. Je stimuleert zelfredzaamheid van bewoners, organiseert (buiten) activiteiten en je zorgt ervoor dat huisregels worden nageleefd. Focussen op de kracht en mogelijkheden van onze bewoners staat centraal. Je bevordert de leefsituatie door bewoners te helpen met het verbeteren van hun gezondheid en sociale contacten en je gaat bijvoorbeeld mee naar afspraken.

Je handelt volgens het begeleidingsplan dat de persoonlijk begeleider samen met de bewoners heeft opgesteld en rapporteert bijzonderheden. Je houdt de administratie bij, rapporteert in het ECD en handelt volgens standaardprocedures en werkafspraken. Als je geen ervaring hebt met medicatie verstrekken volgens het baxtersysteem en het toedienen van insuline dan word je bijgeschoold, zodat je hiervoor bevoegd en bekwaam bent.

Locatie
Het Judith van Swethuis is een woonvoorziening voor 66 bewoners in zowel groepswoningen als eigen studio’s. Hier wonen zij onder een dak van beschermd wonen met dagelijks groepsmomenten. Er zijn gezamenlijke huiskamers, een grote gezamenlijke dagbestedingsruimte en een keuken waar dagelijks door een professionele kok warme gezonde maaltijden worden bereid. Ons team bestaat uit een teammanager, zorgcoördinatoren, verpleegkundigen, persoonlijk begeleiders en ondersteunend begeleiders. We worden regelmatig ondersteund door enthousiaste vrijwilligers. Er wordt gewerkt volgens een maandrooster met ochtend-, avond- en nachtdiensten, zowel doordeweeks als in het weekend. Wil je meer weten over de locatie Judith van Swethuis? Neem dan een kijkje op

    Jouw profiel
    Een empathische en zorgzame doener, die graag klaar staat voor de ander. Jij blijft zien waar je het voor doet, ook als het eens flink anders loopt. Cliënten ondersteunen bij het douchen en de persoonlijke verzorging vind jij geen enkel probleem. Bepalen en bewaren van je eigen houding en handelend optreden in geval van crisissituaties gaat jou goed af. Herken je jezelf ook in onderstaande wensen, dan maken we graag kennis met jou!

    • Je beschikt over een afgeronde (agogische) opleiding op mbo-3 niveau;
    • Je hebt bij voorkeur een aantal jaar werkervaring in een soortgelijke omgeving;
    • Je hebt affiniteit met de doelgroep of ervaringskennis die aansluit bij de doelgroep;
    • Je hebt een proactieve en probleemoplossende werkhouding;
    • Je komt afspraken na en spreekt anderen aan op gemaakte afspraken.

    Arbeidsvoorwaarden en bijzonderheden

    • Een baan met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief;
    • Het betreft in eerste instantie een contract voor de duur van een jaar met uitzicht op verlenging;
    • Jouw salaris bedraagt minimaal € 2.735,- en maximaal € 3.560,- bruto per maand (schaal 35, CAO GGZ) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek;
    • Een 2e klas mobiliteitskaart voor woon-werkverkeer en dienstreizen met OV of gebruik van OV-fiets;
    • Je ontvangt bij een 36-urige werkweek minimaal 23 verlofdagen per jaar. Door feestdagencompensatie en LFB-uren (levensfasebudget) kan dit oplopen tot ongeveer 34 verlofdagen. Daarnaast kun je extra verlofuren kopen vanuit je vakantiegeld, balansbudget en/of 13e maand.
    • Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform CAO GGZ. Denk hierbij aan vakantiegeld, pensioen, fietsplan en een eindejaarsuitkering. We vinden vitaliteit belangrijk en bieden jou daarom jaarlijks een sportvergoeding van € 100,-; Een jaarlijks balansbudget van € 500 (op basis van een fulltime dienstverband). Voor de besteding hiervan kun je kiezen uit de drie opties zoals beschreven in de CAO GGZ;
    • Je hebt ruime keuze uit opleidingen en cursussen;
    • Een referentiecheck en verklaring omtrent gedrag maken onderdeel uit van deze procedure. Tijdens de onboarding vragen we je om een online competentievragenlijst in te vullen;
    • Met een interactief onboardingsprogramma bieden we jou een warm welkom en een goede start.

    HVO-Querido heeft de ambitie om een inclusieve en gelijkwaardige organisatie te zijn waar alle cliënten en medewerkers zichzelf kunnen zijn en zich thuis voelen, met als doel om betere kwaliteit van zorg te leveren aan onze cliënten en een veilige en inspirerende werkplek te bieden voor onze medewerkers. Bij HVO-Querido werken we vanuit drie kennisbronnen: ervaringskennis, praktijkkennis en wetenschappelijke inzichten.

    Meer informatie?
    Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Chahida Allali, zorgcoördinator in opleiding via 06-15439541. Als je vragen hebt over de procedure, kun je bellen met junior recruiter Sana Pinto Silva via 06-15365021.

    Direct solliciteren?
    Graag ontvangen we je digitale reactie vóór 6 oktober a.s.

    Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: NSW Youth Advisory Committee - Youth Engagement Advisor
description:
Ongoing role
Flexible days and times
Expected 1-2 hours weekly

Why Choose to volunteer with Red Cross?

You can help improve lives and create a positive impact in your community
It’s an opportunity to enhance your skills & knowledge & gain new experiences
You’ll be helping Red Cross to support vulnerable people across Australia

The program

The Youth Engagement volunteer will support the NSW Community Mobilisation Team with the management NSW Youth Advisory Committee and the development of engagement initiatives that champion youth access to the Australian Red Cross.

The opportunity

Attend monthly meetings with the NSW YAC, supporting CMT to deliver YAC projects.
Assist the design and consistent implementation of the YAC workplan, building the conditions for effective youth work
Engage YAC members in line with the organisation of the NSW Youth Engagement Strategy
Attend and assist with Red Cross events as required (AGM, World Red Cross Day, ANZAC Day, Member Forums).
Mentor YAC members on their engagement, championing
Provide advice and support to University Clubs, Clubs and Branches as needed
Collaborate with YACs in other States/ Territories.
Work with the state Board and advocate for participation, recognition and support for young people in all relevant activities of Red Cross advice from a youth perspective for Red Cross programs and business functions, particularly those involving young people.

Knowledge Skills and Experience

Experience working within youth engagement and strategic planning
Experience driving youth led initiatives
Experience working with community-based organisations (desirable)

Experience working with diverse people, including culturally and linguistically diverse people
At ease working independently or as part of a diverse and geographically dispersed team to share the workload

Organisational skills including the ability to prioritise tasks and manage commitments
Knowledge of and interest in the work of Australian Red Cross
Strong commitment to taking humanitarian action and voluntary service

Application Requirements

For this role you will be required to undertake a National Police Check, which will be organized through Red Cross.
You will need to provide a recent copy of your CV and provide details for two professional references.
The role will also require you to hold or apply for a Working With Children Check or Working With Vulnerable People Check depending on your State/Territory. Red Cross can assist you to apply for this check.

Further information

To find out more about this opportunity please contact (Insert name and phone number of Volunteer Manager or Team here) or via email kstein@redcross.org.au.

Thank you for considering volunteering at Red Cross. We also have great career opportunities, please visit our website at www.redcross.org.au/careers

title: Grading Assistant (Casual)
description:
The Opportunity

The Alberta University of the Arts (AUArts) is looking for Grading Assistants to support instructors and the Dean, Academic Programs in the evaluation of student work using established grading criteria and in accordance with institutional policies and procedures.

These are casual (hourly) positions commencing as early as October 2027 until June 2027. Hours of work may be up to 30 hours per course section assignment and up to 25 hours per week Monday – Friday.

Key Responsibilities

Grade assignments, tests, papers, and other student work using established criteria.
Complete grading within assigned timelines.
Maintain accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality in grading practices.
Follow instructor direction and course requirements.
Comply with institutional policies, procedures, and guidelines.

Qualifications:

The following qualifications have been determined to promote likelihood of
success in the role. In alignment with the principles of inclusion, individuals with an alternative equivalent qualification may be considered.

An undergraduate degree in a discipline relevant to the subject matter of the liberal studies course – Art History, Design History, English, or comparable Arts discipline.
Previous experience with assessment of undergraduate written work.
Strong oral and written communication and time management skills.
Ability to maintain strict confidentiality regarding student information during and after the term of employment.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and Learning Management Systems (Moodle) is an asset.
Knowledge of post-secondary legislation, policies, and procedures is an asset.

Competencies:

AUArts has established five common competencies to promote unity of vision and action in the organization:

Healthy Spaces
Active Inclusion
Creative Innovation
Collaborative Practice
Strategic Leadership

As a member of the AUPE bargaining unit (Local 071/006), this casual position pays an hourly rate of $17.02 plus 6% pay in lieu of vacation and union dues will be collected at a rate of 1.5% per pay. As this position is casual in nature, there will be no guarantee of hours or a regular schedule.

How to Apply

Applications must include a Cover Letter and Resume / Curriculum Vitae (CV). It is preferred that your application package be submitted as a single PDF document.

Please visit our Application FAQ's page to ensure your application is complete prior to submission. Upload your single PDF to the “Resume” section of the application portal. If you are unable to combine your documents into one file, you may upload them separately under the “Additional Documents” section.

If you are an active AUArts employee, please submit your application through your Dayforce account. From the menu, select Careers > Search Jobs to view open positions.

Review of applications will continue until the position is filled or the search is closed.

While we thank all candidates for their interest, only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Sikkerhedsbyggeleder – vær med til at holde styr på sikkerheden på jernbanen
description:
Har du styr på jernbanesikkerhed og vil du dele ud af din viden og støtte os med at sikre, at reglerne omkring jernbanesikkerhed på vores anlægsprojekter bliver overholdt? Så læse videre her.

Som Sikkerhedsbyggeleder bliver du en vigtig del af Banedanmarks arbejde med at sikre, at sikkerhedsreglerne bliver forstået, fulgt og omsat til sikker drift på vores store anlægsprojekter.

Du bliver tilknyttet sektionen Sikkerhedsbyggeledelse & SR/OR, hvor vi understøtter sikkerhedsarbejdet på tværs af divisionen. Din hverdag vil foregå på et mindre antal af Banedanmarks største projekter i udførelsesfasen, hvor du er med til at koordinere sikkerheden på tværs af faggrupper og holde fokus på, at regler og procedurer fungerer i den virkelige verden.

Rollen indebærer et fagligt ansvar for SR/OR-organisationen på projekterne, ligesom du bliver den faglige sparringspartner inden for sikkerhedsreglementet (SR) og operationelle regler (OR). Samtidig arbejder du tæt sammen med kolleger inden for blandt andet arbejdsmiljø, fareidentifikation og dokumentation.

Kort sagt: Du er med til at få sikkerhed, mennesker og komplekse anlægsprojekter til at spille sammen – og du får en central rolle i at sikre, at jernbanen kan bygges om og udvikles, uden at vi går på kompromis med sikkerheden.

Sikkerhed, koordinering og samarbejde

Som Sikkerhedsbyggeleder får du en vigtig rolle i nogle af Banedanmarks største anlægsprojekter. Du bliver den, der skaber overblik over jernbanesikkerheden, samler trådene på tværs af faggrupper og sikrer, at sikkerheden er tænkt ind hele vejen fra planlægning til udførelse.

Det er en rolle med både fagligt ansvar og bred kontaktflade. Du bliver en central sparringspartner for både kolleger, entreprenører og andre samarbejdspartnere, og du får mulighed for at bringe din viden i spil.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • stå for den faglige ledelse af sikkerhedsorganisationen på byggepladsen
  • koordinere kommunikationen om jernbanesikkerhed på tværs af sikkerhedskoordinering, myndighedskoordinering , byggeledelse og øvrige faggrupper
  • deltage i byggemøder og være den faglige kontaktperson i dialogen om jernbanesikkerhed med entreprenøren
  • føre tilsyn med, at jernbanesikkerhedsreglerne bliver overholdt i henhold til de godkendte jernbanesikkerhedsplaner
  • vejlede entreprenører, eksterne samarbejdspartnere og kolleger i Banedanmark om jernbanesikkerhed i både planlægnings- og udførelsesfasen
  • indsamle og følge op på sikkerhedsmæssige leverancer fra entreprenøren og fagtilsynet, eksempelvis ibrugtagningsprotokoller og anden relevant dokumentation
Du får mulighed for at gøre en forskel og har bemyndigelse til at stoppe arbejdet, hvis jernbanesikkerheden ikke bliver overholdt. Det kræver både faglig sikkerhed, godt overblik og beslutsomhed at fastholde sin vurdering, også når det ikke er mest enkle løsning.

Til gengæld får du en rolle, hvor din faglighed bliver taget alvorligt, og hvor du hver dag er med til at sikre, at komplekse anlægsprojekter kan gennemføres sikkert.

Solid erfaring indenfor jernbanesikkerhed

Der kan være flere veje ind i stillingen, og derfor er din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste er, at du har en solid faglig erfaring med jernbanesikkerhed og kan omsætte din viden til praksis.

Det vægter positivt, hvis du er uddannet i Banedanmarks sikkerhedsreglementer og har erfaring fra både planlægning og udførelse. Kendskab til bygherrens, arbejdsgiverens og rådgiverens pligter og ansvar er også en fordel.

Vi ser gerne at du har erfaring med at håndtere jernbanesikkerhed i forbindelse med arbejde på spor i drift og gerne et bredt kendskab til anlægsbestemmelser, kørestrøm, spor og sikringstekniske forhold.

Herudover trives du med at bruge din faglighed og har en god forståelse for både sikkerheden, samarbejdet og den praktiske virkelighed på byggepladsen.

Som person arbejder du systematisk og bevarer overblikket, samtidig med at du er løsningsorienteret og kan finde en vej videre, når komplekse problemstillinger opstår.

Du kommer til at samarbejde med mange forskellige faggrupper og mennesker med forskellige perspektiver. Derfor er det også vigtigt, at du kan kommunikere klart og konstruktivt – og at du kan tilpasse din kommunikation til den, du står overfor.

Din nye arbejdsplads er fyldt med gode kollegaer og opgaver

Du bliver en del af et erfarent team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler vores viden og møder både opgaver og kolleger med en positiv tilgang.

Dit tjenestested vil være på Banedanmarks hovedkontor i København eller på vores kontor i Fredericia – afhængigt af din bopæl. Begge lokationer er tæt offentlig transport og med mulighed for parkering af cykel og bil.Når de store projekter er i gang, vil din hverdag dog primært foregå ude på det projekt, du bliver tilknyttet. Da Banedanmarks projekter er fordelt over hele landet, skal du forvente en del kørsel til forskellige byggepladser. Derfor er et kategori B-kørekort en forudsætning for stillingen[MB1] .

Jernbanen stopper ikke altid, når arbejdsdagen slutter. I forbindelse med blandt andet tilsyn og ibrugtagning vil der derfor være planlagt natte- og weekendarbejde. Til gengæld får du en hverdag, hvor du kommer tæt på projekterne og kan se din faglighed gøre en konkret forskel.

Du får en arbejdsplads med fokus på at skabe gode rammer for et arbejdsliv i balance. Vi tilbyder kantine, fleksible arbejdstider, flextid og træningsfaciliteter. Vi arbejder også systematisk og målrettet med diversitet, inklusion og god ledelse, fordi Banedanmark skal være en arbejdsplads med plads til alle, der kan og vil være med til at udvikle og sikre en attraktiv jernbane.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Hvis du er akademiker, ansættes du efter den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten.

Du indplaceres på baggrund af akademisk anciennitet og erfaring som specialkonsulent eller chefkonsulent jf. gældende overenskomst, som du finder her og Medarbejder- og Kompetencestyrelsens lønoversigt, som du finder her.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der vil være tilknyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning på 18,07 %.

Ellers ansættes du efter den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt indplaceret i løngruppe 4 jf. gældende overenskomst, som du finder her og Medarbejder- og Kompetencestyrelsens lønoversigt, som du finder her.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der vil til den samlede løn være tilknyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning på 16 %.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Vil du høre mere om stillingen, så kontakt Teamleder Christian Nøddebo, 2532 9998 eller sektionschef Michael Willadsen, 2349 4785.

Hvis du har spørgsmål vedrørende løn og ansættelsesvilkår, kan du kontakte vores personalekonsulenter på banedanmarkpersonale@BANE.dk

Forskellige perspektiver gør os stærkere. Derfor værdsætter Banedanmark mangfoldighed og opfordrer alle interesserede kandidater, uanset personlig baggrund, til at søge.

Du søger stillingen ved at klikke på linket ”Søg stillingen” og følge instruktionerne. Vent ikke med at sende ansøgning og CV da vi løbende vurdere og indkalder til samtaler.

Går du videre fra de indledende samtaler, kan der blive indhentet referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgiver. Du vil blive informeret inden, at der bliver indhentet en reference.

title: Kiinteistönhoidon palveluohjaaja, Tampere
description:
Coor on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista kiinteistöpalvelualan yrityksistä. Coor Suomen kiinteistöhuoltoliiketoiminnan palveluksessa työskentelee yhteensä yli 150 ammattilaista erilaisissa kiinteistöjen yllä- ja kunnossapidon tehtävissä sekä ulkoalueiden hoidossa useilla eri paikkakunnilla Hangosta Rovaniemelle. Tutustu kiinteistönhoitajan työhön Coorissa tarkemmin täällä. Liity sinäkin mukaan kasvavaan porukkaamme rakentamaan entistä parempia kiinteistöpalveluita!

Haemme nyt työhön osallistuvaa kiinteistönhoidon palveluohjaajaa Tampereelle!

Työsuhde: vakituinen ja kokoaikainen (37,5 h/viikko)

Aloitus: sopimuksen mukaan

Työvuorot: arkisin klo 7-15 välillä

Palveluohjaajana huolehdit, että homma kentällä toimii, ja kaikki tietävät tehtävänsä ja vastuunsa. Työskentelet yhdessä alueen esihenkilön kanssa ja osallistut viikko- huolto- ja urakoitsijapalavereihin. Päivittäisiin työtehtäviisi kuuluu myös toimia omien vastuukohteidesi kiinteistönhoitaja vastaten kiinteistöjen ylläpito- ja huoltotehtävistä. Toivomme, että sinulla on päivystysvalmiutta, kun olet perehtynyt asiakaskohteisiin.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Coorin tiimien lisäksi asiakaskohteiden henkilökunnan kanssa ja huolehdit sujuvasta yhteydenpidosta kiinteistöjen käyttäjiin. Asiakaskohteisiimme kuuluu muun muassa hoivakoteja, liiketiloja ja asukaskiinteistöjä. Pääset osaksi hyvähenkistä porukkaa, missä asioita tehdään ja toisiin luotetaan.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Monipuoliset työsuhde-edut, kuten lounas- ja virike-edun, mahdollisuuden liittyä vapaaehtoiseen sairauskassaan sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon
  • Kattavan perehdytyksen kohteisiin, työturvallisuuteen ja Coorin toimintatapoihin
  • Työn luotettavassa ja vakaassa yrityksessä
  • Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja edetä urallasi
  • Kannustavan työyhteisön, jossa ajatuksiasi ja ideoitasi arvostetaan

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Olet työskennellyt kiinteistöhuollon tehtävissä jo useamman vuoden, ja sinulla on tehtävään sopiva koulutus sekä kokemusta tiimin työn ohjaamisesta. Hallitset sprinklerijärjestelmät, paloilmoittimet ja kiinteistöautomaatiot. Pidät ihmisten kanssa työskentelystä, ja jaat mielelläsi osaamistasi muille. Sinulla on silmää hyvälle asiakaspalvelulle, eikä myynnillisestä otteestakaan ole haittaa. Sinulla on hyvä työturvallisuusajattelu.

Tarvitset tehtävässä B-ajokorttia sekä suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Tarvitset tehtävässä työturvallisuus- ja tulityökortin, mutta koulutukset voidaan järjestää työsuhteen alettua.

Tehtävään valitulle henkilölle tehdään huumausainetestaus ja hänen on esitettävä ennen työsuhteen alkua oikeusrikosrekisterikeskuksen rikosrekisteriote, jonka laki lasten kanssa työskentelystä (504/2002) edellyttää.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Hienoa! Lähetä meille hakemus täyttämällä hakulomake nettisivuillamme. Luemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, ja tehtävä täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Rekrytointiprosessistamme lisää täällä.

title: EHS System Lead
description:
EHS Systems Lead

Reports To: Associate Director, Environment, Health & Safety

Position Summary

The EHS System Lead is responsible for leading the deployment, maturity, integration, and continuous improvement of the North Chicago Manufacturing (NCM) EHS Management System. The role provides governance and oversight for EHS programs aligned to Global EHS Management and Technical Standards while developing a network of EHS Program Leads embedded across the site.

Working collaboratively with business leaders, functional experts, and operational teams, the EHS System Lead drives a structured and sustainable approach to EHS program ownership, ensuring clear accountability, effective implementation, and continual advancement of site EHS performance. The role serves as a coach, facilitator, and strategic partner to strengthen EHS capabilities throughout the organization and enable long-term readiness for internal and external assurance activities.

Key Responsibilities

EHS Management System Leadership

  • Lead the ongoing development, deployment, and continuous improvement of the NCM EHS Management System.
  • Ensure EHS programs are aligned with applicable Global EHS Management Standards, Technical Standards, corporate requirements, and regulatory expectations.
  • Establish and maintain a structured governance framework for monitoring program health, maturity, effectiveness, and performance.
  • Promote a systems-based approach to EHS program ownership across the organization.

Program Ownership Network Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate a network of EHS Program Leads from multiple departments and operational functions across the site.
  • Define and communicate roles, responsibilities, and accountability expectations for EHS program owners and process owners.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to drive consistent implementation and sustainment of EHS programs.
  • Establish communities of practice that encourage shared learning, standardization, and continuous improvement.

Coaching and Capability Development

  • Coach EHS Program Leads, managers, supervisors, and functional leaders on their responsibilities within the EHS Management System.

description:
Overview of the role:
WestJet is seeking a Program Manager - Group Audit. Manage and continue developing the company-wide operational safety audit program through detailed planning, scoping, execution, and review. Ensure audits are properly resourced, meet quality standards, and deliver meaningful results to stakeholders.

Implement standards in the operation, coordinate mandatory observations and interviews, and address corrective actions promptly for both external and internal audits biannually.
Identify and report systemic and operational safety deficiencies to the Executive Vice Presidents (EVPs), Vice Presidents (VPs), operations managers, and personnel responsible for the area of deficiency as needed. Collaborate with external consultants, safety auditors, and regulatory authorities as needed to ensure comprehensive audit coverage and compliance with industry standards.
Establish a systematic approach for conducting comprehensive quality control checks on Operational Auditors, ensuring strict adherence to documented policies and procedures.
Identify areas for improvement and efficiency within the audit team, contributing to continuous process improvement.

Extensive travel is required, with the potential to spend up to 26 weeks per year across WestJet’s network. The successful candidate must be willing and able to travel frequently, including overnight and international travel.

3 to 6 years of audit experience and/or relevant airline operational experience

Demonstrated leadership skills with proven experience influencing and managing stakeholders across multiple operational areas

title: Production Washroom Operator
description:
Overview
Performs work as part of a team in an industrial laundry facility. Responsible for the safe, expeditious, and accurate handling of merchandise into and/or out of the laundry facility.
Responsibilities / Essential Functions

Checks all machine safety devices before operating equipment and records and signs the appropriate equipment safety form. If machine does not pass safety inspection, operator will not operate unit, and notifies supervisor.
When loading washer, retrieve sling from storage and maneuvers sling to the washer’s rails and in front of the washer. If loading a dryer, obtain an extracted sling from the overhead feed rail and verifies each batch ticket to avoid mixing lots and batches. Stages similar batches together for maximum product/wash utilization.
Positions washer/dryer in proper loading position (tilted up), removes batch ticket, loads the washer/dryer by untying the bottom cord of sling, forces the items into the washer/dryer cylinder, closes washer/dryer doors, lowers washer/dryer to the horizontal position, selects the appropriate washer/dryer formula, and starts the machine.
Takes the batch ticket and writes the ticket information on the washer/dryer form visually displayed by the machine.
For washer, enters the weight off of the batch ticket into SOFTROL. For dryer, re-ties the sling and transports to hoist staging area.
Unloads washer: opens washer door, tilts washer forward, moves lined cart with clean sling, and removes items from the washer into the cart, places batch tickets on top of items, moves cart to sling raise area, and tilts washer back into load position.
Unloads dryer: opens the front door, ensures items are at the proper moisture levels (if not, re-dry), raises the front-end of the dryer, moves to the rear of the machine, opens the rear door, places the appropriate tub at the dryer opening, removes items from dryer, places batch ticket on top of items, stores in appropriate area, closes rear door, and leaves dryer in tilted position to aid in loading process.
Verifies proper moisture retention of items, carts/tubs are not overload, load items are at proper temperature, all extracted slings are free of excessive water, and all items are properly cooled down.
Identifies any slings with rips or tears and removes them from the system.
Maintains safe and clean work environment, and observes best practices in all production activities.
Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

Ability to understand all required training, written, and verbal instructions.
Working knowledge of basic math skills.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to meet attendance schedule.

Working Environment / Safety Requirements

Work is performed in a warehouse setting and regularly exposed to outside weather conditions, extreme heat and cold conditions as well as dust and noise.
Work is based on a shift schedule, and may include weekends.
Overtime required as needed.

Physical Requirements
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Requires the ability to move or maneuver slings or carriers weighing up to 220 lbs.
Requires the ability to move, lift, carry, push, or pull product weighing up to 50 lbs.
Requires bending, reaching, pulling, and pressing at shoulder level and below waist area.
Requires the use of hands for grasping and other manipulations.
Requires standing and walking for long periods of time.

Education
High school degree or equivalent preferred.
Location: Greenville, SC (Duncan)

title: Business Analyst - Operations (GFS Americas)
description:
AstraZeneca is a global, innovation-driven biopharmaceutical business that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world's most serious diseases. But we're more than one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies. At AstraZeneca, we're proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration. Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives - and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

Global Financial Services (GFS) was formed in Q3 2018 through the merger of Global Finance Operations, Integrated Finance Solutions and Cash Generation. GFS is at the heart of the Finance function - accountable to the AstraZeneca (AZ) Group for the design and delivery of high quality, simple to operate transactional finance processes that enable our customers to focus on AZ’s strategic priorities.

Our processes cover record to report, purchase to pay, order to cash, controllership, financial planning and analysis and finance operations, and we drive AZ’s cash focus through disciplined management of supplier and customer payment terms and practices.

GFS operates globally through a combination of in-house captive and offshored business process outsourcing (BPO). The BPO element has been provided in partnership with our service provider partner Genpact since 2008.

AZ Finance is part way through an ambitious, broad ranging, multi-year transformation programme, called Finance Transformation (FT). FT plans for transactional process and technology improvements will underpin a next wave of GFO transformation and a step change in service effectiveness and efficiency.


Role Profile
The Operations & Enabling Team will establish best practice across the Operations site network, Central Operations, in all manufacturing sites related processes. Your primary focus will be on serving the finance business partners as well as providing support to GFS colleagues.

Role Responsibilities

You will be working in a large team to provide support to the Manufacturing/Quality sites of the Biologics and Small Molecules regions including cost analysis, inventory, and capital expenditures.

  • Perform monthly journal entries including accruals, reclasses, deferral and release of Manufacturing variances, stock provision or any other ad hoc entry to ensure accuracy in the financial information.
  • Execute month-end activities as well as financial reporting and variation analysis activities and related deliverables in a timely and accurate manner, including business insightful commentary for the management information pack.
  • Ensure data across reporting platforms is consistent to guarantee safe decision making for senior management.
  • Perform monthly/weekly analysis of the Manufacturing, Manpower and Opex, Logistics, Capex and/or Inventory Variances that occur in the site to provide a proper visibility to site Finance and take any necessary actions if required.
  • Execute all planning cycle processes (manufacturing, site cost, inventory, Logistics and/or Capex) according to the AZ guidelines including the management information pack and analysis of any variations between the different forecast cycles. Also, ad/hoc support with different analysis required by Embedded Finance for decision making.
  • Provide support and business insights (when possible) with the financial reporting/analysis requests from site Finance.
  • To build and maintain a strong and effective relationship with Embedded Finance and Finance Senior Management.
  • Become planning champions (site cost, manufacturing, inventory, Logistics, and/or capex) to ensure all planning deliverables are fully coordinated and ensuring they are clear and performed as per the planning calendar.
  • Perform all month-end close controls (SOX and non-SOX) with quality and ensuring they are appropriate and as per audit requirements.
  • Provide support to the Financial Analysts related to month end closing or planning deliverables.
  • Cross train with other Analysts to provide back up.
  • Collaborate with external and internal auditors to provide necessary information during the audits that are performed during the year. Guide walkthrough sessions with auditors of key processes (MPC005-01, MPC005-02 & MPC004-01)
  • Work with the continuous improvement initiatives to ensure implementation of the process improvements within the accounting/finance department, including initiatives to streamline close.
  • Ensure all relevant processes are properly documented and that documentation is up to date to ensure a proper business continuity process.
  • Might (based on operational needs) manage interns ensuring they deliver with quality, and they have the right balance of workload and growth in the team.
  • Proactively build business acumen, understand how information flows from end to end within Operations as well as in the plants.
  • Attend to Global Planning and Actuals meetings is required (such as Lean P&L, Check-in Planning calendar).
  • Adopt any Global initiative or implementation and ensure smooth transition of the tools, changes or projects (Manpower Tool, Flex form, Axial, etc) by active participating during testing phase and providing constructive feedback.

Essential

  • 4+ years accounting/cost/FP&A experience where applicable.
  • English Language proficiency, both verbal and written, with the confidence to express clear opinions and ability to explain financial issues to non-financial management.
  • Experience in three of Operations core processes (Manufacturing, Site cost, Product Costing, Inventory and/or Capex).
  • Experience of finance and accounting is required.
  • Use of general office and financial systems for budgeting, forecasting, and reporting such as SAP, BW (SOAR) and Planning Hub (Oracle).
  • Self-motivation and a commitment to teamwork is key.
  • Accounting fundamentals – understands the basic principles of accounting (eg accruals; cost
    centers; budgeting).
  • Strong computer skills and proficient with Excel including pivot tables, multiconditional sumifs, and vlookups. Desire to continue to develop new Excel abilities, speed, and accuracy, and to follow existing departmental spreadsheet structure and formatting conventions and methodologies.
  • Schedule flexibility to work on holidays when necessary.
  • Flexibility and ability to travel and work in another AZ facilities outside the country when necessary (USA visa and valid passport are required).
  • Schedule flexibility to work on the days off given by the wellness policy when necessary (Política de Bienestar).

Desirable

  • Financial Acumen of the Production and Inventory Volume, Standard Pricing, Manpower, Opex, FTE, actuals and forecasting techniques with robust basis is essential to perform in a good shape this position.
  • The experience that this role demands is mostly related to wide knowledge of operations roles included but not limited to: Product Costing and Transfer Prices, Inventory, Capital Expenditures accounting, Manufacturing, Site cost, and Logistic.
  • Qualified finance professional or working towards a recognized financial qualification.
  • Proficiency in the use of SAP. Also, Power BI, Power Apps, Sap Scripting.
  • For Operations – experience of working in Manufacturing industry.

Competences and skills

  • Desire to work in a lean, fast moving organization where not all responsibilities or desired tasks can be anticipated or scheduled ahead of time. Be flexible and willing to exercise judgment over materiality and actively take steps to increase the speed of assembly and accuracy of accounts. Be willing to jump right into an assigned task even if the task can’t be fully clarified or justified at that time/ be comfortable with some ambiguity.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including ability to adapt communication styles to suit the preferred methods of managers, executives, and colleagues, as well as contacts outside of the Company that may be at the level of novice accounting clerks.
  • Ability to solve complex issues where analysis of data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors and be able to exercise good judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for measuring, summarizing, and optimizing spending and accounting accuracy.

The GFS function will interface with the Back Office Shared Services function, Business CFOs/Finance Business Partners and 3rd party specialist functions.

The non-existence of COI is considered as an objective requirement of the position. title: Youth Team Coach III - Advanced Team
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
The Youth Team Coach is a part of a team of coaches who are responsible for delivering practice content to our youth climbing teams and crafting the experience for all levels of Youth Team. Youth Team Climbing Coaches partner with Team Coach Supervisors and/or Manager to plan and execute programming that results in transformative experiences for youth athletes and teaches life skills through sport climbing.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Monitor for physical, mental and emotional wellbeing and support transformative experiences for athletes while ensuring team activities promote our core values and a sense of belonging in team members

Work with Youth Team Manager and/or Team Coach Supervisors to follow the season schedule and deliver the daily instruction for this level of team including Comps, Events, Training plan etc.

May include teaching leading climbing/belaying, top rope belay and bouldering risk management skills at this level after receiving appropriate training and approval
Provide input on or write lesson plans that support the program’s goals and participant growth and promote connection to our community

Coach at practices of this level of team, and competitions as needed based on athlete attendance.

Provide supervision for youth climbers who will be bouldering, lead climbing and belaying.

Assist Team Coach Supervisor with administrative duties for this team level, including monitoring team rosters, tracking belay training, organizing practice notes, and communicating with parents.

Effectively communicate any issues or concerns with coaching staff and the Gym Leadership team in a timely manner.

Collaborate with Team Coach Supervisor to facilitate mentorship opportunities and personal development for their team level.

Embody Movement’s Core Values and the desired culture of our youth team

Passion for working with youth and developing youth climbing athletes

Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with athletes, coaches, parents, and gym leadership.
Knowledge and experience in climbing instruction commensurate with the team level being coached

Availability expectations: Tuesday/Thursday Availability preferred

This position is a Part Time (6-8 hrs), non-exempt position, including gym membership, gear discounts, guest passes, and other benefits available to Movement employees.

Starting pay is $21.30 - $22.92 depending on experience.

title: Data Scientist
description:
AbbVie’s Operations Quality Data Analytics group is continuously innovating to empower the AbbVie network with superior Quality, Product, and Process analytics that enable data-driven insights and decision-making at every organizational level. This Data Scientist role will have wide-ranging analytics experience to work within a diverse Operations business. The Data Scientist will build and oversee the building of predictive/prescriptive models using statistical and machine-learning methodologies. The Data Scientist will also ensure end-to-end delivery of assigned data science applications, studies, and POCs through oversight of project teams and key technology partnerships.

Consulting and collaboration skill sets are key to success in this role. This demanding role will have a highly visible impact to senior leaders across Operations.

  • Operate cross-functionally in a highly collaborative manner with fellow data scientists, senior functional leaders, and business partners.
  • Consult with business users in the analysis of requirements and recommend solutions which anticipate the future impact of changing business needs.
  • Develop advanced data analytical models and techniques from supervised and unsupervised machine learning, statistical analysis, deep learning, predictive modeling, and Gen AI.
  • Build relationships with stakeholders and collaborate with other statistical and data science teams in AbbVie while mentoring and coaching team members.
  • Ensure that data presented to key stakeholders and presentations maintain study integrity. This role is required to support multiple use cases and should ensure that each work product is fit for purpose
  • If assigned, participates in functional innovation and process improvement initiatives
  • Ensures adherence to federal regulations and applicable local regulations, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), ICH Guidelines, AbbVie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and to functional quality standards. Stays abreast of new and/or evolving local regulations, guidelines and policies related to clinical development
  • Responsible for coaching and mentoring junior team members
  • Identify business needs and support the creation of standard KPIs, reports, and statistical analyses
  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree in statistics, mathematics, analytics, bioinformatics, data science or equivalent field with 4+ years (BS), 2+ years (MS) or 0+ years (PhD) of related experience
  • Intermediate-level proficiency in R, Python or other statistical packages. Intermediate-level knowledge of statistical and data mining techniques
  • Intermediate proficiency with visualization tools like PowerBI, Spotfire, Tableau or equivalent
  • Intermediate proficiency with data science platforms like Dataiku, Snowflake, Databricks
  • Experience with Machine Learning and other advanced analytics techniques preferred
  • Demonstrated effective communication skills. Demonstrated ability to communicate analytical and technical concepts in layman’s terms
  • Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Demonstrated history of successful execution in a fast-paced environment and in managing multiple priorities effectively

title: Program Integrator / Dataset Specialist (2026-0222)
description:
Acclaim Technical Services (ATS), founded in 2000, is a premier provider of tech-enabled solutions and operational services to a broad range of U.S. Federal agencies. As an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) company—an uncommon advantage in our sector—we foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and shared success. This commitment to our people shows: ATS is consistently recognized as a top workplace in the DC area and continues to experience strong, strategic growth

We are actively hiring a Program Integrator, Expert with TS/SCI clearance and polygraph to join our Data and Systems Integration Division, working in Bethesda, MD or Mclean, VA.

You will be responsible to support the stand-up of a new business and mission analytics effort. A large focus of this effort will be attaining datasets needed from other offices and agencies that will be critical to building insights and applications of utility for community decision-makers, managers, and employees. As a member of this team, you will work closely with government managers to plan and execute approaches to acquiring datasets from other offices and agencies, as part of a larger strategy to gain insights into the community’s mission and business practices. You will be responsible for helping conceptualize that strategy and these approaches, and duties may include facilitating meetings and offsites; preparing briefing slides and talking points; planning meetings with partners; and assessing datasets for adequacy in meeting the effort’s larger goals. Successful candidates should be self-starters, capable of driving forward projects independently with minimal oversight, and comfortable with ambiguity and complexity. They will be organized program managers who keep projects on track, keep customers informed of risks and issues, and serve as a reliable, visible presence the customer can count on.
RESPONSIBILITIES
  • At government direction, lead and facilitate efforts to identify and meet with partners, with a view to establishing partnerships that yield datasets of utility to the effort.
  • Prepare briefings and talking points in support of government managers.
  • Facilitate meetings and offsites.
  • Support efforts to improve how business data is collected, managed, and used, with a focus on efficiency, standardization, and process improvement across partner organizations.
  • Identify how datasets and partner efforts align with the effort’s strategy and assess datasets for utility against the effort’s goals.
  • Plan meetings with partners, to include developing goals and the agenda of each meeting.
  • Identify and facilitate the adoption of best practices in business and mission analytics.
REQUIRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
  • Master’s degree
  • 15+ years of Intelligence Community or other USG experience
  • 10+ years of experience in management consulting, organizational development, or a related field
  • Understanding of how data is collected, organized, and used to generate insights and inform decisions (no coding required)
  • Demonstrated program management skills, including planning, organization, and risk and issue tracking
  • Experience with interagency or enterprise-wide coordination
  • Basic-to-intermediate Excel skills
  • Intermediate-to-advanced PowerPoint skills
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive projects forward
  • Experience with meeting facilitation
  • Excellent verbal communications and writing skills
PREFERRED SKILLS
  • Familiarity with data structures, databases, and visualization software such as Tableau or PowerBI
  • Background or experience in business analytics, or familiarity with business data
  • Familiarity with data governance and data standardization
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certified

Salary range for this position is $220,000 - $230,000

SALARY TRANSPARANCY

There are many factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Mathematical, mechanical, and technical skills are considered an asset
Ability to troubleshoot and problem solve effectively and efficiently

Experience operating metalworking machines; previous brake press experience preferred

title: Maintenance Tech
description:
JOB SUMMARY
The Maintenance Technicianposition is responsible for independently performing both basic/routine and complex/non-routine maintenance, repair and performance of production equipment in accordance with Safety Standards, SOP’s and Statistical Process Control (SPC) requirements. The Maintenance Technician may be required to help, assist, instruct and train others on the mechanical, electrical and hydraulic repair and maintenance of equipment.

JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITES

Independently modify, repair, install, maintain, improve and troubleshoots various types of injection press & axillary equipment
Diagnose mechanical problems and provide quick, innovative solutions for mechanical equipment breakdowns by applying proven skills in the principles of mechanics, fitting, retrofitting, plumbing, basic welding, metal work, troubleshooting and analytical problem solving
Diagnose electrical faults and failures and trouble shoot solutions by performing control system analysis and interpretation of PLC ladder logic diagrams to solve problems
Fix and maintain plant equipment including air compressors, chillers, water towers, and fire systems
Support the timely and effective line handover between shifts, including the completion of proper documentation and accurate briefing on progress/issues within the Maintenance team and Production Supervisors
Independently conduct PM activities according to PM program schedules and standards
Train others to handle equipment changeover, set up, take down
Recommend and implement solutions to both routine and unique equipment problems, including fabricating or modification of alternate components as needed.
Respond to equipment problems in a timely and customer oriented manner
Solve problems independently as per standard guidelines and procedures, as well as developing new procedures as needed to address non-routine and complex issues
Maintain high standards of organization and general housekeeping
Integrate all plant, quality, safety, and security policies and guidelines into all day to day activities on the job
Follow all proper maintenance, sanitation and Environmental Health and Safety protocols at all times
Demonstrated track record of excellent attendance (i.e. no attendance write-ups)
All other work as assigned by management

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Independently modify, repair, install, maintain, improve and troubleshoot mechanical, hydraulic and electrical issues for various types of press and axillary equipment in rubber manufacturing
Diagnose mechanical problems and provide quick, innovative solutions for mechanical equipment breakdowns by applying proven skills in the advanced principles of mechanics, fitting, plumbing, basic welding, metal work, troubleshooting and analytical problem solving
Support the timely and effective line handover between shifts, including the completion of proper documentation and accurate briefing on progress/issues within the Maintenance Team and Production Supervisors
Solve problems independently
Work cooperatively with co-workers and supervisors as a Quality Focused, Service Oriented Team Player

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY
None

SKILL AND EXPERIENCE

Trade school certification or accreditation
5 years’ experience maintaining electrical and mechanical systems and equipment
PLC experience with AB PLC-5 or Seimens
Trained in hydraulics or 5 years’ relevant experience
Trained in pneumatics of 5 years’ relevant experience
Skilled in lockout tag out
Written skills for document completion and use
Able to acquire new skills as per training provided
Finding information
Must be able to read blueprints and schematics and technical sketches
Literate in Microsoft Office Suite

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Job consists of many repetitive tasks
Must be able to stand for extended periods
Working on elevated surfaces such as ladders, platforms, hoists as required
Must be able to walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and otherwise maneuver the plant
Uses hands and fingers to handle and feel
Must be able to communicate effectively
Listens to machines to troubleshoot problems
Must have strong visual abilities at close, distance, and peripheral with ability to sharp focus and perceive depth
Handling and lifting loads up to 50lbs
Environment contains loud noises
Strong attention to detail

knowledge of sound attenuation principles and compensatory actions; knowledge of DoD Manual (DoDM) 5200.01, Volume 3, DoDM 5105.21, Volume 3, DoDM 5205.07, Volume 3, and IC Tech Spec – For ICD/ICS 705 (Latest Version).

Top Secret, with eligibility for SAP and SCI access.

title: Senior Director, AI Infrastructure Strategy
description:
AFL is seeking a strategic, forward-looking leader to serve as Senior Director, AI Infrastructure Strategy and right hand to the Vice President, Corporate Strategy.

This role will define AFL's enterprise perspective on AI infrastructure and translate market, technology, and competitive shifts into actionable corporate and divisional strategies.

The successful candidate will bring a panoramic view of the AI infrastructure landscape, spanning power, compute, data centers, networks, and emerging AI technologies.

This is not a fiber optics, network engineering, or product engineering role; AFL already has deep technical expertise within its operating businesses. This leader will connect technology, economics, regulation, and infrastructure trends to AFL's long-term strategy and customer opportunities.

The role requires executive presence with Boards, C-Suites, customers, investors, and partners, combined with the ability to work hands-on with business leaders to translate strategy into execution.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Strategy Leadership

Define AFL's strategic perspective on the AI infrastructure ecosystem and translate market, technology, and competitive trends into growth strategies, investment priorities, and long-range plans.

AI Infrastructure Market Intelligence

Develop and maintain AFL's perspective on the AI infrastructure ecosystem, including power, grid modernization, data centers, cloud and edge computing, semiconductors, networking, cooling, and sovereign AI. Monitor hyperscalers, AI labs, utilities, communications providers, investors, and regulators to guide AFL's view of future market direction and strategic implications.

Strategic Foresight and Scenario Planning

Lead long-range scenario planning on AI infrastructure, assessing implications of centralized versus distributed architectures, training and inference economics, agentic AI, sovereign AI, AGI, energy constraints, and regulatory shifts. Translate uncertainty into strategic recommendations, investment priorities, and competitive advantage for AFL.

Divisional Strategy Partnership

Partner with AFL's Products and Services leaders to align business strategies with evolving market opportunities, guiding growth priorities, market focus, resource allocation, partnerships, capabilities, and customer investment. Serve as a trusted advisor and servant leader who translates enterprise strategy into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.

Executive Communication and Influence

Develop executive narratives, Board materials, and strategic recommendations that translate complex market and technology developments into clear business actions. Support AFL leadership in customer, investor, and industry engagements and communicate AFL's strategic vision to executives, customers, partners, and external stakeholders.

Strategic Partnerships and Ecosystem Development

Identify and evaluate strategic partnerships, emerging technologies, investment opportunities, and new market entrants across the AI infrastructure ecosystem. Maintain a broad ecosystem perspective to inform AFL's growth strategy, capital allocation, competitive positioning, and enterprise-level strategic decisions.

Organizational Leadership

Serve as the strategic partner and right hand to the Vice President of Corporate Strategy, helping shape AFL's long-term direction, strengthen enterprise planning capabilities, and develop future leaders. Demonstrate the judgment, leadership, and executive presence required to grow into broader enterprise strategy responsibilities.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA, master's degree, or relevant advanced degree preferred.
  • Preferred fields include Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Energy Systems, Public Policy, or related disciplines.

Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience developing enterprise strategy, evaluating growth opportunities, and guiding business and investment decisions in complex technology, infrastructure, or industrial markets.
  • Experience advising executive leadership teams.
  • Strong understanding of AI, digital infrastructure, or adjacent technology markets.
  • Experience operating in complex, cross-functional environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in AI infrastructure, cloud, hyperscale, digital infrastructure, energy, telecommunications, or adjacent markets.
  • Experience supporting executive teams, boards, or senior decision-making forums.
  • Experience conducting scenario planning and strategic foresight exercises.
  • Deep understanding of AI technology trends, infrastructure requirements, and ecosystem evolution, including agentic AI, inference, compute platforms, sovereign AI, and next-generation architectures.
  • Experience developing investment theses, market-entry strategies, or growth strategies.

Leadership Competencies

Strategic Thinking

Identifies long-term trends and converts uncertainty into strategic choices.

Systems Thinking

Connects technology, infrastructure, economics, policy, customers, and competitors into a clear strategic view.

Executive Presence

Builds credibility and influence with executives, customers, partners, and boards.

Business Acumen

Understands the financial, operational, commercial, and strategic drivers of performance.

Innovation Orientation

Challenges conventional thinking and identifies emerging opportunities.

Influence Without Authority

Builds alignment across organizational boundaries and drives results through collaboration.

Servant Leadership

Enables operating teams while maintaining a hands-on, practical approach.

Learning Agility

Adapts quickly to evolving technologies, markets, and business models.

Success Measures

Within the first 12 months, the successful candidate will:

  • Establish AFL's corporate point of view on AI infrastructure.
  • Build scenario-planning frameworks to guide executive decision making.
  • Improve alignment between corporate and divisional strategies.
  • Develop recommendations that influence resource allocation and investment priorities.
  • Strengthen AFL's executive thought leadership on AI infrastructure.
  • Demonstrate readiness for broader enterprise strategy leadership responsibilities.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is not primarily a fiber expert, network engineer, or product specialist.

They are a strategist who understands how AI infrastructure creates value across power, compute, communications, hyperscalers, inference, AI economics, and future technology trajectories. They combine executive-level strategic thinking with hands-on partnership with business teams to drive outcomes.

Most importantly, they possess the breadth, judgment, leadership capability, and presence to develop into AFL's future Vice President of Corporate Strategy.

title: Storingsrapporteur
description:

  • Het vertalen van functionele gebruikerswensen naar systeemspecificaties.
  • Het ondersteunen van de gebruikers bij het optimaal gebruiken van de applicatie.
  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor het storings(management- en registratie)proces in de regio.

In deze functie heb je affiniteit met techniek en ICT, maar richt je je primair op de gebruikers en de processen van de eindgebruikers.

Jouw plek

We bieden graag ruimte aan iedereen. Daarbij zien we talent als basis en diversiteit als kracht om samen betere resultaten te behalen. Voor jou als storingsrapporteur is er plek in ons team Asset Control Center (ACC). Je werkt landelijk en bent één keer per week op het Operationeel Controle Centrum Rail (OCCR) in Utrecht; het hart van onze organisatie. Het doel van het ACC is het zo snel mogelijk beschikbaar stellen van het spoor na een storing. Hier is het creëren van een veilige werkplek cruciaal.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Direct een vast contract. Wij hebben vertrouwen in jou.
  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.121,- en € 5.671,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week, schaal 7.
  • Daarbovenop 13,61% van jouw bruto salaris in de vorm van een Individueel KeuzeBudget (IKB). Dit budget is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag en 3,25% decemberuitkering.
  • Een goed pensioen bij Rail & OV: een sterk fonds dat vooroploopt in duurzaam beleggen.
    Zit je nu in een ander fonds? Houd er rekening mee dat Rail & OV op 1 januari 2026 al overstapte op het nieuwe pensioenstelsel.
  • Jaarlijks een automatische loonsverhoging van 2,5% tot het maximum in de salarisschaal.
  • Een NS-Business Card met TreinVrij (en een NS-Businesscard Daluren voor directe gezinsleden). Of een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km onbelast bij maximaal 120 kilometer per dag.

Wij kozen voor een kleine selectie uit onze arbeidsvoorwaarden. Maar we bieden je meer. Voor alle arbeidsvoorwaarden en onze CAO klik op deze link.

Jouw inbreng

Bij ProRail vinden wij het belangrijk dat jij gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Daarom zijn wij benieuwd naar wie jij bent. Voor deze functie breng je sowieso mee:

  • Een mbo 4-diploma.

title: Actuarial Associate - Risk and Planning

description:
We're Looking for an experienced Senior Actuarial Assistant, ERM & Planning!
About the Company:Security Benefit is a leader in the U.S. retirement market with more than $75 billion in assets under management. We offer opportunities to thrive, innovate, and make an impact. As part of our team, you’ll play a key role in driving the future of the U.S. retirement industry. Security Benefit is a PLACE where we promise to help our customers To and Through Retirement®.

Named to Ward’s 50 list of top-performing life-health insurance companies
Recognized on list of Ingram’s Top 100 Private Companies in the Kansas City area in 2025

About the Role: As a Senior Actuarial Assistant, ERM & Planning, you will be a key production contributor within the Risk & Planning actuarial team. You will use strong hands-on Prophet skills to develop, maintain, execute, troubleshoot, and validate financial projection models supporting the Company’s Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA), Commercial Insurer’s Solvency Self-Assessment (CISSA) filings, capital planning, and enterprise stress testing across Security Benefit Life and an offshore reinsurer. You will manage assigned modeling workstreams and production timelines with limited oversight, deliver reliable projection outputs, and prepare analysis for review by the Director & Actuary. You will receive guidance on significant methodology, assumption, and model architecture decisions.

This full-time position reports directly to the Director & Actuary, ERM & Planning. It may be based in Topeka or Overland Park, Kansas. Security Benefit associates work in a hybrid environment with both remote and on-site work.

Develop, maintain, execute, troubleshoot, and validate financial projection models supporting ORSA, CISSA, capital planning, and enterprise risk management activities across Security Benefit Life and the offshore reinsurer.
Manage assigned multi-year projection and stress-testing workstreams with limited oversight, maintain progress against established timelines, and communicate status and risks to the Director & Actuary.
Perform financial projections, stress testing, and capital adequacy analyses to evaluate solvency, earnings, and risk outcomes.
Perform asset-liability management analyses by incorporating asset projections, reinvestment strategies, and investment assumptions into enterprise financial projections.
Prepare and validate economic scenarios, model inputs, actuarial assumptions, model point files, and actuarial tables; evaluate the effects of market, interest rate, credit, and policyholder behavior risks on financial results, capital adequacy, and RBC metrics.
Test Prophet model changes, investigate run errors and unexpected results, complete reconciliations and attribution analyses, and document findings and resolutions.
Produce actuarial projection outputs for the annual ORSA filings for SBL and the offshore reinsurer and deliver results to the Senior ERM Analyst on schedule for report integration.
Prepare clear summaries of model results, key drivers, and open issues for review by the Director & Actuary before materials are shared with the CRO or ERM Committee.
Coordinate with Finance, Investments, Legal, and other partners to obtain accurate inputs and align on planning assumptions; escalate material modeling issues, timeline risks, or assumption conflicts promptly.
Improve modeling efficiency through automation and process enhancements, and maintain clear model documentation supporting team continuity, knowledge transfer, and audit readiness.
Provide technical support and peer review to less experienced team members as requested.

What We’re Looking For:

Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Minimum of four actuarial exams passed and actively working toward the ASA designation.
3+ years of actuarial experience, preferably in financial modeling, financial projections, asset-liability management, valuation, or a related actuarial function.
Strong hands-on Prophet experience, including model execution, troubleshooting, testing, validation, and analysis of projection results.
Ability to manage assigned modeling work with limited oversight, meet deadlines, and communicate progress and issues clearly.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.
Preferred: Experience with ORSA, CISSA, stress testing, capital planning, or enterprise risk management.
Preferred: Knowledge of life insurance and annuity products, including fixed and indexed annuities.
Preferred: Experience with asset-liability management, financial projections, valuation, or capital analysis.
Preferred: Programming experience with Python, SQL, VBA, or similar analytical tools.
Preferred: Exposure to multi-entity, reinsurance, captive, or offshore insurance structures, including BMA- and CIMA-regulated entities.

Why Choose Security Benefit?When you join our team, you’re not just getting a paycheck — you’re getting a career path full of growth opportunities, plus a robust benefits package that puts your well-being first. Here’s what you can expect as a full-time Security Benefit associate:

401(k) with company match, plus Profit Sharing & Savings Plan.

Flexible Spending Accounts for medical and dependent care.
Life Insurance to protect your loved ones.
Educational assistance to support your career development.
Associate assistance programs for your personal and professional well-being.

Ready to Make an Impact?Apply today by visiting our career page to submit your resume. We’re excited to meet you!

title: ANIOS Spoedeisende Hulp (SEH)
description:
De Spoedeisende Hulp van het Reinier de Graaf is een dynamische plek waar je iedere dag opnieuw wordt uitgedaagd. We werken in een open cultuur waarin multidisciplinair overleg vanzelfsprekend is en waarin ruimte is om je eigen interesses binnen de spoedeisende geneeskunde verder te ontwikkelen. De missie van Reinier de Graaf, ‘het meest verbonden ziekenhuis’, zie je hier dagelijks terug: verschillende disciplines werken nauw met elkaar samen als één team.

De vakgroep Spoedeisende Hulp van het Reinier de Graaf Gasthuis is op zoek naar twee ANIOS met als startdatum:

  • 1 december 2026 voor 6 maanden
  • 1 januari 2027 voor 1 jaar

Op onze Spoedeisende Hulp zie je een brede en afwisselende patiëntengroep. Je behandelt zowel verwezen als niet-verwezen patiënten en krijgt te maken met uiteenlopende acute zorgvragen. Ongeveer 30% van de patiënten wordt opgenomen. De SEH-arts heeft hierin de logistieke supervisie.

Als ANIOS Spoedeisende Hulp sta je midden in de acute zorg. Je verzorgt de eerste opvang van patiënten, verricht anamnese en lichamelijk onderzoek en vraagt waar nodig aanvullend onderzoek aan. Je stelt een differentiaaldiagnose op en zet de behandeling in. Indien nodig overleg je zelfstandig met andere medisch specialisten in het ziekenhuis en zorg je voor beleid rondom opname of ontslag. Je hebt daarbij aandacht voor zowel de patiënt als de naasten en weet ook in spannende situaties rust en duidelijkheid te bieden.

Je werkt onder directe supervisie van een SEH-arts. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met de verpleegkundigen en soms arts-assistenten van andere specialismen. Ons team bestaat uit 11 SEH-artsen, 6 AIOS Spoedeisende Hulp, 4 tot 5 AIOS Huisartsgeneeskunde, 1 tot 2 ANIOS Spoedeisende Hulp, 2 verpleegkundig specialisten, 35 SEH-verpleegkundigen en 12 verpleegkundigen in opleiding.

Je werkt in een leerzame omgeving. Daarbij krijg je ruimte voor bedside teaching en het ontwikkelen van echo skills. Ook sluit je aan bij de onderwijsmomenten in de dagstart en middagoverdracht. Door de afwisseling en dynamiek is geen dag hetzelfde.

Wil je ontdekken of de acute zorg bij je past, jezelf verder ontwikkelen en ervaring opdoen als voorbereiding op een vervolgopleiding? Dan biedt onze Spoedeisende Hulp je daarvoor een mooie en veelzijdige leeromgeving.

Wij vragen

  • Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding Geneeskunde en bent geregistreerd in het BIG-register.
  • Bij voorkeur beschik je over klinische ervaring. Daarnaast heb je aantoonbare belangstelling voor het vakgebied Spoedeisende geneeskunde en/of interesse in de opleiding tot SEH-arts.
  • Een behaalde ATLS-, ALS-, echo- of een andere erkende ABCDE-cursus is een pre.

De procedure

Solliciteren naar de vacature van ANIOS spoedeisende hulp (SEH)? Upload jouw cv en motivatiebrief via de solliciteer button t.a.v. Charisse van Egmond, Recruiter.

Wil je meer weten over de functie? Dr. R. Knotter, SEH arts (015 260 4348) helpt je graag.

Vragen over de procedure? Bel of stuur een WhatsApp bericht naar Charisse via 06 - 23 48 43 95

Solliciteren kan tot en met 4 oktober aanstaande. Wacht echter niet met solliciteren tot de sluitingsdatum: je sollicitatie wordt direct in behandeling genomen. Mochten we voor het bereiken van de sluitingsdatum een passende kandidaat hebben gevonden, dan sluiten we de vacature voortijdig.

De gesprekken vinden plaats op 12 oktober.
