title: Waste Water Treatment Plant Operator 3
description:
GENERAL DEFINITION OF WORK
Progressive responsibility of operating and maintaining wastewater treatment plant and related systems, including treatment processes, in plant pumping stations, and sludge handling and disposal facilities. Monitors and controls treatment processes, performs laboratory tests, and makes adjustments, as needed, to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. Performs maintenance and repair tasks on equipment and facilities, and maintains records and reports. May supervise lower-level staff and assist in training and development.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Includes, but is not limited to, the following:

Independently operates and monitors wastewater treatment processes, including chemical addition, flow control, and sludge handling.
Performs complex laboratory tests and analyzes results to ensure compliance with regulations.
Independently maintains and repairs equipment, pumps, and valves.
Conducts routine inspections and maintenance of facilities and grounds.
Monitors and responds to alarms and high-priority emergency situations.
Maintains accurate records and reports, including shift logs and compliance documentation.
May assist in supervising and training subordinate staff.
Optimizes treatment process to ensure efficient and effective operations through progressively complex adjustments.
Follows safety protocols and ensures a safe work environment.
Troubleshoots & resolves advanced problems with corrective action.
Operates skid steer and telehandlers.
Performs manual labor, housekeeping, and groundskeeping tasks.
May perform other duties as assigned by supervisor.

Reliable attendance and punctuality are essential functions of this role.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES
Knowledge:

Complex wastewater treatment processes and principles.
Chemical addition and treatment chemicals.
Complex Laboratory tests and analysis.
Safety protocols and regulations.
Independent equipment operation and maintenance.
Regulatory requirements and compliance.
Complex process control and optimization techniques.
Intermediate understanding of hydraulics, mechanics, electrical, I&C, process control, laboratory, and microbiology.

Skills:

Independent operation and control of the treatment process.
Independent equipment maintenance and repair.
Complex Troubleshooting and problem-solving.
Clear and concise communication and record keeping.
Teamwork.

Abilities:

Analyze data and make decisions to more complex issues.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve problems through corrective action.
Communicate effectively with others.
Work safely and follow safety protocols.
Adapt quickly to changing situations and priorities.
Understand regulations and standards.

LANGUAGE SKILLS
Effective communication skills:

Verbal and written communication.
Clear and concise reporting.
Share information to solve problems.

Reading comprehension:

Understand advanced technical documents and regulations.
Interpret complex instructions and manuals.

Basic writing skills:

Maintain accurate reports and logs.
Assists preparing reports and correspondence.

Comprehension skills:

Follow complex written and verbal instructions.
Communicate with coworkers, supervisors, and other departments.
Understand and use complex technical terminology related to wastewater treatment.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS
Basic math operations:

Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
Decimals, fractions, and percentages.

Algebraic skills:

Formula calculation and manipulation.
Solution concentration and dilution calculations.

Geometric skills:

Volume and area calculations.
Flow rate and velocity calculations.

Analytical skills:

Data interpretation and analysis.
Trend recognition and forecasting.

Practical applications:

Calculating chemical dosage and flow rates.
Determining treatment process efficiency.
Understanding and calculating sludge volumes and pumping rates.
Use a calculator and computer software for mathematical calculations.
Apply mathematical concepts to real-world problems in wastewater treatment.
Understand and work with units of measurement, conversion factors, and mathematical formulas related to wastewater treatment.

EDUCATION
A high school diploma or G.E.D is required.
EXPERIENCE
12 plus months at a Grade 1-3 Wastewater Facility or a bachelor’s degree in science degree.
REQUIRED CERTIFICATION AND LICENSE

Grade 3 WWTP Operator Certification through TDEC. (Must obtain Grade 3 certification within 18 months of hire with prior experience or reciprocity from another state)
Must attend all training courses necessary for Grade 3 certification.
Must attend all continuing education courses to keep certification current.

DRIVER LICENSE
A Valid Tennessee Driver’s License with a clear driving record is required.
A CDL driver's license is preferred.
AVAILABILITY REQUIREMENTS
Given the critical infrastructure role of the facility and the need to maintain essential staffing during events such as severe weather, power outages, or other emergency conditions, employees in this position must be available to work rotating shifts, including 24/7 assignments. This position is subject to on-call and call-back requirements, which may include work outside of normal business hours, including days, nights, evenings, weekends, and holidays. The employee must be available to participate in a rotating on-call schedule and may be required to report to duty or remain onsite during emergency operations.
RESIDENCY REQUIREMENTS
Due to the on-call and emergency response nature of this position, the ideal candidate should reside in Wilson County or in one of the surrounding counties that border Wilson County, including Cannon, Davidson, DeKalb, Rutherford, Smith, Sumner, or Trousdale Counties.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, WORK ENVIRONMENT, AND REASONABLE ACCOMMODATIONS
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is required to walk; sit; use tools; operate controls; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and listen, observe, or smell. The employee must frequently lift, move, push, pull or carry up to 50 pounds. May occasionally push, pull, or move 75 to 100 pounds, with assistance. Must be able to use tools such as breaker bar, pipe wrench, and hand truck. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to fumes or airborne particles. The employee occasionally works near moving mechanical parts; in high, precarious places; and in outside weather conditions, and is occasionally exposed to hot, cold, wet, and/or humid conditions and toxic or caustic chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud. Must be available for rotating shift work with 24/7 assignments. This position is subject to call out (working after normal hours and days that include days, nights, evenings, weekends, and holidays). Must be available to work rotating on call assignment. Must undergo required physical examination and complete vaccinations.
It shall be the responsibility of the City of Lebanon Utilities Director to assess the type(s) of reasonable accommodations which may be necessary to allow the individual to perform the essential functions of this position and to provide such necessary reasonable accommodations to a qualified individual with a disability, provided that nothing herein shall be construed to require the provision of reasonable accommodations if doing so will impose an undue hardship on the employing agency or a direct threat to the safety of himself/herself or others.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
The City of Lebanon will provide training for this opportunity. We are accepting applications for both experienced and entry-level candidates.

https://www.bls.gov/ooh/production/water-and-wastewater-treatment-plant-and-system-operators.htm

Promotions: Career ladder promotion for Grades 4 WWTP Operator Certifications in conjunction with on-the-job demonstration of capability.
Training: Professional development opportunities, including training, certification programs, and continuing education credits.

title: Mäklare till Blekinge - vi behöver fler mäklare till Karlshamn, Karlskrona, Ronneby och Sölvesborg
description:
Vi är i en god tillväxtfas i Blekinge och söker fler mäklare att göra jobbet!

Vi har gjort till vårt signum att vara riktigt duktiga på att jobba med underhandsförsäljningar och har ett stort register av både köpare och kommande säljare. Vår utmaning är att vi behöver bli fler för att hinna ta hand om vårt hela tiden växande kundregister.

Här kommer du förhoppningsvis in i bilden.

Vi söker fler mäklare tilla alla våra kontor - med målet att bli marknadsledande i Blekinge.

Eget arbete
Du får hos oss en stor frihet - samtidigt som vår struktur innebär en god stöttning. Vi samarbetar mellan kontoren i länet och hjälper varandra i både processerna men också genom en bra kundberarbetning även när det är på annan ort än "hemma".
Därtill har vi en grupp ledare som finns till för att hjälpa dig på vägen i din kariär.

Vår förväntan på dig är att du vill öka din egen omsättning, vara här för kundernas skull och göra bra affärer som är både trygga och ekonosmikt framgångsrika.

Varför Länsförsäkringar Fastighetsförmedling?
Vi är idag den näst största mäklarkedjan i Blekinge – något vi är stolta över, men inte klara. Vi har en tydlig målsättning att bli ledande och söker därför dig som vill vara med på resan. Här mäklar du under ett av Sveriges starkaste varumärken – med bank, försäkring & fastighetsförmedling under samma tak. Vårt samarbete med banken inom LF blekinge har i flera år prisats centralt i landet som bäst i Sverige - här kan vi ge dig en samkstart!

Varför Blekinge?

Här får du kombinera ett framgångsrikt mäklaryrke med hög livskvalitet, korta avstånd och närhet till hav, natur och familjeliv. Vi är fördelade på fem orter och samarbetar i stor utsträckning med varandra över konstorsgränserna. Detta leder till en fantastisk kollegial stämning både på kontoret och med kollegorna intill dig. Tillsammans utvecklar vi varnadra och du kan bidra med dina erfarenheter till ett team som lyssnar.

Om du vill prova på Sveriges snabbast växande mäklarkedja, ska du inte tveka att söka dig till oss. Låt oss börja med en kopp kaffe för att höra mer om hur vi kan passa för varandra!

Vi ser fram emot att höra ifrån dig!

title: Academic Breast Pathologist, Pathology & Laboratory Medicine
description:
The Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine at Mount Sinai Hospital is seeking a faculty member at the Assistant/Associate Professor Level with diagnostic and academic expertise in breast pathology and an interest in another area of pathology. The anticipated start date is January 4, 2027 or a mutually agreed upon date.
We are seeking an individual who values working in a collegial environment with superb clinical material and collaborations with dedicated clinical colleagues. The successful candidate will join an academic faculty with diverse diagnostic expertise, teaching responsibilities and research activities. Mount Sinai Hospital, in partnership with Women’s College Hospital, has an internationally renowned and expanding clinical program in Women’s Health including a consultation service. We utilize leading-edge diagnostic technologies. The candidate’s responsibilities will include clinical practice in breast pathology, research, and teaching as well as administrative responsibilities as necessary.
Candidates must have a medical degree and hold Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada certification in Anatomical Pathology, or equivalent, and be eligible for licensure by the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario. Fellowship training or experience in breast pathology is required. The preferred candidate must be an excellent diagnostician with a demonstrated interest in teaching and a track record in clinical or translational research. Research interest in artificial intelligence or molecular diagnostics would be an asset. In addition, the candidate should be eligible for an academic appointment in the Department of Laboratory Medicine and Pathobiology, University of Toronto. Rank will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Salary and benefits are in accordance with the Uniform Minimum Level of Compensation (UMLC) in the Province of Ontario. The UMLC program, instituted by the Ministry of Health, ensures that your total compensation package is equal to that of other Laboratory Physicians in the Province. Benefits will be provided.
Interested applicants should send their curriculum vitae, a brief statement of their career plans, and the names of three references to:
Dr. James ConnerSection Head, Surgical PathologyDepartment of Pathology and Laboratory MedicineMount Sinai Hospital600 University AvenueToronto, ON M5G 1X5Email: james.conner@sinaihealth.ca Review of applications will begin on October 5, 2026.
For more information about Mount Sinai Hospital, please visit https://www.mountsinai.on.ca/
For more information about the Department of Laboratory Medicine and Pathobiology, Faculty of Medicine, University of Toronto, please visit http://lmp.utoronto.ca/.

title: Montör / stenarbetare  leverans, montering och bearbetning
description:
Alessandro Signatursten AB söker en ny medarbetare till vårt team inom leverans, montering och bearbetning av sten.

Vi är ett modernt stenhuggeri med fokus på exklusiva bänkskivor och specialtillverkade produkter i natursten, komposit och keramik. Våra kunder består främst av köksföretag, byggföretag och arkitekter med höga krav på kvalitet, precision och finish.

Vi söker nu en person som vill lära sig yrket och utvecklas tillsammans med oss. Tjänsten passar dig som tycker om praktiskt arbete, är noggrann och inte har något emot ett fysiskt krävande arbete där arbetsdagarna kan se väldigt olika ut.

Om tjänsten

Du kommer framför allt att arbeta med leverans och montering av bänkskivor och andra stenprodukter hos våra kunder, men även med bearbetning och andra arbetsuppgifter i vårt stenhuggeri.

Arbetet sker tillsammans med en erfaren handledare och du kommer successivt att få lära dig våra arbetssätt, material och metoder.

Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:

  • Leverans och inbärning av bänkskivor och andra stenprodukter
  • Montering hos kund
  • Anpassning och bearbetning av sten i samband med montage
  • Lastning och lossning
  • Hantering av transport- och lyfthjälpmedel
  • Arbete i vår verkstad vid behov
  • Kontroll av produkter före leverans och efter färdig montering

Vi utgår från Göteborgsområdet men arbetar med kunder över hela Norden. Det innebär att tjänsten innehåller resor.

En stor del av våra uppdrag finns i Västra Götaland, men vi arbetar regelbundet bland annat i Stockholm, Malmö, Köpenhamn och Oslo. Vid längre uppdrag förekommer övernattning. Normalt handlar det om en hotellnatt åt gången.

Vem söker vi?

För oss är din inställning viktigare än att du redan kan stenbranschen.

Vi söker dig som:

  • Är praktiskt lagd och tycker om att arbeta med händerna
  • Är noggrann och har känsla för detaljer
  • Är ansvarstagande och kommer i tid
  • Trivs med fysiskt arbete
  • Kan arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra
  • Är bekväm med att resa i tjänsten och ibland övernatta
  • Har ett professionellt och trevligt bemötande mot kunder


B-körkort är meriterande, men inget krav.

Arbetet är fysiskt krävande. Stenprodukter är tunga och behöver hanteras med stor försiktighet. Vi använder olika hjälpmedel för transport och lyft, men arbetet innebär fortfarande återkommande tunga och fysiskt krävande moment.

Tidigare erfarenhet av sten, bygg, snickeri, köksmontage eller liknande praktiskt arbete är meriterande men inte ett krav. Rätt person får upplärning på plats.

Om oss

Alessandro Signatursten AB arbetar med tillverkning och montering av bänkskivor och specialprodukter i bland annat granit, marmor, kalksten, kvartsit, komposit och keramik.

Vi arbetar i premiumsegmentet där kvalitet och noggrannhet står i centrum. Våra produkter är ofta den sista delen som monteras i ett nytt kök, vilket innebär att vi lägger stor vikt vid precision, finish och ett professionellt bemötande hemma hos kunden.

Vi är ett relativt ungt och snabbväxande företag som befinner oss mitt i en spännande utvecklingsfas. Hos oss blir du en del av ett mindre team där du får möjlighet att vara med på vår fortsatta tillväxt och utvecklas tillsammans med företaget. För rätt person finns goda möjligheter att lära sig yrket från grunden, successivt ta större ansvar och växa in i en viktig roll i organisationen i takt med att vi fortsätter att expandera.

Anställningsform: Heltid

Omfattning: 100 %

Arbetsområde: Västra Götaland samt resor inom Sverige och övriga Norden

Körkort: B-körkort är meriterande

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Ansökan

Skicka en kort presentation av dig själv och berätta gärna om tidigare arbeten eller erfarenheter som du tror kan vara relevanta för tjänsten.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlighet, arbetsvilja, ansvarstagande och viljan att lära sig yrket.

title: Controller
description:
About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.

We build and deploy AI systems for private equity firms, financial services companies, and consumer brands — and we place senior engineering talent directly into client teams. We're roughly 100 people, headquartered in New York with offices in Stockholm, São Paulo, and Portugal. We're growing fast and we're profitable.

Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Financial Controller with experience to work out of our NYC office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we grow our global operations and need thorough financial reporting to plan our business.

A successful candidate in this role will report directly to the COO and will be primarily focused on executing on Financial strategy, modeling, and board-level reporting.
This is a role with a high degree of ownership and very little bureaucracy. This is a great opportunity for a strong Assistant Controller, a Senior Accountant ready to own a function, or a Controller at a smaller company.

Accounting and close

  • Full-cycle accounting and bookkeeping for our US entity

  • Monthly and quarterly close, on a predictable calendar

  • Consolidate reporting from our international entities' local accounting providers

  • Prepare the close package and supporting schedules for our outside CPA on tax and annual accounts

Billing and collections

  • Client invoicing, including multi-workstream and milestone-based arrangements

  • Accounts receivable and collections

  • Accounts payable, including contractor and vendor payments

  • Bank and credit card reconciliation

Payroll and benefits administration

  • Run US payroll and coordinate with local providers internationally

  • Benefits administration and enrollment

  • Contractor onboarding and payment administration

Compliance calendar

  • Track and file federal, state, and local registration, filing, and reporting obligations Insurance renewals: keep coverages current and flag when limits look wrong

  • Pull documentation and evidence for audits and compliance reviews, including SOC 2

Reporting

  • Produce the monthly and quarterly reporting package on a fixed schedule

  • Maintain the operating metrics dashboard: utilization, DSO, bench cost, revenue per head, engagement margin

  • Maintain the cash flow forecast model and keep the inputs current (the COO owns the model and the assumptions; you own the accuracy of what goes into it)

  • Ad hoc reporting and analysis for leadership

Expense management

  • Corporate card program, expense policy enforcement, and expense tracking

  • Vendor and software spend review

Required

  • 5+ years in accounting, including time owning or substantially running a monthly close

  • Solid working knowledge of US GAAP

  • Strong QuickBooks (or comparable) and genuine spreadsheet skill

  • Experience with billing and collections in a services business

  • Payroll experience

  • Comfort operating without a large structured team

  • You catch things. Reconciliations that don't tie, invoices that never went out, a vendor charging us twice.

Strongly preferred

  • Professional services background — consulting, IT services, staffing, or agency

  • Track record of pulling DSO down

  • Benefits administration ownership

  • Multi-entity exposure

Nice to have

  • CPA or CPA candidate

  • Experience with revenue recognition for time-and-materials and fixed-fee work

  • You've implemented or migrated a financial system and lived through it

Benefits:

  • $145,000 – $165,000 base, plus performance bonus. Benefits and PTO.

  • Flexible Hybrid working environment out of our office in the Financial District

  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

🚀 Don’t meet every single requirement? Apply anyway! At our core, we value growth, adaptability, and passion just as much as a checklist of skills. If you are excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every tech requirement, we still encourage you to apply. The only non-negotiable for us is fluent English, as you'll be collaborating daily with global teams. If you’ve got the language skills and the drive to learn, you might be exactly who we are looking for to bring a fresh perspective to our team!

title: Junior Projectleider Energie (Installatie, Onderhoud & Service)
description:
Junior Projectleider | Start jouw carrière als Projectleider in de energietransitie

WAAROM HANAB?

Wij zijn Hanab. Wij bouwen we al meer dan 150 jaar mee aan de vooruitgang van Nederland. Met zes divisies gespecialiseerd in energie, techniek en connectiviteit werken we samen onder de naam Hanab. Met een sterke basis in Nederland en een internationaal werkterrein is Hanab dé partner in een wereld die volop in beweging is.

Duurzame energie heeft de toekomst. En die maken wij vandaag. Want als marktleider in complexe midden- en hoogspanning loopt Hanab Energy Solutions voorop in de energietransitie. Met uitdagende projecten over de volle breedte, en onder de krachtige vlag van Hanab, maak je impact om de transitie naar duurzame energie te realiseren. Zo werken we samen aan een duurzame toekomst, voor de generaties van vandaag en morgen.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Hanab Energy Solutions is dé expert in het ontwerp, de aanleg en het beheer van complexe hoogspanningsinstallaties. Voor onze Installatie, Onderhoud & Service (IO&S) groep zoeken wij een Junior Projectleider die energie krijgt van het organiseren en realiseren van technische projecten. Samen met ons werk je aan de energietransitie en zorg je ervoor dat hoogspanningsinstallaties veilig, kwalitatief en volgens planning worden gerealiseerd.

Als Junior Projectleider Hoogspanningsmontage ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de kabelmontageprojecten. Je stuurt het team van hoogspanningsmonteurs aan en zorgt ervoor dat zij iedere dag met de juiste informatie, tools en materialen de projecten tot een succes kunnen maken. De projecten bevinden zich door heel Nederland (en België regio Antwerpen) en hebben een doorlooptijd van een paar dagen tot enkele maanden. Ons kantoor bevindt zich in Rotterdam, maar je brengt vaak een bezoek aan de projecten om de monteurs te spreken en contact te onderhouden met de opdrachtgever.

Je werkt nauw samen met de werkvoorbereider en manager van de afdeling. Je stemt veel af met de verschillende opdrachtgevers en stelt calculaties en aanbiedingen op. En natuurlijk bewaak je de voortgang, planning, kwaliteit en het budget gedurende de uitvoering van alle projecten.

Dit ga je o.a. doen:

  • Leiden van montageprojecten
  • Opstellen van planningen, plannen en budgetten
  • Zorgen voor een efficiënte uitvoering volgens contractafspraken
  • Bewaken van kwaliteit, veiligheid, voortgang en financiële resultaten
  • Signaleren van risico’s en kansen binnen projecten
  • Onderhouden van goede relaties met opdrachtgevers, leveranciers en onderaannemers

Je komt terecht in een organisatie met veel specialistische kennis in huis. Onze afdeling focust zich op montage, beheer en onderhoud. Samen met de andere projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, monteurs en technisch specialisten vorm je een hecht team en werk je aan projecten met maatschappelijke impact.

WAT BRENG JE MEE?

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels
  • Vermogen om op verschillende niveaus te schakelen en een oprechte interesse in collega’s, team en klanten
  • Actiegerichtheid en besluitvaardigheid op basis van feiten en gevoel voor mens en dynamiek
  • Proactieve bijdrage aan het verbeteren en implementeren van richtlijnen, procedures en hulpmiddelen

WAT HEBBEN WE JE TE BIEDEN?

Werken voor Hanab Energy Solutions betekent werken voor een toonaangevende speler op het gebied van energie-infrastructuren. Zo is Hanab Energy Solutions dé expert in ontwerp, aanleg en beheer van (complexe) hoogspanningsinstallaties. Wij helpen klanten als netbeheerders, energie-opwekkers en zakelijke klanten met uitdagingen die de energietransitie met zich meebrengt. Kortom, wij staan voor technisch vooruitstrevende oplossingen.

De liefde voor techniek is de verbindende factor binnen Hanab Energy Solutions. Wij hebben een werkomgeving waar het samen werken aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een toekomstbestendige energievoorziening centraal staat. Dat zie je terug in een gedreven, resultaatgerichte instelling met een goede werksfeer. Medewerkers zijn trots om bij Hanab Energy Solutions te werken.

En dit..

  • Een sleutelrol binnen een toekomstgerichte organisatie met maatschappelijke impact
  • Bruto maandsalaris: tussen € 3.765,- en € 6.006,- afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
  • Bovenop je bruto maandsalaris ontvang je een flexbudget van 18%, dat je bruto kunt laten uitbetalen, gebruiken om extra verlof mee te kopen of een combinatie daarvan.
  • Auto van de zaak die je ook prive kunt gebruiken.
  • Deelname aan de cao NWb, een goede pensioen regeling, een laptop en een smartphone en fijne collega's. Kortom; alles om jouw functie goed uit te kunnen oefenen.
  • Daarnaast bieden wij nog diverse collectieve Hanab kortingen op verzekeringen en abonnementen.
  • Een sleutelpositie binnen een dynamisch en toekomstgericht bedrijf.
  • Interessante projecten die ertoe doen in de energietransitie.
  • Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid.

Daarnaast investeren we volop in jouw ontwikkeling. Of je nu verder wilt groeien in projectmanagement, techniek of leiderschap: je krijgt toegang tot externe opleidingen, een opleidingsbudget en een digitale leeromgeving om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen. Nieuwe collega’s worden goed begeleid met een buddyprogramma, terwijl interne trainingen en kennislunches zorgen voor het delen van expertise en praktijkervaring binnen de organisatie.

Ook naast het werk is er volop ruimte voor gezelligheid en verbinding. Van vrijdagmiddagborrels en teamuitjes tot personeelsfeesten en wintersportreizen: bij Hanab combineren we professionaliteit met een informele en betrokken werksfeer. Met collega’s van jong tot ervaren houden we van samenwerken, kennis delen én ouderwetse gezelligheid.

LATEN WE KENNISMAKEN!

Klik op de ‘ik ben geïnteresseerd’ button en upload jouw cv met evt. een motivatiebrief. Wij kijken uit naar jouw reactie! Voor vragen of meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Jeroen Boere, Corporate Recruiter, via jboere@hanab.nl of via +31 644477952.

Acquisitie

Voor deze vacature zoeken wij rechtstreeks contact met de sollicitant zelf, zonder tussenkomst van werving- en selectiebureaus of intermediairs. Heb jij zelf interesse? Laat het ons weten!

description:
COMPANY
Global Rescue is the world’s leading membership organization providing integrated medical, security, intelligence and crisis response services to consumers, enterprises and governments. Founded in 2004, Global Rescue’s unique operational model provides best-in-class services that identify, monitor, and respond to threats and emergencies. For more information, please see .

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Associate Software Architect is a hands-on technical leader who designs and builds robust, scalable, and secure software systems while guiding the day-to-day delivery of the engineering team. This role provides technical leadership, defines architecture standards, contributes production code alongside the team, and ensures that solutions align with business objectives, performance requirements, and long-term maintainability.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Define, maintain, and implement enterprise architecture across applications, microservices, integrations, and data platforms — ensuring scalability, security, performance, and long-term maintainability aligned with business objectives.
  • Evaluate and recommend technology stacks, tools, and platforms to deliver solutions and services aligned with long-term strategy.
  • Provide hands-on leadership by implementing services, frameworks, and complex components to set technical direction and quality benchmarks.
  • Develop complex, production-grade software using frameworks/tools like Spring Boot, microservices, JPA, Hibernate and MySQL consistently following coding standards/best practices.
  • Create, review, and execute unit tests using automated testing frameworks to support test-driven development and ensure the functional integrity of solutions.
  • Stay hands-on in the codebase while mentoring less-experienced engineers, running code reviews, and unblocking the team on complex technical challenges.
  • Own the team’s build and release tooling — source control and configuration management (Git/GitLab), build automation (Maven), and CI/CD pipelines — and drive DevOps practices across cloud operations, automation, and system observability.
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks, scalability constraints, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Ensure solutions meet non-functional requirements such as availability, resilience, security, and compliance.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or related field
  • 8+ years of experience in software development, including 3+ years in architecture or technical leadership roles, with strong expertise in system design, distributed systems, microservices architecture, and API design.
  • Proven, hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, Hibernate, Spring AOP, and Angular/TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs, WebSockets, message queues (SQS/RabbitMQ/Kafka), IoT using MQTT, IDP (Keycloak) and authentication protocols such as OIDC and SAML.
  • Hands-on experience with relational (MySQL) and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB), caching strategies (Redis), object storage (S3), and performance optimization.
  • Working experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and AWS (CloudFormation, ECS, EKS, Serverless/Lambda, AWS IoT, EC2, API Gateway).
  • Hands-on experience with JUnit, Git/GitLab, Maven, TDD, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to develop clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
  • Proficient in leveraging AI-powered tools for coding, testing, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work directly with product and QA stakeholders and keep a team on track in a fast-paced environment.

title: Senior Contract Management Specialist
description:
The Senior Contract Management Specialist (SnrCMS) is responsible for ensuring the timely and appropriate execution of Confidentiality Disclosure Agreements (CDAs), Clinical Study Agreements (CSAs), associated Budgets, and vendor agreements in their country(ies) of responsibility.

Those with sufficient experience and seniority may line manage others in the team and be allocated as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for global topics. They may also be designated as a Therapeutic Area Captain for the function, responsible for ensuring OUS requirements are part of the final study budget and aligned with similar OUS budgets per designated Therapy Area.

  • Accountable for the timely preparation and execution of CDAs, CSAs and budgets and related vendor agreements, and a point person for their country / region for legal, finance, Site Management and CPD. The SnrCMS will typically be responsible and/or have oversight for more than one country and/or a Large Business Unit (LBU).
  • Negotiation of CDAs, CSAs and Budgets with investigator sites (directly or with support from local monitor where language necessitates), using templates, guidance and legal/budget playbooks, liaising with R+D legal for approval to changes not already described.
  • Ensure input is provided for ongoing update of legal and budget playbooks and templates for the countries in the area of responsibility .
  • Ensure appropriate tracking of CDAs, CSAs, Country and Site Intelligence.
  • Agree, manage and communicate regarding priorities with local affiliate stakeholders and legal and finance, in alignment with Study and Priority planning.
  • Drive for excellence and continuous improvement in delivery of global Contract Management responsibilities.

Depending on experience and skills/seniority, may:

  • Take on functional responsibility as a “Therapeutic Area Captain” for the global Contract Management function; fostering consistency, SMM alignment and white glove service to internal stakeholders in the relevant TA. This includes responsibility for:
    • Managing the process for obtaining OUS input to study budgets via team collaboration, involvement in Budget Strategy Meetings and budget reviews.
    • Sharing information on TA/Study decisions impacting CSAs with the CPMG team
    • Managing and overseeing the web-based Basic Budget Query (BBQ) process
  • Line manage CMSs / CMAs within the Contract Management function.
  • Liaise with Country Operations Managers in the countries their line reports manage the contracts for.
  • Lead process improvement projects for the OUS Contract Management Function and/or be a SME representing the OUS Contract Management function on process teams with broader impact.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent tertiary qualification; a Health Care, legal or scientific discipline preferred.
  • Significant Clinical Research and/or contract/budget experience. Awareness and understanding of compliance and regulatory matters in clinical research. Experience in cross-functional interactions and working within a global environment an advantage.
  • Proven negotiation, tact and diplomacy skills.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills and the ability to work independently and effectively in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.
  • Sense of urgency and strong goal orientation; track-record of meeting deadlines and goals
  • Experience in line or matrix management an advantage.
  • Strong written and verbal communication including written and verbal fluency in English and local language (if not English) and interpersonal skills, including conflict resolution and problem solving.
  • Proactive and positive team player. Able to maintain high performance during times of ambiguity and change in the work environment

title: Principal Engineer
description:
An engineering professional who, working with little or no supervision, applies advanced scientific knowledge, engineering knowledge, mathematics, and ingenuity to complete complex assignments related to a specific technical field or discipline. A Principal Engineer has full knowledge of other related disciplines beyond their own area of expertise.

Responsibilities

  • Responsibilities of this engineering grade level inherently include and expand upon the responsibilities established for lower engineering grade levels.
  • Responsible for compliance with applicable policies and procedures. Ensures quality and effectiveness of key results of major projects within function through sound design, early risk assessments, and implementation of fallback strategies. Has full awareness of the potential consequences (defects and failure modes) of design changes to established processes. Mitigates risk within functions through sound design, early risk assessments and implementation of fallback strategies.
  • Identifies, plans, and conducts medium- to large-size projects within engineering specialty requiring custom, risk-managed execution plans, investigations, and/or equipment. Manages multiple, often concurrent, projects and meets deadlines.
  • Maintains project controls and reporting for cost, scope and schedule; develops execution strategy including procurement; balances multiple demands within an Understands the business needs of the company, and has a thorough knowledge of the customer and clinical needs when developing a project scope. Incorporates business foresight of emerging technological trends.
  • Works with marketing, product development, and manufacturing to establish scope, priorities, and schedules on multiple projects. - Independently performs economic analysis and feasibility studies related to complex and often multiple competing project alternatives. Responsible for achieving the project's financial targets in support of business objectives.
  • Analyzes business forces (customers, suppliers, competitors, technologies, government regulations) in major markets to identify trends and recommend responses. Independently executes, and/or directs others in the execution of: the design of products/processes/equipment/systems/facilities by applying novel engineering theories, concepts, and techniques within the disciplines. experiments, often with multiple variables, gathers data, and performs detailed analysis.   • Designs and leads complex experiments, often with multiple variables, gathers data, and performs detailed analysis. Assesses relevance. Conceptualizes complete solutions. Creates or coordinates the design solutions for novel or complex problems; integrates regulatory and operational needs; assesses cost benefit. Explores multiple alternatives. Structures studies and integrate cross-disciplinary and cross-functional issues to arrive at optimal cause of action.
  • Applies technology in innovative ways. Combines technologies to anticipate or address customer needs; shares solutions across sites; employs proven solutions to increase effectiveness of engineering methodology or manufacturing process. Mentors others by sharing technical expertise and providing feedback and guidance.
  • Where appropriate, provides tasks/project assignment opportunities for employee development and evaluates performance. Represents the organization as the prime technical contact on contracts and projects.
  • Interacts with both senior management and external personnel on significant technical matters often requiring coordination between organizations. Submits articles for internal or external publication. Acts as a trusted advisor. Balances bottom line objectives of a project with long-term interest of customer. Is identified as a Subject Matter Expert in the discipline. Participates in internal teams to develop and align procedures and standards. May influence validation strategy.

A post-graduate education/degree is desired, and may contribute towards the desired years of experience.Has demonstrated competency within a discipline.
  • Has a career history marked by a consistent series of technical contributions and accomplishments. Significant contribution to product or process development or improvement through creative application of technical effort will equally be recognized.

title: Order Management Specialist
description:
Order Management Specialist | 12 month Max Term Contract

At AbbVie, we are committed to discovering and delivering innovative medicines that solve serious health issues and improve lives.

We're looking for an Order Management Specialist to join our Sydney team and play a critical role in ensuring patients across Australia receive access to life-changing therapies. This is far more than a traditional customer service role. You'll own the end-to-end order management process for Australia's leading pharmaceutical wholesalers and healthcare customers, working at the intersection of customer operations, supply chain, commercial teams and patient care.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with customer service, administration, sales support, logistics coordination or operations experience who is looking to develop their career within the pharmaceutical industry.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES

  • Own end-to-end order management for key wholesale and retail accounts using SAP and the Order to Cash (OTC) process — including order entry, validation, shipment tracking, sales recognition, and reporting across EDI, email, fax, and controlled drug order types
  • Manage Salesforce case management, ensuring priority cases are resolved within agreed SLA/KPI metrics
  • Resolve customer inquiries related to shipping, pricing discrepancies, product returns, and credit processing with speed and accuracy
  • Oversee equipment procurement, delivery, and maintenance coordination to support hospital patient care requirements
  • Analyse order and return data through customer scorecards and KPIs to identify trends and drive continuous improvement
  • Lead and participate in process improvement initiatives, leveraging analytics to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, supply chain, finance, and quality to optimise orders, returns, and new product launches
  • Act as Subject Matter Expert and On-the-Job Trainer (OJT) for customer service policies including orders, returns, and support services
  • Drive AbbVie project initiatives including customer/product divestiture, discontinued products, and pipeline management
  • Report any adverse event within 24 hours as per AbbVie’s policies and procedures.
  • Proactively participate in AbbVie’s WHS programs, adhere to policies and promote a safe work environment at all times.
  • Adhere to AbbVie’s internal codes of conduct and compliance processes.
  • Other ad hoc duties, as requested.
  • Experience in customer service, order management, or a related operations role
  • Organised and detail-orientated
  • Comfortable working with systems and learning new technology
  • Experience with SAP (SD module preferred) and Order to Cash (OTC) processes preferred, but not essential
  • Proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and MS Office 365 preferred, but not essential
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root cause analysis
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, active listening, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work independently and cross-functionally, including with executive-level stakeholders
  • Some experience in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, FMCG, or healthcare industry or study at a university level in Life Sciences or related fields
  • Experience with SharePoint, reporting tools, or process automation

Flexibility and Availability: In line with Australia’s 'Right to Disconnect' legislation, we recognise and respect employees' right to refuse contact outside of their working hours, unless such refusal is deemed unreasonable. As we operate in an international, matrixed environment, there may be occasions where your role requires participation in business meetings outside of standard hours. We value and support flexibility and appreciate your willingness to occasionally accommodate these requests to ensure effective collaboration and communication within our global team.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer, and dedicated to fostering an inclusive, flexible, and supportive workplace that values and respects every individual. We are committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives, and embracing diversity and inclusion. It is AbbVie’s policy to employ qualified persons of the greatest ability. We ensure a fair and inclusive recruitment process without discrimination against any employee or applicant because of, and not limited to, race, religion, age, physical or mental disability, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or marital status. Our hiring process is flexible and accessible, so if you have any specific requests or accessibility requirement, please feel comfortable to let our team know by emailing CareersANZ@abbvie.com or speaking with your Recruiter and we'll make any necessary adjustments to accommodate your needs.

WAYS WE WORK

  • All For One Abbvie; We weigh all decisions against the common good. We inspire, share and create as a team. We solve problems for all rather than serving our immediate team.
  • Decide Smart & Sure; We make intelligent decisions to create the best outcomes. We act quickly, embrace experimentation, and learn what doesn’t work and get on to what does.
  • Agile & Accountable; We streamline and eliminate unnecessary obstacles. We plan but adapt as we go. We delegate and make tough decisions to ensure focus on results, staying keenly aware of the urgency in all we do.
  • Clear & Courageous; Open, honest, candid dialogue is core to our work and how we act with each other. We share information freely and continuously to find solutions. We admit mistakes. We grow stronger by putting the courage of our conviction to the test.
  • Make Possibilities Real; We question with endless curiosity. We’re never satisfied with good enough—patients depend on us to deliver more. We challenge ourselves to find creative, constructive solutions to turn possibilities into reality.

CODE OF CONDUCT & BUSINESS INTEGRITY STATEMENT

  • AbbVie is committed to observing high integrity and ethical standards in all its business dealings with our customers, with each other, business partners and suppliers.
  • AbbVie as a responsible corporate citizen will adhere to these standards, as well as to local, national and international laws.
  • All AbbVie employees are responsible for maintaining the Company’s reputation for conduct in accordance with the highest level of business integrity, ethics and compliance with the law.
  • Soliciting and/or accepting/attempting/offering bribes or any illegal gratification is therefore cause for immediate dismissal.
  • AbbVie is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives, serving our community, and embracing diversity and inclusion.

title: Content Development Specialist
description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Review, analyze, and modernize existing procedural, policy, reference, and knowledge content in accordance with EKM standards.
  • Rewrite and restructure content using approved AI-enabled technologies, templates, content models, style guides, metadata standards, and taxonomy requirements to improve content quality, consistency, and AI readiness.
  • Collaborate with business unit SMEs and content owners to validate content accuracy, completeness, and business intent.
  • Ensure content adheres to plain-language and user-centered design principles to improve findability, comprehension, and usability.
  • Apply metadata, tagging, classification, and content governance standards to support enterprise search and AI-readiness initiatives.
  • Participate in content inventories, audits, and gap analyses to identify outdated, redundant, or duplicate information.
  • Align content with established migration requirements and prepare knowledge assets for future platform migration activities.
  • Support testing, validation, and issue remediation activities associated with content modernization, migration, and knowledge management platform initiatives.
  • Support quality assurance reviews and remediation activities to ensure published content meets EKM standards.
  • Track content modernization progress and maintain status reporting for assigned business units and content portfolios.
  • Identify opportunities to improve content consistency, governance compliance, and end-user experience.
  • Participate in training, workshops, and content governance activities related to EKM modernization efforts

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, English, Journalism, Technical Writing, Knowledge Management, Business, Education, or related field, or equivalent combination of training and experience.
  • Experience creating, editing, or managing business, operational, instructional, procedural, or knowledge-based content.
  • Experience collaborating with subject matter experts to capture and document business processes and procedures.
  • Experience organizing complex information into concise, easy-to-understand documentation.
  • Experience working within defined content standards, templates, style guides, or governance frameworks.
  • Strong editing, proofreading, and quality assurance skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously while meeting established deadlines.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and matrixed environments.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting enterprise content modernization, content migration, or knowledge management initiatives.
  • Experience with structured authoring, content architecture, metadata management, or taxonomy development.
  • Experience working in financial services, banking, credit unions, regulated industries, or large enterprise environments.
  • Knowledge of knowledge management principles, content governance practices, and enterprise search optimization.
  • Experience using knowledge management platforms, content management systems, or digital knowledge repositories.
  • Familiarity with AI-readiness concepts, including content standardization, metadata enrichment, and content quality optimization.
  • Understanding of user experience (UX) writing and information architecture principles.
  • Working knowledge of Navy Federal products, services, policies, and procedures.

title: Myymäläpäällikkö määräaikainen Dressmann Jyväskylä Palokka
description:
Tule meille uudeksi myymäläpäälliköksi!

Dressmannilla työnteko on ennen kaikkea hauskaa – niin tiimin kuin asiakkaidenkin kanssa. Meidän vahvuus on ihmisissä ja siinä, mitä saamme aikaan yhdessä. Olemme tiivis ja välittävä työyhteisö, jossa syntyy hyvä fiilis ja hienoja kokemuksia niin meille kuin kaikille asiakkaille, jotka astuvat myymälään. Tässä roolissa pääset kasvamaan esihenkilönä ja vaikuttamaan siihen, millainen kulttuuri myymälässä vallitsee. Tukenasi on vahva organisaatio ja huipputyypit – kaikki on kohdallaan, jotta voit onnistua ja viihtyä työssäsi.

Voisitko se olla sinä?

Dressmannin myymäläpäällikkönä olet siellä, missä tapahtuu – myymälän arjessa, tiimin ja asiakkaiden keskellä. Olet tiimipelaaja, joka viihtyy vauhdikkaassa ympäristössä ja nauttii vaihtelevista työpäivistä. Sinulla on intohimo luoda huippuluokan asiakaskokemuksia, ja osaat innostaa ja kehittää tiimin jäseniä onnistumaan työssään. Pidät langat käsissäsi: myymäläsi on aina siisti, kampanjat kunnossa ja tiimi oikealla paikalla oikeaan aikaan. Tiedät, mitä tuloksiin pääseminen vaatii – ja osaat myös pysähtyä juhlimaan onnistumisia, pieniä ja suuria.

Tehtävä on sijaisuus, jonka kesto on 24 kuukautta.

Arvioitu alkamispäivä on: 20261015
Arvioitu päättymispäivä on: 20281231

Jos haluat lähteä valmentamaan yhtä voittajatiimeistämme, toivomme vastaanottavamme hakemuksesi jo tänään.

Odotamme, että:

  • Haluat rakentaa vahvaa myyntikulttuuria
  • Sinulla on kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä tai intohimoa johtamiseen
  • Olet positiivinen ja hyvä esimerkki muille
  • Työskentelet fiksusti ja tehokkaasti
  • Sinulla on hyvä taloudellinen ymmärrys
  • Sinulla on koulutusta tai kokemusta kaupan alalta, asiakaspalvelusta tai johtamisesta

Jos tunnistat itsesi tästä, toivomme että lähetät meille hakemuksesi jo tänään!

title: Verpleegkundige Open Afdeling | Spoedkliniek
description:
Ben jij verpleegkundige en zoek je een werkomgeving waar geen dag hetzelfde is? Op onze open afdeling in hartje Amsterdam werk je in een dynamische klinische setting waar je écht het verschil maakt. Je begeleidt cliënten in een cruciale fase van hun herstel, ontwikkelt jezelf continu en werkt intensief samen met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines. Hier combineer je professionele uitdaging met zichtbare impact.


Wat ga je doen?
Op de open afdeling begeleid je cliënten bij wie de acute opnamefase achter de rug is. De problematiek is uiteenlopend: denk aan psychosegevoeligheid, suïcidaliteit en complexe zorgvragen. Geen dag is hetzelfde, en juist dát maakt je werk boeiend.

Als verpleegkundige ben je dagelijks in contact met cliënten, bied je structuur en veiligheid en werk je herstelgericht. Je coacht, observeert en helpt cliënten bij het versterken van hun eigen regie. Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in de samenwerking met behandelaren en het netwerk rondom de cliënt.

Jouw rol is daarin onmisbaar. Je:

  • werkt met signalerings- en begeleidingsplannen;
  • stimuleert en ondersteunt cliënten bij het dagelijks functioneren;
  • bouwt snel een vertrouwensband op;
  • speelt in op wat cliënten op dat moment van jou nodig hebben;
  • draagt bij aan de sfeer, stabiliteit en veiligheid op de afdeling;
  • denkt mee over het behandeltraject en signaleert belangrijke veranderingen.

Dankzij meeroosteren heb je samen met je team invloed op je eigen rooster, zodat werk en privé zo goed mogelijk in balans blijven.

Wij bieden jou:

  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de CAO GGZ, schaal 45/50 (min. €3180,- en max €4716,- bruto op basis van 36 uur);
  • Het betreft een vacature voor 32-36 uur per week voor een jaar met de intentie om dit bij goed functioneren om te zetten in een vast dienstverband;
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering en vakantiegeld van 8,33%;
  • Je bouwt een goed pensioen op bij Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn.

Daarnaast een aantal aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden van Arkin:

  • Voor woon-werkverkeer en dienstreizen krijg je een 2e klasse mobiliteitskaart, ook te gebruiken voor OV-fiets, of een km vergoeding;
  • Korting op verschillende verzekeringen;
  • Arkin biedt met 11 specialismen op verschillende locaties ook veel mogelijkheden op langer termijn voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en persoonlijke groei. Hiervoor hebben we een breed trainingsaanbod;
  • Een meerkeuzesysteem waarbij je brutoloon kunt gebruiken voor extra vakantie-uren, fietsaanschaf en aanvullende reiskostenvergoeding;
  • Voor jouw welzijn toegang tot zorgplatform Lifecheck, een vitaliteitsbudget (jaarlijks maximaal €100,- netto bij een dienstverband van 18 uur p.w. of meer), balansbudget van €1000,- en toegang tot Nrgize voor deelname aan activiteiten zoals bootcamp, yoga en padel. Daarnaast krijg je onbeperkt toegang tot het online cursusaanbod van GoodHabitz;
  • Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van €1000,- bruto.

Wat breng je mee?
Jouw doel is optimale zorg bieden. Je bent open-minded, maakt makkelijk contact en toont flexibiliteit door goed te anticiperen op onverwachte gebeurtenissen. Zowel in jouw team als met andere partners in de zorgketen én met naasten van cliënten zoek je actief de samenwerking. Verbinding maken is niet voor niets een van onze kernwaarden.

We ontvangen graag jouw sollicitatie als jij:

  • Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding mbo-4 of Hbo-opleiding Verpleegkunde.
  • affiniteit en/of ervaring hebt met de psychiatrie;
  • onregelmatige diensten ziet als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van je werk;

Een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag is een vast onderdeel van onze sollicitatieprocedure

Werken bij ons
Mentrum is een van de 11 specialismen van Arkin. Samen zijn we de expert op het gebied van de psychiatrie en verslavingszorg. Met elkaar maken we ons sterk voor de mentale veerkracht van onze cliënten.

Mentrum is er voor volwassenen met ernstige psychiatrische klachten. Zij kunnen bij ons terecht voor een specialistische, intensieve behandeling en voor begeleiding en zorg.

De opnamekliniek van Mentrum aan de Eerste Constantijn Huygensstraat levert kortdurende klinische zorg en maakt deel uit van de crisisketen in de Amsterdamse psychiatrie. De kliniek heeft 92 bedden en 40 behandelplaatsen voor dagbehandeling. Het zorgaanbod van de kliniek is toegespitst op kortdurende behandeling van cliënten met een psychotische of affectieve stoornis, complexe problematiek, dubbele problematiek en vrouwenproblematiek. Binnen de kliniek 1e CH word je verantwoordelijk voor de 24-uurszorg. Dit zijn de 8 verpleegafdelingen met ongeveer 120 FTE

Meer weten over deze vacature?
Ben je nieuwsgierig geworden naar deze vacature en wil je meer informatie, dan faciliteren we dit graag. Je kunt mij een bericht sturen via What’s App: 06-25083857 of mailen op email ranoe.baidjoe@arkin.nl.

Direct solliciteren kan natuurlijk ook.

Bij Arkin omarmen we diversiteit en streven we naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin we het beste in elkaar naar boven halen. Meer over onze visie op D&I lees je bij 'over ons'.

Wij zoeken het liefst zelf naar nieuwe collega’s, dat vinden we wel zo persoonlijk. Acquisitie wordt dan ook niet op prijs gesteld

title: Risk Analyst
description:
Reporting into the GM – Group Risk, you will co-ordinate, monitor and promote Risk Management and Insurance Processes across the business, and support the development, implementation, and direction of Vocus’ Risk Management, business resilience and insurance framework, and ongoing operations of the risk management function.
Responsibilities

Support the Group Risk team in achieving strategic objectives, ensuring effective risk management for the organisation and liaising with key risk stakeholders
Assist in the review, development and maintenance of the Vocus Risk Management Framework, policies and processes

title: Senior Frontend-utvikler – Tech Sales
description:
Vil du være med å skape fremtidens handleopplevelse?

Vi bygger nå Nordens mest innovative eCom‑plattform for fashion retail. Med moderne arkitektur, høy endringstakt og skalerbarhet i kjernen skaper vi en plattform rigget for fremtidens handel. Det mest unike? Hele prosjektet gjennomføres med vår egen leveransekraft – drevet av interne team som kombinerer dyp forretningsforståelse med teknologisk spisskompetanse.

Har du lyst til å være med?

Ansvarsområder og arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Du blir med oss på reisen når vi bygger en ny plattform fra bunnen med Next.js, GraphQL, Edge Workers og andre moderne verktøy
  • Mer kode, mindre PowerPoint – Du utvikler og optimaliserer moderne, brukervennlige grensesnitt i React, brukt av tusenvis av kunder daglig
  • Samarbeide tett med UX- og produktteam for å skape intuitive, estetiske og tilgjengelige løsninger gjennom hele kundereisen

  • Sikre robust kodekvalitet gjennom automatisert testing, kodegjennomganger og CI/CD
  • Bygge skalerbare, fleksible og ytelseseffektive løsninger som gir en sømløs kundeopplevelse
  • Optimalisere for SEO, ytelse og universell utforming (WCAG) i moderne webapplikasjoner
  • Være en pådriver for moderne front-end-teknologier og beste praksis innen ytelse, sikkerhet og tilgjengelighet
  • Bidra i teknologivalg og arkitekturdiskusjoner for å videreutvikle vår front-end teknologistack
  • Veilede og dele kunnskap med resten av teamet

Kvalifikasjoner og personlige egenskaper

  • Minimum 6 års erfaring med front-end utvikling
  • Solid erfaring med React og moderne front-end teknologier
  • Behersker CSS og HTML til fingerspissene
  • God forståelse av front-end-arkitektur, inkludert state management
  • Erfaring med optimalisering for ytelse, SEO og universell utforming
  • Sterk kompetanse i TypeScript og moderne JavaScript.
  • Erfaring med rammeverk for fullstack React-applikasjoner, f.eks. Next.js, er en fordel
  • Erfaring med designsystemer, gjerne Material UI eller tilsvarende bibliotek
  • God kjennskap til CI/CD, gjerne med GitHub Actions
  • Kjennskap til Azure eller annen skyplattform er en fordel
  • En lagspiller som tar initiativ og aktivt bidrar til teamets utvikling
  • Evne til å kommunisere tekniske løsninger klart på både norsk og engelsk
  • Har du erfaring fra retail er det et pluss!

Vi kan tilby:

  • En spennende rolle med mulighet til å eie og utvikle tekniske løsninger
  • Inspirerende arbeidsmiljø med kunnskapsdeling og rom for personlig utvikling
  • En arbeidsplass som feirer suksess med sosiale samlinger og fest
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn og betingelser med svært god personalrabatt i alle våre brands
  • Moderne kontor på Slependen med fantastisk lunsj og egen kaffebar med barista
  • Miljøkompensasjon ved bruk av kollektiv transport

Din hverdag hos oss
Som front-end-utvikler i Varner Tech får du en sentral rolle i å forme fremtidens kundeopplevelser og digitale løsninger i våre salgskanaler, både online og i butikk. Du tar aktivt ansvar i hele utviklingsprosessen – fra tidlige konsept- og designfaser til produksjonssetting og kontinuerlig forbedring. Hos oss får du stor frihet til å påvirke teknologivalg, arbeidsmetoder og innovasjon innen front-end-utvikling. Samtidig blir du del av et engasjert team med en uformell kultur og raske beslutningsprosesser.

Teamet du vil bli en del av består av 17 personer. Du rapporterer til teamansvarlig og samarbeider tett med resten av teamet som inkluderer UX-designere, utviklere (front-/back-end), produkteiere og systemspesialister. Teamet er delt inn i flere produktområder.

Er dette en match for deg? Da håper vi du sender oss din søknad i dag! Søknader vurderes fortløpende.

title: Monitored Services Coordinator
description:
Title: Monitored Services Coordinator Reports to: Director of Service
Class: Full-Time Type: Hourly
Position Summary:
The Monitored Services Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and responsiveness of monitored accounts. This position is responsible for overseeing the lifecycle of monitored accounts—from creation and setup to ongoing supervision and modification. The Monitored Services Coordinator serves as a key liaison between technical teams and customers, ensuring that all monitored services are configured correctly and maintained to the highest standards.
Key Responsibilities:

Account Creation & Setup Monitoring:

Verify and validate new monitored account setups.
Ensure all required data and configurations are accurately entered into monitoring systems.
Coordinate with installation teams to confirm communicator programming and connectivity.

Account Supervision Monitoring:

Regularly auditing active accounts for proper supervision settings.
Identify and resolve discrepancies or missing supervision parameters.
Monitor system alerts and escalate issues as needed.
Daily check-ins on accounts and customer calls regarding overnight signals and missed test events.

Account Modifications & Changes:

Process and track changes to monitored accounts, including zone updates, contact changes, and service level adjustments.
Ensure all modifications are documented and implemented correctly.
Deactivation of monitored accounts when systems are placed out of service.

Communicator Programming:

Assist with or oversee the programming of communicators for new and existing accounts.
Troubleshoot communication issues and coordinate with technical support when necessary.

Security System User Code Management:

Handle user code changes and updates for remote managed systems.
Maintain secure records of user access levels and permissions.

Customer Support:

Provide responsive and knowledgeable support to customers regarding their monitored accounts.
Address inquiries related to account setup, changes, and troubleshooting.
Educate customers on best practices for maintaining their monitored systems.

Qualifications:
High school diploma or equivalent.
Experience in security monitoring, alarm systems, or technical support is highly desirable.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Excellent communication and customer service abilities.
Familiarity with communicator programming and alarm panel systems is a plus.
Proficiency in using monitoring software.
Working Conditions:
Office-based with occasional remote support capabilities.
May require occasional after-hours support depending on customer needs or system alerts.

description:

As a Community Integration Specialist, you'll work directly with individuals who have developmental disabilities to help them become more independent, more connected within their community, and learn to advocate and make choices. You’ll support them as they explore interests, learn new skills, build relationships, and gain meaningful experiences through volunteering and community activities.

Teach real-life skills like communication, social skills, work skills, conflict resolution, independence, self-advocacy, self-determination, and safety.
Help build social connections and encourage independence through community and/or social activities.
Create and maintain strong partnerships with local organizations for volunteer and skill-building opportunities.
Track progress, complete documentation, and share updates with the care team.
Offer hands-on coaching and support in real-world settings.
Ensure everyone’s health and safety while out in the community, including using approved, taught behavioral interventions as needed.
Drive individuals safely to and from programs and activities.

Assist with personal care and medication if needed.
Join team meetings to discuss participants’ progress and goals.
Help manage participant petty cash when assigned.
Advocate for individuals’ independence and inclusion.
Handle other tasks as assigned.

At least 1 year of experience working with people with developmental disabilities (IDD/DD) or in a similar field.
Experience with personal care or teaching is a plus.
College coursework related to IDD/DD preferred.
Valid Ohio driver’s license and car insurance.
Ability to pass a DOT physical or obtain a doctor’s clearance to provide Non-Medical Transportation (NMT) in vehicles equipped to accommodate necessary devices.

The candidate will direct engineering execution, manage resource capacity, and lead distributed teams across multiple timezones. Minimum Qualifications

  • 8 to 11+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Platform Development, or Automation with a focus on integrated backend systems.
  • 3+ years of direct experience leading engineering teams, managing resource capacity, and delegating work across multiple timezones.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Python for backend development, API integration, and system automation.
  • Proven track record of designing, building, and deploying internal tools, scalable automation frameworks, and data validation systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to automate build and deployment workflows.
  • Solid understanding of data structures, relational and non-relational datastores, and query optimization.
  • Experience managing team delivery, setting technical acceptance criteria, and conducting performance reviews.

title: Tax Analyst
description:
The Tax Analyst will focus primarily on federal and state income tax compliance within the direct tax function. The Tax Analyst will support the preparation of federal and state tax workpapers, quarterly provision calculations, taxable income computations, annual filings, and audit documentation to help ensure accurate and timely tax compliance.

The Tax Analyst will also contribute to process improvement and automation initiatives that streamline invoice processing, tax calculations, data management, and other tax-related workflows. By leveraging tools such as Alteryx and Power Query in Excel, the Tax Analyst will help improve efficiency across direct and indirect tax processes while gaining exposure to a broad range of tax and cross-functional operations.

In addition, the Tax Analyst will support selected indirect tax activities, including customer communications, exemption certificate management, inquiry tracking, and related compliance tasks. The Tax Analyst will collaborate with finance, accounting, customer service, billing, and external service providers to complete these responsibilities.

Primary Duties

Direct Tax

1. Federal and State Quarterly Provision Support

  • Assist in preparing quarterly tax provision computations for senior review.

  • Use ONESOURCE, Alteryx, and Power Query to support quarterly tax provision processes.

  • Analyze and reconcile tax-related general ledger accounts to help ensure accuracy and completeness.

2. Notice and Audit Resolution

  • Prepare and organize audit documentation in accordance with applicable compliance checklists.

  • Track and process tax notices and provide status updates to the Income Tax Management Team.

  • Collaborate with the Income Tax Management Team on response letters, supporting documentation, and required payments.

3. Federal and State Taxable Income Computations and Annual Filings

  • Prepare workpapers supporting federal taxable income computations in collaboration with finance and accounting teams.

  • Support annual federal and state income tax filings using third-party tax software.

  • Assist with additional federal and state tax filings as required.

4. Special Projects and Tax Research

  • Conduct tax research regarding legislative and regulatory changes affecting federal and state tax compliance.

  • Document relevant findings and communicate potential compliance or process impacts to the Income Tax Management Team.

Cross-Functional

1. Alteryx and Power Query Development

  • Develop and optimize Alteryx workflows and Power Query processes to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and consistency of tax processes.

  • Serve as an Alteryx Champion by supporting team training, knowledge sharing, and workflow improvements.

2. Process Improvement and Automation

  • Identify automation opportunities within direct and indirect tax processes.

  • Assist with the development of tax data and reporting solutions using Snowflake, SQL, Python, and other applicable technologies.

3. Project Participation and Compliance

  • Participate in invoice processing and tax calculation projects involving billing systems to support accurate tax treatment and compliance.

  • Collaborate with finance, accounting, billing, customer service, and other stakeholders on tax-related operational initiatives.

Indirect Tax

1. Customer Communications and Dunning Letters

  • Prepare and send dunning letters for expiring exemption certificates.

  • Track responses and follow-up activities related to expiring exemption certificates.

2. Indirect Tax Email Support and Issue Resolution

  • Track indirect tax inquiries and coordinate timely follow-up and resolution.

  • Maintain applicable guidance and communicate tax requirements to customer service and billing teams.

3. Exemption Certificate Management

  • Process and verify exemption certificates for completeness and eligibility.

  • Update the applicable exemption certificate database and periodically review certificate status and eligibility.

Quality and Compliance

  • Perform all work in compliance with company quality procedures, internal controls, and applicable standards.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Required Education, Training and Experience

  • Bachelor degree required in Accounting or Finance (or other discipline if combined with Master's degree in Accounting or Finance)

  • No previous experience required

Preferred Education, Training and Experience

  • Master's degree in Accounting or Finance

  • Experience in accounting or tax

  • ERP: SAP, NetSuite

  • Software: Power Query, Power Automate, and Snowflake.

  • Coding: SQL, Python, VBA

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Consistently upholds and reflects the core ethical principles and values that bioMérieux promotes.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally allowing for better collaboration and communication when working across teams to achieve shared objectives

  • Driving continuous improvement by evaluating processes and implementing necessary changes

  • Written Communications - including the ability to communicate technical data in written form

  • Thriving in a fast-paced environment by managing tasks, multitasking, and adapting quickly to maintain productivity.

  • Critical thinking, using logic and reason to analyze information and make decisions in the workplace.

  • Skilled in MS Office tools to include but not limited to Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel

  • Intermediate: applies skills independently in most situations; handles moderately complex tasks with occasional guidance

  • Understanding of federal and indirect tax compliance, financial reporting, income tax accounting, and general ledger processes.

  • Proficient in research, communication, and documentation, especially in tax-related matters.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

  • Ability to remain in stationary position, either sitting or standing, for prolonged periods.

The estimated salary range for this role based in Utah is between $66,800 – $84,900. This role is eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and individual performance per bioMerieux’s bonus program. Actual compensation within this range is determined based on the successful candidate’s experience and will be presented in writing at the time of the offer.
