title: AIOS Kindergeneeskunde
description:
Functie

De opleiding Kindergeneeskunde van het OOR-ON staat bekend om zijn innovatieve karakter. Uniek aan onze opleiding is de stagegebonden academische opleiding, waarbinnen specifieke stages binnen de kindergeneeskundige deelspecialismen worden gevolgd. Daarnaast zijn we actief bezig met vernieuwingen binnen de opleiding en met ontwikkeling van interventies op het gebied van intraprofessioneel leren.

Binnen onze opleiding zijn wij op zoek naar diversiteit. Wij zijn daarom ook nieuwsgierig naar wat jij als nieuwe collega toevoegt aan ons team. Naast aandacht voor verschillende klinische competenties en medisch overstijgende kerntaken, hechten wij waarde aan verschillen in persoonlijkheid, drijfveren, talenten en maatschappelijke of culturele achtergrond. Wij geloven dat deze verscheidenheid bijdraagt aan een inspirerend opleidingsklimaat, betere samenwerking en uiteindelijk betere zorg voor kinderen en hun gezinnen.

We bieden de ruimte om in de opleiding, in samenhang en afstemming met de opleidingsgroep, te onderzoeken waar jouw kwaliteiten liggen en hoe deze optimaal kunnen worden ontwikkeld en benut. Dit kan bijvoorbeeld door middel van exploratie van de kindergeneeskunde in de volle breedteof door verdieping of profilering in een medisch overstijgende kerntaak. Uiteraard leiden wij op in nauwe samenhang met de bedrijfsvoering en staan wederkerigheid en teamgevoel bij ons hoog in het vaandel.

Jouw werkplek

Het opleidingscluster Oost Nederland (OOR-ON) biedt opleidingsplaatsen voor assistenten in opleiding tot kinderarts. De afdeling Kindergeneeskunde binnen het Amalia kinderziekenhuis van het Radboudumc vormt samen met de afdelingen Kindergeneeskunde van het Canisius Wilhelmina Ziekenhuis in Nijmegen, het Rijnstate Ziekenhuis in Arnhem en het Jeroen Bosch Ziekenhuis in 's-Hertogenbosch het cluster OOR-ON. Binnen het Amalia kinderziekenhuis en deze drie topklinische ziekenhuizen in de regio Oost-Nederland bieden wij uitstekende patiëntenzorg, onderzoek, onderwijs en opleiding ten behoeve van de kindzorg.

De opleiding vindt in principe gedurende 1,5 jaar in één van de drie algemene opleidingsziekenhuizen plaats en gedurende 3,5 jaar in het Radboudumc. De vier kinderklinieken overleggen frequent en intensief over de opleiding. Je wordt opgeleid tot een deskundig beroepsbeoefenaar die in ruime mate voldoet aan de vakcompetenties van het door de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Kindergeneeskunde (NVK) vastgestelde opleidingsplan kindergeneeskunde.

Profiel

Je bent in het bezit van het basisartsdiploma en je hebt minimaal een jaar klinische ervaring als anios kindergeneeskunde in een opleidingsziekenhuis met erkenning voor de opleiding Kindergeneeskunde. Het is van belang dat het opleidingsteam van het ziekenhuis waar je het meest recent ervaring hebt opgedaan jouw sollicitatie voor de opleiding steunt.

Kerncompetenties die wij belangrijk vinden in een kinderarts zijn integriteit, luisterend oor naar de patiënt, sensitiviteit, stressbestendigheid en zelfontwikkeling. Daarnaast hechten we waarde aan creativiteit, flexibiliteit en onderscheidende kwaliteiten.

Naast klinische ervaring zoeken we kandidaten met talenten en aantoonbare ervaringen binnen verschillende domeinen zoals:

  • Onderwijskundige vaardigheden en ervaring
  • Bestuurlijke of organisatorische ervaring
  • Kwaliteitsverbetering en zorginnovatie
  • Maatschappelijk betrokkenheid en pleitbezorging
  • Wetenschappelijke vaardigheden
  • Andere relevante opleidingen, vaardigheden of ervaringen die een bijdrage leveren aan ons vakgebied.

Goed om te weten

  • De aan te nemen kandidaten worden aangesteld in één van de algemene ziekenhuizen uit onze regio (zie boven). Salaris wordt aldaar geregeld net als het aantal contracturen. De contracturen worden in onderling overleg met de opleider vastgesteld.
  • De selectieprocedure bestaat uit een objectieve en transparante voorselectie, mogelijk gevolgd door een E-assessment en gestructureerde gesprekken. Het E-assessment vindt plaats in de periode van 26 oktober tot 5 november a.s. en wordt gebruikt om beter zicht te krijgen op de persoonlijkheid en drijfveren van de kandidaat en in de ontwikkelbaarheid van competenties die wij voor een kinderarts relevant achten.
  • De gestructureerde gesprekken met de sollicitatiecommissie vinden plaats op 23 november a.s. Ongeveer 1 week voorafgaand aan de gesprekken ontvang je bericht of je wordt uitgenodigd.
  • Referentiebrieven of mondelinge aanbevelingen worden door de selectiecommissie niet in behandeling genomen.
  • Voor deze functie is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist.
  • Wij streven naar een objectieve en transparante selectieprocedure en verwelkomen sollicitanten ongeacht achtergrond, genderidentiteit, leeftijd, geloofsovertuiging, beperking of andere kenmerken. We moedigen iedereen aan om te solliciteren en ondersteunen kandidaten waar nodig in het sollicitatieproces.

Wij werven zelf voor deze vacature. Acquisitie stellen wij niet op prijs; delen in je netwerk wél.

title: Contract Management Specialist
description:
At AbbVie, we are committed to advancing innovative medicines and improving patients' lives around the world. We are currently looking for a Contract Management Specialist to join our Clinical Operations team in Portugal. In this role, you will support clinical research activities and contract management processes for studies conducted in Portugal, while collaborating with local, regional, and global stakeholders.

You will be responsible for managing and negotiating clinical trial agreements, budgets, and related legal documentation to support the successful and timely start-up and conduct of clinical studies. Working closely with Legal, Finance, Clinical Operations, and external research sites, you will play a key role in ensuring contracts and budgets do not become a barrier to study delivery while maintaining compliance with applicable regulations and company policies.

This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with both local and global stakeholders while contributing directly to the success of AbbVie's clinical research programs.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary contract management contact for Portugal, partnering with Legal, Finance, Clinical Operations, Site Management & Monitoring, and Study Teams.
  • Manage the preparation, negotiation, and execution of clinical trial agreements, confidentiality agreements, study budgets, and related vendor contracts.
  • Lead contract and budget negotiations with investigator sites and research institutions to support timely study start-up and execution.
  • Review and support contract-related and legal documentation associated with clinical studies, working closely with Legal and other key stakeholders.
  • Liaising with Legal where playbook doesn’t already address an issue and seeking Legal approval for deviations.
  • Setting, managing and communicating priorities to local affiliate stakeholders, Legal, and Finance in alignment with study plans and priority for start-up.
  • Ensure accurate tracking of contracts, budgets, and study-related documentation, while maintaining relevant metrics and records.
  • Collecting and tracking site intelligence and communicating such to appropriate stakeholders in the Study Team, Legal, Finance, etc.
  • Ensure contracts and budgets are finalized within agreed timelines to support the timely start-up and ongoing execution of clinical studies.
  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, Business Administration, Law, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of clinical research experience, including experience in contract and budget negotiation.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Understanding of clinical research processes, as well as medical, legal, and financial concepts relevant to clinical trials.
  • Good knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and applicable local regulations.
  • Ability to interpret and apply legal, compliance, and regulatory requirements within a clinical research environment.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and decision-making ability.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills.

AbbVie Culture

At AbbVie, we care deeply about bringing innovative solutions to patients in need. By joining us as a Contract Management Specialist, you'll be at the forefront of our mission, working in a dynamic and supportive environment that encourages growth and collaboration.

  • All4OneAbbVie: Foster strong interpersonal relationships and teamwork.
  • Decide Smart & Sure: Navigate ambiguity and make informed decisions.
  • Agile & Accountable: Communicate a clear and inspiring vision.
  • Clear & Courageous: Provide honest and constructive feedback.
  • Make Possibilities Real: Efficiently plan and execute tasks while adapting to challenges.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

title: Myyjä, Porvoo Sammontie 1
description:
Hymyiletkö vielä silloinkin, kun kiire painaa päälle? Sytytkö asiakaskohtaamisista ja haluat tehdä arjesta helpompaa – sekä itsellesi että muille? Jos nyökkäilit, saatat olla seuraava R‑kioskin myyjämme.

R‑kioskilla asiakkaamme tulevat hakemaan nopeutta, mutkattomuutta ja hyvää fiilistä. Myyjänä olet tämän kokemuksen ydin: palvelun ammattilainen, joka osaa ratkaista tilanteet tyynesti ja toimia omatoimisesti myös silloin, kun tehtäviä on monta.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

  • Palvelet asiakkaita ystävällisesti ja tehokkaasti – myös ruuhkahetkinä.
  • Hallitset kassatyöskentelyn, tuotteet, palvelut ja lisämyynnin tilanteet rennolla otteella.
  • Esittelet ja suosittelet rohkeasti uutuuksia sekä kampanjatuotteita.
  • Huolehdit, että kioski on siisti, viihtyisä ja hyllyt runsaat.
  • Osallistut arjen sujuvuuteen: asiakkaat, työkaverit ja sinä viihdytte kioskilla yhtä lailla.

title: Adviseur energiemarkt en contracten
description:
Werk aan de energietransitie van het Nederlandse spoor en verbindt ProRail met de energiemarkt.

Werk om trots op te zijn

De energiemarkt verandert razendsnel. Nieuwe vormen van duurzame opwek, flexibiliteitsdiensten en ontwikkelingen op het elektriciteitsnet zorgen voor grote uitdagingen én kansen. De afdeling Energievoorziening (EV) van ProRail zorgt ervoor dat de energievoorziening van het spoor betrouwbaar, betaalbaar en toekomstbestendig blijft.

Als adviseur energiemarkt en contracten ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen ProRail en de gas- en elektriciteitsmarkt. Je werkt aan complexe vraagstukken rondom duurzame energie-inkoop, flexibiliteit op het elektriciteitsnet en het optimaliseren van energiekosten. Hierbij is er specifiek focus op Power Purchase Agreements (PPA’s), balanceringsdiensten en het restprofielbeheer. Je werkt samen met energieleveranciers, netbeheerders, marktpartijen en ProRail collega’s. Jouw analyses en adviezen dragen direct bij aan een efficiëntere, duurzamere en betaalbare energievoorziening voor ProRail en de branche.

In je dagelijkse werkzaamheden houd je je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het volgen en beoordelen van ontwikkelingen binnen de energiemarkt en deze vertalen naar kansen en risico's voor ProRail.
  • Het op basis van data bewaken van contractuele verplichtingen en KPI’s.
  • Het beheren en optimaliseren van contracten (PPA’s) voor energievoorzieningen.
  • Het adviseren over inkoop-, contracterings- en marktstrategieën en bijdragen aan aanbestedingen, contractonderhandelingen en marktconsultaties.
  • Het onderhouden van contacten met energieleveranciers, netbeheerders en andere marktpartijen.
  • Het analyseren van energieverbruik, prognoses en kostenontwikkelingen onder andere voor balanceringsdiensten en restprofielbeheer.

Jouw plek

Wij bieden graag ruimte aan iedereen. Daarbij zien wij talent als basis en diversiteit als kracht om samen betere resultaten te behalen. Voor jou als adviseur energiemarkt en contracten is er plaats binnen het team Energievoorziening, onderdeel van Assetmanagement Techniek en Systeemmanagement. De afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 50 specialisten die dagelijks werken aan een betrouwbare energievoorziening voor het Nederlandse spoor. Daarnaast werk je intensief samen met onze specialisten van de afdeling Duurzaamheid. Zij helpen je om besparings¬kansen te vinden en te contracteren.

Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan de energietransitie én tegelijkertijd concrete resultaten te realiseren in een dynamische markt.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.091,- en € 7.262,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week, schaal 9.
  • Daarbovenop 13,61% van jouw bruto salaris in de vorm van een Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Dit budget is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag en 3,25% decemberuitkering.
  • Direct een vast contract. Wij hebben vertrouwen in jou.
  • 170 vakantie-uren én de optie om tot 185 extra vakantie-uren bij te kopen vanuit jouw IKB.
  • Een NS-Business Card met Treinvrij (en een NS-Businesscard Daluren voor directe gezinsleden). Of een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km onbelast bij maximaal 120 kilometer per dag.
  • Een goed pensioen bij Rail & OV: een sterk fonds dat vooroploopt in duurzaam beleggen. Zit je nu in een ander fonds? Houd er rekening mee dat Rail & OV op 1 januari 2026 al overstapte op het nieuwe pensioenstelsel.

Wij kozen voor een kleine selectie uit onze arbeidsvoorwaarden. Maar we bieden je meer. Voor alle arbeidsvoorwaarden en onze CAO klik op deze link.

Jouw inbreng

Bij ProRail vinden wij het belangrijk dat jij gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Daarom zijn wij benieuwd naar wie jij bent. Voor deze functie breng je sowieso mee:

  • Een afgeronde hbo/wo-opleiding, aangevuld met minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in contractmanagement en/of leveranciersmanagement.
  • Analytisch denken / Probleemoplossend vermogen: Je ordent informatie, legt verbanden en vindt oplossingen voor ingewikkelde vragen.
  • Overtuigingskracht: Je overtuigt anderen met sterke argumenten en heldere ideeën.
  • Initiatief: Je herkent kansen en speelt er snel en doeltreffend op in.
  • Verantwoordelijkheid: Je komt je afspraken na en accepteert de gevolgen van je acties als je dat niet doet.

Jouw sollicitatie

Wil je als adviseur energiemarkt en contracten werken aan de toekomst van Nederland én aan die van jezelf? Solliciteer vóór 12 oktober. Bij voldoende reacties is het mogelijk dat de vacature eerder wordt gesloten dan 12 oktober. Toch eerst nog een vraag? Stel deze gerust aan Steven de Jong via steven.dejong@prorail.nl. Voor inhoudelijke vragen kun je contact opnemen met Sven Gruters via sven.gruters@prorail.nl.

Binnen 5 dagen (na de sluitingsdatum) krijg je onze reactie. Na uitnodiging voor het kennismakingsgesprek vragen we je om een online assessment te maken als aanvulling op je cv en motivatie. Een referentiecheck kan deel uitmaken van de procedure.

Word jij onze nieuwe collega? Dan hoort het aanvragen van een VOG tot de indiensttredingsprocedure. De kosten voor de VOG krijg je terug nadat je bent gestart.

title: BTS，Senior BRM
description:
The BTS Senior BRM is a pivotal senior individual contributor role within the affiliate BTS organization, serving as the primary strategic bridge between Affiliate Brand Teams, Customer Excellence, core functions, and Geo and Global Commercial BTS teams. Operating as the delegate to the LBU BTS Head, the role shapes and governs the affiliate technology agenda, ensuring commercial strategies are translated into prioritized, value-driven, and compliant technology roadmaps.

Operating in a highly complex and matrixed environment, the BTS BRM Lead partners closely with Affiliate Business Unit Directors, Brand leadership, and Customer Excellence to understand strategic priorities, identify opportunities, and influence technology investment decisions. The role has accountability for affiliate‑level demand shaping, cross‑brand prioritization, portfolio governance, and financial stewardship, while ensuring alignment with enterprise platforms, global standards, and Geo and Global capability roadmaps.

As a member of the Extended Geo BTS leadership community, the BTS BRM Lead represents the voice of the affiliate in Area and Global capability forums, influencing enterprise capability evolution and enabling fit‑for‑purpose local solutions where required. The role focuses on maximizing the value of the affiliate technology ecosystem by activating global solutions to support business needs and business models, supporting adoption, reuse, and innovation to improve value realization, speed to market, and customer impact, and owning end to end local solutions where applicable.

While the role has no direct people management responsibilities, it provides senior craft and thought leadership across the Solution Lead & BRM community by setting standards, coaching, and guiding ways of working. Acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, the BTS Solution Lead brings an externally informed, forward‑looking perspective on industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to commercial priorities, enabling brands to continuously evolve their go‑to‑market models through technology.

Major Responsibilities

  • Act as a senior strategic technology advisor to Affiliate Business Unit Directors, Brand leadership, Customer Excellence, and key affiliate functions, shaping how the commercial technology ecosystem enables business strategy, value realization, and competitive advantage.
  • Serve as the primary point of accountability and escalation for affiliate commercial technology topics, providing authoritative guidance on complex technology decisions, trade‑offs, and execution approaches in partnership with Geo and Global BTS teams.
  • Lead affiliate‑level demand shaping, intake, and cross‑brand prioritization, balancing business value, compliance, cost, capacity, and technical sustainability.
  • Define, govern, and continuously evolve the affiliate commercial technology roadmap, ensuring alignment with Global and Geo capability strategies while enabling fit‑for‑purpose local solutions where justified.
  • Represent the voice of the affiliate in Area, Geo, and Global BTS capability forums as a member of the Extended Geo BTS leadership community, influencing enterprise roadmap outcomes and ensuring affiliate needs are visible and addressed.
  • Build and sustain strong working relationships with Geo BTS Capability teams, Area/Cluster BTS leadership, Corporate BTS services, and external partners to drive alignment, reuse, and effective delivery.
  • Provide local product leadership and solution stewardship for affiliate and localized commercial technology solutions, partnering with solution architects and capability owners to shape solution options and design decisions.
  • Orchestrate delivery across Geo and Global delivery teams, PMO, and external partners, acting as release sponsor for critical affiliate initiatives and proactively managing dependencies, risks, and escalations.
  • Anticipate and manage the business and technology impact of Global and Area capability evolution, ensuring smooth transitions, minimal disruption, and alignment with existing systems and processes.
  • Drive adoption and effective use of commercial technology capabilities, partnering with UX, change, and enablement teams to ensure solutions are understood, adopted, and deliver intended business outcomes.
  • Articulate and position the value and benefits of BTS solutions, briefing stakeholders and teams on how to maximize the integrated ecosystem and continuously improve value realization through feedback and insights.
  • Shape business cases and value hypotheses, supporting business‑savvy decisions related to risk, cost, ROI, and measures of success for affiliate commercial technology initiatives.
  • Provide delegated oversight of affiliate technology investment, vendor engagement, and run/change balance within defined financial guardrails.
  • Partner with BTS governance teams to ensure compliance with SDLC, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements across all affiliate initiatives.
  • Provide craft leadership, coaching, and standards for the affiliate BRM community, enabling BRMs to operate as strategic consultants to the business without direct line management responsibility.

Experience Required

  • 8–10+ years of experience in technology, digital, or consulting roles within commercial, marketing, or sales domains.
  • Demonstrated experience in technology strategy, portfolio management, and product‑oriented delivery in a matrix environment.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross‑brand initiatives through influence rather than authority.
  • Experience working in regulated environments, including SDLC, privacy, and information security requirements.

Knowledge / Education Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field (Master’s degree a plus).
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate commercial strategy into technology roadmaps.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decisions in complex, multinational environments.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise platforms (e.g., CRM/Salesforce, Data & AI, MarTech) and integration principles.
  • Financial literacy, including business case development and investment trade‑off analysis.

Skills Required

  • Strategic thinking and portfolio prioritization
  • Technology product management and roadmap ownership
  • Stakeholder influencing and executive communication
  • Solution governance and architecture awareness
  • Financial and value management
  • Risk, compliance, and delivery oversight
  • Leadership without direct authority

title: BUSINESS ANALYST
description:
TITLE: Business Analyst

POSITION OBJECTIVE: This position serves as a bridge between business users and IT/programming teams by understanding and evaluating business needs, translating them into clear system requirements, and coordinating system enhancements, reporting, data analysis, and process improvements to support business operations.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Information Systems, Data Analytics.
3–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar role.
AS400 / IBM-i experience required.
Knowledge of business applications, databases, and enterprise systems.
Familiarity with manufacturing processes and production workflows.
Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements.
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into clear functional requirements for IT/programming teams.
Experience generating reports and running queries to retrieve, analyze, and validate system data.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting/analytics tools such as Tableau or similar BI tools.
Experience with system testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
Ability to work effectively as a bridge between business users and technical/programming teams.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Ensure consistent, dependable attendance and demonstrate a willingness to accommodate non-standard work hours as necessary.
Capable of effectively managing job-related stress and fostering productive workplace interactions.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Work closely with business users to understand business needs, processes, issues, and system requirements.
Serve as the primary liaison between business users and IT/programming teams.
Evaluate business requests and determine system requirements, potential solutions, and impacts.
Translate business needs into clear requirements and functional specifications for programmers.
Coordinate with programmers on system enhancements, modifications, integrations, and issue resolution.
Follow up on system development and enhancements to ensure requirements are understood and addressed.
Coordinate system testing and UAT with business users and programmers.
Generate reports and run system queries to analyze business data and support decision-making.
Analyze sales, production, inventory, customer, and other system data to identify trends, issues, or opportunities for improvement.
Maintain and improve business processes, system documentation, and reporting requirements.
Assist with implementation of new systems, system enhancements, and process improvements.
Provide support and guidance to users regarding system functionality and business processes.
Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency, data accuracy, and business processes.
Manage multiple system-related projects and priorities and communicate status, issues, and follow-up items to relevant teams.
Support special projects and other duties as assigned. .

WORK ENVIRONMENT CONDITIONS:

This is a hybrid position, with a combination of in-office and remote work based on business needs.
Occasional travel is required for plant visits, and business events.
Fast-paced environment with multiple concurrent projects and deadlines.
Tools/ Equipment/ Software: AS400 / IBM i, Microsoft Office/Excel, Tableau or similar reporting and analytics tools, CRM, ERP, and other company business systems.
Frequent computer and monitor use to review detailed data, reports, spreadsheets, system screens, and documentation.

title: Senior Director, Inspection Readiness
description:
About Absci

Absci is a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing novel therapeutics using generative AI. Our Integrated Drug Creation™ platform combines cutting-edge AI models with a synthetic biology data engine, enabling the rapid design of innovative therapeutics that address challenging therapeutic targets.

Absci is a global company headquartered in Vancouver, WA, and maintains offices in New York City, Switzerland, and Serbia. Learn more at or follow us on LinkedIn (@absci), X (@Abscibio), and YouTube.

The Senior Director, Inspection Readiness leader is a senior, hybrid Clinical Operations professional who provides Sponsor-level leadership for inspection readiness, GCP compliance, and clinical trial operational excellence across Absci’s clinical development portfolio. This individual will work across studies and functions to ensure that clinical trial processes, documentation, oversight, systems, and study conduct are maintained in a state of inspection readiness and can withstand regulatory inspection.

A critical responsibility of this role is to bring a cross-functional Sponsor perspective to inspection readiness. The leader will proactively identify operational and compliance gaps, assess their potential impact, establish practical remediation plans, and drive issues to resolution in partnership with Clinical Operations, Quality, Regulatory, Data Management/Biometrics, Clinical Development, Development Services, and other relevant functions.

This leader reports directly to the Senior Vice President & Head of Global Clinical Operations and will serve as a senior subject-matter expert and operational partner across the development organization. The role requires the ability to operate strategically while remaining sufficiently hands-on to review processes and documentation, support study teams, and ensure sustained execution of inspection-ready practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Sponsor-level leadership for inspection readiness and GCP compliance across clinical studies, programs, and relevant functional areas.

  • Develop, implement, and maintain a risk-based, scalable inspection readiness framework that supports Absci’s evolving clinical development portfolio.

  • Assess the inspection readiness of clinical studies and operational processes, including documentation quality, Sponsor oversight, issue management, data integrity, and adherence to applicable procedures and regulatory requirements.

  • Proactively identify compliance, process, documentation, and oversight gaps; evaluate risk and potential regulatory impact; and partner with accountable functions to establish, track, and complete remediation and preventive actions.

  • Provide cross-functional Sponsor oversight and coordination of clinical trial registration and results-reporting requirements, including and other applicable public disclosure obligations, in partnership with Regulatory, Clinical Development, Biostatistics/Data Management, and other stakeholders.

  • Establish and oversee processes for tracking applicable reporting requirements, accountabilities, timelines, supporting documentation, and evidence of compliance.

  • Partner with functional leaders to establish, maintain, and periodically assess clinical development training requirements and training matrices, ensuring role-based training is current, documented, and inspection-ready.

  • Review and assess clinical development SOPs, work instructions, plans, templates, and related controlled documents for clarity, consistency, regulatory alignment, appropriate Sponsor oversight, and operational practicality.

  • Identify areas where new or revised SOPs, work instructions, standards, tools, or processes are needed and support development, implementation, training, and adoption.

  • Partner closely with Data Management/Biometrics and other cross-functional teams to support operational quality, data integrity, inspection readiness, issue resolution, and readiness for key study milestones such as database lock.

  • Support study teams in maintaining inspection-ready Trial Master Files and other essential records, including appropriate documentation of Sponsor oversight, decisions, escalations, risk management, and issue resolution.

  • Evaluate CRO and vendor oversight practices and documentation to ensure Sponsor responsibilities, governance, escalation, performance management, and evidence of oversight are appropriately defined and documented.

  • Establish inspection-readiness metrics, dashboards, risk indicators, and management routines that provide visibility into compliance health, emerging risks, remediation status, and readiness across the portfolio.

  • Lead or coordinate periodic inspection-readiness reviews, mock inspections, gap assessments, and targeted deep dives, and ensure resulting observations and actions are tracked through closure.

  • Support preparation for and execution of regulatory inspections and Sponsor audits, including inspection planning, document readiness, interview preparation, response coordination, and post-inspection remediation, as applicable.

  • Partner with Quality to ensure appropriate alignment between Clinical Operations execution and the company Quality Management System while maintaining clear functional ownership and accountability.

  • Monitor evolving ICH-GCP expectations, applicable clinical trial regulations, regulatory inspection trends, and industry best practices and translate them into practical improvements to clinical operations processes and oversight.

  • Promote a culture of quality, accountability, operational discipline, continuous improvement, and proactive inspection readiness across study teams and functions.

  • Provide senior-level coaching and guidance to study teams and functional stakeholders on GCP compliance, inspection readiness, documentation practices, and operational excellence.

  • Support strategic initiatives across Global Clinical Operations and the broader development organization where strong cross-functional operational and compliance leadership is required.

  • Up to 20–30% domestic and international travel, as required.

Qualifications & Preferred Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

  • 15+ years of clinical operations, clinical quality, or related drug-development experience, with substantial direct experience in global clinical trial execution and inspection readiness.

  • Deep knowledge of ICH-GCP, Sponsor responsibilities, applicable clinical trial regulations, quality systems, and regulatory inspection expectations.

  • Demonstrated experience preparing for and supporting regulatory inspections, Sponsor audits, mock inspections, and inspection-readiness assessments.

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end clinical trial operations across study start-up, conduct, monitoring, data management, safety interfaces, TMF, CRO/vendor oversight, database lock, closeout, and reporting.

  • Experience with clinical trial registration and results disclosure requirements, including , and the operational controls needed to support timely and compliant reporting.

  • Demonstrated experience reviewing, developing, or improving SOPs, work instructions, controlled documents, training requirements, and operational processes.

  • Experience assessing and remediating cross-functional compliance and operational gaps, with the ability to translate regulatory expectations into practical, sustainable processes.

  • Strong knowledge of TMF requirements and inspection-ready documentation practices, including documentation of Sponsor oversight and decision-making.

  • Experience partnering with Data Management/Biometrics, Regulatory, Quality, Clinical Development, Safety, and other functions on clinical trial compliance and operational readiness.

  • Strong CRO and vendor oversight experience, including governance, performance management, escalation, risk management, and documentation of Sponsor oversight.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a small, fast-paced, growth-oriented biotechnology or pharmaceutical environment and to create structure where processes are still evolving.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive accountability without direct authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate complex compliance and operational issues clearly and pragmatically.

  • Highly analytical, detail- and process-oriented, with strong project management, problem-solving, prioritization, and follow-through.

  • Ability to operate strategically at the Sponsor and portfolio level while remaining hands-on enough to assess documentation, processes, and study-level execution.

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be a pragmatic, highly experienced clinical operations leader who combines deep GCP and inspection-readiness expertise with a strong understanding of how clinical trials are actually executed. They will bring an enterprise-wide Sponsor perspective, identify risks before they become inspection findings, and work collaboratively across functions to establish practical and sustainable solutions. This individual will be comfortable challenging existing practices when needed, driving accountability without creating unnecessary bureaucracy, and building an enduring culture in which inspection readiness is embedded in day-to-day clinical trial execution rather than treated as a periodic exercise.

AbSci offers highly competitive salaries and benefits, including medical and dental insurance, paid time off, and 401(k) with a generous company match.

Legal authorization to work in the United States is required. Absci is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which they have applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact hiring@absci.com.

title: Discovery Trail Keeper
description:
Hours: 37.5 hours over 5 days
Work pattern: Including weekends, bank holidays and evenings
Duration: Permanent

West Midlands Safari Park currently has a permanent vacancy available for an Animal Keeper on the Discovery Trail Section.
This is an exciting opportunity, where we are looking for applicants who can demonstrate the ability and knowledge to work with an extensive range of species. The role involves mainly working with the reptiles, invertebrates, bats and red pandas. The position involves husbandry tasks, such as feeding, cleaning, health monitoring and enclosure maintenance delivered to a high standard. It includes monitoring of our guests and being front of house delivering talks and guest experiences. The role also includes some tasks with the animals in our Safari Academy area.

About you
The role requires someone who is confident, motivated and enthusiastic about wildlife conservation and has excellent communication skills. The successful applicant will require good wildlife knowledge and have an animal related qualification to HND level or above. We are looking for someone with previous experience in a similar role. It is a physically demanding but very rewarding role.
You will need to be observant with excellent attention to detail and be able to keep calm under pressure in a fast paced environment.
Due to driving company vehicles, we are looking for applicants who have full, valid driver’s licenses. Weekend, bank holiday working and flexibility in working hours is essential to this role. Some evening work will be required during special events throughout the year

Benefits
As well as benefiting from working in a unique and beautiful setting, you’ll also receive a range of additional perks to employment including:

WMSP Annual Pass which gives you and your family and friends free admission and theme park wristbands, and free entry to our sister site Drayton Manor Park also Water World Stoke On Trent
20% Discount in our retail and catering outlets and off park special events.
24 Hour access to an online doctor and access to online prescriptions.
Counselling access.
Online retailer discount portal.

What we are
West Midlands Safari Park is an award-winning visitor attraction, located in Worcestershire in the heart of England. It is home to some of the world’s most beautiful and critically endangered species, with a four-mile safari drive-through, walk-through Discovery Trail, African Village and Lemur Woods, as well beautiful walking trails, allowing guests to experience up close encounters with hundreds of amazing animals. Guests can also choose from a wide range of catering and retail outlets, as well as enjoying a large amusement area with over 25 rides and attractions providing the ideal venue for family days out.
In 2021, the Park introduced Safari Lodges – luxury accommodation allowing guests to stay overnight for the first time. Guests can wake up to incredible sights of elephants, giraffes, rhinos, hippos and red pandas, or sleep just a ‘whisker’ away from lions, white lions, tigers and cheetahs.
In addition, the Park is home to three incredible venues – Spring Grove House, Treetops Pavillion and Cellarz, which play host to weddings, corporate events and social celebrations.

What we do
Our mission is to bring people together to create unique wildlife experiences that exhilarate, educate and leave memories to last a lifetime.
Our 200-acre site allows us to do just that, whether you’re a day guest, wedding guest or overnight guest! We create experiences unlike no other, attracting visitors from across the Midlands and beyond.
Our brand and our team members live by our core values. We’re passionate and work with a sense of togetherness, always striving to be progressive, with preservation at the heart of everything we do, all while creating unforgettable experiences.
Through these principles we aspire to achieve our vision: to be the number one UK wildlife attraction through the creation of immersive animal habitats and unique visitor experiences.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Vill du driva den datadrivna utvecklingen inom svenskt lantbruk?

Vill du arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan affär, data och teknik och vara med och skapa verkligt affärsvärde? Trivs du i en roll där du får kombinera analys, förändringsledning och verksamhetsutveckling? Då kan det här vara nästa steg för dig.

Just nu söker vi en Business Analyst till Lantbruks divisionen inom Lantmännen. Här får du en nyckelroll i vår fortsatta resa mot ett mer datadrivet arbetssätt, där du hjälper verksamheten att identifiera nya möjligheter, utveckla smartare lösningar och omsätta data till konkreta affärsresultat. Du blir en viktig brygga mellan verksamhet och IT och får möjlighet att påverka hur framtidens beslutsstöd, dataprodukter och digitala lösningar utvecklas.

Det här kommer du att göra
Som Business Analyst har du en nyckelroll i att förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem till datadrivna lösningar som skapar affärsvärde. Du fungerar som länken mellan verksamhet, produktägare och utvecklingsteam och bidrar till att stärka organisationens förmåga att fatta bättre beslut med stöd av data, analys och AI.

Du driver initiativ från behovsanalys och kravinsamling till implementering och uppföljning av affärsnytta. I rollen arbetar du med att identifiera möjligheter, definiera krav och säkerställa att lösningarna ger önskad effekt för verksamheten.

Du kommer att samarbeta med många olika intressenter och ha kontaktytor inom våra tre bolag i divisionen. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med olika funktioner inom verksamheten såväl som IT. Därför söker vi dig som trivs med att bygga relationer, förstå olika perspektiv och arbeta tvärfunktionellt.

Vi har en stark grund inom data och analys, men ser stora möjligheter att utveckla vårt datadrivna arbetssätt ytterligare. Därför söker vi dig som är nyfiken, initiativrik och motiveras av att identifiera nya möjligheter, utmana invanda arbetssätt och omsätta idéer till konkreta resultat.

Du blir en del av vårt Data Insight & Automation-team, som idag består av sju personer, med placering i Malmö.

Det här behöver du för att lyckas och trivas

Du har:

title: Leasing Consultant - ReNew on Ridgewood
description:
About Trinity Property Consultants

At Trinity Property Consultants, your expertise fuels our mission. Guided by our values of innovation, teamwork, excellence, and empowerment, we’ve been a leader in the multifamily industry for over 25 years and proudly manage properties for a nationally ranked NMHC’s Apartment Owner. We are building more than great places to live – we’re creating vibrant communities and meaningful careers.

Compensation: $18 to $20 hourly, depending on experience, plus lease commissions and lease renewal bonuses.

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.

The Opportunity

As a Leasing Consultant, you will be the face of the property, providing exceptional customer service while driving leasing goals and creating a seamless experience for prospective and current residents. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career in multifamily property management while helping shape a welcoming, thriving community.

What You’ll Own

Leasing & Sales

  • Show, lease, and welcome prospective residents to the property.
  • Assist in completing market surveys and execute marketing strategies to maintain strong occupancy.
  • Process rental applications accurately and efficiently.
  • Guide residents through move-in, ensuring a smooth experience.

Resident Experience & Service

  • Provide superior customer service, responding promptly and professionally to resident inquiries or concerns.
  • Process maintenance requests and work with the team to ensure timely resolution.
  • Maintain resident files with completeness and accuracy.

Operational & Administrative Performance

  • Maintain daily updates of unit availability and community calendars.
  • Perform regular inspections to ensure all units meet Trinity’s move-in ready standards.
  • Support property management with administrative duties, phone support, and other tasks as needed.
  • Conduct move-out inspections and assist with property turnover procedures.
  • Handle resident collections in accordance with Trinity’s standards.

What You Bring

  • Customer Focus: Passion for providing a high-quality, personalized experience for residents.
  • Sales Drive: Consistently achieve leasing objectives while upholding the highest standards of professionalism.
  • Organization & Efficiency: Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize wisely, and maintain accurate records.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with residents, prospects, and the team.
  • Problem Solving: Able to handle high-stress situations and resolve conflicts constructively.

Qualifications

  • Experience: At least 1 year in a customer service or sales role; multifamily leasing experience preferred.
  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education or certifications are a plus (e.g. knowledge of Fair Housing laws and regulations).
  • Tech Proficiency: Intermediate skills in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook). Experience with Yardi, Entrata, EliseAI, Celeri and social media is a bonus.

Requirements

Availability & Travel

This position will require availability for nights, weekends, and holidays as needed. Active participation in team functions and regional or company activities is expected.

Physical Demands

This position necessitates regular periods of sitting, standing, walking, as well as use of hands and arms. Occasional climbing may be required. Extended use of computers or telephones is also necessary. The role may require lifting up to 25 pounds independently, and occasionally up to 50 pounds with assistance. The ability to respond promptly to both visual and auditory alarms is essential. Candidates must be able to work both indoors and outdoors under various weather conditions, including rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, and sleet.

We Take Care of You

  • Medical, Dental & Vision: Highlights include company-paid individual PPO-HSA plan (with $1,200 annual employer contribution); HMO options for California residents. Dental and vision premiums are fully covered for employees; coverage for dependents is available at an additional cost.
  • Retirement Plans (401K): The company matches the employee's contribution up to 2% of salary.
  • Life & Disability Insurance: We provide up to $25,000 in life insurance and AD&D, short and long-term disability when enrolled in a medical plan.
  • Time Off: 11 paid holidays, 2-4 weeks of vacation (based on tenure), and paid sick time.
  • Referral Bonuses: $1,000 referral bonuses for eligible hires.
  • Volunteer Time Off: Up to 16 hours annually (8 for personal volunteer activities, 8 for company-sponsored events).
  • Perks: Professional development, tuition reimbursement, employee discounts, and more.

Our Commitment to Belonging

Trinity Property Consultants is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful workplace where all individuals can thrive irrespective of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability or other protected classes.

Ready to Join Us?

Explore what it’s like to grow your career with a company that values people as much as performance. Learn more and apply today!

Note: This job description includes the core Leasing Consultant responsibilities of Trinity Property Consultants. These duties are subject to change based on company discretion.

Trinity Property Consultants is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against persons because of age, race, color, creed, religion, disability, gender, ethnic or national origin, or veteran status. Trinity Property Consultants prohibits discrimination against individuals with disabilities and will reasonably accommodate applicants with a disability, upon request, and will also ensure reasonable accommodation for employees with a disability.

title: Enrollment Services Associate
description:
Summary
The Enrollment Services Associate is responsible for ensuring all prospective and enrolled students receive timely, accurate and compliant information and overall excellent customer service.

Compensation: The starting pay range for this position is $25.00-$29.00 per hour.

Schedule: M-F 8a-5p, 9a-6p, and one late shift of 10a-7p per week

The Enrollment Services Associate will promptly schedule and conduct interviews with prospective students, providing complete and accurate information regarding educational programs, expected outcomes, student services, and financial considerations while determining the appropriateness of candidates for enrollment.


The Enrollment Services Associate will follow up with both interviewed and enrolled students through to matriculation.

The Enrollment Services Associate works primarily with students interested in one of San Joaquin Valley College’s core or linear programs. These programs typically start every 5 to 16 weeks and can include onsite, blended, and fully online certificate and degree programs, as well as degree completion programs.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Ensures compliance in all recruiting activities, adheres to all laws and regulations governing student recruitment activities, and upholds Carrington College's conduct and ethics expectations.
  • Conducts a high volume of outbound telephone calls and interviews with prospective students, providing complete and accurate information regarding educational programs, expected outcomes, student services, and financial considerations while determining the appropriateness of candidates for enrollment.
  • Meet or exceed all performance metrics and individual production goals.
  • Manages workflows to ensure regular, active outreach and follow-up with prospective students interested in interviewing, those who have already interviewed, and enrolled students through to matriculation.
  • Must learn detailed information regarding all campus program offerings to ensure that only accurate information is communicated. Utilize resources and subject matter experts as appropriate.
  • Partners daily with the Student Finance team and with each interviewed student to provide them with the necessary information to make an informed decision regarding enrollment and to provide clear communications regarding next steps.
  • After each contact with prospective and enrolled students, update the Student Information System with detailed notes.
  • Exhibits a sense of urgency to follow the application process and assists students with navigating the enrollment processes related to timelines and the collection of information and documents required before starting classes.
  • Is prepared for and participates effectively in student review meetings.
  • Networks to develop professional relationships to generate relationship inquiries and referrals.
  • Provides accurate and timely enrollment forecasts.
  • Is open to and acts upon feedback and coaching.
  • Takes initiative and is skilled in self-management, demonstrating effective analytical, problem-solving, multi-tasking, and time management skills.
  • Uses enrollment services tools and data from the student information system and from student review meetings to know how to balance the need to conduct additional interviews and the need to follow up with those who have interviewed and with those individuals who have already enrolled to ensure you meet or exceed individual goals.
  • Works effectively in a team environment, supporting overall campus goals and objectives.
  • Maintains effective communications with all departments of the College.
  • Engages with the entire College Campus community, cross-departmental meetings, events and activities as appropriate.
  • Completes other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.

Competency: To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Business Acumen – Leverages knowledge of the business to develop solutions balancing business needs with organizational risk.

Analytical Thinking – Synthesizes complex or diverse information to identify trends and develops proactive solutions to minimize risks to the business.

Conflict Resolution – Takes actions that resolve conflicts in a manner that is best for both the organization and the individuals involved; addresses complaints and problems quickly and effectively; keeps all parties
informed of the status.

Professional Development – Commits to his/her professional development and personal development to stay current in field.

Language Skills – Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to build relationships and influence hiring decisions.

Computer Skills – To perform this job successfully, an individual should have experience with Microsoft Office Suite, intermediate Excel skills. Experience in working with customer relationship management solutions.

Qualifications
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty listed above satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience

  • Bachelor degree preferred, Associate degree required.
  • Minimum of 3 years of high-volume, fast-paced customer service experience.
  • Prior Enrollment Services/Admissions or non-durable sales experience a plus.
  • Superior organizational, problem-solving, multi-tasking, and time management skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills are required.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite – Outlook, Word, Visio, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee is occasionally required to stand; climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

Work Environment
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions and outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

All qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment. To ensure the safety and integrity of our operations, it is imperative that a review of all applicants' criminal history is conducted. Failure to do so poses a significant risk to the Employer, potentially compromising both business operations and the organization's reputation.

As part of our standard hiring process, all candidates offered a position at San Joaquin Valley College Inc. will undergo a thorough background screening. This includes education verification, county and national criminal background checks, a motor vehicle report, and social security number trace/verification along with an address history search. Depending on the specific position, additional requirements may apply, such as drug testing, a Fraud and Abuse Control Information System check, and verification for access to the National Student Loan Database System.

title: Asiakaspalvelupäällikkö, K-Citymarket Jämsä
description:
Haemme nyt tekijöiden taloon K-Citymarket Jämsään asiakaspalvelupäällikköä, jonka sydän sykkii myynnin tekemiselle ja joka yhdessä tiiminsä kanssa tähtää joka päivä kohti parempaa kauppaa.

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja alkaa 1.1.2027

Millainen rooli on kyseessä?

Vastaat siitä että kaupassa on kiva käydä ja että asiakas ja laatu ohjaavat kaikkea tekemistä kaupassa. Sinulla on vastuu tavaratalon kassa- ja palvelutoimintojen päivittäisestä operatiivisesta johtamisesta tavaratalosta vastaavan tavaratalopäällikön alaisuudessa. Yhteistyö talon muiden esihenkilöiden kanssa on tiivistä. Yhdessä varmistatte, että kauppa vastaa asiakkaiden odotuksia ja tarjoaa ensiluokkaisen ostokokemuksen.

Cittarissa asiakaspalvelupäällikkö on oman joukkueensa kapteeni

Johdat monipuolista asiakaspalvelun ammattilaisten joukkuettasi läsnäolevasti myymälän sykkeessä. Varmistat palveluiden sujuvuuden ja että asiakaskokemus on tasalaatuinen myös kiireisinä hetkinä. Innostat tiimiä kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita ja varmistat, että jokaisella on selkeä rooli, ajantasainen osaaminen ja hyvä fiilis tulla töihin. Viet ideat käytäntöön yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Tässä tehtävässä johdat tavaratalon asiakaspalvelun arkea. Vastaat siitä, että tiimilläsi on selkeä suunta, toimivat käytännön työn rakenteet ja hyvät edellytykset onnistua jokaisessa asiakaskohtaamisessa. Työsi painottuu ennen kaikkea henkilöstöjohtamiseen: valmennat, sparraat ja tuet tiimiäsi sekä autat heitä kasvamaan omassa roolissaan.

Vastuualueellesi kuuluvat mm. kassalinjaston ja asiakaspalvelupisteen toiminta, työvuorosuunnittelu, perehdytykset ja myynnin kehittäminen. Työssäsi huolehdit myös talousasioiden ja rahaliikenteen sujuvuudesta ja turvallisuudesta. Vastaat myös ikärajavalvonnan toteutumisesta.

Johdat tekemistä datan avulla asettaen selkeät tavoitteet ja seuraamalla keskeisiä tunnuslukuja. Hyödynnät tietoa päätöksenteossa varmistaen sujuvat, tehokkaat ja asiakaslähtöiset palvelut. Kehität toimintaa systemaattisesti tiimisi kanssa K-Citymarketin strategiaan nojaten. Varmistat kassatoimintojen, palvelupisteen ja palvelutoimintojen (mm. Veikkaus, pakettipalvelut) laadukkaan ja kannattavan toiminnan. Huolehdit henkilöstö- ja asiakastyytyväisyydestä ja teet yhteistyötä tavaratalon elintarvikepuolesta itsenäisenä yrittäjänä vastaavan K-Citymarket kauppiaan kanssa.

Meillä pärjäät, kun sytyt tavoitteista, tartut toimeen ja viet tiimiäsi eteenpäin hyvällä fiiliksellä. Työssä yhdistyvät ihmisläheinen esihenkilötyö, myyntihenkisyys ja numerot hallitseva ote. Saat energiaa ison tiimin luotsaamisesta, palautteen antamisesta ja siitä, kun näet ihmisten onnistuvan ja asiakaskokemuksen kehittyvän. Arkea rytmittävät sesongit ja kampanjat. Meillä arvostetaan Let's K asennetta: olet valmis käärimään hihat ja auttamaan siellä, missä tarvitaan. Välillä se voi tarkoittaa työskentelyä infossa tai kassalla, esillepanojen tekoa tai inventointia varhain aamulla. Tähtäämme odotukset ylittävään palvelukokemukseen, jossa asiakkaat lähtevät kaupasta hymy huulilla ja plussat taskussa.

Tämä rooli sopii sinulle, joka haluat johtaa näkyvästi, olla läsnä tiimisi arjessa, kehittää tekemistä ja olla mukana rakentamassa yhdessä tiimisi kanssa parasta Cittari kokemusta 🧡

Käy tutustumassa Kiiran ja Annan ajatuksiin työstä Cittarissa: Töissä K-Citymarket päällikkönä

Töihin tekijöiden taloon?

  • kuukausipalkan lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustavaan tulospalkkioon kerran vuodessa
  • saat käyttöösi monipuoliset henkilöstöedut, jotka tukevat arkeasi ja vapaa-aikaasi: Epassi Flex, henkilöstöalennukset K-ryhmän myymälöissä, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus sekä yhteistyökumppaneiden edut liikuntaan, hyvinvointiin, optikkopalveluihin sekä matkailuun ja majoitukseen
  • tuemme osaamisesi kehittämistä koulutusten, eLearning-sisältöjen ja verkostojen kautta
  • useita urapolkuvaihtoehtoja kansainvälisessä konsernissa
  • vastuullisen ja näkyvän roolin vilkkaassa kauppaympäristössä
  • mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman osastosi tuloksiin ja tekemisen tapoihin
  • perehdytyksen ja esihenkilöiden tuen tehtävässä onnistumiseen
  • joustavat työajat kaupan arjen puitteissa

Menestyt tehtävässä, jos sinulla on

  • kaupallista koulutusta ja aiempaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä
  • näyttöä tuloksellisesta tekemisestä tai tiimin vetämisestä
  • vahva halu kehittää myyntiä ja saavuttaa erinomaisia tuloksia, aitoa asiakaspalveluasennetta sekä halua luoda ylivertainen asiakaskokemus
  • kyky innostaa, ideoida, ohjata toimintaa kohti tavoitteita ja saada tiimi mukaan tekemiseen
  • reipas ja vastuullinen työote sekä halu olla läsnä arjessa ja tarttua toimeen
  • valmius työskennellä kaupan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti
  • tehtävässä tarvitset hyvää suomen kielen taitoa. Englannin kielen osaaminen on eduksi.
  • Toivomme, että hyödynnät työssäsi digitaalisia ja älykkäitä työkaluja sujuvamman tekemisen, paremman päätöksenteon tai työn kehittämisen tukena silloin, kun se on roolin kannalta tarkoituksenmukaista.
  • Tehtävässä tarvitset hyvää suomen kielen taitoa. Englannin kielen osaaminen on eduksesi.

Kiinnostuitko?

Hae tehtävää ja kerro meille, millaisella otteella innostat tiimiäsi ja johdat asiakaskokemusta.

Jos haluat lisätietoa tehtävästä, soita tai laita sähköpostia: tavaratalopäällikkö Erja Tuominen, puh. 0504063098 tai sähköpostitse erja.tuominen@citymarket.fi. Olisi hienoa kuulla sinusta mahdollisimman pian, joten lähetäthän hakemuksesi viimeistään 11.10.2026 mennessä oheisen linkin kautta.

Meillä K-ryhmässä toimitaan LET´S K asenteella. Se tarkoittaa meille tekemisen kulttuuria, jossa toimimme ratkaisukeskeisesti, asiakaslähtöisesti, periksiantamattomasti ja suhtaudumme asioihin positiivisesti. Uskomme vahvasti siihen, että jokaisella on lupa loistaa.

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Yhdenvertaisuus, syrjimättömyys ja oikeudenmukaisuus ovat keskeisiä periaatteitamme rekrytoinnissa, palkitsemisessa ja urakehityksessä.

title: Optometric Assistant Part Time
description:

Want to bring the “care” back to the vision care industry? We're looking for charismatic types who are ready to be the heart of our brand. title: Senior Director, Practice Systems & Business Enablement
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Position Overview
The Senior Director, Practice Systems, Product & Business Enablement is a strategic leadership role within the MSO Technology Solutions organization, responsible for the vision, roadmap, delivery, and continuous improvement of the non-clinical systems and workflows that power day-to-day operations across the MSO. This includes practice management and other business-critical platforms supporting scheduling, patient access, check-in/out, insurance verification, prior authorization, revenue cycle workflows, and related administrative functions.

This leader will operate with a strong product mindset, ensuring that technology investments are tightly aligned to business priorities, user needs, and measurable operational outcomes. They will work in close partnership with field operations, revenue cycle, clinical and administrative leaders, and technology partners to identify high-value problems, prioritize opportunities, and deliver practical solutions that reduce administrative burden, improve billing accuracy, increase throughput, and support a high-quality patient and staff experience.

A key part of the role is translating operational needs into clear product direction and disciplined specifications that can be executed in partnership with a Principal Architect / Forward Engineer and an AI-enabled delivery model. This leader does not need to be the deepest technical architect, but they must be highly effective at framing problems, defining desired outcomes, driving prioritization, and enabling rapid, high-quality execution through strong collaboration with architecture and engineering partners.

As the MSO expands into new specialties, markets, and care models, this leader will ensure that core business systems and workflows remain scalable, adaptive, and performance-oriented. The ideal candidate brings a combination of healthcare or adjacent provider workflow experience, product-oriented leadership, and a relentless focus on incremental business value.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for practice systems and related administrative platforms across the MSO.

  • Apply product management principles to identify user needs, prioritize opportunities, and sequence investments based on business value, feasibility, and organizational readiness.

  • Translate operational pain points and strategic priorities into clear problem statements, product direction, and measurable outcomes.

  • Balance enterprise standardization with flexibility needed to support specialty, market, and operational differences.

Business Enablement and Operational Impact

  • Lead the continuous improvement of systems and workflows that support front-office, administrative, and revenue-enabling functions, including scheduling, registration, check-in/out, insurance verification, prior authorization, and related business processes.

  • Drive measurable improvements in operational performance, such as administrative efficiency, billing accuracy, throughput, cycle times, staff experience, and patient experience.

  • Partner closely with operations and revenue cycle leaders to ensure solutions address root causes and create durable business value.

  • Maintain a strong orientation toward incremental wins, adoption, and outcomes rather than feature delivery alone.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as a senior partner to field operations, business leaders, revenue cycle teams, and technology stakeholders in shaping priorities and delivering change.

  • Build strong relationships across a matrixed environment, aligning diverse stakeholders around common goals, tradeoffs, and roadmaps.

  • Lead through influence, clarity, and execution discipline in a fast-paced, evolving organization.

Architecture, Specifications, and AI-Enabled Delivery

  • Partner closely with a Principal Architect / Forward Engineer to translate business needs and product priorities into disciplined specifications that enable efficient solution design and delivery.

  • Contribute to an operating model in which clear requirements, thoughtful product framing, and strong architectural partnership accelerate execution through AI-enabled development and delivery approaches.

  • Ensure solutions are designed with scalability, usability, reliability, and operational sustainability in mind.

  • Help establish repeatable ways of working that improve speed, quality, and consistency across technology delivery.

Innovation and Modernization

  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies, automation opportunities, and AI-enabled capabilities that can simplify administrative workflows and improve operational performance.

  • Champion practical innovation, focusing on solutions that are implementable, measurable, and meaningful to end users and the business.

  • Support the evolution of business systems and processes to meet the needs of a growing, multi-specialty MSO.

7. Travel and Field Engagement

  • Spend time in the field visiting practices to understand workflows, challenges, and opportunities firsthand.

  • Build deep empathy for the lived experiences of staff and patients, ensuring systems are grounded in real-world needs.

  • Expected travel: ~20-30%, with flexibility based on organizational needs.

It does not alter actual job duties, responsibilities, reporting lines, working conditions, grading, compensation, or other essential terms and conditions of employment.

Where a team member's role is governed by an employment agreement, local terms and conditions, prior job description or collective bargaining agreement, those documents shall prevail in case of any inconsistency. Mandatory local laws shall also prevail.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, healthcare administration, business, engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare technology, business systems, digital product management, operational enablement, or related functions.

  • Experience leading or enabling systems and workflows in healthcare provider, ambulatory, MSO, physician practice, or closely related environments.

  • Demonstrated success applying product-oriented ways of working to operational or workflow-heavy business domains.

  • Strong track record of delivering measurable business outcomes, not just technical implementations.

  • Experience partnering across operations, revenue cycle, business, and technology teams in complex, matrixed organizations.

  • Ability to translate business needs into structured priorities, roadmap decisions, and clear specifications for technical delivery teams.

  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Orientation:Ability to balance long-term business enablement goals with the tactical demands of execution and scalability.

  • Operational Excellence:Demonstrates rigor and discipline in managing processes, driving efficiency, and delivering results.

  • Empathy for Stakeholders:Balances the needs of staff, patients, and field operations with a focus on creating seamless, impactful experiences.

  • Enablement Mindset:Builds tools, structures, and cultures that empower staff and administrators to succeed, fostering a sense of ownership and accountability.

  • Change Leadership:Guides teams through ambiguity and transformation, ensuring clarity, alignment, and engagement throughout the journey.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. title: Associate Director, Patient Services Business Design
description:
AbbVie Patient Services is an industry-leading organization, providing unparalleled patient support resulting in superior patient satisfaction. The Associate Director, Patient Services Business Design, serves as a strategic bridge between business vision and operational execution. Reporting to the Director, Business Design, the role operates within the Patient Services Business Design team, applying business architecture principles to translate organizational strategy into actionable capabilities, processes, and roadmaps — enabling people, processes and technology to meet present and future needs of the patient. This individual will work closely with key stakeholders to define the end-to-end business process of our patient support programs ensuring alignment of business objectives, while looking for opportunities to optimize the current state, overcome challenges, drive consistency, and efficiencies in speed to market.

To be successful, this person will have a strong business acumen to enable collaboration across stakeholders, while leading cross functionally to support the strategy. In addition to being highly collaborative, they must have strong written and oral communication skills and be capable of obtaining alignment from multiple key stakeholders across a highly matrixed organization. They should be comfortable with developing relationships across a diverse spectrum of customers, while having the ability to prioritize initiatives based on key impact propositions. This role will be required to clearly evaluate, articulate and partner to drive alignment across diverse business functions given complex interdependencies, specifically Business Technology Solutions, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Patient Engagement teams, Access and Reimbursement teams, Enterprise Strategy, and vendor partners.

    • Influence and persuade across multiple external and internal constituents (stakeholders and partners) to deliver the best solutions to support patients. Infuse AbbVie Ways of Working and Talent Philosophy in day-to-day leadership and interactions with the team.
    • Be capable of communicating plans and status at all levels of the organization
  • Translate Strategy into Execution
