title: Plant Controller
description:
Job Summary
The Plant Controller serves as the financial leader of the manufacturing facility and is accountable for maximizing plant profitability through rigorous cost management, operational partnership, and proactive leadership across the manufacturing organization. Owns the financial performance of the plant P&L and is expected to be highly visible on the production floor, partnering daily with Operations, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, and Plant Leadership to drive labor productivity, material yield improvement, overhead optimization, and working capital performance. Actively influences plant decisions, identifies inefficiencies, challenges assumptions, and drives corrective actions to deliver world-class manufacturing performance. Influences every dollar spent and every dollar earned within the plant.

Key Responsibilities
Plant Financial Leadership

Serve as the primary financial leader and strategic business partner to the Plant Manager.
Provides financial leadership across all operational decisions.
Own the complete plant P&L, including manufacturing costs, labor, materials, overhead, maintenance expenses, consumables, and inventory performance.
Deliver timely, accurate, and actionable financial insights that enable rapid decision-making.
Lead monthly financial reviews, forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning processes.
Drive a culture of financial accountability throughout the facility.

Manufacturing Cost Management

Support all manufacturing cost improvement initiatives focused on:

Material utilization and yield
Labor productivity
OEE improvement
Overhead management
Waste elimination

Develop and implement processes to identify, quantify, and eliminate cost losses throughout the manufacturing process.
Partner with operations teams to translate manufacturing metrics into financial outcomes and measurable savings.
Establish rigorous cost controls and continuously challenge spending levels against benchmarks and standards.
Ensure recovery of customer associated costs

Shop Floor Financial Leadership

Maintain a highly visible presence on the manufacturing floor.
Spend significant time in production areas understanding drivers of performance and financial results firsthand.
Partner directly with Production Managers, Supervisors, Maintenance Leaders, Supply Chain teams, and Operators to identify cost-saving opportunities.
Drive accountability for labor efficiency, material usage variances, productivity metrics, downtime costs, scrap reduction, and inventory performance.
Utilize daily management systems to connect operational performance with financial outcomes.

Labor Productivity and Workforce Cost Control

Lead labor cost analysis across all the production lines and departments.
Monitor staffing and crewing levels, overtime, efficiency metrics, and workforce productivity.
Identify opportunities to optimize labor deployment while supporting safety, quality, and service objectives.
Partner with Operations leadership to institutionalize labor performance metrics and accountability.

Material Cost and Yield Management

Own financial oversight of material consumption and manufacturing yields.
Drive variance analysis related to:

Raw materials
Packaging materials
Ingredient utilization
Scrap and waste
Rework losses

Ensure robust controls exist around inventory consumption, production reporting, and loss tracking.
Lead financial reviews of yield opportunities and manufacturing process improvements.

Overhead, Repair & Maintenance Control

Establish financial discipline around plant overhead spending.
Drive aggressive management of:

Repair and maintenance expenses, Plant supplies and consumables
Indirect labor
Utilities and Contract services

Challenge spending requests and ensure every expenditure supports operational value creation.
Partner with Maintenance and Engineering leadership to optimize preventive maintenance investments while controlling total maintenance costs.
Develop visibility and accountability around plant fixed and variable spending.

Financial Planning, Analysis, and Controls

Lead annual budget, forecasts, monthly and weekly estimate processes including standard costs development and maintenance for the Plant
Develop predictive financial models that support plant performance management.
Ensure compliance with all internal controls, accounting policies, and corporate reporting requirements.
Lead month-end close activities related to plant operations.
Maintain audit-ready financial processes and controls.

Continuous Improvement and Operational Excellence

Partner with Plant Leadership to identify and execute productivity initiatives.
Support Continuous Improvement programs.
Quantify financial benefits of operational improvement projects.
Challenge the status quo and continuously seek opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.
Foster a data-driven culture focused on operational and financial excellence.

Inventory and Working Capital Management and Control

Maintain strong financial control over inventory accuracy and working capital performance.
Ensure robust processes exist for:

Cycle counts
Physical inventories
Inventory reconciliation
Obsolescence management
Slow-moving inventory reduction

Qualifications
Required

Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or related field.
5+ years of progressive finance experience within a manufacturing, consumer products, industrial, or supply chain environment.
Experience supporting Manufacturing, Engineering, or Operations functions.
Strong expertise in financial planning, business partnering and cost management.
Financial modeling and data analytics capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive business decisions.

Preferred

MBA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent advanced qualification.
Experience in a global Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) organization.
Experience with SAP, Power BI, Tableau, Anaplan, Hyperion, or similar planning and analytics platforms.
Experience supporting capital investment projects.

Core Competencies

Strategic thinking
Business Partnership
Manufacturing & Supply Chain Acumen
Financial Modeling & Analytics
Executive Communication
Results Orientation
Continuous Improvement Mindset

title: Konsultchef till SallyQ
description:
Vi är ett kompetensbolag inom Life Science som hjälper innovativa företag och människor att göra så stor positiv skillnad de möjligtvis kan i världen. I praktiken innebär det att vi stöttar våra kunder med kompetens antingen genom direktrekrytering eller genom interima konsultprojekt.

Vi är ett bolag under stark utveckling. Idag är vi ca 15 konsulter med expertkompetens inom QA, validering, projektledning och datoriserade system. Vi är ambitiösa och tror på riktigt att vi kan göra skillnad så nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och bygga nästa kapitel.

Om Rollen

Som en del av vårt seniora konsultteam tar du ägandeskap för konsultaffären tillsammans med affärsområdeschefen Charlotte Duvefelt. Du bidrar i ledarskapet av konsultgruppen, i rekryteringen av nya kollegor och i införsäljningen av nya uppdrag utan att lämna konsultrollen bakom dig.

En del av din tid arbetar du själv som konsult hos kund, inom ditt eget expertisområde. Det kan vara QA, CMC, projektledning eller något annat där du har djup erfarenhet. Exakt hur fördelningen ser ut beror på vart vi är och vad som skapar mest värde, vi tror på flexibilitet och hittar den balans som fungerar för dig och för bolaget.

Du ingår i ett team och vi jobbar tillsammans. Ingen av oss sitter enskilt på svaren eller lösningarna, utan vi utvecklar bolaget gemensamt, med transparens som en självklarhet. Alla i teamet har insyn i avtal, affär och riktning. Så är vi byggda och så vill vi fortsätta vara.

Vi brinner för utveckling och förbättring av Life Science branschen och skapar värde genom att bidra till våra kunders utveckling. Det är där det händer inte på vår kontor i Hagastaden/Uppsala.

Vem vi söker

Vi letar inte efter ett CV. Vi letar efter en person. Du har en teknisk bakgrund inom Life Science; kanske som specialist, kanske som chef, kanske som konsult. Du är trygg i din kompetens och vet vad du kan leverera. Du har ett etablerat nätverk inom pharma, medtech eller diagnostik eller brinner för att bygga ett. I vår bransch är kunskap, erfarenhet och relationer allt, och vi tror att du förstår det.

Du är:

  • Genuin – du menar det du säger och säger det du menar

  • Orädd – du tar tag i saker, även när det är oklart hur det ska gå

  • Kreativ – du hittar vägar framåt som andra inte sett

  • Nyfiken – du vill förstå, utvecklas och utmana hur saker görs

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av ledarskap eller konsultbranschen.

Om SallyQ

Vi är inte ett titelstyrt bolag. Hos oss är inga arbetsuppgifter finare än andra och vi drivs av att bidra på riktigt inte av att imponera. Det innebär att du som Konsultchef lika gärna kan skriva en offert, följa upp med en kollega eller ta ett svårt samtal när det behövs. Det är så vi jobbar.

Vi har korta beslutsvägar, högt i tak och ett genuint engagemang för det vi gör. Vår förebild är Sally Bauer, första skandinav att simma över Engelska kanalen, tre veckor innan andra världskriget bröt ut. Vi inspireras av hennes mod att gå sin egen väg och uthållighet att fortsätta simma även när kustlinjen är långt bort.

Vi sitter på Forskaren vid Torsplan i Stockholm. Hybridarbete fungerar men vi trivs när vi är på plats tillsammans.

Vi erbjuder:

  • En dynamisk och stimulerande arbetsmiljö med möjligheter att växa och utvecklas.

title: Senior AI-Enabled Product / Project Manager
description:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

Our client is a physician-owned healthcare group with nine entities, an acquisition most quarters, and a rebrand underway that turns one parent company into eight to ten specialty brands.

Executives built prototypes themselves during an AI programme, and the organization now needs those prototypes turned into shipped software.

The environment includes Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, HubSpot, QuickBooks Online across nine entities, an EMR, and an FP&A platform being implemented.

Role Overview

The Senior AI-Enabled Product / Project Manager will interview the M&A Director about diligence requirements and the Marketing Lead about the rebrand, then document those requirements precisely enough for an Engineer to work from without having to guess.

The role will own the cadence while the organization’s teams own the rules of the business. The Senior AI-Enabled Product / Project Manager will work with the M&A Director and CFO daily, the Marketing Lead weekly on the rebrand, and alongside the Engineer and QA.

Location

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | Must overlap US Eastern business hours through 5:00 PM ET

Key Responsibilities

M&A Tooling

  • Own the backlog across the M&A track, including a diligence data room with notifications, a target-analysis summary tool, and target identification.

  • Sequence the M&A backlog so something ships early.

  • Work with the M&A Director to document how a deal runs from identifying an owner to a signed file.

  • Turn the documented deal process into a specification.

Rebrand Program

  • Run the rebrand as a programme as one parent company becomes eight to ten specialty brands.

  • Define what “a brand is launched” means, including name, logo, colour system, website, signage, collateral, and ad creative.

  • Track all eight to ten specialty brands against the defined launch requirements.

  • Work with the Marketing Lead to decide which specialty launches first and determine the dependency order.

  • Sequence the brand launches rather than launching all of them at once.

Brand Asset Engine

  • Scope the brand asset engine with Marketing.

  • Determine which formats matter and in what volume.

  • Determine who approves assets before publication.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Write acceptance criteria that the Engineer and QA both work from.

  • Ensure acceptance criteria are specific enough that “done” is not an opinion.

Project Cadence

  • Own the sprint, board, tickets, standup, and weekly review.

  • Provide executives with updates without requiring them to carry the project overhead.

  • Keep the cash-flow and reconciliation work sequenced after the FP&A platform is ready.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product or Project Manager shipping internal tools with non-technical stakeholders.

  • Business operations background is preferred over deep domain specialization.

  • M&A experience on the business-operations side, including diligence, data rooms, deal pipelines, or post-merger integration, is a plus.

  • Experience running a rebrand, multi-brand launch, or campaign system as a programme on the operational side is a plus.

  • Creative or marketing operations experience managing asset production at volume with a review-and-approve step is a plus.

  • Healthcare operations experience involving revenue cycle, practice management, or multi-site clinical operations is a plus.

  • Multi-entity finance experience involving month-end close, intercompany reconciliation, or consolidation is a plus.

  • A business-analysis background or consulting experience where interviewing operators was part of the work is a plus.

  • Experience working with an outsourced IT provider is a plus.

Skills

  • Ability to read a data model and schema and identify when two systems use the same word differently.

  • SQL skills sufficient to answer questions independently or read a query and challenge the number it returns.

  • Understanding of APIs, webhooks, and authentication sufficient to assess the scope of technical work.

  • Ability to write acceptance criteria that an Engineer can build from and QA can test against without a translation layer.

  • Ability to manage a backlog using Jira, Linear, or Azure DevOps, including boards, sprints, tickets, and releases.

  • Ability to build working prototypes using AI tooling.

  • Practical prompt engineering skills.

  • Understanding of evaluation sufficient to assess whether an AI-enabled system remains accurate over time.

  • Ability to read process maps and document flows, including where records are created, who interacts with them, and what happens when multiple people interact with them simultaneously.

  • Ability to interview an executive and identify the actual sequence of steps behind a process.

  • Ability to communicate when something is out of scope and explain what it would displace.

  • Ability to write clearly using short sentences and no jargon.

  • Ability to run a standup without unnecessary ceremony.

  • Power Platform experience is a plus.

  • Experience with reporting tools such as Power BI is a plus.

  • Basic scripting is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days:

  • Own and sequence the M&A backlog covering the diligence data room with notifications, target-analysis summary tool, and target identification.

  • Document how a deal runs from identifying an owner to a signed file and turn it into a specification.

  • Run the rebrand programme across eight to ten specialty brands.

  • Define what “a brand is launched” means and track all eight to ten brands against those requirements.

  • Sequence the brand launches with the Marketing Lead.

  • Scope the brand asset engine with Marketing, including formats, volume, and approval before publication.

  • Write acceptance criteria that the Engineer and QA can work from.

  • Own the sprint, board, tickets, standup, and weekly review.

  • Keep cash-flow and reconciliation work sequenced after the FP&A platform is ready.

Opportunity

The Senior AI-Enabled Product / Project Manager will report to the Head of IT and work with the M&A Director and CFO daily, the Marketing Lead weekly on the rebrand, and the Engineer and QA. The first 90 days will focus on M&A tooling first, with marketing and the rebrand alongside it.

  • Fill in the application form

  • Record a video showcasing your skill sets

title: Shipping & Receiving Specialist
description:
Shipping & Receiving Specialist

Position Summary

The Shipping & Receiving Specialist is responsible for coordinating inventory replenishment, processing customer orders, receiving and checking in pumps for the Service Department, auditing service order bins, and supporting the overall day-to-day operations of the warehouse. This position requires strong attention to detail, organization, accuracy, and the ability to work effectively with the Service, Warehouse, and other internal departments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Purchase Orders & Inventory
    • Issue purchase orders to replenish inventory based on stock levels, customer orders, and business needs.
    • Review inventory requirements and ensure needed parts and materials are ordered in a timely manner.
    • Process purchase orders accurately and maintain proper documentation.
    • Coordinate with vendors and internal departments as needed regarding orders and inventory.
  • Service Department Receiving
    • Receive and check in pumps and related equipment being brought into the Service Department.
    • Verify incoming equipment against service orders and receiving documentation.
    • Ensure pumps are properly identified, labeled, and routed to the appropriate service order or department.
    • Identify and communicate discrepancies, missing information, or damaged equipment.
  • Service Order Bin Audits
    • Regularly audit service order bins to verify that parts, materials, and paperwork are properly accounted for.
    • Ensure service order bins are organized and accurately reflect the work being performed.
    • Identify missing, misplaced, or unaccounted-for items and communicate discrepancies to the appropriate personnel.
    • Help maintain accurate inventory and service order records.
  • Shipping & Receiving / Warehouse Support
    • Assist the Warehouse team with daily shipping and receiving activities.
    • Receive, inspect, count, and put away incoming materials.
    • Pick, pack, and prepare customer orders for shipment.
    • Assist with loading and unloading shipments as needed.
    • Maintain an organized, clean, and safe warehouse and shipping area.
    • Follow company procedures for handling, labeling, and documenting shipments.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in shipping, receiving, warehouse operations, inventory control, or a similar position.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently while also supporting a team environment.
  • Basic computer skills and ability to learn inventory and order-management systems.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with vendors, customers, service personnel, and warehouse staff.
  • Ability to safely lift and move materials and equipment as required.
  • Experience with pumps, mechanical equipment, industrial parts, or a service environment is a plus.

Key Skills

  • Inventory management
  • Purchase order processing
  • Shipping and receiving
  • Receiving inspection
  • Order fulfillment
  • Inventory accuracy
  • Organization and attention to detail
  • Warehouse coordination
  • Communication and teamwork
  • Problem solving

Work Environment

This position is primarily based in a warehouse and service environment and may involve frequent movement between the warehouse, shipping/receiving area, and Service Department. The position may require standing, walking, lifting, and moving equipment or materials throughout the workday.

title: Buyer
description:
Who are we?

XNRGY Climate Systems is a North American leader in sustainable design and advanced manufacturing of custom air treatment systems. We are focused on research and energy development, contributing to the reduction of carbon footprint.

XNRGY is excited to announce the opening of our new technology headquarters in Mesa, Arizona, in 2025, with a second manufacturing site launching next door in 2026. This expansion reflects our continued commitment to growth, innovation, and leadership in the climate solutions industry, and to supporting the AI industry.

As part of this expansion in the US, XNRGY is seeking a qualified Buyer to join its team. In this role, you will lead procurement for assigned categories and support the development of sourcing strategies to ensure quality, cost efficiency, and reliable supply. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to manage supplier relationships, drive cost optimization initiatives, and ensure procurement processes support the company’s operational and manufacturing goals. Success in this position requires strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to lead complex negotiations in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

An overview of your responsibilities:

  • Procurement Leadership: Lead sourcing and procurement activities for assigned categories of goods and services that support manufacturing, operational, and office needs, ensuring alignment with procurement strategies and business objectives.

  • Strategic Sourcing: Identify sourcing opportunities, develop procurement strategies, and lead negotiations to secure optimal pricing, quality, and delivery terms.

  • Supplier Relationships: Develop, manage, and strengthen relationships with key suppliers to ensure performance, reliability, and continuous improvement.

  • Cost Optimization: Identify and implement cost reduction initiatives, analyze spending trends, and ensure procurement activities align with budget and cost targets.

  • Contract Management: Draft, review, and manage supplier agreements and contracts while ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.

  • Market Intelligence: Conduct market research to evaluate supplier capabilities, identify new sourcing opportunities, and monitor industry trends that may impact supply and pricing.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with operations, engineering, finance, IT, and other departments to understand procurement needs and deliver effective sourcing solutions.

  • Procurement Process Improvement: Support the development and continuous improvement of procurement processes, tools, and reporting to enhance efficiency and transparency.

  • Inventory & Supply Support: Coordinate with internal teams to ensure appropriate inventory levels of indirect materials and services required to support uninterrupted operations.

What you'll need, among other things!

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in procurement or strategic sourcing within an industrial or manufacturing environment, with demonstrated experience leading sourcing initiatives.

  • Strong negotiation, supplier management, and strategic sourcing skills.

  • Experience with procurement systems, ERP platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders across the organization.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly present information and lead supplier negotiations.

title: Engineer ontwerpbeoordeling tankwagens gevaarlijke stoffen
description:
Van ontwerp tot goedkeuring: jij bewaakt de veiligheid van voertuigen en containers voor het vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen gedurende hun volledige levenscyclus.

Waar zie je een tankwagen ontstaan, controleer je de bouw ervan bij de fabrikant én kom je hem jaren later weer tegen voor een periodieke keuring? Bij de RDW! Hier ben je niet verantwoordelijk voor één onderdeel, maar voor het complete traject. De ene dag beoordeel je ontwerpen en technische berekeningen, de andere dag voer je inspecties uit bij klanten in binnen- of buitenland. Die unieke combinatie van ontwerp, praktijk en internationale samenwerking zorgt ervoor dat je het volledige proces overziet en jouw werk terugziet op de weg door heel Europa.

Interessant aan deze baan volgens Inspecteur Jeroen

De combinatie van techniek, regelgeving en praktijk maakt dit werk ontzettend afwisselend. Je blijft jezelf ontwikkelen, terwijl je samenwerkt met een hecht team van collega's dat kennis deelt en altijd bereid is elkaar te helpen.

Lees de verhalen van andere RDW’ers >

Werken aan de mobiliteit van morgen

Tankwagens, ADR-voertuigen, trekkers en containers vervoeren dagelijks brandstoffen, chemicaliën, gassen en andere gevaarlijke stoffen door heel Europa. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze voertuigen veilig de weg op kunnen. Je bent betrokken bij de volledige levenscyclus van een tankwagen: van eerste ontwerpbeoordeling tot periodieke inspecties jaren later. Zo draag je direct bij aan een veilig vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland en daarbuiten.

Je start de week met het beoordelen van een ontwerp voor een nieuwe tankwagen. Kloppen de berekeningen, materialen en lasprocedures? De volgende dag stap je in de auto voor een inspectie bij een fabrikant. Op locatie controleer je of de tank daadwerkelijk volgens de regelgeving is opgebouwd en bespreek je je bevindingen met de klant. Na jouw beoordeling volgt de goedkeuring van het voertuig. Jaren later zie je dezelfde tank opnieuw terug voor de herkeuring. Dit doe je in Nederland en soms elders in Europa.

Dit is jouw thuisbasis

Je komt terecht in een hecht team van ongeveer tien collega’s dat verantwoordelijk is voor de inspectie en toelating van voertuigen voor het vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen. De sfeer is open en informeel. Collega’s zoeken elkaar gemakkelijk op, delen kennis en schakelen snel wanneer nodig. Iedere dinsdag ontmoeten we elkaar op kantoor in Zoetermeer, terwijl je de rest van de week hybride werkt en regelmatig op pad bent naar klanten in Nederland en een paar keer per jaar in Europa.

Zo helpen wij jou graag op weg

Bij de RDW werk je met ruim 2.000 collega’s aan veilige en duurzame mobiliteit in Nederland en daarbuiten. Hier sta je vooraan bij slimme oplossingen en technologische innovaties in de automotive. Daardoor is óók jouw werk voortdurend in beweging. Om dat zo goed mogelijk en met plezier te doen, geven we je ruim baan voor jouw ontwikkeling. Bijvoorbeeld met interne stages en toegang tot ons leerplein. Daarnaast helpen we je vooruit met de volgende arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Salaris tussen € 3.787 ,- en € 6.009,- bruto per maand (op basis van fulltime).
  • 8% vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% over het in dat jaar genoten salaris.
  • Goede werk-privébalans: 36 uur is fulltime en je kunt deels thuis en 4 x 9 uur werken. Je krijgt een budget om een thuiswerkplek in te richten en een thuiswerkvergoeding.
  • Een fijne werkomgeving waarin je je eigen route mag uitstippelen en collega’s met je meedenken.
  • Pensioenregeling via het ABP: wij betalen 70% van de premie.
  • 6 weken verlof per jaar.
  • Bijdrage aan je reiskosten voor woon-werkverkeer of een volledige ov-vergoeding.
  • Leaseauto.
  • Telefoon en laptop.

title: Financial Planning & Analysis Expert
description:
POSIZIONE - Financial Planning & Analysis Expert
AREA ORGANIZZATIVA - Finance & Legal / Programme Management
SEDE DI RIFERIMENTO - Roma / Ibrido
SUPERVISORE - Head of Financial Planning and Analysis
TIPOLOGIA CONTRATTUALE - Co.co.co.
RANGE RETRIBUTIVO - 29.000 – 32.000
LIVELLO SAFEGUARDING - 1

INCARICO

Il/La Financial Planning & Analysis Expert contribuisce alla gestione finanziaria, sia attiva sia passiva, di uno o più Programmi, garantendo un presidio efficace delle attività di reporting, controllo finanziario e monitoraggio della compliance con le procedure interne ed esterne. Il ruolo assicura un supporto qualificato ai processi decisionali, favorendo una gestione trasparente, accurata e coerente delle risorse economiche e finanziarie assegnate.

PRINCIPALI ATTIVITA’/RESPONSABILITA’

Gestione finanziaria:

  • coordinamento e finalizzazione della pianificazione finanziaria annuale delle aree tematiche di riferimento;
  • revisione, verifica e supporto nello sviluppo dei budget delle singole componenti progettuali;
  • supervisione della gestione finanziaria di staff e progettuale, secondo i requisiti di Save the Children Italia e di ogni singolo donatore;
  • individuazione e organizzazione di formazioni amministrative e ad hoc e capacity building per referenti di progetto delle aree programmatiche di riferimento, ove necessario;
  • analisi del rischio finanziario/gestionale e sviluppo di strategie di riduzione dello stesso, al fine di garantire il perseguimento degli obiettivi progettuali;
  • partecipazione a meeting con donatori potenziali, finalizzata alla supervisione della parte gestionale e finanziaria, ove richiesto;
  • Monitoraggio del budget e sviluppo di proposte progettuali nell’ambito delle aree programmatiche di riferimento
  • monitoraggio con cadenza trimestrale della implementazione del budget delle aree programmatiche di riferimento e nelle singole componenti progettuali anche al fine di intervenire in caso di scostamenti;
  • Supporto al Program manager e/o ai referenti gestionali delle aree programmatiche di riferimento, nella gestione economico-finanziaria progettuale, nell’implementazione budgetaria e nella pianificazione e imputazione finanziaria delle risorse umane;
  • supporto nello sviluppo di proposte progettuali per donatori privati e istituzionali;
  • supervisione di proposte di modifica budgetaria da presentare e discutere con i donatori;
  • verifica e supporto nella redazione di proposte di modifica budgetaria presentate dai partner di progetti nell'ambito delle Aree Programmatiche di riferimento;
  • supporto nella identificazione e gestione di partner progettuali.

Tutte le attività elencate dovranno essere realizzate in stretto raccordo con le aree Programmatiche di riferimento (principalmente tramite le figure dei Program Manager e dei coordinatori di progetto), la Direzione Finance (Aree Legal, Grant e Contabilità) e sotto la supervisione della Head of Financial Planning and Analysis.

Reportistica:

  • controllo e revisione dei rapporti finanziari dei partner di progetto, seguendo le regole di Save the Children e dei donatori;
  • supervisione della preparazione di tutta la documentazione necessaria ai fini della reportistica finanziaria;
  • finalizzazione della reportistica finanziaria dei progetti grant, in collaborazione e sotto la supervisione dell’area Grant di Save the Children Italia.

Altre attività specifiche:

  • verificare l'accuratezza delle registrazioni dei costi progettuali attraverso controlli periodici sul sistema di gestione contabile utilizzato da Save the Children;
  • supportare l'ufficio Payroll per una corretta imputazione dei costi del personale;
  • Contribuire allo sviluppo e al miglioramento delle procedure di gestione finanziaria e progettuale interne a Save the Children Italia
  • supportare il processo di finalizzazione di accordi di partenariato;
  • fornire supporto in occasione di audit interne ed esterne, in coordinamento con gli altri uffici coinvolti;
  • partecipare a riunioni periodiche di coordinamento del Dipartimento;
  • partecipare a meeting convocati ad hoc dalle aree programmatiche di riferimento;
  • partecipare a meeting convocati dagli eventuali donatori;
  • coordinamento e finalizzazione del processo di preparazione del budget, della sua revisione semestrale (re-forecast) e della pre-chiusura annuale per le aree programmatiche di riferimento, secondo i termini e le modalità comunicate dalla Direzione Finance.

ESPERIENZE, QUALIFICHE E CONOSCENZE LINGUISTICHE/INFORMATICHE

  • Esperienza di 4 anni in monitoraggio e rendicontazione finanziaria.
  • Competenze amministrative, conoscenza dei principi contabili e di rendicontazione
  • Laurea, preferibilmente in Economia
  • Buona conoscenza dell’inglese, parlato e scritto
  • Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Microsoft Office

SOFT SKILLS

  • Precisione e attenzione al dettaglio
  • Flessibilità
  • Spiccate capacità relazionali e di mediazione
  • Gestione dello stress

ALTRO

  • Condivisione della mission e dei principi di Save the Children.

SAFEGUARDING

Save the Children vuole essere un’organizzazione sicura per tutte le persone beneficiarie - minori e adulte - che raggiunge con i propri programmi. Per questo motivo implementa un sistema di tutela per prevenire qualsiasi rischio di abuso e sfruttamento in loro danno.
Coloro che collaborano a qualunque titolo con Save the Children dovranno dimostrare i più alti standard di comportamento così come indicato nella Policy sulla Tutela di Bambine, Bambini e Adolescenti e nella Policy per la Protezione di beneficiari/e maggiorenni dallo sfruttamento sessuale, l’abuso, le molestie ().

LE PERSONE AL CENTRO
Lavorare per una missione come quella di Save the Children è importante.

Crediamo che un’Organizzazione fatta di persone che stanno bene e che hanno passione per il proprio lavoro, è un’Organizzazione innovativa, coesa, agile ed efficiente, che riesce quindi ad essere efficace nel perseguimento dei suoi obiettivi. Per questo cerchiamo sempre di mettere al centro le nostre persone, preservarne il benessere e la motivazione, e valorizzarne le competenze.

title: Behavior Specialist
description:
Company Summary:
Beacon is a successful and national behavioral health company providing residential-based services and supports to children and adults Complex Behavioral Health conditions, Severe Mental Illness, Autism, and other compounding medical conditions.

Position Summary:
The Behavior Specialist plays a critical role in providing specialized behavioral support services to individuals across various settings. This position supports the development and implementation of individualized behavior intervention plans under the direction and approval of a qualified supervisor, while also delivering training and guidance to Care Team staff to ensure effective plan execution. The Behavior Specialist collaborates with a multidisciplinary team to ensure effective and consistent application of behavior support strategies. Key responsibilities include monitoring and evaluating the progress of individuals, conducting data analysis, and adjusting intervention plans as needed. The Behavior Specialist is dedicated to enhancing the quality of life for individuals by promoting positive behaviors and addressing challenging behaviors through evidence-based practices.

This position requires completion of the specified degree within 90 calendar days of the employee’s start date. The employee is responsible for providing documentation confirming degree completion. If the required degree is not obtained within the 90-day timeframe, the employee will no longer meet the minimum qualifications for the position and employment will be terminated.

Primary Responsibilities:

Meets with assigned individuals to assist in the development and implementation of Behavior Support Plans (BSP) under the guidance and approval of a qualified supervisor.
Acts as a member of a team addressing significant behavioral and/or medical changes in consumers and regularly reviews and revises the Behavior Support Plan (BSP) and any related support guidelines or restrictive procedures plans with input from key persons such as the supported individual, other care team members, and external stakeholders.

Trains staff directly working with the consumer to implement the BSP; may model how to work with the consumer and directly intervene when challenging behavior occurs. May assist with general training of staff regarding behavior management.
Participates in monthly clinical/behavioral consultation meetings with residential managers and direct service providers
Develops and implements multi-site crisis management and behavioral management support services including on-site staff support, as well as hands on crisis management assistance if required. May be available by phone when emergencies occur; may assist in person.
Provides support and debriefing to staff and individuals supported following incidents, including conducting post-crisis management services reviews and consultation.
Compiles internal and external reports as required; analyzes data and makes recommendations.
Maintains comprehensive notes and tracking records as required.
Participate in team and agency staff meetings and required in service training sessions. Regularly communicates and meets with Supervisor.
Ensure program records are properly maintained, and reports are prepared and submitted on time, including but not limited to, time and attendance and electronic case records. Enters data into an electronic consumer database each day of work.
Assists in communicating with family members and friends of the individuals supported as appropriate.
Participates in inter-agency meetings for the supported individual and assists with the development of outcomes and goals.
Assists with resident abuse and neglect assessment issues and communicate findings with home manager, compliance, clinical and operations’ leadership. Cooperates regarding investigations and inspections.

Education and Qualifications:

Must be 21 years of age or older.
Bachelor’s degree in psychology or related field required, Master’s degree preferred.

Minimum 1-2 years’ experience working with both mentally ill and intellectually disabled adult populations is preferred.
Experience with behavioral observations and interventions with complex, high intense/high frequency behaviors is required.
Skilled in teaching and coaching staff to implement Behavior Support Plans (BSP).
Approved by the state, federal, and local governmental entities to work within BSLS programs.
Maintains own mandatory training and certification requirements.
Required experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Must possess a valid Driver’s License.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Proficient in speaking, reading and writing the English language required.

Skills and Abilities:

Must be able to communicate and function in an interdisciplinary team.
Skilled in teaching and coaching staff to implement Behavior Support Plans (BSP)
Strong computer skills utilizing various software programs and applications.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Ability to create professional employee communication materials.
Works well independently.
Demonstrated organizational skills and the ability to multitask and meet project deadlines.
Capable of working well with all levels of the organization.
A professional demeanor.
Ability to work with little daily supervision.

Work Environment:
Most of your job duties will be performed from our corporate office, or in our homes or day programs. You may have potential for exposure to infectious disease and physical and verbally aggressive behaviors. Universal precautions are required to minimize the risk of infections. Work sites may include locations that are not barrier-free. Duties are performed in an environment where there is a potential for physical aggression from individuals.

Physical Demands:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets, and bend or stand on a stool as necessary.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:
This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Occasional evenings and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

title: Weekend Lab Assistant - Sat and Sun
description:
Job description
“The Largest Independent Established Multi-Specialty Group in Central North Carolina is Seeking a Weekend Lab Assistant to join our Team!”

VOTED “BUSINESS OF THE YEAR” 2018

VOTED ONE OF THE “FASTEST GROWING COMPANIES IN THE TRIAD” 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022

Our mission at BMC is to provide excellent care through a multi-specialty approach from prevention to intervention of potentially life-threatening health problems. Seeking a Weekend Lab Assistant for our Kernersville Lab location.

Summary of Position:

The Weekend Lab Assistant performs the general daily specimen receiving processes as set forth by the laboratory guidelines. The Weekend Lab Assistant monitors specimen logs and manifests to ensure acceptable specimens are received in the laboratory for testing. The Weekend Lab Assistant immediately notifies the General Supervisor of any problems or concerns.

Responsibilities:

  • Receives specimens by un-bagging them and confirming samples received match those listed on the sample manifest from the individual stations
  • Creates orders, prints labels, and/or prints requisitions as needed in the Harvest LIS system
  • Sorts samples according to analyzer and creates racks for each
  • Rejects or cancels samples according to Laboratory Sample Rejection protocols
  • Pours off urine samples from urine cups to the appropriate tube for analysis
  • Creates orders for specimens that should be sent out to reference labs
  • Performs individual specimen checks and discards samples per the laboratory’s defined schedule for sample storage and purging.
  • Processes Occupational Health urine samples
  • Completes daily temperature logs and notifies the supervisor when any temperature is out of range
  • Answers telephone calls and inquiries from various stations within Bethany Medical Center
  • Provides a safe environment from physical, chemical, and biological hazards.
  • Performs other related duties as negotiated.

Education/Experience:
  • High School diploma or equivalent

Continuing Education (CE) Requirements:
  • Although there are no continuing specific education requirements, CLIA and COLA encourages CE for all laboratory staff.
  • Bethany requires at least 4 continuing education units every 2 years.

Typical Mental Demands:
  • Must be able to analyze variables and choose an effective course of action. Must react favorably in stressful situations.
  • Must be mentally adaptable and flexible in dealing with a variety of people.
  • Emotional stability and personal maturity are important attributes in this position.

Physical Demands:
  • Requires eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity to operate laboratory instruments and a computer.
  • Requires a normal range of hearing and color vision.
  • Requires standing, reaching, and lifting of up to ~ 50 pounds.

Working Conditions:
  • Saturday and Sunday from 9 am to 5 pm. First shift.
  • Occasionally called on to work overtime.

List procedures and equipment the employee is expected to master:
  • Computer / Laboratory Information System

Bethany Medical is open 7 days a week, with 13 convenient locations and 16 practices in Greensboro, Winston-Salem, High Point, Kernersville, Jamestown, North Wilkesboro, and Mt Airy, North Carolina. Practice staff members are known for treating each patient with prompt, personalized care and attention. Bethany Medical employs over 65 providers and over 530 employees. The Triad is 1 hour from the mountains and 3 hours from the beach. Charlotte and Raleigh are 1.5 hours from the Triad. The Triad offers all the amenities of a larger city without all the traffic. The Piedmont Triad International Airport is conveniently located in Greensboro with convenient non-stop flights to most major cities. Enjoy an outstanding quality of life with no shortage of arts, entertainment, recreation, shopping, and hundreds of restaurants. The Triad is home to 85 colleges and universities, including Wake Forest University, High Point University, UNC-Greensboro, NC A&T, Guilford College, Bennett College, and Greensboro College.

title: Safety Specialist - Per Diem
description:
Bay Cove Human Services’ mission is to partner with people to overcome challenges and realize personal potential. Bay Cove pursues this mission by providing individualized and compassionate services to people facing the challenges associated with developmental disabilities, mental illness, substance use disorders, and homelessness at more than 175 program sites throughout Greater Boston and Southeastern Massachusetts.

Job Summary: The Safety Specialist promotes health, wellness and safety in our low threshold services for adults with histories of homelessness, most of whom are impacted by substance use and misuse, co-occurring mental health challenges, and complex health conditions. The Safety Specialist directly supports Bay Cove’s mission by working on behalf of persons served, staff, and all community stakeholders in a proactive and professional manner. This staff member is critical to providing a welcoming and inclusive environment for persons who live in our permanent housing programs and whose work reflects a commitment to health, racial and housing equity.

By providing respectful and responsive supports and by working collaboratively with all stakeholder, this staff member implements hare reduction and trauma informed supports to pesos who have often been marginalized and stigmatized by others. The Safety Specialist brings great value to our tenants and team members by offering practical assistance in a calm, positive, and respectful manner. In such environments, people can work to build or rebuild their lives, and enjoy the benefits of a safe and affordable home. The Safety Specialist severs as a community diplomat and represents the CCC and Bay Cove as a good neighbor and responsive community partner.

This is a non-except position.
Essential Functions of Position:

Welcomes and logs in all guests, visitors, and community partners.
Reinforces expectations and policies for tenants and guests that support the safety and benefit of all tenants, staff, and neighbors. Ensures that Narcan is administered in the event that a person over doses and waits with the person until First Responders are onthe scene. From the front desk, monitors cameras with all staff to support tenants’ needs. Ensures that health and safety systems (security camera, Automated External Defibrillator, door alarms, smoke detectors in common kitchens, First Aid kits, CPR masks, Narcan, fentanyl test strips, etc.) are all in good supply and in working order. Intervenes in crisis situations using good judgement, communication skills, de-escalation techniques, and calling upon emergency services as needed.
Demonstrates dependability and reliability.
Must be able to work all shifts including weekend and holidays as scheduled.
Attends all required training.
Communicates in real-time with Program Director and staff at the CCC.
Maintains privacy and confidentiality of tenants’ personal and private health conditions in accordance with state and federal law.
All other duties as requested by the Program Director.

Requirements for the position:

High School diploma or equivalent.

Personal Characteristics:

Must be able to work with a diverse population in a respectful, compassionate and supportive manner. Demonstrates kindness and professionalism in all interactions.

Physical Requirements

Must be able to stand for long periods of time.
Must be able to work during inclement weather.
Must be able to walk up and down stairs and throughout all common areas and bathrooms in the building as scheduled by Program Director
Is able to lift and carry up to 40 lbs. as needed.

Bay Cove Human Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, or any other groups as protected by Massachusetts or federal law. All qualified candidates, regardless of background, are encouraged to apply.

title: Network Engineer till OKQ8
description:
Hela samhället ställer om mot en fossilfri framtid. Vi vill visa vägen i utvecklingen av vår bransch, så att fler kan ta sig fram, ta hand om sitt fordon och driva verksamheter med ett så lågt klimatavtryck som möjligt. Vill du vara med och bidra till hållbar utveckling, på riktigt? Välkommen att följa med på vår resa!

Vill du utveckla nätverket som ska bära OKQ8:s framtida cloud- och infrastrukturlösningar? Vi söker nu en erfaren Network Engineer som vill bygga en säker, stabil och automatiserad nätverksplattform för både datacenter och cloud.

Om rollen

OKQ8 etablerar ett nytt Platform Engineering Team i Stockholm. Teamet blir en viktig del av vår nästa transformationsresa och ska skapa förutsättningarna för att genomföra vår nya cloud- och infrastrukturstrategi.

Det är ett tvärfunktionellt team där specialister inom cloud, nätverk och infrastruktur arbetar tillsammans mot gemensamma mål. Teamet kommer att samarbeta nära utvecklingsteamen och vårt cybersäkerhetsteam för att skapa standardiserade, säkra och skalbara plattformstjänster som gör det enklare att utveckla och driftsätta nya lösningar.

Som Network Engineer får du ett centralt ansvar för att designa, implementera och förvalta OKQ8:s nätverksplattform. Du bidrar till att etablera ett modernt hybridnätverk som stödjer både datacenter och cloud och som möjliggör stabila och effektiva leveranser för våra applikations- och utvecklingsteam.

Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Designa och vidareutveckla nätverksarkitektur för on-prem, cloud och hybridmiljöer.
  • Implementera, konfigurera och förvalta nätverksinfrastruktur inom LAN, WAN, datacenter och cloud.
  • Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet, redundans, prestanda och kapacitet.
  • Hantera nätverkets livscykel, inklusive patchning, uppgraderingar och teknisk refresh.
  • Automatisera nätverksdistribution och konfiguration med Infrastructure as Code.
  • Utveckla standardiserade deploymentmönster, templates och self-service-kapabiliteter.
  • Bidra till CI/CD-pipelines för nätverk och plattform.
  • Implementera nätverkssäkerhet, segmentering och accesskontroller enligt Zero Trust-principer.
  • Designa och implementera cloud networking i Azure och vid behov AWS.
  • Integrera on-prem-nätverk med cloud genom exempelvis VPN och ExpressRoute.
  • Stötta utvecklings- och applikationsteam med nätverksdesign, onboarding och felsökning.

Vi söker

Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av nätverk i komplexa IT-miljöer och som vill vara med och modernisera hur nätverk designas, implementeras och förvaltas. Du kombinerar djup nätverkskompetens med ett intresse för automation, cloud och platform engineering.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:

  • Djup kompetens inom routing och switching.
  • Erfarenhet av BGP, OSPF, L2/L3, VLAN och VRF.
  • God förståelse för WAN, SD-WAN, DNS, DHCP och IPAM.
  • Erfarenhet av brandväggar, VPN, segmentering och nätverkssäkerhet.
  • Erfarenhet av design och drift av större eller komplexa nätverksmiljöer.
  • God felsökningsförmåga inom nätverksprestanda, trafikflöden och anslutningar.
  • Erfarenhet av att dokumentera nätverksarkitektur, standarder och tekniska lösningar.
  • God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

  • Moderna datacenternätverk som Leaf-Spine, VXLAN och EVPN.
  • Software-Defined Networking.
  • Azure VNet, AWS VPC, peering och private endpoints.
  • Hybrid connectivity genom VPN eller ExpressRoute.
  • Infrastructure as Code med exempelvis Terraform eller Bicep.
  • Python, PowerShell eller annan skriptning.
  • CI/CD-pipelines och DevOps-baserade arbetssätt.
  • Regulatoriska krav och ramverk som NIS2.

Som person är du strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och säkerhetsmedveten. Du tycker om att arbeta tvärfunktionellt och kan omsätta verksamhets- och teknikbehov till standardiserade lösningar. Du tar initiativ, driver förbättringar och bidrar gärna till att höja både kvaliteten och kunskapen i teamet.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss på OKQ8 får du arbeta i en flexibel miljö med viktiga och varierande arbetsuppgifter. Vi uppmuntrar samarbete, innovation och utveckling – och vi tror på att vi tillsammans gör varandra bättre. Här blir du en del av en familjär kultur där vi stöttar varandra, har roligt tillsammans och där du ges möjlighet att växa och göra skillnad. Vi vill vara ett företag som speglar samhället, med en inkluderande kultur som minskar utanförskap och främjar mångfald.

Vi vill vara ett företag som speglar samhället, med en inkluderande kultur som minskar utanförskap och främjar mångfald.

I den här rollen får du dessutom:

  • Vara med och forma OKQ8:s framtida nätverksplattform.
  • Arbeta med både datacenter, hybridmiljöer och cloud.
  • Flytta nätverksområdet mot mer automation och Infrastructure as Code.
  • Samarbeta nära cloud, infrastruktur, cybersäkerhet och utveckling.
  • Påverka arkitektur, tekniska standarder och framtida arbetssätt.

Övrig information

Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition Partner Nabila Ur-Rehman via nabila.ur-rehman@okq8.se.

Placeringsort: Stockholm, Sveavägen.
Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning

För den här tjänsten behöver du vara medborgare i Sverige, ett annat nordiskt land eller ett EU/EES-land, ha permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige eller vara asylsökande med rätt att arbeta. Du ska kunna styrka ditt medborgarskap eller din rätt att arbeta i Sverige under rekryteringsprocessen.

I rekryteringsprocessen ingår både psykometriska tester och kompetensbaserade intervjuer, med syfte att främja en rättvis utvärdering för alla kandidater.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Project Manager
Function: Commercial - Medical Technologies
Location: Hybrid – Two days per week in the Alfreton & Wakefield office
Contract type: FTC - March 2027
Salary: Offered on a starting salary of £47,874 with the potential to increase up to £56,322 over the course of three years + additional benefits
Closing Date: 28th August 2026

We have an exciting opportunity for a Project Manager to join our Commercial Medical Technologies team working closely with the Procurement Strategy Delivery Lead on one of our high-profile stakeholder programmes.

Supporting the Procurement Strategy Delivery Lead, you will play a key role in delivering complex projects and transformation initiatives across the programme. Working collaboratively with internal teams and our key stakeholders you will manage the successful delivery of projects that embed sustainable improvements, enhance business performance, and deliver value for patients, customers, and the wider NHS.

Every day you will …

Be responsible for the effective delivery of assigned projects and initiatives, working closely with the Procurement Strategy Delivery Lead to ensure objectives are clearly defined and achieved within agreed timescales, budgets and quality standards.

Plan, coordinate and manage project activities and initiatives, proactively identifying and managing risks, issues, dependencies and opportunities to ensure successful delivery.
Coordinate and manage cross-functional teams and stakeholders who feed into projects and initiatives, ensuring timely contributions, effective collaboration and alignment with project objectives.
Apply appropriate project management methodologies and controls, maintaining robust governance, accurate documentation and clear reporting throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide structured project governance, oversight and reporting to ensure transparency, accountability and informed decision-making.
Build and maintain effective relationships with cross functional teams and stakeholders at all levels, managing expectations and ensuring clear, consistent communication throughout project delivery.
Drive continuous improvement by identifying recurring themes, capturing lessons learned and implementing actions that enhance efficiency, effectiveness and future project outcomes.
Work collaboratively with NHS Supply Chain service providers to support the successful delivery of projects contributing to the organisation's modernisation programme.

What can we offer you?
We want to reward you for your passion, enthusiasm, and hard work so we offer much more than a competitive salary:

Hybrid working opportunities, giving you the flexibility to work collaboratively in the office and remotely.
We recognise our employees' hard work and contributions with annual bonus schemes, long service, and colleague recognition awards.
27 days holiday plus bank holidays
We are dedicated to your development, through in-house training, support, and access to external qualifications to maximise your potential.
A focus on your well-being offering 1 day of paid well-being leave and free access to the 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
Generous pension scheme (with us contributing 12% when you contribute 6%)
Access to our Flexible Benefits Scheme, where you can choose from a variety of benefits such as Life Insurance, Critical Illness Cover, Income Protection, Health Cash Plan, Dental Insurance, and additional pension contributions that suit you.
2 days of paid volunteering leave allowing you to give back to your community.
Access to many discounts from the Blue Light Card to NHS Discounts.

NHS Supply Chain, who are we?
Our role is to support the NHS to save lives and improve health. We are a part of the NHS family, and our role is to source, deliver and supply healthcare products, services and food for NHS trusts and healthcare organisations across England and Wales.
We serve every NHS Trust and operate a national network of distribution centres, managing relationships with more than a thousand suppliers and delivering more than 8,000,000 orders each year to more than 17,000 locations. Doing all of this on behalf of the NHS gives NHS staff more time to focus on their main priority of providing excellent patient care.

What skills will help you thrive in this role?

Project delivery - Experience delivering low to medium complexity projects across the full lifecycle within a wider programme.
Methodology and governance - Understanding of project management methodologies (Agile / Waterfall), with the ability to manage governance, change, and budget.
Communication and stakeholder management - Strong verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to engage and manage a range of stakeholders.
Team and supplier coordination - Experience working in matrix environments and coordinating cross-functional teams; with project delivery team management, desirable.
Considered competent in the use of using software packages such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Microsoft Project (or equivalent project management tool).
Qualifications and sector knowledge - Relevant PPM qualification or equivalent experience; knowledge of healthcare, supply chain, or change frameworks desirable.

Our Inclusive Commitment
At NHS Supply Chain, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where difference is not only valued, but celebrated, giving everyone the opportunity to thrive in their career. Developing our people is key to our success, so if this role sounds like the right next step in your career but your experience doesn’t match perfectly with the job advert, we encourage you to still apply.

Struggling to complete our application form, and require additional support? Reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at careers@supplychain.nhs.uk who will be happy to help you with alternative ways to apply.

title: Tool & Die Maker
description:
Suncast Corporation is the leading US-based designer, manufacturer, and distributor of high-quality resin products for the home and industrial markets. A privately held company headquartered in Western Chicago, Illinois, Suncast prides itself on 35 years of innovation and sustainability across a wide range of product categories with materials proudly sourced in the USA. Everything we do is supported by the strength and ingenuity of American workers and we are committed to helping families across the country make the most of their unique spaces. We utilize state-of-the-art machinery and innovative manufacturing techniques to consistently engineer products of the highest possible quality.

Position Summary:
The Tool and Die Maker repairs and maintains production dies and tooling used in manufacturing. They read blueprints, machine and assemble parts, and make adjustments to keep tools operating properly. This role is also responsible for preparing new dies for production, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring repairs are completed safely and on time.

Responsibilities:

Maintain and repair production tooling while applying proper tool and die knowledge, timing principles, and rework techniques.
Prepare new dies for production.
Review blueprints and other instructions to modify or repair dies as required.
When possible, modify or repair the die while it’s in the press.
Position work for machining and assembly (e.g., using machine tables, chucks).
Select the machine and the machine tool setup for each task.
Select materials for die modifications and repairs.
Disassemble and re-assemble dies as required while inspecting for wear and damage.
Machine parts for die modifications and die repairs while ensuring they meet dimensional and functional requirements.
Test electrical systems and hydraulic systems in the die.
Repair or replace defective components.
Work to ensure modifications and repairs are done within the production deadline.
Check in new dies when received from vendors and complete appropriate procedures and documents.
Report breakdown of root causes, tool damage, and concerns to management.
Lift dies and work pieces in a safe and efficient manner.
Drive a forklift to transport and store dies and follow all safety rules.
Assist with training the less experienced Tool Room employees and evaluate their progress as necessary.
Support and comply with all Suncast safety policies, quality standards, and housekeeping methods at all times.
Perform additional duties as required.

Qualifications:

High school diploma is required.
5+ years of manufacturing experience with 2+ years of experience with stamping dies.
5+ years of experience with stamping dies preferred.
Proficient in operating lathes, milling machines, and electrical discharge machining equipment.
Strong understanding of precision measuring instruments such as calipers, micrometers, and gauges.
Must demonstrate solid mathematical ability, up to trigonometry, for calculating dimensions, tolerances, and material requirements.
Excellent critical thinking skills with a focus on quality and precision.
Experience with CAD software preferred.
Knowledge of programming CNC machines preferred.
Ability to obtain a forklift license.

The Anticipated Pay Range for This Position: $28.00-$35.00 hourly.
Suncast offers a comprehensive benefits package including:

Medical, Dental, Prescription Drugs, Vision insurance, Telehealth benefits
Group Term Life insurance
401K with employer match
Paid vacation time off
Paid holidays
Short- and long-term disability coverage
Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health
Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
Tuition Reimbursement

All qualified applicants will be given equal consideration regardless of race, age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, color, religion, protected veteran status or national origin.

title: Salgsassistent til Q8 Harte Nord, 12 timer
description:
Er du interesseret i en stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at tage ansvar, udvikle dig og gøre en reel forskel for kunderne? Så kan det være, at dit livs måske vigtigste job venter på dig her hos os.

Hos Q8 bliver du en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi passer på hinanden og sørger for, at du trives i dit arbejde. Når du har det godt, kan du give kunderne den bedste oplevelse – og det er præcis det, vi brænder for. Vores gode samarbejde internt er samtidig med til at drive den udvikling, vi som virksomhed er i fuld gang med. Q8 står nemlig midt i en spændende transformation, hvor vi arbejder aktivt med at reducere vores klimapåvirkning. Lyder det som noget for dig? Så bliv en del af Q8‑familien.

Hvad kommer du til at lave?

Som salgsassistent får du en hverdag, hvor ingen dage er ens. Du sørger for, at stationen altid er indbydende og klar til at tage imod kunderne. Det ene øjeblik hjælper du på forpladsen, det næste betjener du kunder ved kassen, tilbereder og serverer mad eller fylder varer op. Der er fart på – men også plads til grin med kollegaerne og tid til at give kunderne en god service.

Det praktiske

  • Ansættelsesform: timelønnet
  • Omfang: Ca. 12 timer pr. uge
  • Arbejdstid: Vagterne vil ligge både i hverdagene og weekenden, typisk i både dag –og aftentimerne. Faste vagter mandag kl. 11:00-17:00 og torsdag kl. 11:00-17:00.
  • Start: Efter aftale
  • Løn: Grundløn for ufaglærte: 142,17 kr. Grundløn for faglærte: 151,53 kr. Derudover får du aften-, nat-, weekend- og helligdagstillæg i henhold til butiksoverenskomsten.
  • Pension: 10,7% firmabetalt pension gennem PFA. Gælder efter 3 måneders ansættelse og for medarbejdere over 20 år – med mindre du allerede er omfattet af en pensionsordning, så får du pension fra start.

OBS! Du skal kunne fremvise en straffeattest, hvis du går videre i processen. Det kræver en bil at komme til og fra arbejdet, da vi har adresse på motorvejen

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

  • En arbejdsplads med alsidige opgaver og mulighed for at lære nyt hver dag
  • Et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det sjovt
  • En medarbejderapp med mulighed for fleksibel lønudbetaling, indflydelse gennem vores ungeministerium samt gode fordele og rabatter
  • En struktureret onboardingproces, der sikrer, at du kommer godt fra start – understøttet af vores medarbejderapp, hvor du finder guides, træning og nyttige værktøjer

Hvis du vil vide mere om, hvordan det er at være medarbejder i Q8, så læs mere på karrierestationen.

Hvem passer jobbet til?

Vi leder efter dig, der har lyst til at tage ansvar og give kunderne en god oplevelse. Erfaring er ikke afgørende – det vigtigste er din energi og dit engagement.

OBS! For at søge skal du være fyldt 18 år og tale flydende dansk, da kundekontakt er en stor del af jobbet.

Klar på at blive en del af Q8?

I ansøgningen har du flere muligheder, men for at vi kan lære dig bedre at kende, så skal du besvare nogle enkelte spørgsmål. Derudover skal du optage en kort video, hvor du fortæller om dig selv og hvorfor du gerne vil arbejde hos Q8. Vi ved godt, at det kan lyde lidt grænseoverskridende, men det behøver ikke at være perfekt eller professionelt, og du kan bare filme på mobilen.

Du kan også vedhæfte dit CV, hvis du har et, men det er helt frivilligt. Vi håber at høre fra dig!

Det kan være dit livs måske vigtigste ansøgning.

title: Director of SOX Compliance & Internal Audit
description:
MacLean Power Systems is seeking a Director of SOX Compliance & Internal Audit to build and lead the Company's Sarbanes-Oxley compliance and internal audit functions as it prepares to operate as a public company.
This leader will establish a practical, risk-based control environment, develop the internal audit function, create enterprise policy governance, and serve as a key advisor to executive management and the Audit Committee. The role requires a hands-on leader who can build the function while working effectively across a decentralized, multi-entity manufacturing company.
This role is based in our Fort Mill, SC Office.
What You’ll Do

Design and implement the Company's SOX compliance program, including financial reporting controls, entity-level controls, business process controls, and IT general controls.
Lead the design, implementation, and testing of IT general controls in partnership with IT leadership.
Lead annual risk assessment, scoping, control documentation, testing, deficiency evaluation, remediation, and management certification.
Build a sustainable control environment aligned with COSO and applicable SEC and PCAOB requirements.
Partner with business and functional leaders to design practical controls, assign ownership, and embed controls into normal operations.
Establish the internal audit charter, methodology, staffing model, annual plan, issue tracking, and Audit Committee reporting.
Develop and execute a risk-based internal audit plan covering financial, operational, compliance, technology, cybersecurity, and fraud risks.
Lead the development and governance of enterprise financial, accounting, compliance, and internal control policies.
Coordinate with external auditors to support an efficient audit and reduce duplication where appropriate.
Provide clear reporting to executive management and the Audit Committee on SOX readiness, audit findings, deficiencies, remediation, and emerging risks.
Recruit, develop, and lead the SOX and internal audit team.
Support Legal in building and improving the ERM program and aligning key risks with internal audit planning.

What You’ll Need to Excel in This Role

Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field.
Certified Public Accountant designation.
At least 10 years of progressive experience in external audit, internal audit, SOX compliance, accounting, or risk management.
Public accounting audit experience serving public companies or companies preparing to become public.
Internal audit or SOX leadership experience within a large, complex company.
Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, SOX Sections 302 and 404, COSO, SEC reporting requirements, and PCAOB standards.
Experience assessing control design, leading testing, evaluating deficiencies, and overseeing remediation.
Experience presenting to executive leadership, external auditors, and an Audit Committee or Board.
Ability to travel to operating locations as needed.

Additional Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Direct experience creating an internal audit department or materially transforming an existing function.
Experience developing enterprise policies and establishing a policy governance process.
Experience supporting an IPO, public-company readiness program, or first-year SOX implementation.
Experience in a decentralized, multi-entity manufacturing or industrial company.
Knowledge of IT general controls, ERP systems, cybersecurity risk, and data analytics.
CIA, CISA, or other relevant certification in addition to a CPA.

Total Rewards Offering:
MPS offers a competitive compensation package; including a bonus potential based on company performance and a dynamic work environment that encourages creativity, innovation, and professional growth. A comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, and Vision, 401k with employer match, employer-paid disability and more...
For Us, For Family. Surround yourself with fun, energetic, and hard-working professionals who are dedicated to achieving Mission Zero; zero safety or environmental incidents.

title: Procesontwikkelaar Projectmanagement
description:
Jij ziet kansen, verbindt mensen en maakt processen slimmer, efficiënter en toekomstbestendig.

Werk om trots op te zijn

Als procesontwikkelaar projectmanagement ontwikkel, verbeter en beheer je processen binnen het infraprojectendomein. Je zorgt dat deze logisch, effectief, uitvoerbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn. Samen met drie collega’s verbind je strategie en uitvoering, signaleer je verbetermogelijkheden en begeleid je de implementatie van nieuwe werkwijzen. Zo draag je bij aan professionele en succesvolle infraprojecten binnen ProRail.

Voorbeelden van werkzaamheden zijn:

  • Het ontwikkelen, beheren en optimaliseren van processen binnen het infraprojectendomein en zorgen voor kwaliteit, structuur, uniformiteit en aansluiting op de organisatiedoelen.
  • Het vertalen van bestaande en niet-beschreven werkwijzen naar logische en uitvoerbare projectprocessen die toegankelijk, actueel en toekomstbestendig zijn.
  • Het signaleren van knelpunten en verbetermogelijkheden en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteringen. Je bedenkt en faciliteert hiervoor verbetersessies.
  • Het begeleiden van de implementatie van nieuwe en gewijzigde processen samen met het lijnmanagement en houdt overzicht over de integrale implementatiekalender.
  • Het stimuleren van continu verbeteren en datagedreven werken en zorgt dat ontwikkelingen op het gebied van veiligheid, wetgeving en digitalisering tijdig worden vertaald naar processen.

In deze functie werk je nauw samen met proceseigenaren, infraprojectmedewerkers en experts. Je verbindt verschillende processen en disciplines, neemt digitalisering mee in het procesontwerp en schakelt gemakkelijk tussen strategie en uitvoering. Daarbij ben je een stevige gesprekspartner die mensen meeneemt in veranderingen en organisatiegrenzen overstijgt.

Jouw plek

We bieden graag ruimte aan iedereen. Daarbij zien we talent als basis en diversiteit als kracht om samen betere resultaten te behalen. Voor jou als procesontwikkelaar projectmanagement ben je onderdeel van het kenniscluster Projectmanagement, binnen het cluster Projecten. Je rapporteert samen met je 3 collega’s direct aan de domeinmanager beleid projecten. Jouw werk doe je voor het hoofdproces Realiseren. Jouw standplaats is Utrecht, maar je bent indien nodig ook in de regio waar veel collega’s werken.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Direct een vast contract. Wij hebben vertrouwen in jou.
  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.860,- en € 8.972,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week, schaal 10.
  • Daarbovenop 13,61% van jouw bruto salaris in de vorm van een Individueel KeuzeBudget (IKB). Dit budget is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag en 3,25% decemberuitkering.
  • Een goed pensioen bij Rail & OV: een sterk fonds dat vooroploopt in duurzaam beleggen.
    Zit je nu in een ander fonds? Houd er rekening mee dat Rail & OV op 1 januari 2026 al overstapte op het nieuwe pensioenstelsel
  • Jaarlijks een automatische loonsverhoging van 2,5% tot het maximum in de salarisschaal.
  • Een leasefietsvergoeding van € 25,- netto per maand.

Wij kozen voor een kleine selectie uit onze arbeidsvoorwaarden. Maar we bieden je meer. Voor alle arbeidsvoorwaarden en onze CAO klik op deze link.

Jouw inbreng

Bij ProRail vinden wij het belangrijk dat jij gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Daarom zijn wij benieuwd naar wie jij bent. Voor deze functie breng je sowieso mee:

  • Hbo- of wo- werk- en denkniveau.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar aantoonbaar werkervaring met procesontwikkeling en procesoptimalisatie.
  • Conceptueel denken: je ziet verbanden tussen verschillende ontwikkelingen, legt complexe vraagstukken helder uit en vertaalt deze naar een duidelijke visie en aanpak.
  • Resultaatgericht: je stelt duidelijke doelen, houdt focus op voortgang en het gewenste resultaat en zorgt dat afspraken en acties daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd.
  • Verbindend communiceren: je communiceert helder en verbindend, luistert actief en weet verschillende mensen en belangen op diverse niveaus met elkaar te verbinden.

Jouw sollicitatie

Wil je als procesontwikkelaar projectmanagement werken aan de toekomst van Nederland én aan die van jezelf? Solliciteer voor maandag 5 oktober 2026. Toch eerst nog een vraag? Stel deze gerust aan Fabienne Jansen via fabienne.jansen@prorail.nl. Voor inhoudelijke vragen kun je contact opnemen met Charlotte Verheijdt via charlotte.verheijdt@prorail.nl.

Binnen 5 dagen na de sluitingsdatum krijg je onze reactie. De gesprekken vinden plaats op dinsdag 13 en woensdag 14 oktober 2026. Dan heb je twee sollicitatiegesprekken met een afvaardiging van de afdeling, management en recruitment. Voor degenen die doorgaan volgt daarna op donderdag 15 oktober 2026 een derde gesprek met de manager Datagedreven werken Programmeren en Realiseren. Voor het kennismakingsgesprek met de manager en recruiter vragen we je vooraf thuis een online assessment te maken als input voor het gesprek. Het opvragen van referenties is een vast onderdeel van de procedure.

Word jij onze nieuwe collega? Dan hoort het aanvragen van een VOG tot de indiensttredingsprocedure. De kosten voor de VOG krijg je terug nadat je bent gestart.

title: Wellness Experience Director
description:
