title: Principal Research Scientist II, Process Chemistry
description:
Job Description

The Process Chemistry group is responsible for inventing and executing the chemical processes for preparing active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) to enable toxicology studies, clinical trials, and drug product development for AbbVie’s pre-clinical and clinical candidates. We create valuable intellectual property through composition of matter, chemical processes, and technology, resulting in the development of safe and cost-effective commercial manufacturing processes.

AbbVie is seeking a highly skilled and innovative Principal Research Scientist II to contribute to chemical process research and development of small molecules, peptides, antibody-drug conjugates, and other modalities via expertise in chemical catalysis. The selected candidate will lead the development of catalytic processes for the scalable synthesis of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and application of AI/ML tools for the discovery and optimization of catalytic reactions. Deep expertise in chemical catalysis, a strong foundation in synthetic organic chemistry, and the technical versatility to integrate modern computational and high-throughput experimentation tools into process development is required for this role.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the setting and implementation of strategies for solving complex synthetic problems in process development, via implementation of chemical catalytic methods.

  • Lead efforts in the identification and design of chemical catalysts in support of novel or improved synthetic transformations for API process development.

  • Effectively apply expertise in CMC development in support of business development activities.

  • Leverage AI/ML tools and high-throughput experimentation (HTE) to accelerate reaction screening, optimization, and process development cycles.

  • Participate in and/or lead project teams associated with process development and characterization for small molecules, peptides, antibody-drug conjugates, and other modalities.

  • Lead a group of scientists, set project strategies and responsibilities, define timelines, and provide mentorship in a matrixed team setting.

  • Connect unrelated concepts to generate new ideas and always be on the lookout for the next big win.

  • Author and review technical reports, regulatory documents, patents, and scientific publications, present findings at internal and external scientific forums.

  • Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding GxP compliance, code of conduct, safety, and appropriate handling of materials.

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD Degree in organic chemistry with typically 16+ (BS), 14+ (MS) or 8+ (PhD) years of experience.

  • Expertise in synthetic organic chemistry with demonstrated hands-on experience in catalysis

  • Experience with high-throughput experimentation (HTE) platforms and data analysis workflows for rapid catalyst identification and reaction optimization.

  • Demonstrated ability in innovating new chemical and automation technologies.

  • Proven scientific leadership; strong interpersonal and communication skills for facilitating collaborations.

  • Experience in synthetic molecule process development.

  • Proven track-record of high impact publications in external scientific journals.

  • Proven track-record as an industry leader in the field of catalysis.

  • Proven track-record as a people manager.

title: Analyst II, Analytical Development
description:
Overview

Replimune’s mission is to revolutionize cancer treatment with therapies designed to activate a powerful and durable full-body anti-tumor response, boldly transforming cancer care because patient’s lives depend on it.

At Replimune, we live by our values:

United: We Collaborate for a Common Goal.

Audacious: We Are Bold.

Dedicated: We Give Our Full Commitment.

Candid: We Are Honest With Each Other.

People are at the center of everything we do, and when it comes to our employees, we make it personal. With a deep sense of purpose, a strong and evolving culture, a competitive and forward-looking total rewards program, everyone at Replimune has a unique opportunity to impact on the lives of patients, caregivers and themselves.

Join us, as we reshape the future.

Summary of job description:

The Analyst II, Analytical Development (AD) is primarily responsible for performing routine analytical testing to support AD, Process Development (PD), Research and Quality Control (QC) projects. The Analyst II, AD, also provides support for AD characterization and method development projects. The Analyst II, AD, is also responsible for supporting the day-to-day operation of the Analytical Development (AD) laboratories.

This position is based in our Milton Park location and typically has a 5-day on-site expectation.

Key responsibilities:

  • Key performer of PCR, ELISA, chromatography and cell-based analytical tests to support PD, AD, Research and QC testing.

  • Provide support for performing analytical method development and product characterisation projects.

  • Prepare laboratory chemical reagents and biological assay standards and controls for use in routine testing and development projects.

  • Oversee and perform internal periodic maintenance, calibration and verification of laboratory equipment.

  • Perform general laboratory housekeeping tasks, including maintaining stock levels of laboratory consumables.

  • Operate in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), company procedures and health and safety practices.

  • Author, update and adhere to equipment and method SOP’s as required.

  • Other responsibilities

  • Perform review of assay sheets, lab books and GMP documentation.

  • Training team members in equipment usage and maintenance.

Educational requirements:

  • Biological Sciences BSc degree preferred.

  • Experience and skill requirement:

  • Minimum of 1 year of relevant laboratory experience.

  • A self-motivated individual, with good time management and able to work in an organised manner.

  • An interest in biological science essential and experience of working in a GMP laboratory environment beneficial.

  • An ability to work independently and as part of a small team, with effective communication and an ability to work flexibly to meet varying workloads

  • Experience in any of cell culture, ELISA, PCR, chromatography.

  • Good IT skills in core applications e.g. Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook.

About Replimune


Replimune Group, Inc., headquartered in Woburn, MA, was founded in 2015 with the mission to transform cancer treatment by pioneering the development of a novel portfolio of oncolytic immunotherapies. Replimune’s proprietary RPx platform is based on a potent HSV-1 backbone intended to maximize immunogenic cell death and the induction of a systemic anti-tumor immune response. The RPx platform is designed to have a unique dual local and systemic activity consisting of direct selective virus-mediated killing of the tumor resulting in the release of tumor derived antigens and altering of the tumor microenvironment to ignite a strong and durable systemic response. The RPx product candidates are expected to be synergistic with most established and experimental cancer treatment modalities, leading to the versatility to be developed alone or combined with a variety of other treatment options. title: Hygiene Assistant
description:
Accelerated Hygiene Support Role
Position Summary
The Hygiene Assistant supports the hygienist, doctor, and clinical team by assisting with patient flow, room preparation, sterilization, radiographs, charting support, clinical documentation support, patient education reinforcement, and other duties that help create an efficient and high-quality hygiene experience.
This role is designed to support an accelerated hygiene model by allowing the hygienist to focus on direct patient care while the Hygiene Assistant helps prepare, organize, turn over, and maintain the hygiene operatory and clinical workflow. The Hygiene Assistant plays an important role in ensuring patients are seated on time, clinical records and imaging are prepared, rooms are properly disinfected, instruments are sterilized, and the hygiene schedule runs efficiently and safely.
The Hygiene Assistant must follow all office protocols, OSHA standards, HIPAA requirements, infection control guidelines, radiation safety requirements, and practice standards of care.

Essential Responsibilities
1. Hygiene Clinical Support
Assist the hygienist with clinical and administrative duties before, during, and after hygiene appointments.
Prepare patients for hygiene procedures, examinations, radiographs, periodontal charting, iTero scans, and provider exams as directed.
Seat patients, review basic appointment needs, update patient information as directed, and notify the hygienist when the patient is ready.
Assist with periodontal charting by accurately recording measurements and findings as dictated by the hygienist or doctor.
Assist with patient education by reinforcing hygienist and doctor recommendations, including home care instructions, fluoride, periodontal therapy, re-care intervals, Invisalign, nightguards, or other recommended services as directed.
Support the hygienist with provider handoffs by ensuring radiographs, scans, periodontal charting, notes, and clinical findings are available for doctor review.
Assist with maintaining schedule flow by anticipating the needs of the hygienist, preparing the next patient, and communicating delays or concerns to the appropriate team members.

2. Radiographs, Imaging, and Scanning
Take diagnostic-quality radiographs as allowed by certification, state regulations, doctor direction, and office protocol.
Ensure radiographs are properly exposed, positioned, labeled, mounted, saved, and available for hygienist and doctor review.
Take bitewings, periapicals, panoramic images, and other required images according to office protocols and patient needs.
Complete iTero scans or digital intraoral scans when trained and directed by the hygienist, doctor, or office protocol.
Take intraoral photos or other diagnostic images as directed to support patient education, documentation, and treatment planning.
Communicate any imaging concerns, errors, or retake needs promptly to the hygienist or doctor.

3. Sterilization and Infection Control
Prepare, clean, disinfect, and turn over hygiene operatories according to OSHA, CDC, state, and office infection control standards.
Sterilize and disinfect instruments according to practice protocol, including proper transport, cleaning, packaging, labeling, sterilization, storage, and documentation.
Set up instrument trays, hygiene cassettes, disposable barriers, materials, and supplies needed for hygiene appointments.
Maintain sterilization areas in a clean, organized, safe, and compliant manner.
Monitor and report sterilization concerns, equipment issues, supply shortages, or broken instruments to the appropriate team member or manager.
Support the entire clinical team with sterilization duties as needed to maintain patient flow and infection control compliance.

4. Operatory Preparation and Patient Flow
Prepare hygiene rooms before each appointment with the correct instruments, materials, disposables, PPE, and equipment.
Ensure operatories are clean, stocked, organized, and ready for patient care.
Turn over rooms efficiently between patients while maintaining infection control standards.
Help maintain the flow of the hygiene schedule by preparing the next patient, checking appointment needs, setting up required supplies, and supporting timely provider exams.
Assist with seating patients, escorting patients, updating the team on patient readiness, and supporting transitions between hygiene, doctor exam, treatment coordination, and checkout.
Support the practice with emergency, limited, or overflow needs when appropriate and directed by leadership.

5. Documentation and Administrative Support
Assist the hygienist with charting, documentation, and clinical record preparation as directed and within office protocol.
Confirm that radiographs, scans, periodontal charting, intraoral photos, medical alerts, and appointment notes are available for provider review.
Support accurate documentation of services completed, patient education provided, treatment recommendations, re-care needs, and follow-up items as directed by the hygienist or doctor.
Assist with re-care, scheduling communication, pending treatment awareness, and patient handoff details as needed.
Maintain confidentiality of all patient information in accordance with HIPAA guidelines and office policies.

6. Teamwork and Practice Support
Work collaboratively with hygienists, doctors, dental assistants, front office team members, practice managers, and regional leadership.
Assist with reasonable tasks requested by the hygienist, doctor, practice manager, or other members of leadership to support patient care and practice operations.
Support the clinical team with sterilization, room turnover, radiographs, iTero scans, patient seating, patient flow, supply stocking, documentation support, and other duties as needed.
Maintain a positive, flexible, team-oriented attitude and contribute to a respectful and efficient work environment.
Participate in huddles, team meetings, training, coaching, and continuing education as requested.

7. Safety, Compliance, and Professional Standards
Follow all OSHA, HIPAA, infection control, radiation safety, and practice compliance requirements.
Maintain annual OSHA, HIPAA, BLS/CPR, infection control, and any other required training as required by law or practice policy.
Use proper personal protective equipment and follow universal precautions at all times.
Maintain patient confidentiality and professionalism in all communication.
Follow office protocols, standard of care expectations, and directions from the doctor, hygienist, practice manager, and leadership team.
Report safety concerns, compliance concerns, equipment issues, patient concerns, or workflow barriers promptly.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent

Dental assistant certification where required by state law or practice policy

X-ray certification, if required to expose radiographs

Current CPR/BLS certification

Completion of required OSHA, HIPAA, infection control, and safety training

Ability to follow clinical protocols, infection control standards, and office procedures

Strong attention to detail and organization

Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced clinical environment

Professional communication skills and a team-focused attitude

Preferred Qualifications

Prior dental assisting or hygiene assisting experience

Experience supporting accelerated hygiene workflows

Experience with digital radiographs, intraoral cameras, iTero scanning, or digital intraoral scanning

Experience with dental practice management software

Nitrous oxide certification, where applicable and permitted

Strong understanding of sterilization, room turnover, and clinical supply organization

Role Expectations
The Hygiene Assistant is expected to:

Support the hygienist in maintaining an efficient, high-quality hygiene schedule

Prepare patients, rooms, instruments, materials, and equipment for hygiene care

Take diagnostic-quality radiographs when certified and permitted

Complete iTero scans or digital scans when trained and directed

Assist with periodontal charting and documentation support as directed

Maintain sterilization and infection control standards

Support patient flow, provider exams, and clinical handoffs

Keep hygiene operatories stocked, clean, organized, and ready

Follow directions from the doctor, hygienist, practice manager, and leadership team

Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, reliability, and a positive team attitude

Assist with additional tasks as needed to support patient care and practice operations

title: Takeoff Assistant
description:
Takeoff Assistant

  • Work Type: Full-time.

  • Schedule: Standard US business hours, with occasional overtime and weekend work required based on bid schedules and workload demands.

  • Location: 100% Remote.

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Takeoff Assistant for a highly focused production role designed to increase the overall throughput and capacity of our estimating department. By performing detailed quantitative take-offs and compiling initial material quotes, you will allow Senior Estimators to focus on advanced scope compilation, margin strategy, and final verification. This role is ideal for a process-driven professional looking to minimize risk and accelerate bid output while advancing their estimating career based on demonstrated competency and growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Digital Quantification: Perform highly accurate, digital quantity takeoffs for various disciplines (including Low Slope, Steep Slope, Glazing, and Cladding) utilizing Bluebeam and Edge Estimating software.

  • Quote Compilation: Solicit, receive, and compile quotes from material suppliers and vendors, organizing them effectively for the Senior Estimator’s review.

  • Data Entry & Processing: Input foundational takeoff quantities and baseline material pricing into the designated estimating systems.

  • Project Handoff: Package the completed takeoff and compiled quotes cleanly, handing them off to the Senior Estimator for final compilation, verification, and pricing strategy.

  • Continuous Improvement: Meet established production metrics, actively apply coaching and feedback to reduce errors, and consistently develop your estimating skills and accuracy.

Requirements & Qualifications

title: Senior Scrum Master
location: Austin, TX, US; Tempe, AZ, US
description:
Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact.

Kestra is seeking a talented, experienced Senior Scrum Master to support our Data, Analytics & AI Platform group. In this role, you will partner with multiple Scrum and/or Kanban teams to strengthen efficiency, predictability, and collaboration across dynamic Data, Analytics, and AI initiatives. As part of Kestra’s Scrum Master team, you will apply your experience and Agile expertise to help align teams and Scrum Masters around consistent practices, improve delivery effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement.

What you’ll Do:

Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and release planning.
Partner with Product Owners to maintain healthy backlog management, prioritization, and value-driven delivery.
Identify, remove, and escalate impediments, risks, and organizational barriers that impact team performance and delivery.

Coordinate dependencies, issue resolution, and collaboration across distributed teams and multiple time zones.

Coach teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum practices, continuous improvement, and self-organization.
Provide leadership and coaching within our Scrum Master team.

Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, healthy communication, and continuous learning.

Lead and continuously improve release planning and delivery processes, enabling engineering teams to focus on execution and Product Owners to focus on business priorities.

Use Agile metrics and performance data to identify trends, measure team effectiveness, and drive corrective actions and process improvements.

Promote engineering best practices, including predictable delivery, automation, continuous delivery, technical debt management, and product sustainability.

Stay current with industry practices; experiment with new techniques to improve teams’ Agile maturity and effectiveness.

Uphold Kestra’s core values (Make it Happen, One Team, Serve) in daily interactions and delivery commitments.

What You Bring:

Must have 5+ years’ Scrum Master experience.

Must have 3-5 years’ experience working with teams in a data domain, ideally with experience in Cloud-based data platforms, e.g. Databricks, and master data management tools, e.g. Profisee.

Must have 10+ years of overall technology industry experience.

Certified Scrum Master (preferred).
Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban (and experience operating as a Scrum Master in both frameworks).

Strong experience with Jira, or a similar issue-tracking tool. Experience with Jira Service Management is desired.

Experience with distributed teams across multiple time zones and resolving the challenges this can present.

Experience with data lifecycle & pipelines (ingestion → transformation → consumption).

Understanding of batch vs streaming vs near-real-time delivery.

Awareness of data quality, lineage, and governance dependencies.
Exposure to analytics and AI/ML workflows is a plus, including supporting teams delivering data science and machine learning use cases.

Experience working in the financial industry and awareness of basic financial concepts.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Effective written and verbal communication skills.

title: Private Banker, Innlandet
description:
Teamet ditt
Handelsbanken Innlandet har kontorer på Hamar og Lillehammer og teller i dag 14 ansatte som jobber innen privat- og bedriftsmarkedet. Siden oppstart i 2006 har Handelsbanken lykkes i å bygge en attraktiv bank for både kunder og ansatte i Innlandet.

Banken og kontoret har et stort potensial for videre vekst både innen private banking, family offices og større kapitalplasseringer. Vi søker nå en Private Banker som skal bidra til å nå bankens og Innlandets ambisiøse mål for vekst innen kapitalforvaltning.

Med bankens satsning på nye produkter, tjenester og konsepter, får den rette kandidaten gode muligheter til å lykkes og skape lønnsom vekst.

Om rollen

Som Private Banker får du en sentral rolle i å utvikle og ivareta langsiktige kunderelasjoner. Du vil følge opp eksisterende kunder og bidra til å skape nye forretninger gjennom tillitsbasert rådgivning og høy faglig kvalitet. Rollen gir stor grad av selvstendighet, samtidig som du blir en del av et kompetent team som samarbeider tett om å skape gode kundeopplevelser.

For å sikre de beste løsningene samarbeider du tett med spesialister og kolleger i banken, og leder relevante kundeteam. Sammen bidrar dere til å styrke kundenes økonomiske utvikling og Handelsbankens posisjon innen Private Banking.

Hos oss blir du en del av et inkluderende og kompetent fagmiljø innen investeringer og kapitalforvaltning. Vi deler kunnskap, lærer av hverandre og jobber sammen for å finne de beste løsningene for kundene våre.

Hvem er du

Vi ser etter deg som trives med å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit gjennom god rådgivning. Du har interesse for investeringer og kapitalforvaltning, og motiveres av å hjelpe kunder med å nå sine økonomiske mål.

For å lykkes i rollen er du nysgjerrig, proaktiv og trygg i møte med kunder med komplekse behov. Du evner å omsette innsikt til verdiskapende løsninger og bygger troverdighet gjennom høy faglig kompetanse, integritet og god forretningsforståelse.

Du trives med å arbeide både selvstendig og i samarbeid med kolleger og spesialister, og du har en strukturert arbeidsform som sikrer høy kvalitet i kundeoppfølgingen. Samtidig er du en tillitsvekkende relasjonsbygger med gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter og evnen til å skape engasjement hos ulike typer kunder og samarbeidspartnere.

Vi tror du kjenner deg igjen i mye av dette:

  • Høyere økonomisk utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå
  • Relevant erfaring fra Private Banking, Wealth Management, kapitalforvaltning eller annen rådgivende rolle innen finansmarkedet
  • Autorisasjon innen AFR Sparing og Investering
  • God forståelse for finansielle markeder, investeringer og kapitalforvaltning.
  • Solid regnskaps- og økonomiforståelse
  • Evne til å bygge sterke relasjoner og utvikle langsiktige kundeforhold.
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og et ønske om å bidra til et sterkt faglig og kommersielt team

Dette er en spennende mulighet for deg som ønsker å utvikle sterke kunderelasjoner, bidra til videre vekst og være en del av et faglig sterkt miljø hvor samarbeid, tillit og langsiktighet står i fokus.

Noe reising på påregnes. Kontorplassen vil være lokalisert på Hamar.

Handelsbanken ønsker å være en mangfoldig og inkluderende arbeidsplass med like muligheter for alle, uavhengig av hvem du er og hvilken bakgrunn du har.

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad

Handelsbanken er en del av kritisk infrastruktur og en av verdens mest solide banker, hvilket stiller store krav til banken og våre ansatte. Vi har dermed et sikkerhetsfokus gjennom vår ansettelsesprosess , som også innebærer en bakgrunnssjekk av alle søkere vi ønsker å ansette.

title: Project Manager
description:
Summary

Balfour Beatty is seeking a Project Manager to join our team in Raleigh. The ideal candidate will be a results-driven construction professional with strong communication and leadership skills, capable of managing all phases of commercial construction projects from preconstruction through closeout.

As a Project Manager, you’ll lead a collaborative project team, overseeing budgets, schedules, contracts, and client relationships to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality project delivery. You’ll work closely with the Superintendent, Project Executive, and design partners to plan, execute, and deliver projects that align with Balfour Beatty’s standards of excellence and our Zero Harm® safety culture.

Essential Functions

Project Leadership: Manage all aspects of assigned projects, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, and reporting.
Client Relations: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, design partners, and stakeholders to maintain strong relationships and ensure project satisfaction.
Financial Management: Develop and maintain project budgets, financial reports, and revenue projections; review and approve subcontractor pay applications and change orders.
Preconstruction & Planning: Provide constructability input, coordinate project logistics, and develop staffing and resource plans.
Scheduling: Lead project scheduling in collaboration with the Superintendent, develop baselines in Primavera P6, and oversee regular updates and pull-planning sessions.
Procurement & Contracting: Manage subcontractor buyouts, contract negotiations, and material purchasing to ensure cost control and timely delivery.
Safety & Quality: Promote and enforce Balfour Beatty’s Zero Harm® safety culture and lead quality control programs to maintain high construction standards.
Communication & Reporting: Chair Owner-Architect-Contractor (OAC) meetings, lead coordination sessions, and provide regular progress updates to clients and internal stakeholders.
Closeout: Direct project turnover and closeout documentation, ensuring all financial, safety, and quality obligations are met.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related field.
6–8 years of progressive experience in commercial construction project management.
Proven ability to manage full project lifecycle from preconstruction through closeout.
Proficiency with project management and scheduling software (Procore, Primavera P6, Sage 300 CRE, or similar).
Strong leadership, organization, and communication skills.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing complex or large-scale commercial projects.
Demonstrated success building client relationships and leading diverse teams.
Experience in business development or early-stage project pursuits.

40 hours a week

  • Comfortable with digital media tools, such as Parsely, Slack, Airtable, and Google Workplace, as well as working within a proprietary CMS.

title: Senior Resident Service Coordinator
description:
Senior Resident Service Coordinator, Beacon House Square - Baltimore, MD
Position Description: The Senior Resident Service Coordinator (Sr. RSC) develops and coordinates support services for residents. The Sr. RSC will ensure resident and community success through close work with property management, clinical leadership and care coordination, building and sustaining relationships with local and regional partners, planning programs and other on-site opportunities for residents, and working one-on-one with residents to assist them in achieving their goals and maintaining housing stability.This position requires a licensed clinician (LCSW) and includes lead responsibility for coordinating referrals and services with Project PLASE, the on-site Permanent Supportive Housing (PSH) partner.
A Sr. RSC is defined in one of the following three ways:

Supervising other RSCs at the same property or at proximal properties.
Responsible for supporting proximal properties without an RSC.
Complexity/size of property requires someone with more experience.

Senior Resident Service Coordinator Role

Provide strategic leadership for the property in creating and implementing programs, partnerships and services that meet the needs of residents and fulfill any obligations based on property financing.
Serve as the lead wellness and service coordination point of contact with Project PLASE, the on-site Permanent Supportive Housing (PSH) partner, ensuring clear referral pathways, shared care plans, and coordinated interventions for residents with complex behavioral health, medical, or housing stability needs.
Provide guidance to the property management staff related to high-risk residents, crisis situations, and complex service needs.
May include supervising RSCs both within the property and across the region and supporting properties without an RSC.
Participate in Sr. RSC leadership calls with other Sr. RSCs across the company and lead projects and tasks to further the goals of the department.
Attend meetings to plan for acquisition of new properties in the region.
Ensure effective working relationships with Area Resident Service Manager (ARSM), RSC colleagues, corporate staff and Property Management team.

RSC Role:

Assess and coordinate resident referrals and resources by recommending solutions to resolve resident issues impacting their life and refer them to suitable community services, resources and entitlement programs, as appropriate.
Build relationships with residents to better understand their aspirations and goals and connect them with local resources and opportunities.
Create partnerships with local organizations to successfully implement community engagement initiatives including implementation of required contracts.
Assist elders or those at-risk, and non-elderly residents with disabilities to maintain living independently through collaboration and coordination of programs with wellness nurse/health care agency to addresses common health concerns such as, fall prevention, nutrition, grief and loss, medication management, dealing with incontinence, healthy weight loss, brain health/improving cognitive functions and general social-emotional wellbeing.
Lead coordination of resident support and resources on housing stabilization issues such as late rent payments, housekeeping, and other lease violations.
Collaborate with property management team to develop program budgets that reflect needs of the resident population and that comply with program finance obligations.
Create consistent outreach and communication with residents including completing new resident assessments, newsletters, flyers, monthly calendars, telephone calls and door knocking.
Use Beacon’s data collection and analysis systems to document services provided to residents and outcomes achieved.
Track and monitor the property’s Community Engagement budget.
Processes Reasonable Accommodation requests for residents with disabilities.
Collaborate with the property management team and attend weekly meetings as required.
Respond to resident crises, including behavioral health emergencies, in coordination with clinical providers, emergency services, and property management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Experience working with older adults, and issues relating to isolation, health and wellness and other social determinants of health.
Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, serious mental illness, substance use, and/or chronic health conditions, including Permanent Supportive Housing models.
Experience working with chronically homeless veterans, including familiarity with VA systems, veteran benefits, trauma-informed care, and housing stabilization strategies for veteran populations.
Experience working with youth and families and issues relating to workforce development, youth enrichment, education, and asset building.
Ability to understand and respect values, attitudes, and beliefs that differ across cultures and to respond appropriately to these differences with residents in planning, implementing, and evaluating programs and services.
Demonstrated leadership ability to manage and support a team to implement programs and services in a changing landscape.

title: Toolmaker Team Leader - $2,500 Signing Bonus
description:
GENERAL SUMMARY
The Tool & Die Team Leader is a working leader responsible for coordinating day-to-day tooling activities while performing Tool & Die Maker responsibilities as needed. This position provides technical direction and floor leadership to Tool & Die Makers and apprentices to ensure production tooling is safe, reliable, available, and maintained to meet production and customer requirements.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Coordinate the tool room schedule, assign daily priorities, and ensure production tooling and equipment are ready to meet customer requirements.
Lead and support troubleshooting of tooling problems at presses, including complex or recurring issues.
Work with Tooling, Production, Engineering, Quality, and Maintenance to continuously improve tooling reliability, quality, and production performance.
Perform Tool & Die Maker duties and support production equipment as necessary to maintain production.
Coordinate supplies, spare parts, and critical tooling components; maintain organized tool room and die storage areas.
Ensure safe, clean, and organized work areas and reinforce 5S expectations within the tooling area.
Coordinate with outside trades and suppliers as required and communicate status, timing, and needs to the Tooling Manager.
Coordinate and support overtime or call-in coverage as required to meet production and tooling needs.
Participate in technical and leadership training and support training and development of Tool & Die Makers and apprentices.
Lead and support continuous improvement activities focused on tooling reliability, die performance, quality, safety, and cost.
Interpret prints for tooling modifications, accuracy, repairs, and improvements; provide technical guidance to the tooling team.
Work with Engineers to create or modify prints and documentation to accurately reflect tooling changes.
Coordinate and perform preventive maintenance assignments; monitor completion and escalate overdue or high-risk tooling concerns.
Provide daily direction, coaching, and technical support to Tool & Die Makers and apprentices; communicate shift priorities and open issues; perform other duties assigned by the next-level leader.

TEAM LEADER RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead by example through professionalism, attendance, workmanship, urgency, accountability, and teamwork.
  • Provide feedback to the Tooling Manager regarding associate performance, training needs, workload, recurring tooling issues, and department concerns.
  • Reinforce NASG policies, safety requirements, Lockout/Tagout, PPE, quality standards, and department expectations.
  • Ensure clear shift-to-shift communication of open tooling issues, repair status, parts needs, and production risks.
  • Monitor progress of tooling repairs, PM activities, and improvement work; follow through to completion and escalate risks affecting safety, quality, production, or delivery.
  • Confirm daily manpower and work assignments and adjust priorities based on production needs, downtime, preventive maintenance, and emergency repairs.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS
Education:

Required - High School Diploma or GED
Preferred - Certified Toolmaker or 5 years’ experience in Tool and Die field
Would be nice - Apprenticeship Program completion

Experience and skill requirements:

Minimum five (5) years Tool & Die Maker experience preferred, with demonstrated proficiency in die repair, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and tooling modifications.
Demonstrated leadership, communication, coaching, and problem-solving skills; self-motivated and able to set priorities and meet Tooling Department goals.
Working computer skills including Microsoft Word and Excel; CAD experience preferred. Previous mentoring, training, team lead, or demonstrated leadership experience preferred.
Ability to learn and support basic electronics, sensors, mistake-proofing, and die-protection systems; ability to identify recurring failures and support root-cause corrective action.

description:

title: Production Technician l (3rd Shift- 10:30pm-7am)

title: Senior Principal Product Manager, AI Platform
description:

title: Selger deltid og lagermedarbeider deltid - Megaflis Vestby
description:
Hos oss i Megaflis trenger du ikke å kunne alt fra før, vi sørger for opplæring og kunnskapen du trenger! Det viktigste er at du er nysgjerrig, læringsvillig og ønsker å bidra til gode kundeopplevelser.

Det er medarbeiderne våre som gjør Megaflis til Megaflis. Her møter du engasjerte og dyktige kollegaer som støtter hverandre og skaper gode arbeidsdager sammen. Hverdagen er variert og til tider travel, og vi ser derfor etter deg som trives med tempo, samarbeid og kundekontakt. Vår visjon er «alltid fornøyde kunder».

Dette får du hos oss:

  • Et team hvor samarbeid og inkludering er avgjørende for gode dager
  • En variert hverdag med mestring og påvirkningskraft
  • God opplæring, produktkunnskap og jevnlig kursing
  • Utviklingsmuligheter og reell karrierevekst, vi ansetter ofte internt
  • Verdifull arbeidserfaring som du får bruk for videre i livet
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn og personalgoder

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er serviceinnstilt, positiv og løsningsorientert
  • Trives i en jobb med ulike oppgaver og til tider høyt tempo
  • Samarbeider godt og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Liker å ta ansvar, og evner å jobbe selvstendig når det trengs
  • Har lyst til å lære mer om produktene våre og bli skikkelig god
  • Er trygg på bruk av PC og systemer
  • Ser verdien i et smil og «hei»
  • Er over 18 år

Vi har flere ledige stillinger akkurat nå, både som selger og lagermedarbeider.

Arbeidstidene vil være 1-2 kvelder i uken og annenhver lørdag. Det vil være mulighet for å ta på seg ekstravakter i høysesonger og ferier.

Som selger ser vi etter deg som:

  • Synes salg er gøy og får energi av kundemøter
  • Har et sterkt ønske om å lykkes med salg

Som selger i Megaflis er du den viktigste delen av kundenes butikkbesøk. Både førsteinntrykk og sisteinntrykk teller. Du er aktiv i kundemøtene, tar initiativ og sørger for at kundene føler seg sett, hørt og trygge i kjøpet. Samtidig har du alltid fokus på mersalg, gode løsninger og et resultat som gagner både kunden og Megaflis.

Som lagermedarbeider ser vi etter deg som:

  • Liker struktur, orden og fysisk arbeid
  • Har interesse for lager og logistikk
  • Truckførerbevis er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Som lagermedarbeider i Megaflis handler ikke lager bare om varer. Det handler om flyt, samarbeid og fornøyde kunder. Du bidrar til at kundene våre får en god opplevelse gjennom kundebehandling i kundemottaket, klikk & hent, mottak og håndtering av vareleveranser, truckkjøring og vareflyt på lager, lossing av biler og containere, samt telefonhenvendelser og reklamasjoner via PC.

Synes du dette høres spennende ut?

Da håper vi på å høre fra deg! Spesifiser gjerne hvilken stilling du søker på.

Presiser gjerne i søknaden hvilken stillingsprosent du er interessert i.
Og du – hos oss er det valgfritt med CV og søknad. Bruk gjerne AI, men vær deg selv (det holder lenge). Vi vil bli kjent med deg, ikke en perfekt tekst.

Vil du lese mer om rollene og de ulike stillingene hos oss?

Sjekk ut megaflis.no/jobb-hos-oss/roller

title: Herkkukeittiöön ja herkkutorille myyjä (30-35h/vko) K-Supermarket Basilika, Sipoo
description:
Haluamme tarjota asiakkaillemme ensiluokkaista asiakaspalvelua sekä helppoja ruokaratkaisuja arkeen ja herkkuja juhlaan. Haemme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen innostunutta Herkkutorin myyjää K-Supermarket Basilikaan.
K-Supermarket Basilika sijaitsee Sipoon Nikkilässä ja tänne on helppo tulla vaikka omalla autolla. Meille tärkeää on luoda asiakkaidemme toiveiden mukaista ruokakauppaa, jossa asioinnin helppous ja vaivattomuus sekä matkan varrelta tarttuneet uutuudet ja herkut tuovat kauppareissun jälkeen hyvän mielen, ja jossa voimme palvella arkena ja sesongeissa Nikkilän sekä lähialueen asukkaita mahdollisimman kattavasti.

Valmistat ja pakkaat meidän omatekemiä tuotteita ja huolehdit Herkkutorilla palvelusta ja sekä fileoit ja pakkaat kalaa ja lihaa. Lisäksi autat tarvittaessa paistossa ja einesten ja lihajalosteen kuorman purussa. Huolehdit erinomaisesta asiakaspalvelusta, olet tärkeä osa työyhteisöämme ja kaupan kokonaisuutta. Työ sisältää sekä aamu- että iltavuoroja. Työskentelet mielelläsi yhteistyössä muiden kanssa ja pyrit aina erinomaiseen asiakaspalveluun ja kauppakuntoon. Arvostamme kykyä ja halua ratkaista ongelmia, toimia paineen alla ja ottaa vastuuta. Emme etsi täydellisyyttä, tärkeintä on aito into ja halu kehittää osastoa sekä kuunnella asiakkaita ja heidän toiveitaan. Työsuhde alkaa viimeistään marraskuun alusta tai sopimuksen mukaan. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.


Odotamme sinulta:

  • asiakaslähtöisyyttä sekä avointa ja iloista asennetta
  • aiempaa kokemusta kaupan alasta sekä vastaavista tehtävistä pidämme erittäin tärkeänä
  • vuorovaikutustaitoja
  • halua kehittyä ja oppia uutta
  • suunnitelmallisuutta, laatua ja nopeutta
  • vastuunottokykyä sekä oma-aloitteista ja joustavaa asennetta
  • sujuvaa suomen tai ruotsin kielitaitoa ja vähintään 18-vuoden ikää
  • voimassa olevaa hygieniapassia
  • mahdollisuutta työskennellä kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • monipuolisen, vastuullisen ja itsenäisen työn
  • K-ryhmän ja oman talon ostoedun
  • sinua tukevan työyhteisön ja kauppiaat
  • sopimuksen mukaisen palkan

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
The Role
Joining Balfour Beatty as a Senior Project Manager in our Stone Mountain, GA team you will be responsible for the overall direction, completion, and financial outcome of construction projects assigned to you. You will direct and supervise activities related to contract administration, change orders, submittals, procurement, project financial projections, and schedule requirements to ensure projects are completed with quality, profitable, adhering to our Safety/Zero Harm culture.
Essential Functions

Collaborates with scheduling, superintendent, subcontractors, and suppliers to create a construction schedule.
Develop an organizational and responsibilities matrix at the start of each project and determine the resources needed for the project (e.g., people, tools, equipment, materials, internal and external services).
Review the contract documents with all project participants (e.g., customers, employees, subcontractors, suppliers, government regulators, utilities) to ensure work is completed on time and within budget.
Coordinate and deliver all requirements for subcontractors and suppliers to meet project schedules.
Responsible for project administration and daily operations. Prepares and maintains the project schedule, milestone dates, and close-out checklist. Reviews with project staff each quarter and assigns responsibilities, execution, and follow-up plans.

Minimum 10 years of commercial construction experience, with specific experience working on K-12/educational institution projects.

Proven experience developing and working within demanding client relationships, demonstrating excellent communication.
Demonstrated attention to detail, with the ability to deliver the highest quality product and lead teams to do the same.
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
Proven experience with project manager software (Constructware, P6, Timberline, etc.).

specifications.

title: Switchman/Conductor
description:
Switchman/Conductor with Cando are responsible for providing safe and efficient rail car switching services. If you enjoy working outdoors, physical activity, problem solving, and a company that promotes a strong safety culture, this opportunity is for you!

Cando provides specialized rail operating services. We provide a wide range of rail services including short line operations, industrial switching, material handling, terminal & transload services, and more.

Cando Advantages

  • Work Life Balance
  • Cando’s Technical and Leadership Training Programs
  • Award Winning Safety Culture
  • Group Life, Accidental Death & Dismemberment, and Long-Term Disability Insurances
  • Health & Dental Benefits include voluntary options.
  • Expanding in the US and we welcome you to come grow with us!

Hours/Days required for this position: 2 On, 2 Off, 2 On, Night Position 6 PM - 6 AM

Job Description

Switchman/Conductor with Cando are responsible for providing safe and efficient rail car switching services. Working in a fast-paced, customer-oriented environment, the Switching crew must work well in teams to maximize efficiency and safety, while demonstrating a strong initiative, and organizational skills.

Roles & Responsibilities

The incumbent works in a team environment to provide safe and effective switching services. Responsibilities include:

  • Ensuring safe operation of the locomotive and train movements including conducting clear and concise job briefings.
  • Applying rules, special instructions, and switching procedures while operating as a locomotive engineer or grounds person. This includes but is not limited to working as a team to operate switches and derails, coupling and uncoupling rail cars, managing air hoses, and applying or releasing handbrakes to perform necessary rail car switching maneuvers for the customer.
  • Providing protection of train, track, and equipment.
  • Performing plant and equipment inspections, including air brake tests.
  • Complying with all applicable operating rules, switching procedures, regulations imposed by government, the customer, and/or Cando; practicing and promoting safe work habits.
  • Keeping the interior of the locomotive safe, clean, and tidy.
  • Completing daily inspection and testing of the locomotive brakes and safety devices.
  • Completing daily reports, daily logs, and other reports deemed necessary for the customer or Cando.
  • Actively participating with the team and providing excellent customer service while promoting a superior company image.
  • Participating in training or company initiatives as required.

Skills, Knowledge, & Abilities

  • Excellent teamwork skills and strong customer service skills.
  • Ability to read and write general documentation including safety briefings, policy and procedure manuals, and switching lists.
  • Physically fit including the ability to pull yourself up and down from a railcar on a continuous basis, able to lift and twist air hoses, able to secure rail car brakes, and operate both derails and switches effectively.
  • Knowledge with technology and computer systems with a willingness to use Excel and Outlook on a daily basis.
  • Ability to obtain necessary certification, and pass Drug/Alcohol and medical clearances to perform the role.

Education & Experience

  • Experience as a Locomotive Operator and/or Switchman is preferred.
  • Previous experience in a customer-oriented environment is preferred.

Note: This description is not intended to limit the assignment of work or be construed as a complete list of the many duties to be performed by the incumbent. The qualifications are provided so interested candidates understand of the level of expertise required in this position

title: Senior Director Process Engineering
description:
Position Summary

The Sr Director Process Engineering BDS CGT sets enterprise direction and senior technical governance for process engineering strategy, process platform deployment, process package design, technical assurance, manufacturing technology interfaces and project delivery for biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing within AbbVie Strategic Investment.

The role supports Strategic Investments through engineering leadership, technical expertise, standards development, technical governance and project execution support across multiple manufacturing sites, strategic investments and technology platforms.

The role supports engineering activities associated with new biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing facility investments, new production capabilities, strategic capacity creation, advanced manufacturing platforms and new technology deployments across the Strategic Investment portfolio.

The role partners with Strategic Investments, manufacturing sites, operations, quality, EHS, validation / CQV and external engineering partners to deliver technically robust and business-aligned engineering solutions.

Strategic Investment Context

Strategic Investment provides engineering leadership, technical governance, standards development and project execution support across AbbVie’s Strategic Investments and strategic capital portfolio.

The organization supports new biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing facilities, new platform deployments, strategic capacity creation, advanced biologics and CGT manufacturing capabilities and standards development for emerging technologies across Strategic Investments.

Strategic Investment roles are expected to promote common standards, transfer lessons learned across regions and sites, and enable consistent engineering delivery across strategic capital investments.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Investment Governance and Standards

  • Establish, maintain and deploy global engineering standards, technical practices and governance expectations for biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy process engineering strategy, process platform deployment, process package design, technical assurance, manufacturing technology interfaces and project delivery.

  • Drive consistent application of technical standards, design principles, lessons learned and engineering playbooks across regions, sites and capital projects.

  • Define enterprise standards, engineering requirements and technical guardrails for new biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy technologies, including requirements for consistent design, deployment, qualification, operation and scale-up across Strategic Investments.

  • Ensure discipline strategies support AbbVie’s long-range Strategic Investment objectives, strategic investment programs and adoption of new technologies across future manufacturing platforms.

  • Provide governance and escalation for technical decisions with material safety, quality, compliance, cost, schedule, operability or lifecycle impact.

Strategic New Technology and Capital Investment Support

  • Provide engineering leadership for strategic capital investments, including new biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy facility builds, technology platform deployments, new production capabilities, strategic capacity projects and lifecycle technology upgrades.

  • Support front-end engineering, facility concept development, investment option evaluation, manufacturing capability assessments and site / platform planning activities for biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy assets.

  • Partner with Strategic Investments and project leadership to ensure technical assumptions, deliverables, risks and resource needs are integrated into capital program plans.

  • Apply Strategic Investment lessons learned and standards to improve project quality, speed, reliability and readiness across the portfolio.

Technical Leadership and Delivery

  • Lead or support technical decision-making for biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy process engineering strategy, process platform deployment, process package design, technical assurance, manufacturing technology interfaces and project delivery across multiple manufacturing sites, capital projects and technology platforms.

  • Ensure engineering deliverables support safety, quality, compliance, operability, maintainability, reliability, sustainability and operational readiness.

  • Coordinate technical input from project teams, site SMEs, external engineering partners, vendors and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Drive timely resolution of technical issues and ensure suitable escalation when decisions have broader project, network or business impact.

Cross-Functional Integration

  • Partner with Strategic Investments, manufacturing operations, quality, validation / CQV, EHS, site engineering, MS&T, supply chain, finance and related engineering disciplines.

  • Ensure discipline decisions are integrated with biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing strategy, network capacity, technology platform deployment, regulatory expectations and site handover needs.

  • Facilitate collaboration across Strategic Investments, sites and project teams to avoid fragmented solutions and drive consistency across the strategic capital portfolio.

  • Represent Strategic Investment in technical reviews, project forums and risk discussions relevant to assigned scope.

Capability Building and Continuous Improvement

  • Share engineering best practices, lessons learned and technical knowledge across sites, regions and projects.

  • Build capability through coaching, mentoring, technical review discipline and development of reusable engineering practices.

  • Promote a culture of engineering excellence, safety, quality, reliability, collaboration, accountability and proactive risk management.

  • Support continuous improvement of Strategic Investment standards, templates, knowledge management and project delivery approaches.

Strategic Investment Leadership Expectations

  • Collaborate across Strategic Investments to identify, develop and deploy best practices, technical standards, lessons learned and capability-building initiatives.

  • Promote consistency, quality, reliability, sustainability and project delivery performance across regions, sites and capital projects.

  • Support long-range manufacturing strategy, strategic investment planning and Strategic Investment capability development.

  • Build technical capability through coaching, mentoring, standards governance, knowledge management and cross-functional collaboration.

Stakeholder Interfaces

Strategic Investments: Investment planning, portfolio alignment, technical assumptions, front-end engineering, biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy technology deployment standards and strategic capital program support.

Manufacturing Sites and Operations: Network needs, site readiness, operability, maintainability, startup, handover and operational performance support.

Quality, Validation / CQV and EHS: Compliance expectations, validation strategy, qualification readiness, safety, risk review and inspection readiness interfaces.

Strategic Investment Disciplines: Cross-discipline technical integration, standards, design reviews, technical issue resolution and lessons learned.

External Engineering Partners, EPCM Firms, Vendors and OEMs: Technical oversight, deliverable review, issue escalation, supplier alignment and execution quality.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science or a relevant technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred where relevant.
  • Typically 15+ years of relevant engineering, manufacturing, capital project, technical operations or regulated manufacturing experience.
  • Demonstrated technical capability in biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy process engineering strategy, process platform deployment, process package design, technical assurance, manufacturing technology interfaces and project delivery.
  • Experience supporting biologics drug substance, cell therapy, gene therapy, viral vector, mRNA, sterile biologics or similarly regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing environments preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across global functions, manufacturing sites, project teams, suppliers, vendors and external engineering partners.
  • Strong communication, risk management, technical judgment, stakeholder engagement and structured problem-solving skills.

Technical Competencies

  • Biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy process design and process package review
  • Front-end engineering and concept development
  • Biologics and CGT technology transfer, platform deployment and manufacturing scale-up
  • Process safety and CQV interfaces
  • Strategic Investment support
  • Strategic capital investment and new biologics / CGT technology deployment support
  • Engineering governance and standards
  • Development of engineering standards and deployment requirements for emerging biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing technologies
  • Technical understanding of bioreactor, harvest, purification, single-use, closed processing, aseptic processing, viral vector, cell processing and cryogenic / cold-chain interfaces as applicable to biologics and CGT platforms
  • Technical risk management
  • Project execution support
  • Stakeholder management
  • Vendor / partner technical coordination
  • GMP and regulated manufacturing awareness
  • Operational readiness and handover support

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and enterprise mindset
  • Matrix leadership and influence without direct authority
  • Clear technical communication and executive-ready recommendations
  • Risk-based decision making and issue escalation
  • Collaboration across functions, sites, regions and external partners
  • Capability building, mentoring and knowledge sharing
  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing technical engineering team with clear priorities, accountability, development plans and delivery expectations aligned to Strategic Investment objectives.
  • Set technical direction for the engineering team, ensuring work is prioritized against safety, quality, compliance, business value, capital delivery needs and long-range manufacturing strategy.
  • Build technical bench strength by identifying capability gaps, developing succession depth, mentoring senior engineers and enabling knowledge transfer across sites, projects and technology platforms.
  • Create an inclusive, disciplined technical decision-making environment where engineers challenge assumptions, manage risk transparently and escalate decisions with material safety, compliance, cost, schedule or operability impact.
  • Align team performance with enterprise standards by reinforcing consistent engineering practices, structured technical reviews, lessons learned adoption and measurable delivery outcomes.
  • Continuous improvement and commitment to safety, quality and compliance

Working Relationships

This role works globally with Strategic Investments, Strategic Investment disciplines, biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing sites, quality, validation / CQV, EHS, operations, MS&T, supply chain, finance, external engineering firms, technology vendors and equipment suppliers. The role is expected to operate across multiple projects, manufacturing sites and technology platforms, supporting new biologics and CGT manufacturing investments, new production capabilities and enterprise standards for emerging biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy technologies.

Vi söker dig som har flerårig erfarenhet av entreprenadverksamhet, har ett naturligt och tydligt ledarskap och är van att leda personal i daglig produktion. Du känner dig trygg i ditt ledarskap som du baserar på transparens och delaktighet.

Förändringar i produktionen och ett högt tempo är inget du räds, utan snarare något du hämtar energi ifrån. Du är driven, beslutsam och har god prioriteringsförmåga samt har ett genuint intresse för affären, kvalitet och säkerhet.

Du har:

title: Camera Power & Performance Engineer
description:
Apple’s Camera Performance team is looking for an engineer who combines a passion for power and performance optimization with a desire to deliver the best image quality alongside the most fluid user experience possible. In this role, you’ll be responsible for analyzing and optimizing camera Power and performance across Apple’s product range. Building on a strong foundation of computer architecture, electrical engineering and operating system fundamentals, you’ll work to setup experimental boards, measure power, profile performance and memory issues and identify solutions, working closely and collaboratively with partners across both software and hardware teams to fully realize the capabilities of Apple’s world-beating silicon.

The Camera performance team works cross-functionally across Apple to optimize and sustain the camera experience for both next-generation and existing products. You’ll use a range of profiling and analysis tools as well as experimental prototyping setups to triage problems and identify optimizations, whilst simultaneously working to assist partner teams in modeling the demands of upcoming features. At a high level, you’ll work to ensure that implementation of Apple’s image processing algorithms is aligned to silicon capabilities - gaining extensive exposure to GPU and Apple Neural Engine hardware in the process.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proficiency in C, C++, or Objective-C
  • A knowledge of OS, systems, computer architecture and electrical engineering.
  • Experience with virtual memory, scheduling, IPC / inter-process communication, and synchronization
  • Expertise in software profiling techniques and tools (such as Xcode, valgrind, vmmap, Instruments, VTune, or Perfetto)
  • An ability to quickly understand and debug unfamiliar codebases

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience of realtime audio/video processing pipeline development
  • A proven ability to debug performance issues and implement system-level memory and latency optimizations
  • Proficiency with the use of GPU & TPU hardware to accelerate image processing and AI/ML workloads
  • History of making data-driven decisions and recommendations to move projects forward
  • CS degree or equivalent experience

title: Teamleider Project Control
description:
Geef leiding aan 25 projectcontrollers en versterk de financiële voorspelbaarheid van ProRail-projecten.

Werk om trots op te zijn

Als teamleider project control geef je leiding aan 20 tot 25 projectcontrollers. Hierbij ben je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en inzet van jouw medewerkers. Daarnaast zorg je voor ontwikkeling, opleiding, bijscholing en coaching.

Andere werkzaamheden zijn:

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de vormgeving, ontwikkeling en implementatie van verbeterprocessen.
  • Je ziet toe op een eenduidige toepassing van control methodieken die zijn afgesproken binnen de financiële organisatie van ProRail.
  • Je stuurt dagelijks 20 tot 25 projectcontrollers aan.
  • Je rapporteert tijdig en volledig ontwikkelingen binnen jouw projecten.
  • Je signaleert kansen en risico’s richting financiers en directie.
  • Je zorgt voor tijdige escalatie van (financiële) issues (indien nodig).

In deze functie lever jij een bijdrage om de financiële voorspelbaarheid van onze programma’s en projecten te verbeteren in samenwerking met het hele projectteam.

Goed leiderschap

Als leidinggevende creëer je een omgeving waarin medewerkers zich verbonden voelen met het eindresultaat voor reiziger, verlader en omgeving. Je bouwt aan een bevlogen team dat samen resultaten behaalt in een omgeving die steeds verandert. Je geeft medewerkers de ruimte zichzelf te zijn en daagt hen uit het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Jouw leiderschapsstijl sluit je moeiteloos aan bij wat de situatie en medewerkers nodig hebben: zowel resultaatgericht als mensgericht. Het herkennen van talent en het ontwikkelen van potentie horen daar vanzelfsprekend bij. Daarbij leg je de nadruk op resultaat en eigenaarschap. Je kijkt verder dan je eigen domein, hebt oog voor het geheel en handelt steeds in het belang van de klant.

Jouw plek

We bieden graag ruimte aan iedereen. Daarbij zien we talent als basis en diversiteit als kracht om samen betere resultaten te behalen. Voor jou als teamleider project control is er plek op de afdeling Projectbeheersing en Control. Deze afdeling bestaat uit 100 medewerkers die zijn opgedeeld in 3 project control teams, een portfolio control team en een MPB team. Samen zorgen wij voor een beheerste uitvoering van programma’s en projecten voor ProRail waarbij wij een kritische business partner zijn. Zo adviseren en challengen wij op basis van dashboards en het uitvoeren van analyses. Als teamleider ben je onderdeel van een van deze teams, waar onderling veel afstemming en kennisuitwisseling plaatsvindt.

Binnen de afdeling is er de ambitie om de financiële voorspelbaarheid van onze programma’s en projecten te verbeteren in samenwerking met het gehele projectteam. Hierbij hoort ook het tijdig en volledig rapporteren van ontwikkelingen binnen je projecten en het aankaarten van kansen en risico’s richting financiers en directie. In deze functie zorg je indien nodig voor tijdige escalatie van (financiële) issues.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Direct een vast contract. Wij hebben vertrouwen in jou.
  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.860,- en € 8.972,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week, schaal 10.
  • Daarbovenop 13,61% van jouw bruto salaris in de vorm van een Individueel KeuzeBudget (IKB). Dit budget is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag en 3,25% decemberuitkering.
  • Een goed pensioen bij Rail & OV: een sterk fonds dat vooroploopt in duurzaam beleggen.
    Zit je nu in een ander fonds? Houd er rekening mee dat Rail & OV op 1 januari 2026 al overstapte op het nieuwe pensioenstelsel.
  • Jaarlijks een automatische loonsverhoging van 2,5% tot het maximum in de salarisschaal.
  • Een leasefietsvergoeding van € 25,- netto per maand.

Wij kozen voor een kleine selectie uit onze arbeidsvoorwaarden. Maar we bieden je meer. Voor alle arbeidsvoorwaarden en onze CAO klik op deze link.

Jouw inbreng

Bij ProRail vinden wij het belangrijk dat jij gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Daarom zijn wij benieuwd naar wie jij bent. Voor deze functie breng je sowieso mee:

  • Wo- werk- en denkniveau.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie en ervaring met leidinggeven aan professionals.
  • Mondelinge communicatie: Je spreekt duidelijk, kan je mening overbrengen en past je taal aan de luisteraar aan.
  • Oplossingsgerichtheid: Je herkent problemen en kansen en speelt hier goed op in.
  • Leiderschap: Je stuurt mensen aan en motiveert ze om samen doelen te behalen.

Jouw sollicitatie

Wil je als teamleider project control werken aan de toekomst van Nederland én aan die van jezelf? Solliciteer voor maandag 5 oktober. Toch eerst nog een vraag? Stel deze gerust aan Desirée ter Haar via desiree.terhaar@prorail.nl. Voor inhoudelijke vragen kun je contact opnemen met Stanny Schapendonk via stanny.schapendonk@prorail.nl.

Binnen 5 dagen na de sluitingsdatum krijg je onze reactie. De datum voor het gesprekscarrousel vindt plaats in overleg. Dan heb je twee sollicitatiegesprekken met een afvaardiging van de afdeling, management en recruitment. Voor het kennismakingsgesprek met de manager en recruiter vragen we je vooraf thuis een online assessment te maken als input voor het gesprek. Een IBB-gesprek (Inspraak bij Benoeming) en het opvragen van een referentie zijn een vast onderdeel van deze procedure.

Word jij onze nieuwe leidinggevende? Dan hoort het aanvragen van een VOG tot de indiensttredingsprocedure. De kosten voor de VOG krijg je terug nadat je bent gestart.

title: Production Utility Operator

Performs work as part of a team in an industrial laundry facility. Responsible for the safe, expeditious, and accurate handling of merchandise into and/or out of the laundry facility.

Cleans equipment, water and lint traps, performs blows down ironer, dryer, and tunnel.

Good verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to meet attendance schedule.

Education
High school degree or equivalent preferred.

title: Estates Specialist
description:
Why Meridian?

At Meridian our aspiration is to integrate our purpose into everything we do for people, the planet, and communities. We believe that our greatest opportunity is to create opportunity and meet people where they are.

Factor us into your next career opportunity. We want you to grow with us and have an experience that’s different. This is a place where you can expect the unexpected.

Find our story here: About Meridian

2 Vacancies - 1 Permanent & 1 Contract (14 Months)

The role: Operating within a centralized Estates support model, the Estate Specialist serves as a primary point of contact for Trustees throughout the estate administration process. The Specialist connects directly with Trustees to explain requirements, clarify next steps, provide practical guidance, and set clear and realistic expectations, while applying Meridian policies, procedures, privacy requirements, and risk controls consistently.

They are responsible for maintaining high standards of Member service, contributing to quality control and operational efficiency that contribute to a positive Member experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage all aspects of Meridian responsibilities relevant to estate management and tax reporting.
  • Respond to inquiries, both via email/fax and phone, from external agencies such as solicitors, trustee’s beneficiaries, mutual fund companies and Aviso.
  • Responsible for handling the estate phone line, determining the appropriate next steps for each case, provide guidance and advice to the branch staff, and assist them with setting realistic expectations with the trustees.
  • Support the delivery of Meridian’s centralized Estates model by acting as the dedicated Estates contact for assigned deceased member files and coordinating the file from intake through settlement.
  • Connect directly with Trustees through phone, email, and virtual channels to explain estate documentation requirements, outline available next steps, and provide timely, clear, and empathetic guidance throughout the process.
  • Assess the information and documentation provided by Trustees, identify outstanding requirements or potential risks, and provide advice within established policies, procedures, legal guidance, and delegated authority.
  • Set and manage realistic expectations regarding file requirements, review timelines, dependencies, and next steps, while maintaining consistent communication and documenting material interactions and decisions.
  • Partner with branch teams and internal stakeholders to resolve complex estate matters, clarify ownership, and ensure Trustees receive consistent information regardless of their point of contact.
  • Create a consistent and positive experience for our partners and our Members.
  • Build a culture that marries a focus on compliance, best practices, and risk mitigation with meeting member needs timely and accurately.
  • Take ownership of estate case and collaborate with other departments as needed.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in the financial services industry
  • Desire for continuous learning and growth: Availability to take external courses to enhance estate knowledge.
  • Knowledge of estate administration, relevant legal documents and / or processes relating to area of expertise.
  • Commitment to values and service excellence
  • Attention to detail and ability to exercise sound judgment mitigating risk to Meridian and Trustees
  • Communicate clearly and professionally, as well as demonstrate empathy
  • Exceptional relationship and communication skills – capable of using written, spoken and interpersonal skills to create clear understanding of expectations; address escalated challenges and issues in reporting areas; and to represent the functional area across the organization.
  • Demonstrate ability and creativity in developing and implementing process improvement initiatives
  • Confident in providing advice and direction including but not limited to deceased member processes, mutual fund transactions and compliance
  • Strong knowledge of computer systems, embracing virtual technology platforms for use with both Member and Meridian partners. Ovation/Encore and Microsoft Office products, and asset.
  • Member Focus - Personally demonstrating that our Members are our highest priority.
  • Proactive - Seize the initiative by anticipating needs and identifying opportunities to provide a higher level of service.
  • Open Communication - Engaging in honest and transparent dialogue to develop mutual understanding, trust and cultivate deeper relationships.
  • Business Savvy - Continuously acquiring the knowledge needed to do one’s job to the fullest, using internal or external resources and applying the knowledge productively.
  • Partner Orientation - Initiates opportunities for collaboration and maintains productive relationships to achieve shared goals.
  • Integrity - Doing the right thing by always acting with openness, honesty and respect.
  • Talent Developer: nurtures and supports direct reports, identifies strong team members, develops digital and analytical skills in direct reports
  • Creates a Supportive and Positive Team Environment: creates and contributes to a positive team environment which encourages innovation, risk taking, and learning; speeds up team learning through sharing best practices; leverages the strengths and opportunities of the broader marketing team.
  • Comfort learning and adopting new digital tools, with an openness to using AI‑enabled technology to enhance productivity, accuracy, and the Member experience

This role represents an existing vacancy. Internal candidates are being considered as part of our standard process.

Salary Range: $46,400.00 to $69,600.00 CAD

Compensation for this role is based on a combination of skills, experience, and internal equity. Candidates with stronger alignment to the role’s requirements may be placed higher within the range. Your recruiter will share more information about our total rewards package during the hiring process.

Office Location: Toronto Corporate Office with the ability to travel to our St. Catharines office as needed. This is a hybrid work opportunity.

Meridian has a remote work policy that allows flexibility for employees to work remotely but also requires a minimum of one day per week in the office for purposeful meetings to collaborate, innovate, and build effective relationships with your team, your colleagues, and your leader, which is important to us.

What’s in it for you?

  • We have an inclusive and collaborative working environment that encourages teamwork, creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success.
  • We provide you with the tools and technology needed to delight your candidates and clients.
  • You will get to work with and learn from diverse industry leaders and colleagues, who have hailed from top organizations.
  • Hybrid work arrangements with in-person office time to collaborate, innovate, and build relationships with your colleagues.
  • This is not your typical “corporate” job. We work hard and we have fun!

Build the Future of Banking with Us

At Meridian, we’re not just adapting to the future—we’re shaping it. We see talent as a catalyst for sustainable growth, community impact, and future-readiness. As the financial landscape evolves, we’re looking for team members who bring:

  • Embedding & leveraging technology – Confidence and willingness to learn and integrate AI and emerging technologies into new ways of working. Experience with low/no code tools like the Microsoft Power Platform and generative AI productivity tools like Microsoft Copilot is considered an asset
  • Critical Thinking – The ability to analyze, evaluate and interpret information from various sources and apply logic and problem solving to make decisions.
  • Data Driven– Leverage data and insights to identify, prioritize and improve member experience and business efficiency.
  • Curiosity & Flexibility – Comfortable navigating and embracing change and uncertainty, ask more questions, explore more options. Continuously learn and grow.

Experience the Difference!

Meridian committed to promoting an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to employing a workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities and Members in which we live and serve.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or disability.

Please note that due to the volume of applications, only those under consideration will be contacted for an interview.
