title: Skolerengøring/Rengøringsassistent Kalundborg Kommune
description:
Om jobbet

Rengøringsafdelingen i Kalundborg Kommune er en forholdsvis ny afdeling, der blev startet op 1. april 2024.

I Kalundborg Kommune arbejder vi med synlig Rengøring. Vi anvender helt nye ergonomisk korrekte maskiner og udstyr, microfiberklude og mopper og svanemærket kemi til daglig rengøring. I de fleste bygninger anvender vi gulvvaskemaskiner.

Kalundborg Kommune er en røgfri arbejdsplads – du må ikke ryge i hele din arbejdstid.

Hvis du er ansat mere end 6 timer, skal du afholde en ½ times selvbetalt pause, denne tillægges din arbejdstid. Du skal være på din arbejdsplads hele arbejdstiden.

Du får udleveret en fuld arbejdsbeklædning, som du skal bære, mens du er på arbejde. Du skal selv vaske din arbejdsbeklædning.

Det kræver ren børne- og straffeattest for at arbejde I Kalundborg Kommune - det vil være Kalundborg Kommune der anmoder om begge attester.

Det er obligatorisk at deltage i følgende kurser:

Modul 1: Kom godt i gang – Grundlæggende om Kemi og rekvisitter

Modul 2: Sanitet – Rengøring af baderum og toiletter

Modul 3: Overflader – hvordan vedligeholder og rengør du forskellige overflader

Vi har fokus på et gode arbejdsforhold, med sikkerhed, arbejdsglæde, respekt og samarbejde på tværs af Kommunen.

Din profil

  • Du er omstillingsparat, fleksibel, mødestabil og pligtopfyldende.
  • Du kan møde tidligt om morgenen
  • Du kan lide at arbejde, hvor der er børn
  • Det er en fordel hvis du kan tale og forstå dansk.
  • Du er god til at samarbejde, planlægge og strukturere din arbejdstid og opgaver.
  • Du er effektiv og servicemindet og har blik for renhold og rengøringskvalitet.
  • Du kan lide at arbejde og gøre rent selvom der er mennesker omkring dig.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Lønnen bliver sammensat med udgangspunkt i 3F's overenskomst 41.21 løntrin 14, samt eventuelle kvalifikationer og erfaring. Du får fuld arbejdsgiver betalt pension.

Skolerengøring:

Arbejdssted: Årby skole

Timetal: 34 timer ugentligt - Lønkvota 30,73 - skoleansat

Rengøringsassistent - barselsvikariat

Arbejdssted: Firhøjhallen, Føllenslev samt Akt.center Vesterlunden og legestue, Snertinge

Timetal: 37 timer ugentligt.

Hvis du vil vide mere

Kontakt Koordinator Lonni Larsen mobil: 30 66 23 92 træffes i tidsrummet 05.30 - 12.30

Ansøgning

Ansøgningen med relevante bilag sendes elektronisk via kommunens jobportal - hurtigst muligt, senest d. 1. oktober 2026 - Der afholdes samtaler løbende.

Om os

I Kalundborg Kommune er vi optaget af, at vores borgere, virksomheder, foreninger og institutioner får den bedst tænkelige service. Det kan vi kun levere hvis vi har dygtige og motiverede medarbejdere. Derfor er vi dedikeret til at støtte medarbejdernes personlige og faglige udvikling, og sikre en dynamisk og fleksibel arbejdsplads.

Hos os er medarbejderne med til at gøre en forskel hver dag, sammen med ca. 3500 kollegaer. Kalundborg Kommune er placeret i noget af Danmarks smukkeste natur – og er samtidig hjemsted for en række af de industrier der bidrager mest til den danske økonomi – med vægt på biotech- og energiproduktion.

Der bor cirka 48.000 mennesker i Kalundborg Kommune, som også er hjemsted for flere og flere uddannelser, der er med til at understøtte udviklingen i kommunen.

Du kan læse mere om Kalundborg Kommune som arbejdsplads Vores medarbejdere finde generelle oplysninger om Kalundborg Kommune Gotokalundborg lytte til vores podcast-serie Karriere på Kalundborgsk Podcast og vodcast

Vi opfordrer alle uanset baggrund, køn, religion mv. til at søge.

----------

I Kalundborg Kommune har vi en generel politik om indhentning af straffeattest.

Ansatte som i deres ansættelse har adgang til personfølsomme oplysninger, skal have privat MitID, fordi de skal identificere sig med deres private MitID Dette for at efterleve den skærpede lovgivning og derved sikre borgernes tillid til, at alle myndigheder, herunder Kalundborg kommune, behandler personfølsomme oplysninger sikkert.

title: Reception - Philadelphia
description:
Job Description

Job Title:

Reception

Location:

Philadelphia

Reporting to:

Reception Manager

Position Overview

Creating Outstanding First Impressions

As a member of the Reception team at F1 Arcade, you'll be the first friendly face our guests see, setting the tone for an unforgettable experience. Whether welcoming guests at the entrance, managing check-ins, or helping with reservations and walk-ins, you'll be at the heart of the action-making sure everyone feels valued from the moment they arrive

Bringing the Energy

Your warm welcome, engaging personality, and attention to detail will help create a buzz of excitement right from the start. You'll play a key role in keeping things running smoothly at the front desk while delivering exceptional service with a smile. Whether it's a special celebration or a casual visit, you'll help make every guest feel like a VIP.

At F1 Arcade, we aim to impress-and your energy and enthusiasm will help make every visit one to remember.

Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Welcome Guests with Warmth: Be the friendly face that greets every guest, creating a positive and exciting first impression.
  • Support Smooth Check-Ins and Walk-Ins: Help manage reservations and walk-ins efficiently to keep the guest flow running smoothly.
  • Deliver Exceptional Guest Service: Provide attentive, professional, and friendly service that reflects the F1 Arcade experience.
  • Work as One Team: Communicate and collaborate with other departments to ensure every guest has a seamless visit.
  • Handle Guest Questions with Care: Respond to inquiries with confidence, making sure guests feel listened to and well taken care of.
  • Keep the Front of House Looking Sharp: Maintain a tidy and organized reception area, helping to create a welcoming and energetic environment.

Skills Required

  • Guest-Focused Experience: Previous experience in hospitality, entertainment, or a fast-paced guest-facing role is a plus.
  • Great Communicator & Problem-Solver: Friendly, clear communicator who can think on their feet and handle guest questions with confidence.
  • Organised & Proactive: Reliable and detail-oriented, with a can-do attitude and a hands-on approach.
  • Team Player with Positive Energy: Enjoys working with others and brings enthusiasm and professionalism to every shift.

Pursuit of Excellence

Positive Energy

Integrity

Team Spirit

Basic Physical Requirements

When working at an F1 Arcade venue, Team Members must be able to perform the duties of that venue. The team member will frequently sit for short periods of time, talk via Cloud Based video conferencing and the phone often, and hear and manipulate objects constantly.

Additional requirements will include lifting up to 10 (ten) pounds constantly and up to 50 (fifty) pounds as required. Lifting from floor to shoulder constantly and overhead infrequently. Twisting and reaching frequently. Grasping objects to move or manipulate constantly. Working in hot then cold environments for extended periods of time. May inadvertently bump into team members in a relatively small work area. Will stand and walk for extended periods of time. FREQUENT hand washing and sanitation is required. Ability to use knives, slicing equipment, and other food preparation equipment. Team Member must be able to communicate with Guests and other Team Members and manipulate handheld and desktop devices.

F1 Arcade is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

This role is paid a base wage plus tips. Total hourly rate cannot be guaranteed. The advertised pay is an estimate and may vary based on schedule & availability.

description:

title: Software Engineer Manager: Agentic Evaluation Platform
description:
Join the team redefining what a deeply personal and integrated assistant can be and lead the platform that defines how we measure it.

As part of the Siri Agentic Evaluation Engineering organization, you will help shape one of the world's most widely used AI assistants, powered by our next generation of Apple Intelligence, with capabilities like personal context understanding and on-screen awareness, built with privacy from the ground up. Your work will have direct, meaningful impact for users across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS.

As the engineering leader of the evaluation platform and services, you'll own the systems that run and scales Siri’s evaluations, leveraging the best Apple platform capabilities and unlocking new ones to create novel evaluations. Your team applies large scale infrastructure, apple platforms and service, and AI agents to steer, validate, and judge evaluation scenarios at scale. These generate the signals that leadership relies on to make ship decisions. When we say a capability is ready, it's your platform that backs the claim.

This is a rare opportunity to build scalable software and services for real world products at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and human-centered design, shipping technology that is centered around users and their needs.

In this role you'll lead and grow a team of engineers building the backend services, compute orchestration, and evaluation harnesses that let us evaluate Siri reliably and at scale. You'll own the technical direction and the roadmap, and you'll be accountable for delivery.

The through-line of the work is interfaces. Your team owns the APIs that expose evaluation as a platform capability, the harness contracts that determine how devices and models are driven through a run, and the data workflows that carry results from execution through scoring to reporting. Those boundaries are the product: they decide how much compute the organization can actually use, how quickly a failure can be traced to its cause, and how many teams can build on evaluation without coming to you first. Get them right and the platform scales past your team; get them wrong and everything routes through you.

You'll also have meaningful autonomy in how you get there. Both the evaluation platform and the underlying Siri architecture are evolving, so the specific frameworks, runtimes, and components will change over time. We're looking for a leader who operates well in that ambiguity, someone who can reshape team scope deliberately as the domain matures, decide what to invest in versus retire, and keep the team's momentum through the change.

Just as importantly, you'll build the team itself: recruiting, mentoring, and developing engineers including senior ICs, with a focus on engineering rigor, technical depth, and clear ownership.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience developing production software (e.g., Python, Java, Go, or Swift)
  • 3+ years of engineering management experience, including owning roadmap and delivery, mentoring, setting clear expectations, and providing consistent, honest feedback
  • Strong technical leadership and the ability to set architectural direction and inspire a team
  • Experience with test infrastructure, CI/CD, or evaluation/ML platforms
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with demonstrated creative and critical-thinking abilities
  • Excellent spoken and written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate across teams
  • M.S. or B.S. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or leading teams that apply LLMs / AI agents to real engineering workflows (e.g., data generation, code generation, or agentic pipelines with human-in-the-loop review)
  • Depth in one or more of: distributed systems and backend services (REST/gRPC), cloud infrastructure (Docker/Kubernetes), data platforms, or large-scale test and release infrastructure
  • Familiarity with LLM and Agentic evaluation concepts
  • Experience implementing model evaluation frameworks and experiment workflows, including offline and online experiments, to measure how model or platform changes affect key metrics such as accuracy, latency, and engagement
  • Experience building machine learning platforms and infrastructure used by multiple teams for experimentation and deployment
  • Experience designing and integrating monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions — dashboards, anomaly detection, and real-time alerts — to track reliability and performance in production systems
  • Experience developing data processing pipelines with big data frameworks (such as Apache Spark, Kafka, or Flink) to ingest, transform, and analyze large-scale log or event data
  • Demonstrated cross-functional leadership and the ability to drive coverage and quality decisions with senior stakeholders
  • Experience hiring and growing a team, including senior engineers
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and reshaping team scope as the domain matures

title: Shipping & Receiving Specialist
description:
Shipping & Receiving Specialist

Position Summary

The Shipping & Receiving Specialist is responsible for coordinating inventory replenishment, processing customer orders, receiving and checking in pumps for the Service Department, auditing service order bins, and supporting the overall day-to-day operations of the warehouse. This position requires strong attention to detail, organization, accuracy, and the ability to work effectively with the Service, Warehouse, and other internal departments.

Key Responsibilities

    • Issue purchase orders to replenish inventory based on stock levels, customer orders, and business needs.

title: Reporter
description:
Position: Reporter

Position Type: Full-time, Permanent (Existing Vacancy)

Location: Ottawa, ON

Division: Postmedia Editorial Department

The Company:

Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across print, digital and mobile platforms. Our award‑winning journalists and innovative product teams deliver engaging content to millions of people each week.

The Ottawa Citizen/Sun newsroom is the largest in the city, where your colleagues are offering committed, supportive and professional, and you have opportunities for mentorship and career development.

The Opportunity:

The Ottawa Citizen/Sun is seeking a driven, experienced reporter to cover public safety in Canada’s capital city. They will tackle systemic issues that are impacting daily life in Ottawa, including major crime, homicides, violence, opioid use, homelessness, issues affecting vulnerable populations, unsafe roads for pedestrians and drivers, environmental emergencies and more.

Their beat will also include watchdog coverage of Ottawa’s four intersecting police forces: the Ottawa Police, the Ontario Provincial Police, the Parliamentary Protective Service, and the RCMP.

Their reporting mission is to hold power to account by uncovering systemic issues, investigating operations and decisions that affect the region and scrutinizing how public tax dollars are being spent to improve public safety.
They will develop a solutions journalism method when telling stories about complex social issues, to not just shine a light on problems, but illuminate ways forward.

The successful candidate is a tenacious journalist with keen investigative instincts and the ability to find stories others miss. They will be the eyes and ears of the public, trawling public data, developing deep sources, and fact-checking information the public is being provided.

They will work collaboratively alongside the Citizen team of reporters, digital editors, photographers and editors to produce impactful accountability journalism that builds public trust, strengthens transparency and meaningfully contributes to the Ottawa Citizen’s mission.

What You’ll Do:

Produce a mix of enterprise stories, long‑form investigations, and quick‐turn pieces that hold decision-makers to account in all areas that impact the public safety of the citizens of Ottawa
Bolster breaking news coverage of serious crime and emergencies by investigating those involved and finding new angles;
Analyse and decipher publicly available documents and data;
Build and maintain sources within police services, government institutions and the local community;
Fact-check statements and claims made by key decision makers; and
Work collaboratively on ambitious and innovative team projects.

Who You Are:

A degree in journalism or equivalent professional reporting experience;
More than five years of experience in a major newsroom with exposure to crime; justice, data, and investigative reporting;
Experience researching and collecting information from both traditional and non-traditional sources;
A strong understanding of police systems, government structures, public records databases and FOI/ATI requests;
A clear understanding of legal and ethical issues involved in watchdog reporting; and
Enthusiasm for experimenting with emerging digital storytelling tools and platforms

Please submit your resume along with a cover letter detailing your accountability reporting experience and the perspectives you would bring to the role.

Compensation:
Employment offers presented to the selected candidate are based on a combination of qualifications, experience, responsibilities of the role and the candidate's location.
Base Salary: $66,682.2—$73,928.92
This is a unionized position subject to the terms and conditions of the collective agreement. The starting salary listed in this job posting is based on the Year 2 to Year 4 rate outlined in the collective agreement. Offers will be made based on the candidate's qualifications and experience.

title: Engineer, Process
description:
Process Engineer

The Process Engineer operate as a key resource to Company Manufacturing with metallurgical expertise directed to process improvement and new product development. Conducts and documents applied research and development projects for product and process improvement and new product development. Leads the transfer of technology to Manufacturing. Accountable for process improvement and product development activities which ensure worker safety and integrate with the Company quality systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Provides metallurgical, technical and scientific expertise to Company Manufacturing focused on product and process improvements. Develops and maintains a strong technical competency in the core company thermite, powder products and manufacturing processes.

Identifies and implements project work to improve the plant products and manufacturing processes. Conducts applied research to improve existing and develop new Company products and manufacturing processes.

Leads the transfer of all process improvements and new products to Company Manufacturing. Works with Manufacturing Management and others to originate Capital Appropriation Requests and similar documents to support new or changed equipment, systems and resources.

Generates new/updated Standard Operating Procedures, Workstation Procedures and similar documents. Accountable for process improvement and new product activities which ensure worker safety, and integrate with the Company quality systems.

Remains current on new technology options for Plant products and manufacturing improvements and regularly shares information with the Director of Operations and others. Generates weekly, monthly and other reports to document and communicate all Process Engineering activities.

Provides technical and scientific expertise, along with exceptional customer service, to Company clients, vendors, and related stakeholders. Offers technical support to Production, Sales, and Quality teams as needed, including reviewing customer specifications, generating process capability reports, and addressing customer corrective actions.

Maintains a self-improvement program through participation in professional associations, attendance at conferences and seminars, completion of course work and readings to continuously develop expertise in the master alloys industry and markets, process improvements, metallurgical engineering, materials science and to continue to develop leadership and coaching skills.

Job Requirements

BS in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science, Engineering or a similar science major.

3 - 7 years of experience in an industrial manufacturing environment, with emphasis on process improvement and new product development. Experience in molten/hot metals or powders preferred.

General metallurgical laboratory skills.

The proven ability to bring focus, clarity and results to process improvement and new product development.

Solid skills as a leader and the proven ability to manage multiple priorities with timely results.

A career with a succession of increased responsibility based on the achievement of defined results.

The proven ability to work productively with individuals at all levels inside and outside the organization.

Skills and Competencies

  • General SPC knowledge (experience using a statistical analysis program such as JMP/MiniTab is a plus).

Lean Six Sigma awareness (certifications are a plus).

The HRIS Data Validation Analyst is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of employee data across multiple systems. Experience with Dayforce, Spectrum, or Sage is a plus

Summary:

The Operations Control Center (OCC) Supervisor is responsible for supervising 24/7 control-room operations, ensuring renewable energy assets operate safely, reliably, and efficiently while meeting grid, market, and regulatory requirements.   • Ensures procedures comply with company policies and applicable regulatory/grid requirements.
  • Participates in audits, procedure development, and operational readiness exercises.
  • Complies with Employee Handbook, Code of Conduct and Company Policies & Procedures.
  • Attends work regularly and punctually, as scheduled or expected.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Renewable Energy, Engineering Technology, or a related field, or equivalent operational experience preferred.

  • 5+ years with NERC Reliability Standards experience required.
  • Technical Knowledge: SCADA/EMS, electrical systems, renewable generation, BESS, grid operations, alarms/events, switching procedures.

  • Operational: outage management, emergency response, dispatch coordination, root-cause analysis, operational reporting.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de begeleiding van een aantal cliënten. Jouw begeleiding is gericht op stabiel en prettig wonen. Het echte thuisgevoel waar wij met elkaar dagelijks aan bijdragen, helpt hier enorm bij! Je stelt een begeleidingsplan op waarbij je je richt op het ondersteunen van de cliënt bij de persoonlijke verzorging en je motiveert cliënten om naar de dagbesteding te gaan. Het begeleiden bij ADL taken hoort hierbij. Wij focussen op de individuele krachten van onze cliënten binnen de veilige omgeving van de groep waar men woont.

Als persoonlijk begeleider monitor, evalueer en rapporteer je de ontwikkeling van de cliënt op alle leefgebieden. Je deelt je caseload met een ondersteunend begeleider met wie je regelmatig overleg hebt over de voortgang. Bij cliënten die langdurige zorg nodig hebben, is het mogelijk dat je meerdere keren per week bij de cliënt aanwezig bent.

Locatie
Het Judith van Swethuis is een woonvoorziening voor 66 bewoners in zowel groepswoningen als eigen studio’s. Hier wonen zij onder een dak van beschermd wonen met dagelijks groepsmomenten. Er zijn gezamenlijke huiskamers, een grote gezamenlijke dagbestedingsruimte en een keuken waar dagelijks door een professionele kok warme gezonde maaltijden worden bereid.

Ons team bestaat uit een teammanager, zorgcoördinatoren, verpleegkundigen, persoonlijk begeleiders en ondersteunend begeleiders. We worden regelmatig ondersteund door enthousiaste vrijwilligers. Wil je meer weten over de locatie Judith van Swethuis? Neem dan een kijkje op

Jouw profiel
Zelfstandig werken, samenwerken en zelfreflectie zitten in je DNA. Je bent van nature flexibel en op je best als geen dag hetzelfde is. Je bent stressbestendig en hebt een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen, ook in geval van acute crisissituaties. Je kunt enthousiasme en humor combineren in het contact met cliënten en je houdt van aanpakken. Herken jij jezelf ook in onderstaande wensen, dan maken we graag kennis met jou!

  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde (bij voorkeur agogische) hbo-opleiding;
  • Je hebt kennis van methoden en technieken;
  • Je hebt ervaring met werken in de psychiatrie;
  • Je hebt affiniteit met de doelgroep of ervaringskennis die aansluit bij de doelgroep;
  • Je bent positief, flexibel en opbouwend in je manier van communiceren;
  • Je hebt een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden en bijzonderheden

  • Een baan met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief;
  • Het betreft in eerste instantie een contract voor de duur van een jaar met uitzicht op verlenging;
  • Jouw salaris bedraagt minimaal € 3.560,- en maximaal € 4.716- bruto per maand (schaal 50, CAO GGZ) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek;
  • Een 2e klas mobiliteitskaart voor woon-werkverkeer en dienstreizen met OV of gebruik van OV-fiets;
  • Je ontvangt bij een 36-urige werkweek minimaal 23 verlofdagen per jaar. Door feestdagencompensatie en LFB-uren (levensfasebudget) kan dit oplopen tot ongeveer 34 verlofdagen. Daarnaast kun je extra verlofuren kopen vanuit je vakantiegeld, balansbudget en/of 13e maand.
  • Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform CAO GGZ. Denk hierbij aan vakantiegeld, pensioen, fietsplan en een eindejaarsuitkering. We vinden vitaliteit belangrijk en bieden jou daarom jaarlijks een sportvergoeding van €100,-;
  • Een jaarlijks balansbudget van € 500 (op basis van een fulltime dienstverband). Voor de besteding hiervan kun je kiezen uit de drie opties zoals beschreven in de CAO GGZ;
  • Je hebt ruime keuze uit opleidingen en cursussen;
  • Een referentiecheck en verklaring omtrent gedrag maken onderdeel uit van deze procedure. Tijdens de onboarding vragen we je om een online competentievragenlijst in te vullen;
  • Met een interactief onboardingsprogramma bieden we jou een warm welkom en een goede start.

HVO-Querido heeft de ambitie om een inclusieve en gelijkwaardige organisatie te zijn waar alle cliënten en medewerkers zichzelf kunnen zijn en zich thuis voelen, met als doel om betere kwaliteit van zorg te leveren aan onze cliënten en een veilige en inspirerende werkplek te bieden voor onze medewerkers. Bij HVO-Querido werken we vanuit drie kennisbronnen: ervaringskennis, praktijkkennis en wetenschappelijke inzichten.

Meer informatie?
Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Niels Zwaan, zorgcoördinator via 06-15617425. Als je vragen hebt over de procedure, kun je bellen met junior recruiter Sana Pinto Silva via 06-15365021.

Direct solliciteren?
Graag ontvangen we je digitale reactie vóór 6 oktober a.s.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Administratör till Mäklardisken
description:
Vill du arbeta i en bred administrativ roll med många kontaktytor och vara en viktig del av ett engagerat team? Vi söker nu en driven och serviceinriktad administratör till vår Mäklardisk i Örnsköldsvik.

Hos oss får du en central roll där du stöttar Söderberg & Partners förmedlare i hela Skandinavien. Tillsammans ansvarar teamet för att ge service och support via telefon och mejl samt säkerställa hög kvalitet i hanteringen av försäkringsärenden och administrativa processer.

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats med korta beslutsvägar, stort eget ansvar och goda möjligheter att bidra med nya idéer och förbättringsförslag. Vår verksamhet växer kontinuerligt och vi arbetar i ett högt tempo där samarbete, engagemang och trivsel står i fokus.

  • Bemanna vår Mäklardisk via inkommande telefonsamtal och mejl.
  • Hantera och följa upp försäkringsärenden.
  • Ansvara för fakturering samt hantering och uppföljning av fakturarelaterade frågor.
  • Ge support och vägledning till Söderberg & Partners förmedlare i Skandinavien.
  • Säkerställa att administrativa processer genomförs med hög kvalitet och noggrannhet.

Vi söker dig som

  • Trivs i en administrativ roll med varierande arbetsuppgifter.
  • Är strukturerad, noggrann och ansvarstagande.
  • Har god förmåga att prioritera och hantera flera uppgifter parallellt.
  • Är serviceinriktad och tycker om att hjälpa andra.
  • Har lätt för att samarbeta samtidigt som du arbetar självständigt.
  • Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.

Meriterande

  • Erfarenhet av sakförsäkring.

Vad vi erbjuder

Du blir en del av ett team med hög kompetens, stark sammanhållning och stort engagemang. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas i en spännande verksamhet där du arbetar nära både förmedlare och försäkringsbolag och bidrar till att skapa bästa möjliga service och kvalitet.

Välkommen med din ansökan. Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

title: Myyjä visualistin vastuulla - Stadium Ideapark Lempäälä
description:
JOS SINULTA LÖYTYY TAHTOA, MEILTÄ LÖYTYY LOPUT!

Oletko sinä seuraava tähtipelaajamme?
Ovatko visuaalinen myynti, asiakaspalvelu ja aktiivinen elämäntapa intohimosi? Oletko aikaansaava, palveluhenkinen ja vuorovaikutustaitoinen joukkuepelaaja, joka ottaa mielellään vastuuta? Mahtavaa, saatat olla seuraava tähtipelaajamme!

Sitoutuminen ja vastuullisuus luovat perustan Stadiumin toiminnalle. Päivittäinen työmme pohjautuu näihin arvoihin sekä energiseen asiakaspalveluun ja tiimityöhön. Nämä ovat meidän intohimojamme – mikä sinua inspiroi?

Mitä joukkueemme tarjoaa sinulle?

  • Merkityksellinen työ - Olemme alkujaan pieni perheyritys, joka on kasvanut yhdeksi Pohjoismaiden suurimmista urheilukaupan ketjuista – alkuperäämme unohtamatta. Olemmekin edelleen yhtä suurta perhettä, ja teemme tuloksia tiiminä intohimo, energia, kehittyminen ja yksinkertaisuus ohjenuoranamme. Tarjoamme paikkaa tiimissä, jossa sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvaa ja olla osa missiotamme: aktivoida maailmaa!
  • Voittavan joukkueen yhteisöllisyys ja ilo – Me uskomme työympäristöön, jossa tunnet olosi kotoisaksi ja arvostetuksi. Olemme tiivis tiimi, joka tekee töitä yhdessä ja pitää hauskaa matkan varrella! Järjestämme aktiviteetteja ja tapahtumia, jotka vahvistavat yhteisöllisyyttä, niin kentällä kuin sen ulkopuolella.
  • Kehittymisen mahdollisuuksia - Meillä kehittyminen tapahtuu arjessa, saat tukea ja koulutusta omaan kehittymiseen. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia vahvistaa osaamistasi myynnin parissa, ottaa lisää vastuuta ja edetä uusiin tehtäviin Stadiumin sisällä. Saat työkalut, sparrauksen ja joukkueen tuen, jotta onnistut ja löydät oman seuraavan pelipaikkasi.

Katso lisää työstä Stadiumilla urasivuiltamme, Instagramista @workatstadiumfinland tai LinkedInistä Stadium Finland.

Mitä tarkoittaa olla tähtipelaaja Stadiumilla?
Visualistina edustat Stadiumia ja meille on ensiarvoisen tärkeää, että työntekijämme nauttivat työstään ja haluavat aktivoida maailmaa kanssamme. Haluamme, että asiakkaamme tuntevat olonsa tervetulleiksi Stadiumille, ja että asiakaskokemus on yhtenäinen läpi koko myymälän juoksuradan.

Visualistina Stadiumin joukkueessa:

  • Varmistat onnistuneen asiakaskokemuksen ensiluokkaisella palvelulla.
  • Autat aktiivisella myynnillä asiakkaita löytämään oikeat tuotteet ja ratkaisut heidän tarpeisiinsa.
  • Organisoit ja kehität visuaalista myyntiä myymälässä siten, että asiakkaiden on helppo löytää ja valita oikeat tuotteet.
  • Vastaat myymälän ulkoasusta esillepanoilla sekä varmistat myymälän ajankohtaisuuden.
  • Valmennat ja koulutat tiimiä visuaalisessa myynnissä.
  • Visuaalisen työn lisäksi päiväsi sisältävät päivittäistä kassatyöskentelyä ja henkilökohtaista myyntityötä.
  • Osallistut aktiivisesti myymälän johtoryhmän työskentelyyn. Toimit esimerkkinä ja luot hyvän ilmapiirin yhdessä johtoryhmän kanssa. Vastaat tarvittaessa myymälästä silloin, kun myymäläpäällikkö ei ole paikalla.
  • Pääset hyödyntämään kiinnostustasi ja osaamistasi urheilumuodista ja -varusteista. Katsomme eduksi aiemman kokemuksen vähittäiskaupan visualistin työtehtävistä sekä tottumuksen työskennellä määräaikojen puitteissa.
  • Tarvitset järjestelmällisyyttä, värien ja muotojen esteettistä ymmärtämistä ja kykyä luoda inspiroivan myymäläkokemuksen.

Toivomme, että jaat ajattelutapamme ja näkemyksemme mahdollisuuksien löytämiseen haastavissakin tilanteissa. Hallitset myymäläkokonaisuuden, työn suunnittelun, priorisoinnin sekä tehtävien jakamisen. Nautit vastuusta ja mahdollisuudesta kasvaa roolissasi sekä muiden työntekijöiden kehittämisestä. Edellytämme, että pystyt työskentelemään sujuvasti suomen kielellä, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

Työsuhteen kesto ja työaika
37,5 h/vko
Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.

Palkkaus Stadiumilla on Kaupan TES:in mukainen. Visualisteille maksetaan B taulukkopalkkaa, minkä lisäksi tehtäväkohtaista lisää.

Hakeminen Osana rekrytointiprosessia saat kutsun persoonallisuus- ja soveltuvuustestiin. Näihin vastaaminen vie noin 20 minuuttia.

Hakijoiden yhdenvertaisuuden varmistamiseksi huomioimme ensisijaisesti rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta saapuneet hakemukset.

Viestimme enimmäkseen sähköpostitse, joten tarkkaile sähköpostiasi. Pidäthän varmuuden vuoksi silmällä myös roskapostikansiotasi.

Ilmoitamme kaikille hakijoille rekrytoinnin etenemisestä mahdollisimman pian hakuajan päätyttyä.

Toimi nopeasti, sillä saatamme edetä rekrytoinnissa jo ennen hakuajan päättymistä.

Odotamme hakemustasi!

Tavoitteenamme on edistää monimuotoisuutta ja varmistaa yhdenvertainen ja arvostava työympäristö kaikille. Haluamme luoda työpaikan, jossa jokainen kokee olevansa arvostettu, osallinen ja yhdenvertaisesti kohdeltu. Meille on tärkeää, että kaikilla on yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet kehittyä ja menestyä työssään.

title: Revenue & Analytics - Freight Auditor
description:
SUMMARY
The Freight Auditor is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely rating, billing and collection of freight charges in alignment with customer contracts and internal pricing strategies. This role plays a key part in maintaining revenue integrity by auditing freight bills, applying appropriate charges, working closely with internal and external stakeholders, and supporting the implementation of customer rates. The Freight Auditor works closely with the Revenue, Operations, and Pricing teams to ensure coverage, consistency and compliance.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Audit freight bills to verify accuracy of charges and ensure proper application of customer pricing and fuel programs.
Assign charges to new accounts and update systems as required.
Monitor and maintain unrated and probill count records for historical reporting.
Review successful quotes and ensure correct application to corresponding shipments.
Apply secondary charges (e.g., reships, shunting, trailer detention) based on supporting documentation or reports.
Review delivery manifests to identify and correct any missed account updates or rating discrepancies.
Maintain current customer rates and fuel surcharge programs.
Ensure accurate implementation and upkeep of rating templates and pricing rules as per customer agreements.
Assist in building and maintaining cost models to support rate setting and profitability analysis.
Conduct weekly and periodic audits of billing data to verify accuracy and contract compliance.
Maintain records of interline partner rates and support invoice validation based on cost and service performance.
Support ad hoc rate reviews, quoting, cost validations, and pricing updates as required.
Assist with investigation and negotiations of Aging reports.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS

Post-secondary education in Finance, Accounting, or a related field preferred.
Experience in LTL pricing, transportation auditing, or a similar role preferred.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Proficient in Microsoft Office with advanced Excel skills.
Familiarity with Solomon (AS400) systems is an asset.
Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with both internal and external stakeholders.

WORKING CONDITIONS

In office Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 4:30pm

title: Oracle Fusion Techno-Functional Lead
description:

Oracle Fusion Techno-Functional Lead

Oracle Fusion Techno-Functional Lead possess a strong blend of technical and functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications, particularly in the Financial and Supply Chain domains. This role is critical in leading and supporting Oracle Fusion implementation, enhancement, and maintenance projects.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Lead and participate in the full lifecycle of Oracle Fusion projects, from requirements gathering and design to configuration, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support.

  • Serve as the primary liaison between technical teams and finance users, ensuring clear communication and understanding of requirements.

  • Provide functional and technical expertise in various Oracle Fusion modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payables, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, Procurement, Inventory, and Manufacturing.

  • Assist finance teams with month-end close processes and provide ongoing support.

title: Work, Health Safety Coordinator
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
St Agnes’ Catholic Parish is seeking an experienced Work Health and Safety (WHS) Coordinator to join our Work Health and Safety team in Port Macquarie.
Reporting to the WHS Manager, this role will work across our diverse service areas to coordinate and deliver practical WHS initiatives, participate in the scheduled review of our WHSMS to and support leaders and employees in maintaining safe and compliant workplaces.
A key focus of the position will be coordinating specific WHS projects and embedding initiatives into day-to-day operations, including services delivered by third-party contractors. You may also contribute to broader operational WHS and injury management activities as priorities require.
This is a varied role suited to someone who enjoys working collaboratively across an organisation, can balance competing priorities and takes a practical, solutions-focused approach to workplace safety.
The position can be offered to the successful applicant on a Max Term Contract till October 2027, In a Part - Time or Full-Time Capacity.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Coordinate and implement WHS projects and initiatives across Parish operations, ensuring alignment with relevant legislation, Standards and Codes.

Work collaboratively with leaders and employees to develop practical WHS solutions and support their documentation for subsequent implementation.

Review, develop and implement WHS policies, procedures and management systems.

Support site leaders and employees with the consistent application of WHS systems and processes.

Digitise WHS checks and processes using our existing WHS software, Mitti.

Participate in annual site safety inspections, reporting and follow-up of corrective actions.

Coordinate WHS training requirements and maintain relevant compliance and renewal records.

Support incident and hazard reporting, investigations and corrective actions.

Assist with workers compensation and injury management activities as required.

WHAT WE OFFER OUR EMPLOYEES

**Competitive remuneration package of up to $90,000 per year . Plus Salary packaging & Super

Working for a reputable, longstanding, values-based organisation

A commitment to providing a responsive and supportive work environment

Salary Packaging options of up to $15,900 Tax Free, plus $2,650 Meals & Entertainment Card

17.5 % annual leave loading

An Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your immediate family.

As a corporate partner of Westpac, employees will have access to special offers, discounts and financial information.

You will have access to great employee perks including BENY, Fitness Passport & discounted Allied Health Services, i.e., remedial massage, physiotherapy, exercise physiology etc.

Paid professional learning and development

Career advancement opportunities and study assistance for approved courses

Generous employee referral program

A focus on work/life balance and on your wellbeing

WHO YOU ARE

Minimum of five years’ experience in Work Health and Safety, along with demonstrated experience contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

A Certificate IV or Diploma in WHS, relevant Human Resources qualification or equivalent is desirable.

SIRA-approved Return to Work Coordinator certification is desirable.

Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to consult, negotiate and influence across different levels of an organisation.

A practical, resourceful and solutions-focused approach.

The ability to work independently, prioritise competing demands and apply sound judgement across varied situations.

Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to establish credibility and rapport with internal stakeholders.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Strong computer literacy and the ability to produce high-quality professional documentation and see it through to completion.

Commitment to work in harmony with Catholic Values and Principles

HOW TO APPLY
If you are interested in this role and would like more information, please contact Jodi McAlary, WHS Manager on 04•• ••• 067.

title: Quality Services Intern
description:

Location: Appleton, WI

Working alongside project teams and quality professionals, you'll assist with inspections, documentation reviews, and verification activities to help ensure work is completed in accordance with project specifications, contract requirements, and industry standards. You’ll be paired with experienced mentors who are invested in your growth, while also collaborating with fellow interns across the country—building connections that extend beyond your project. From day one, you’ll contribute to real work and gain experience you’ll be proud to showcase on your resume. At Boldt, high performance starts with strong relationships. Our culture blends accountability with support; where learning, mentorship, and collaboration, power results. You won’t just contribute to projects that matter; you’ll grow alongside people who are investing in your success.


What You Bring

  • Passion and desire to work in the construction industry
  • Strong communication skills, including a willingness and comfortability to create and maintain relationships by means of cold and warm phone calls.

title: Receiver

title: Kiinteistönhoitaja, Vaasa
description:
Coor on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista kiinteistöpalvelualan yrityksistä. Coor Suomen kiinteistöhuoltoliiketoiminnan palveluksessa työskentelee yhteensä yli 150 ammattilaista erilaisissa kiinteistöjen yllä- ja kunnossapidon tehtävissä sekä ulkoalueiden hoidossa useilla eri paikkakunnilla Hangosta Rovaniemelle. Tutustu kiinteistönhoitajan työhön Coorissa tarkemmin täällä. Liity sinäkin mukaan kasvavaan porukkaamme rakentamaan entistä parempia kiinteistöpalveluita!

Etsimme nyt kiinteistönhoitajaa Vaasaan!

Työsuhde: vakituinen ja kokoaikainen (37,5 h/viikko)

Aloitus: mahdollisimman pian

Työvuorot: arkisin klo 7–15 välillä

Kiinteistönhoitajana työnkuvaasi kuuluu alueesi kiinteistöjen ylläpito- ja huoltotehtäviä. Teet päivittäisiä tarkastuskierroksia, raportoit mahdollisista vioista tai puutteista sekä teet pieniä korjaustehtäviä. Työnkuvaasi kuuluu myös ulkoalueiden vuodenajan mukaista hoitoa. Toivomme, että sinulla on päivystysvalmiutta, kun olet perehtynyt asiakaskohteisiin.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Coorin tiimien lisäksi asiakaskohteiden henkilökunnan kanssa ja huolehdit sujuvasta yhteydenpidosta kiinteistöjen käyttäjiin.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Monipuoliset työsuhde-edut, kuten lounas- ja virike-edun, mahdollisuuden liittyä vapaaehtoiseen sairauskassaan sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon
  • Kattavan perehdytyksen kohteisiin, työturvallisuuteen ja Coorin toimintatapoihin
  • Työn luotettavassa ja vakaassa yrityksessä
  • Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja edetä urallasi
  • Kannustavan työyhteisön, jossa ajatuksiasi ja ideoitasi arvostetaan

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme tiiviiseen tiimiimme sinua, jolle kiinteistöhuollon arki on jo tuttua. Sinulla on silmää hyvälle asiakaspalvelulle, olet ylpeä osaamisestasi ja osaat jakaa sitä myös muille.

Lisäksi tarvitset:

  • Kiinteistönhoitajan tai muun soveltuvan alan tutkinnon tai aikaisempaa työkokemusta kiinteistönhoidon tehtävistä. Eduksi katsomme, jos sinulta löytyy molemmat.
  • Sujuvan suomen kielen taidon
  • B-ajokortin

Tehtävään valitulle henkilölle tehdään perusmuotoinen turvaselvitys, huumausainetestaus sekä henkilöluottotietojen tarkastus. Tarvitset tehtävässä työturvallisuuskorttia, mutta koulutus voidaan myös järjestää työsuhteen alettua.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Hienoa! Lähetä meille hakemus täyttämällä hakulomake nettisivuillamme. Luemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, ja tehtävä täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Tutustu tarkemmin rekrytointiprosessiimme nettisivuillamme.

title: Handyperson - Rydges Hobart
description:
About EVT: Rydges Hobart is part of EVT, one of Australasia's market-leading experience creators offering careers that can take you wherever you want to go across entertainment, ventures, and travel. In a world of cookie cutter experiences, here at EVT we believe in changing the game. About the Role
This role is predominantly gardening-focused, with around 75% of your time spent on gardening duties from September to May (9 months). During winter (June – August), gardening demands ease and you'll shift into general Handy Person duties to support the wider maintenance team.
Key Responsibilities

Maintain hotel gardens and outdoor grounds to a high standard, including planting, pruning, mowing, watering and general landscaping upkeep (predominant focus, Sept – May).
During winter months (June – Aug), pivot to Handy Person duties - executing timely, quality repairs across hotel facilities and responding rapidly to work requests and service calls.
Show initiative - you don't wait to be told. Spot defects, log work, and proactively maintain our grounds, equipment and public areas.
Provide warm, friendly service to guests, quickly addressing their needs, and providing assistance to other departments.
Ensure a clean and safe working environment and operate with a full knowledge of all WH&S guidelines.
Report urgent or dangerous facility matters directly to management and expertly coordinate with outside trades for complex issues.

What You'll Bring

Proven experience in gardening and grounds maintenance (planting, lawn care, pruning, general landscaping).
Proven ability in routine maintenance and minor repairs (e.g., plumbing, electrical, basic carpentry, general facility upkeep) to support winter Handy Person duties.
An enthusiastic, service-oriented approach that aligns with our goal to make the connection.
The ability to work independently, manage your tasks, and log your work accurately.
Unwavering commitment to maintaining a safe work environment for yourself, your team, and our guests.

How You Work

Daymaker ethos — no one's too big for the small things.
Inclusive leader — values diverse perspectives; builds belonging.

Perks from Day One
As part of EVT, you unlock Elevate Perks from your first day. Parity for all levels - no ivory towers.

50% off dining and stays across EVT hotels – QT, Rydges, Atura, LyLo and more.
$2 movie tickets + discounts on Gold Class, Moonlight Cinema and Candy Bar.
Seasonal perks at Thredbo.
Rapid career growth across our hotel & entertainment network.
Paid parental leave; community & volunteering opportunities.

Apply Now
Join Rydges Hobart and become an EVT experience creator, opportunity taker, the ultimate Daymaker.
Join and make a positive impact on our people, communities, and environment every day.
Send your CV and a short cover letter. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and review applications as they come in - don't wait! We can't wait to see the places your career will go with EVT.
When you click apply, you'll be taken to our secure EVT careers portal (powered by Dayforce). This is our official system for managing applications across the EVT Group. You'll simply enter your details and answer a few quick screening questions so we can get to know you better.

title: Commercial Projects Manager (Program Design and Implementation)
description:
Position Purpose:
Infrastructure Ontario is seeking a high-performing Commercial Projects Manager to join the Energy Infrastructure and Project Innovation (EIPI) team within the Capital Delivery division.
In this role, you will lead and coordinate the delivery of complex infrastructure initiatives that support precedent setting government priorities across Ontario. Working at the intersection of strategy, execution and industry engagement you will develop strategies to support project design and implementation to advance public sector objectives and deliver lasting value for Ontarians.
The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and innovative problem-solving to address complex public policy and infrastructure challenges. Leveraging experience gained in the public and/or private sectors, you will apply data-driven analysis, sound judgment, and stakeholder collaboration to develop practical solutions and drive successful project outcomes. Motivated by public impact, you will help shape and deliver transformative infrastructure investments that strengthen communities and support Ontario's long-term growth.

What You Will Do:

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of current and future projects, including project strategy development, design, implementation and delivery. Ensure project outcomes align with client mandates, government priorities, and organizational objectives.
Lead the delivery of key program workstream in support of program implementation, including developing and managing project plans, coordinating multidisciplinary teams and external advisors, overseeing contract performance, identifying and managing issues and risks, and engaging with service providers, government partners, and other stakeholders to achieve critical milestones and successful outcomes.

Lead change management activities to support successful program and project implementation, including the development of transition strategies, stakeholder engagement plans, communications approaches, and adoption frameworks to enable sustainable outcomes.
Develop strategic program and policy recommendations informed by stakeholder engagement, market intelligence, jurisdictional research, and evidence-based analysis to support government decision-making and program objectives.
Translate strategic priorities into actionable delivery plans by establishing implementation approaches, governance frameworks, performance measurement strategies, funding models, and risk management mechanisms.
Conduct research, analysis, and stakeholder engagement activities to assess market conditions, industry trends, jurisdictional approaches, operational considerations, opportunities, and risks, and translate findings into actionable recommendations that inform program development, project prioritization, and government decision-making.
Provide strategic advice and thought leadership on program design, implementation challenges, and emerging issues, identifying opportunities to enhance program effectiveness, improve outcomes, and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.

Act as a liaison between contractors, industry stakeholders, regulatory agencies, and project partners to resolve deployment barriers, permitting challenges, implementation issues, and other risks that may impact project delivery.
Synthesize complex information and analyses into clear, strategic recommendations, briefing materials, and decision-ready products for project teams, senior leadership, and client ministries.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders and delivery partners, using sound judgment, negotiation, collaboration, and problem-solving skills to advance complex initiatives and achieve shared outcomes.
Contribute to a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, and service excellence, while supporting knowledge sharing and organizational learning across project teams.

Who You Are:
We're seeking a professional who brings a combination of commercial acumen, project delivery expertise, and strategic thinking.
You have:

Demonstrated knowledge and expertise acquired through education and professional experience in infrastructure development, project delivery, commercial management, change management practices and project implementation approaches, or related fields.
Demonstrated experience in program delivery and implementation within the infrastructure, energy, telecommunications, consulting, government, or related sectors, including procurement, contract management, project governance, risk management, budget oversight, and the successful delivery of complex initiatives.
Demonstrated experience conducting market engagement activities and working with industry partners, government organizations, regulatory agencies, and service providers.
Demonstrated experience identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks while effectively managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines in a dynamic environment.
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, facilitate decision-making, negotiate agreements, and present recommendations to senior leadership.
Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to synthesize information, develop sound conclusions, and defend recommendations under pressure.
Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a strong work ethic, sound judgment, and exceptional attention to detail.
Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, exercise initiative, and advance complex workstreams with incomplete or evolving information.
Professional designations or advanced credentials such as MBA, P.Eng., PMP, or equivalent are considered assets.

What We Offer:

Commitment to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that promotes a sense of belonging and represents and reflects the needs of the communities we serve.
A defined contribution pension plan, where IO contributes the equivalent of 5% of a full-time employee’s annual salary, with an option for IO to match an additional 5% contribution made by the employee. IO also offers a Group Retirement Savings Plan and Group Tax Free Savings Account, designed to help IO colleagues plan and save for their future.
A comprehensive package that covers health, dental, vision, out-of-country care, paramedical services, and more.
A pregnancy and parental leave program that offers expecting, eligible employees a top-up to 95% of their annual base salary for 31 weeks, and our parental leave program offers eligible employees a top-up to 95% of their annual base salary for 15 weeks.
Access to our $1000 Healthcare Spending Account to top up expenses not covered in the benefits program and a Lifestyle Account that expands the eligibility of health and wellness options and can include coverage for gym memberships and fitness equipment, nutrition counselling or financial planning.
Support for professional development opportunities for all colleagues through a broad range of learning programs that include in-person and online training, leadership development, and support for colleagues’ well-being.IO will also cover the costs associated with up to two membership and license fees per year for eligible colleagues if directly related to the employee’s role.
Access to a suite of virtual healthcare options to support non-urgent medical needs.

Interviews will occur on a rolling basis until the role is filled.

title: Community Supervision & Courts Supervisor
description:
Closing Date: September 28th, 2026, or upon receipt of the first 50 applicant submissions

Community Supervision & Courts Supervisor
Children, Youth & Family Services
Salary Range: $70,553.60- $105,830.40

The Milwaukee County DHHS Children, Youth, & Family Services (CYFS) helps youth involved in the justice system. They assist with community safety by providing a broad spectrum of programs and services for youth before, during, and after involvement in the justice system.

Job Summary: Under the direction of the Manager of Community Supervision & Courts, the primary function of the Community Supervision & Courts Supervisor is to supervise, oversee, and support a team of approximately ten (10) Human Service Workers (HSWs). This position provides individual case management audits, guidance, and coaching. Supervisors ensure staff are providing individualized services, supervision, and adhering to court orders for all cases. The position is also responsible for maintaining department policy and procedures as it relates to case management and the HSWs individual role. Must have knowledge and ensure adherence to relevant statutes. Represent the CYFS with stakeholder and DHHS.

Job Duties:

Direct and Coordinate Staff Workload. Responsible for all activities of their teams related to intake, youth assessment, and supervision of youth referred to the division, including equitable case assignment and ensuring case/court work is done appropriately, consistently, and timely. Ensure all staff are familiar and follow CYFS policies. Schedule 30-to-60-minute meeting, bi-weekly with each team member. Facilitate bi-weekly team meetings to share information regarding updates, areas of attention, and training boosters. Attend and participate in bi-weekly supervisor meetings, attend monthly management meetings, and address situations with staff as they arise.
Train Staff. Provide orientation, onboarding, and training for HSWs in their roles and responsibilities. This may be in collaboration with the CYFS Administrative Coordinator.
Monitor Staff Performance. Assess staff performance (i.e., review court and case documents, review Synthesis notes and YASI assessments, case plans, and perform behavior analysis). Complete formal staff probationary and annual performance evaluations as well as performance improvement/corrective action and regular action plans. Investigate complaints related to personnel issues and collaborate with Section Manager or Deputy Administer to determine course of action.
Public and Court Work. Promote a welcoming culture to clients and their families. Attend court hearings with all new HSW’s for the first six months of their employment. Provide conflict resolution with families if needed. Respond to case or staff issues raised by the Judiciary. Collaborate with Wraparound Milwaukee, contracted providers, DMCPS (Dept. of Milwaukee Child Protective Services), Public Defender office, District Attorney Office, Milwaukee Public Schools, law enforcement, and community agencies.
Perform Administrative Activities. Participate in division meetings and activities. Provide coverage as needed and review/approve time and attendance, staff mileage, and service authorizations. Interview new staff and assist with reviewing and development of department policy.
Perform Other Duties as Assigned. Participate and implement activities to accomplish any special assignments or projects as assigned by Section Manager, Deputy Administrator and/or department Administrator.

Minimum Qualifications:

Must be a resident of Wisconsin
Valid Wisconsin Driver's License and access to a reliable insured vehicle; both maintained throughout employment
Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Human Services, Human Services, Criminal Justice, or a closely related field from an accredited college or university.
At least three (3) years of experience working in a Social Work, Human Services, and/or Criminal Justice field is required.
At least one (1) year of supervisory experience in a Social Work, Human Services, and/or Criminal Justice field is required.
At least intermediate level of experience with all related computer and Microsoft Office software applications
Intermediate level of experience with Synthesis, and/or JPM

Preferred Qualifications:

State of Wisconsin Intake Training/Certification is highly desirable; must complete within six (6) months from start date.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Knowledge of social work principles and practices; knowledge of youth and family development and family system theory; knowledge of case management/assessment techniques, knowledge of mandatory reporter requirements; knowledge of community resources and services available; skilled in verbal and written communication; skill in interpersonal relationships; skill in organizing office work and cases; ability to communicate case needs to staff; ability to conduct performance evaluations; ability to direct the workflow of staff; ability to work in stressful situations; ability to collect and analyze data and summarize in a useful/appropriate format; ability to comfortably use an email system.

NOTE: This ORIGINAL APPLICATION is open to qualified residents of the State of Wisconsin at the time of application. Candidates need to submit a full account of their training and experience (i.e., by submitting an up-to-date resume or by fully completing the application) during the application process and may also be asked to take additional written or performance tests as part of the selection process.

APPLICANTS MUST POSSESS MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AT TIME OF FILING APPLICATION

title: Sr Scientist, Quantitative Bioimaging
description:
We are seeking a Senior Scientist to advance quantitative bioimaging capabilities in support of immunology discovery research. In this role, you will work within a cross-functional team with access to multiple microscopy modalities, complex in vitro models, multimodal biological datasets, and advanced computational infrastructure.

You will develop and apply quantitative imaging, computer-vision, and machine-learning approaches to characterize cellular and tissue phenotypes, support the development of biological models, including co-cultures, organ-on-chip systems, organoids, and tissue explants, and generate insights that advance immunology discovery programs. This role combines hands-on delivery of robust, reproducible image-analysis workflows with the evaluation and application of advanced AI/ML approaches, including biomedical image segmentation, representation learning, foundation models, and scalable computational workflows. You will partner closely with wet-lab scientists, imaging specialists, computational scientists, and other subject-matter experts to translate biological questions into rigorous and impactful analysis strategies.

The role sits at the intersection of biology, bioengineering, microscopy, and computational science. Candidates with combined expertise in two or more of these areas are especially encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, optimize, and apply imaging assays and quantitative image-analysis workflows for 2D and 3D cellular and tissue models to characterize cellular and other complex biological phenotypes.
  • Collaborate with wet-lab assay scientists, imaging specialists, and computational scientists from experimental and assay design through image acquisition, analysis, validation, and data delivery.
  • Extract biologically meaningful, multiparametric features from high-content imaging datasets and use them to characterize disease-relevant phenotypes, mechanisms, and treatment responses.
  • Apply statistical, machine-learning, and deep-learning methods to identify candidate imaging biomarkers and relate imaging phenotypes to molecular, functional, and other biological readouts.
  • Contribute to the integration of imaging data with multimodal datasets, including molecular, single-cell, spatial, or perturbational data, where appropriate.
  • Establish quality-control and evaluation frameworks to assess image and assay quality, distinguish biological signal from technical artifacts, and define data-quality criteria, acceptance thresholds, and analytical limitations.
  • Maintain clear experimental and analytical records; analyze, visualize, and present results rigorously to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Communicate methods, assumptions, results, uncertainties, and limitations effectively to cross-functional project teams.
  • Stay current with advances in quantitative bioimaging, image analysis, computer vision, and AI/ML for biological imaging, and evaluate opportunities to incorporate relevant approaches into team workflows.

Basic Qualifications

  • BS, MS, or PhD in engineering, biophysics, computational biology, imaging science, bioinformatics, or a related discipline, with typically 10-12+ (BS), 8-10+ (MS), or 0-4+ (PhD) years experience.
  • Demonstrated experience developing quantitative image-analysis or computational solutions involving one or more of the following: image segmentation, feature extraction, phenotypic profiling, object classification, or analysis of high-content imaging data.
  • Experience with at least one relevant imaging modality or assay type, such as confocal microscopy, high-content imaging, or cell painting.
  • Ability to assess image quality, recognize common imaging artifacts, and interpret biologically meaningful phenotypes.
  • Working knowledge of machine-learning or deep-learning approaches for biological imaging, with the ability to understand model behavior, assess performance, and contribute to appropriate evaluation strategies.
  • Proficiency with the Python data-science ecosystem, including NumPy, pandas, Polars, scikit-learn, and/or PyTorch.
  • Strong biological grounding, attention to experimental rigor, and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with wet-lab and computational colleagues.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain methods, results, assumptions, and limitations to diverse audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with complex in vitro models, such as organoids, organ-on-chip systems, co-cultures, tissue explants, or other advanced in vitro platforms.
  • Experience with classical bioimage-analysis tools such as CellProfiler, scikit-image, ImageJ/Fiji, or comparable platforms.
  • Exposure to deep-learning, self-supervised learning, foundation-model, embedding-based, or multimodal AI approaches for biological imaging.
  • Peer-reviewed publications, patents, conference presentations, or other demonstrated scientific contributions in quantitative bioimaging, computer vision, computational biology, bioengineering, or a related field.

Position will be filled at level commensurate with extent of education, experience, and accomplishment— Senior Scientist I or Senior Scientist II

title: Blowmold Operator - 3rd Shift
description:
Blowmold Operator
Build your future with G&J Pepsi. Our Blowmold Vacation Relief Workers earn $26.51 per hour and receive competitive benefits, such as:

401K Matching
Pension Plan
Weekly Pay
Paid Time Off
Medical, Dental, Vision, and supplemental insurance benefits

Schedule: 3rd Shift Schedule - 6:30 pm - 7:00 am (12 Hour Shift), 2-2-3 Schedule
Position Summary
To serve our internal customers by ensuring that Blow Mold facility machines are set up and operated according to established company standards to achieve key performance indicators and to ensure that all warehouse goods (e.g. finished goods, raw materials) are loaded, unloaded and stored accurately and safely according to established company standards.

Essential Functions

Operates blow mold facility equipment (e.g. blowmolder, labeler, palletizer, conveyor, airveyor, wrapper) according to established company standards to ensure highest level of quality and efficiency; performs equipment changeovers and ensures machines are set for correct specifications (e.g. package, flavor and mold size) and ensures the removal and proper return of materials and fulfillment of next flavor/package requirements; wraps and tags pallets according to established standards.

Monitors label splicing; assists in label inventory management and performs double checks on all raw materials and finished goods.

Performs quality checks (e.g. burst, expansion, top load, section weights and finished goods visual inspections) and follows up to correct quality issues according to established standards; performs label application inspections performing tear-offs to ensure proper adhesion.

Unloads incoming goods (e.g. preforms, labels) from delivery trucks and trailers to storage area in the Warehouse and provides raw materials to the production line (e.g. preforms, labels); moves and loads finished goods according to established standards (e.g. goods being loaded, unloaded and stored safely, FIFO guidelines observed); ensures outbound loads are accurate and that preform and pallet dunnage is managed according to established guidelines.

Troubleshoots manufacturing equipment to include the blowmolder, labelers, airveyor and palletizing equipment; evaluates equipment performance and anticipates issues to facilitate high efficiency and reduce downtime.

Maintains cleanliness of work area (e.g. ensures labeler is clean, checks glue flow, vacuum drums, fills glue pot, cleans labeler parts on carts); recycles all materials, empties bins appropriately and refeeds bottles when possible to reduce scrap and ensures that preform dunnage is managed and loaded according to standards for return; works as needed to clean equipment, production areas, labelers, blow molders and airveyor.

Supports others in the department as directed by management (e.g. cross training in other positions to cover for lunches, vacations and other team member's absences from work, performing routine maintenance tasks and assisting on equipment repairs and rebuilds).

Communicates with co-workers and supervisor verbally regarding the status of work activities (e.g. critical work issues, quality, performance, raw materials, schedule and sanitation) and other information; supervisor regarding questions or issues with daily assignments.

Completes quality checks, time off requests and other required paperwork according to established standards.

Adheres to all company policies, standards and procedures (e.g. OSHA and safety requirements, AIB and Pepsi standards, Federal/State/Local laws); wears all required personal protective equipment.

Works assigned schedule, exhibits regular and predictable attendance and works overtime as needed to meet workload demands. Performs other related duties as required.

Education Level
Minimum - High School or GED
Preferred - Vocational / Technical in Electronics

Experience
Years of Experience - 1 – 3 - Machine operator experience in food/beverage/pharmaceutical manufacturing required. Previous quality control experience strongly preferred.

Computer Skills
Must have basic computer skills in Microsoft Word and Excel.

Additional Requirements
Forklift Certification required. Be able to operate: forklift, motorized pallet jack and walkie rider.

title: IT Analyst I - Central Service Desk
description:
Job Summary

The IT Analyst I serves as the first point of contact for employees seeking technical assistance. This position is responsible for responding to service desk tickets, troubleshooting common hardware and software issues, providing excellent customer service, and ensuring timely resolution or escalation of incidents and service requests. The role supports Microsoft 365 applications, Windows devices, user account management, and standard business applications while maintaining accurate documentation within the IT service management (ITSM) system. Team members are expected to resolve as many issues as possible at first contact, document troubleshooting activities clearly, and escalate appropriately when specialized support is required

Job Duties

Receive, prioritize, troubleshoot, and resolve incoming service desk incidents and requests through phone, email, chat, and ticketing systems.
Provide Level 1 technical support for desktops, laptops, printers, mobile devices, Microsoft 365 applications, and standard business software.
Create, update, and close service tickets while maintaining accurate documentation and resolution details.
Reset passwords, manage user accounts, and support access requests in accordance with company security policies.
Escalate complex issues to senior analysts, infrastructure teams, or application support groups when appropriate.
Assist with onboarding and offboarding activities, including hardware setup, account provisioning, and equipment collection.
Support workstation deployments, replacements, and technology refresh activities.
Support the collection and retirement of end-user devices as part of workstation lifecycle activities.
Maintain knowledge of standard operating procedures and contribute to knowledge base articles when recurring issues are identified.
Monitor service queues to ensure service-level agreement (SLA) targets are met.
Communicate professionally and effectively with employees at all levels of the organization.
Follow established ITIL and ITSM processes for incident, problem, and request management.
Maintain accurate asset information and assist with inventory tracking.
Adhere to all company safety, quality, environmental, and cybersecurity policies.
Protect confidential information and follow company privacy and acceptable-use requirements in all support activities.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Experience and Education

Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
0 to 2 years of experience in a service desk, technical support, help desk, or customer support environment.
Experience supporting Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 applications, endpoint hardware, printers, peripherals, and basic networking concepts preferred.
Familiarity with ITSM/ticketing systems and basic IT troubleshooting concepts.
ITIL Foundation, Microsoft, CompTIA A+, or similar certifications are a plus

Competencies/Skills

Customer Service Excellence
Verbal and Written Communication
Technical Troubleshooting
Problem Solving
Time Management
Attention to Detail
Documentation Skills
Team Collaboration
Organizational Skills
Adaptability and Continuous Learning
Basic Knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Windows Environments
Ability to Prioritize Multiple Tasks in a Fast-Paced Environment
Security and Confidentiality Awareness
