title: Uniformed Security Services (USS) Supervisor
description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.
Koniag Professional Services, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Uniformed Security Services (USS) Supervisor with a TS/SCI security clearance to support KPS and our government customer in Arlington, VA.

This position is covered under the Service Contract Act. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.

Essential Functions, Responsibilities & Duties may include, but are not limited to:

The purpose of the uniform security officer services is to protect personnel, information, property, and business continuity by “detecting, deterring, observing and reporting.”
The personnel of the uniformed security services shall accomplish this by performing the following activities:
Control access to and within the building, to include administering safety screening, requiring employees and/or visitors to display proper passes or identification before entering the facility or a controlled area
Escort and closely observe various personnel, with special emphasis on foreign nationals, maintenance personnel, and people without security clearances that are in DARPA controlled space
Enforce DARPA and DoD security and safety rules and directions
Direct and control vehicle and pedestrian traffic
Operate emergency equipment (e.g., AED, Protective Mask, etc.)
Respond to potential medical emergencies and perform first aid, CPR, and AED. In relation to these activities, the contractor shall perform periodic evaluations (not less than once per month per shift) of the response to potential medical events.
The evaluations will be in a written format that is prescribed by the Government and will be provided to the Government for review
Observe and immediately report suspicious, illegal, unsafe, or unsecure, activities or people inside or outside the building, taking protective or corrective actions where prudent or necessary
Check and report on equipment, security containers, doors, and computer, mechanical, electrical, HVAC, and telephone equipment/systems, facilities, and environmental conditions, taking corrective action where possible
Check and report on, and where possible, take corrective action, for unsafe and unsecure conditions, threats and vulnerabilities using their senses (sight, hearing, smell, touch, and taste) and various equipment provided by DARPA
Respond to incidents and emergencies and take appropriate action, to include response to alarm conditions such as SCIF and duress alarms. In relation to the alarm response, the contractor shall perform periodic evaluations (not less than once per month per shift) of the response to potential alarm events.
The evaluations will be in a written format that is prescribed by the Government and will be provided to the Government for review
Support DARPA’s COOP and Pandemic Plan as required
Call for emergency services when necessary or in accordance with DARPA procedures and guiding emergency responders to the scene of an incident
Take accurate and complete notes and document their activities and incidents by writing detailed reports and journals
Report their activities and any incidents to the Government in a timely manner and as directed by the Government.

Required Skills and Experience for this position

Knowledge of:
DoD security methods and procedures including patrol, crime prevention, traffic control, and investigation, emergency response, basics of fire detection, suppression, and prevention.
Pertinent DoD, federal, state and local laws, codes and regulations including law and regulation governing jurisdiction and apprehension; techniques and applications of self-defense and proper use of force.
Operational characteristics of security equipment and tools; methods and techniques used in interviewing witnesses, victims, complainants, or suspects; and ability to interpret and explain security policies and procedures and to assess a variety of routine and critical situations involving security and safety and act appropriately.
Minimum of five (5) years of security officer experience, with one year being served immediately prior to working on this contract in a supervisory capacity of five or more people (related military service such as Military Police or law enforcement service can be used to meet this requirement).
High school diploma.
Shall have successful completion of the requirements for Preventing Disease Transmission (i.e., blood-borne pathogens); successful completion of all training required by the contract.
Certified in First Aid, Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR), Automated External Defibrillator (AED), Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT) First Responder – Awareness Level, and certified to use and operate X-Ray and Magnetometer devices.
In good general health without physical impairments which would interfere with the performance of duties, including prolonged walking, standing, sitting, climbing stairs, moving rapidly to respond to various situations.

Clearance Requirement:

Secret with ability to obtain a Top Secret, with eligibility for SAP and SCI access. Top Secret clearance process must begin within one (1) month of working onsite.

Required Skills and Experience for work at DARPA on this contract

Be a US Citizen
Be able to work a flexible schedule to accommodate SID and DARPA needs
Be able to travel and perform work at other geographical locations
Have the ability to maintain cooperative working relationships with those contacted in the course of work activities;
Able to read, write, speak, and understand the English language and have the ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing
Have the ability to accurately and completely prepare and maintain files, records, and reports and to convey factual information
Have the ability to coordinate multiple tasks efficiently
Have the ability to remain calm in emergency situations
Have the ability to understand and carry out oral and written directions with limited supervision
Have skill in reading, writing, basic math, document composition, and analytical problem solving
Must be at least 21 years of age at the time of employment on the contract.
Fluent in the written and spoken English language and shall have strong written and oral communication skills.

title: Adult Therapist
description:
We are seeking dedicated and compassionate individuals to join the team at Polara Health, where our mission is to provide accessible, compassionate whole person care that strengthens our community. As an Adult Therapist, you will have the opportunity to provide comprehensive therapeutic services to adult clients with mental health disorders and support their journey towards wellness and recovery.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Adult Therapist at Polara Health, you will work collaboratively with a diverse team of mental health professionals to provide individual and group therapy services to adult clients. You will conduct assessments, develop treatment plans, and implement evidence-based therapeutic interventions to support clients in achieving their mental health goals.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

· Conduct comprehensive assessments of adult clients to determine their mental health needs and develop appropriate treatment plans.

· Provide individual therapy sessions using evidence-based therapeutic modalities, tailoring interventions to meet the unique needs of each client.

· Facilitate therapeutic groups to promote skill-building, coping strategies, and peer support.

· Collaborate with the interdisciplinary team to ensure coordinated and holistic care for clients.

· Monitor and evaluate clients' progress, adjusting treatment plans as needed and documenting outcomes.

· Provide crisis intervention and support to clients in acute distress.

· Educate clients and their families about mental health conditions, treatment options, and community resources.

· Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation in compliance with regulatory standards and best practices.

· Stay up-to-date with the latest research and therapeutic approaches in the field of mental health.

· Provides individual and group therapy services as allowed by credentialing.

· Works internally with clinical and medical teams ensuring coordination of care and comprehensive service and treatment planning.

· Provides outreach and engagement to clients enrolled with Polara Health as needed and as time allows.

· Works closely with local community partners and forges close relationships to ensure on-going collaboration and coordination of care surrounding behavioral health services.

· Participates as a team member and attends regular staffings and supervision.

· Provides documentation and requests for authorization as required by funding sources.

· Coordinates and assists treatment team in treatment planning and continuum of care.

· Maintains clinical records per agency policy and procedure.

· Attends team meetings, case reviews, staff meetings, supervisory sessions, and in-service trainings as scheduled.

· Manages all aspects of treatment, including referrals to additional resources as appropriate.

· Assists in department strategic planning and implementation through participation in department staffings, staff meetings, training, and other meetings as assigned.

· Actively participates in agency affairs, including marketing, promotion of chemical dependency services, development of programs, and other related duties as assigned.

· Participates in training, workshops, seminars, both internal and external, as required by agency policy and procedure and certification requirements.

· Participates in the Residential Unit on call system.

· Conducts necessary case management to ensure proper referral and follow-up on associated services.

· Documents and reports to referral sources, both external and internal.

· Performs other duties as assigned.

· Must be able to provide or obtain an AZDPS Level One Fingerprint Clearance Card

· Must possess a valid Driver License

· Master's degree in Counseling, Psychology, Social Work, or a related field.

· Current licensure or eligibility for licensure as a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC), Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), or similar license in the state of Arizona.

· Experience working with clients in a mental health setting is preferred.

· Strong knowledge of evidence-based therapeutic approaches for treating mental health disorders.

· Ability to establish rapport and build therapeutic alliances with diverse populations.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Empathy, compassion, and a non-judgmental approach to client care.

title: Senior Commercial Product Director
description:
Position Summary and Areas of Responsibility

This newly created senior leadership role is responsible for defining and executing ACAMS' commercial product strategy across our training portfolio and digital ecosystem. The role will drive portfolio growth, market expansion, customer value, and commercial performance by developing compelling value propositions, optimizing pricing and packaging strategies, and ensuring ACAMS' offerings remain aligned with evolving industry needs. Working closely with the Chief Product Officer and cross-functional leaders, the successful candidate will translate market insights and strategic priorities into growth initiatives, investment decisions, and scalable solutions that strengthen ACAMS' market leadership and deliver sustainable business results.

Accountable for driving growth and the performance of ACAMS' training portfolio and digital ecosystem, including certification and certificate programs, enterprise solutions, pricing and packaging, this position will oversee portfolio strategy, commercial performance through the lifecycle of products. Success will be measured through business growth, revenue performance, customer adoption, market impact, and the ability to capitalize on emerging opportunities across global markets including creating new products from existing content.

A key responsibility will be shaping portfolio priorities through customer insights, market intelligence, competitive analysis, and commercial evaluation. The position will work closely with Product, Technology, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure offerings are differentiated, commercially successful, and deliver measurable value for customers and the business.

In partnership with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, the successful candidate will lead go-to-market strategies that drive acquisition, retention, expansion, and cross-sell opportunities. This includes defining segment-specific value propositions and growth strategies across enterprise, and individual professionals.

The position will lead a team of senior product managers, providing strategic direction, coaching, and portfolio oversight, while fostering a culture of customer focus, accountability, innovation, and commercial excellence.

As a senior leader, the successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to senior sales leaders and executive stakeholders representing ACAMS with key customers, partners, and industry practitioners. Working in close partnership with the Chief Product Officer, the role will help shape long-term strategy, evaluate growth opportunities, guide investment decisions, and ensure the portfolio delivers strong commercial performance alongside meaningful customer outcomes.

Job Duties

Commercial Strategy: Own the commercial performance of the product portfolio, including revenue growth, profitability, and market impact. Lead portfolio planning, investment prioritization, and business case development to ensure resources are focused on the highest-value opportunities. Evaluate portfolio performance, customer demand, strategic alignment, and growth potential, making recommendations on product expansion, enhancement, rationalization, or retirement to maximize long-term value and business results.

Pricing and Packaging: Develop and maintain pricing and packaging that maximize customer value, competitiveness, and revenue growth across individual, enterprise, and specific segments. Conduct pricing analysis, assess market dynamics and customer willingness to pay, and partner with Sales and Finance to ensure pricing models support acquisition, retention, expansion, and profitability objectives.

Team Leadership
Lead and develop a high-performing team of product managers, providing strategic direction, coaching, and performance management. Establish clear portfolio ownership and effective operating models that encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, and accountability. Foster a culture of commercial excellence, customer focus, and continuous improvement while championing product management best practices and data-driven decision-making. Ensure the team remains informed on AFC developments, regulatory changes, and industry trends to support growth.

Market Research and Industry Engagement Lead market, customer, and competitive research to identify emerging trends, growth opportunities, and evolving customer needs. Define target segments, assess market attractiveness, and evaluate ACAMS positioning to inform strategic decisions. Strengthen mechanisms for gathering and synthesizing customer feedback, both qualitative and quantitative, ensuring insights are translated into actionable commercial strategies.

Cross-Functional Go-to-Market Leadership: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other key stakeholders to develop and execute go-to-market strategies that drive customer acquisition, adoption, retention, and growth. Ensure the team conducts effective launch planning, sales enablement, customer communications, and ongoing product promotions. Champion initiatives that improve customer experience, increase product adoption, and create opportunities for cross-sell and upsell across the portfolio.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience

Strong commercial acumen and product management expertise including clear understanding of business case development and product performance management
At least 10+ years of relevant industry experience in financial services, preferably with exposure to regulated sector
Degree/ Master’s Degree in business, law, finance, economics, computing, engineering or other related fields or equivalent experience
Strong Excel skills, data analysis and ability to translate metrics into tangible actions. Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience of innovation, new product launch, service/solution design in large complex international organizations for example financial services, consulting, software
Experience of securing investment, and managing price transformation
Strong interpersonal skills, relationship building skills both with internal and external stakeholders

About the Team

Our Data & AI team sits at the intersection of off-road vehicle engineering and advanced analytics. We have deep expertise in mechanical systems, telematics, CAN communication protocols, vehicle data offboarding, and big data processing. We use that domain knowledge to deliver high-quality data analysis and insights to engineering and program stakeholders. Our processes are grounded in rigorous Verification & Validation (V&V) disciplines to deliver high-quality data. We are seeking a motivated early-career Software Engineer (2+ years of experience) with a Computer Science background to join our team as a long-term contributor. You will work alongside experienced vehicle data engineers and analysts to build internal tooling, automate job orchestration, and maintain CI/CD pipelines — enabling the team to move faster and focus on higher-order analysis work. This is a heads-down engineering role with a meaningful impact on the team's overall productivity. The right candidate will be technically sharp, self-directed, and eager to learn the large-scale data domain and product application over time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain internal tooling that supports team data workflows and reduces manual effort

Required

Nice to Have Experience

  • Docker / Containers: basic containerization concepts for reproducible environments

Soft Skills & Competencies

  • Collaborative team player who thrives in a cross-disciplinary environment alongside domain experts
  • Strong written communication skills — ability to produce clear documentation and process notes
  • Process-oriented mindset with attention to detail; comfortable working within V&V and quality frameworks

Experience & Education

title: Director, Clinical Development AI Partnerships
description:
Reporting to the Head of Clinical Development AI Partnerships, the Director, Clinical Development AI Partnerships will play a key role in advancing AbbVie’s external innovation agenda for artificial intelligence applied to clinical development. This role will help identify, assess, and progress partnership opportunities from the global AI and life sciences innovation ecosystem, with focus on AI-enabled capabilities that can improve clinical trial design, efficiency, quality, execution, evidence generation, and participant engagement.

This leader will be responsible for independently leading substantive workstreams across sourcing, evaluation, diligence, pilot design, benchmark planning, partner engagement, and internal governance recommendations. This person works in close collaboration with Clinical Development leaders, AI Strategy & Partnerships, Search & Evaluation, Business Development & Acquisitions, Business Technology Solutions, Transactions, Legal, Procurement, Privacy, Compliance, and R&D stakeholders. The primary scope is Clinical Development, with opportunities spanning therapeutic areas and transaction types such as pilots, research collaborations, licenses, option structures, and other partnership models.

The successful candidate will bring enough clinical development context to understand the problems AbbVie is trying to solve, enough AI and technology fluency to assess external capabilities credibly, and enough strategy and deal-process discipline to help the organization make practical, evidence-based decisions. This is a builder role in a new and high-priority area: the person should be comfortable operating with ambiguity, developing trusted internal and external relationships, and converting emerging opportunities into rigorous, well-governed partnership paths.

The Role

This Director role will be a hands-on partner to the Development AI cross-functional team as well as to the broader AbbVie AI Partnerships team. This person will be leading AI Strategy and Operations for the ClinDev organization and serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership in strategy, functions, and business technology. This role is pivotal in driving our organization towards becoming a leader in the application of AI in pharma, ensuring that AI initiatives align with our overarching business objectives, delivering tangible business value and accelerating our promise to patients. He or she will help translate AbbVie’s Clinical Development AI priorities into a focused external innovation pipeline. The core areas of emphasis include clinical trial acceleration, clinical trial innovation, and related AI-enabled capabilities that can improve the speed, quality, and execution of drug development.

Responsibilities

  • Deal sourcing: Closely monitor the evolving landscape of AI and pharmaceutical innovation as it relates to clinical development. Proactively identify and evaluate potential partnering opportunities from AI startups, technology companies, frontier model labs, clinical technology platforms, digital health companies, academic groups, and life sciences investors.

  • Opportunity evaluation and diligence: Lead or co-lead the structured assessment of external opportunities with Clinical Development, R&D, BTS, S&E, BD&A, legal, privacy, compliance, and functional subject matter experts. This includes managing partner interactions, organizing diligence workstreams, synthesizing scientific and technical input, and preparing clear recommendations for senior leaders and governance forums.

  • Pilots, benchmarks, and technical evaluations: Design and coordinate pilots, benchmarks, proof-of-concept studies, and technical evaluations of AI models and platforms applied to clinical development. Ensure evaluations are scoped to answer decision-relevant questions, with clear success criteria, data needs, operational assumptions, risks, and next-step recommendations.

  • Deal flow management: Track active assessments, partner interactions, diligence materials, pilot status, decision points, and open issues. Communicate progress and risks to key stakeholders in a timely and concise way, including through written updates, management presentations, governance materials, and working team discussions.

  • Partnership and deal execution support: Contribute to the development of appropriate partnership structures, non-binding term sheets, statements of work, technical and operational inputs, risk mitigation strategies, and negotiation considerations in collaboration with BD&A, Transactions Legal, Procurement, BTS, and functional teams.

  • Ecosystem development: Build and maintain relationships with external partners and ecosystem participants to improve awareness of AbbVie’s Clinical Development AI priorities and to source high-quality opportunities aligned with business needs.

  • Internal alignment and stakeholder management: Help align Clinical Development leaders, functional SMEs, BTS, AI Strategy, and enterprise stakeholders on opportunity fit, value potential, implementation needs, and decision criteria. Facilitate meetings and working sessions that move the organization toward informed decisions.

  • Operating model and playbook contribution: Develop reusable approaches for Clinical Development AI external innovation, including diligence templates, pilot design principles, stakeholder maps, decision criteria, ROI and success metric frameworks, and practical guidance on buy-build-partner tradeoffs.

Required

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in clinical development, clinical innovation, clinical operations, clinical data science, AI strategy, business development, search and evaluation, management consulting, venture, corporate strategy, or related life sciences technology roles. Candidates with more traditional strategy, S&E, BD&A, or consulting backgrounds should have clear exposure to clinical development or AI-enabled life sciences work.

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, engineering, computer science, data science, business, or a related discipline is required. Advanced degree such as MD, PharmD, PhD, MBA, master’s degree in a quantitative discipline, or equivalent experience is preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to understand clinical development workflows and pain points, including trial design, study start-up, enrollment, clinical operations, evidence needs, or adjacent drug development processes.

  • Working knowledge of AI/ML, generative AI, agentic AI, analytics, clinical technology, digital health, or data-enabled platforms, with the judgment to evaluate credibility, feasibility, implementation requirements, and potential business impact.

  • Experience contributing to external opportunity assessments, technical or business diligence, pilots, collaborations, partnerships, licensing discussions, or other strategic initiatives involving cross-functional decision-making.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. Able to synthesize complex clinical, technical, operational, and business information into concise recommendations for senior stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a 0-to-1 environment. Capable of quickly building an internal network, developing trust with cross-functional partners, and collaborating effectively with external organizations.

  • Highly organized and execution-oriented, with strong project management, meeting facilitation, stakeholder management, and follow-through. Able to work independently while staying tightly connected to broader team priorities.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and judgment, including communication adaptability, negotiation support, issue spotting, conflict management, and the ability to operate with discretion when handling confidential partner and strategy information.

Preferred

  • Experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology drug development, particularly in clinical development, clinical operations, clinical innovation, R&D strategy, or business development.

  • Experience in immunology, oncology, neuroscience, eye care, obesity, or another AbbVie-relevant therapeutic area is a plus but not required.

  • Experience at or advising AI-native startups, technology companies, product-focused organizations, venture-backed companies, or top-tier management consulting firms serving life sciences or technology clients.

  • Experience designing or interpreting pilots, benchmarks, technical evaluations, or value assessments for AI-enabled products or platforms.

  • Familiarity with data, privacy, compliance, regulatory, procurement, information security, and change-management considerations involved in deploying external technology in a regulated clinical environment.

dit breng je mee


Je houdt van mensen en wilt klanten echt helpen. Je bent nieuwsgierig, durft initiatief te nemen en krijgt energie van samenwerken. Je hebt gevoel voor service én voor verkopen. Kortom: je kijkt verder dan je takenlijstje en bent graag van waarde – voor de klant én je team.

jij maakt HEMA echt


Bij HEMA werken we met ruim 17.000 collega’s aan een beter alledaags leven in een mooiere wereld. Met producten die praktischer, mooier, beter zijn en ook nog eens langer meegaan. Én met kleurrijke winkels in dorpen, steden en online. We zijn trots op hoe ver we zijn gekomen, maar we zijn nog niet tevreden. HEMA is weer écht HEMA en klaar voor de volgende stap. Onze ambitie? Koploper worden in een uitdagende markt. Dat doen we samen, als één team, met trotse collega’s, ondernemers en partners. Door te spelen om te winnen. Dat betekent dat je nieuwsgierig bent, kansen grijpt, met plezier samenwerkt en altijd gaat voor het beste resultaat. Je durft jezelf uit te spreken en anderen uit te dagen om samen beter te worden. Jij kunt met jouw unieke bijdrage meebouwen aan het HEMA van morgen. Jij maakt HEMA echt. Doe je mee?

title: Director, Transformation & Governance
description:
Lead the Digital Lab+ through a practical, sustainable transformation that strengthens organizational effectiveness, governance, capabilities, and ways of working. This role partners closely with the VP and senior leaders to translate strategy into disciplined execution, align stakeholders around complex trade-offs, and embed operating rhythms that improve clarity, accountability, and business impact. Operating at the intersection of business strategy, transformation, analytics, and leadership influence, this leader will navigate complex relationships, influence without direct authority, foster collaboration, and measure progress against outcomes that matter.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

The ideal candidate brings consulting-style problem solving, executive presence, systems thinking, and practical transformation leadership. They are equally comfortable structuring ambiguous problems, connecting seemingly unrelated challenges, identifying patterns across functions, facilitating senior leader alignment, and rolling up their sleeves to make scalable ways of working stick. This individual will serve as a proactive thought partner to leadership, helping identify emerging risks, opportunities, and interventions that strengthen organizational effectiveness, leadership accountability, collaboration, and readiness for the future.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the end-to-end activation and adoption of Digital Lab+ transformation priorities, translating strategic intent into actionable workplans, operating model design, governance routines, decision rights, accountability frameworks, engagement models, and scalable ways of working.
  • Build and manage an integrated transformation roadmap that clarifies milestones, dependencies, risks, quick wins, resource trade-offs, and interventions required to accelerate adoption and value realization.
  • Lead change management, culture, and stakeholder engagement workstreams across Digital Lab+ to embed leadership behaviors, accountability, collaboration, decision-making practices, and operating rhythms.
  • Analyze organizational structures, team interfaces, workflow friction points, adoption metrics, stakeholder feedback, and performance indicators to identify improvement opportunities and course-correct execution.
  • Partner with Finance, HR, Therapeutic Businesses, Analytics & Operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to connect patterns across functions, shape integrated solutions, and drive operational effectiveness and measurable business outcomes.
  • Facilitate executive and cross-functional forums that align leaders around complex trade-offs, prioritize the highest-value opportunities, convert decisions into clear next steps, and sustain momentum across workstreams.
  • Develop practical playbooks, toolkits, communications, and leadership enablement materials that help teams adopt new ways of working with clarity and confidence.
  • Identify future-state capabilities and skills required to support Digital Lab+’s evolution, strengthen organizational effectiveness, scale effective practices across teams, and embed continuous improvement into day-to-day operations.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leaders by synthesizing complex information into clear recommendations, executive-ready narratives, and decision materials that surface emerging risks, opportunities, and interventions.
  • Build informal influence networks and create mechanisms to monitor adoption, value realization, and organizational health, ensuring transformation efforts are sustained across boundaries and beyond launch.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred (e.g., MBA).
  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in strategy consulting, transformation, organizational effectiveness, governance, or senior operations roles.
  • Experience designing governance models, operating rhythms, decision rights, accountability frameworks, engagement models, adoption measures, and continuous improvement routines.
  • Strong interpersonal skills that build trusted relationships, foster alignment, create clarity, and enable higher performance across a matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to move seamlessly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution, balancing long-term direction with near-term delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading large-scale transformation, governance, operating rhythms, organizational effectiveness, or strategy initiatives in complex matrixed environments.
  • Strong analytical, systems thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize ambiguity, identify patterns across functions, assess organizational effectiveness, and develop integrated, data-driven recommendations.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, executive communication, and strategic advisory skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and informal networks without direct authority.
  • Proven ability to shape narratives, craft compelling messages, and represent leadership in internal and external forums across diverse stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to drive strategic transformation, culture and behavior change, future capability building, and organizational effectiveness by identifying improvement opportunities, aligning stakeholders, implementing solutions, and scaling sustainable ways of working.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Translate strategy into executable priorities, thoughtful operating model choices, practical workplans, and sustainable routines.
  • Influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners through systems thinking, data, insight, structured problem solving, trusted relationships, and informal networks.
  • Navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and portfolio trade-offs while maintaining clarity, momentum, accountability, and focus on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Balance analytical rigor with empathy, change leadership, culture-building, behavior change, and strong people partnership.
  • Drive measurable business outcomes while strengthening organizational effectiveness, future capabilities, leadership behaviors, collaboration, and team performance.

title: Incident response investigator
description:
WithSecure™ delivers research-led cyber security to defend organizations, society and people from real-world attacks and build resilience into their approach. Our people are a mix of technical and creative experts – diverse, talented, and passionate people – working tirelessly to help us advance the industry with new ways of thinking. They lead their own development, in and out of the office. They call the shots when it comes to building a place to call home in our organization.


WithSecure™ protects businesses all over the world from modern threats. We do this through a Co-security approach born from first-hand knowledge that no one can solve every cyber security problem alone. Every single day, our diverse, growing team fights against online extortion, threats to national infrastructure, the unlawful spread of sensitive information, and everything in-between. The best part about working for WithSecure is our people! We are a community of dedicated and passionate professionals that take workplace happiness seriously. If you’re looking for something that’s more than just a job – we’d love to hear from you.


The role also requires the ability to clearly communicate to a range of audiences from technical practitioners through to executive boards. This requires the ability to identify technical issues and describe them in the language of the business leaders you are engaged with.
A successful candidate should have an experience of both enterprise IT platforms and information security. They will be required to understand the motivations and methods adopted by a wide range of threat sources with a good understanding of how exploitation of systems occurs.
In addition, supporting Incident Readiness activities (such as Tabletop sessions, Client Training, and Playbook creation), when not actively supporting investigations.

Key Responsibilities

    • Performing investigations for WithSecure clients and producing high quality reports to present findings and guidance.
    • Maintaining target utilization on client chargeable projects whilst working as a Senior Incident Response Investigator.
    • Producing output to highlight the technical competence of the company to a standard that can be published.
    • Supporting your practice area in successful delivery and growth.
    • Mentoring juniors along with supporting key business objectives though advice and guidance based on current industry trends.
  • What are we looking for?
    • CISSP qualification or equivalent experience
    • Experience with investigating targeted attacks across large enterprise networks
    • Demonstrable experience of client-server infrastructures, security architectures and related logging and alerting across multiple operating systems
    • Demonstrable experience networking with the ability to perform network forensic analysis down to packet level
    • Demonstrable detailed knowledge of file-system analysis including FAT, NTFS, HFS+ and/or EXT2/3/4 and ability to find and extract common disk-based indicators of compromise
    • Knowledge of Windows, Linux and/or OS X internals and able to demonstrate knowledge of key system artefacts for each platform
    • Able to articulate the phases of Incident Response as defined by NIST
    • Familiarity MITRE ATT&CK Matrix for Enterprise framework
    • Knowledge of and experience in memory analysis
    • Ability to report key findings in a clear and concise manner both at technical and senior management level

Bonus points

    • Experience in Malware Analysis to a minimum level of behavioral analysis
    • Familiarity with one or more scripting language such as Python, Ruby, PowerShell or Bash is desirable
    • Experience of common cloud technologies
    • Vendor independent qualification in Incident Response and Forensics such as GIAC, IISFA, IACIS, ISFCE, ECCouncil or CREST certifications (e.g. CFCE, CCE, CIFI, CHFI, ECIH, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GCFE, GREM, GCED, Intrusion Analyst, Network or Host Intrusion Analyst or Malware Reverse Engineer)
    • Vendor specific qualification such as AccessData Certified Examiner (ACE), Encase Certified Examiner (EnCE) certification or X-Ways Professional in Evidence Recovery Techniques (X-PERT)
    • DV-clearance
    • Chartered Cyber Security Professional-status (ChCSP)

What will you get from us

    • Freedom – you will have the opportunity to define new ways of working how we engage with our customers, and how product value gets represented.
    • You will work together with experienced and enthusiastic colleagues, and within WithSecure you will find some of the best minds in the cyber security industry.
    • Your work will be clearly visible and recognised – all over the world and across our business units.

title: Superintendent
description:
Summary

Balfour Beatty is seeking a Superintendent to join our team in Charlotte. The ideal candidate will be a proven field leader with strong communication and coordination skills, responsible for managing all day-to-day construction activities on-site.

Field Leadership: Manage all field operations and daily site activities; supervise subcontractors, foremen, and field staff to ensure safe, efficient, and quality-driven performance.
Safety Management: Establish and lead the site safety team; develop project-specific safety plans, conduct hazard analyses, and ensure compliance with OSHA and company standards.
Planning & Scheduling: Develop and maintain project schedules in collaboration with the Project Manager; lead pull planning sessions, identify milestones, and track progress against critical path.
Quality Control: Implement and oversee the project’s Quality Control program; ensure materials, workmanship, and testing comply with contract specifications and standards.
Preconstruction Support: Review drawings, specifications, and budgets for constructability; provide input to estimating teams and preconstruction schedules.
Financial Oversight: Monitor labor, equipment, and general conditions budgets; approve subcontractor payment applications and verify cost accuracy.
Subcontractor Coordination: Lead weekly coordination meetings, ensure accountability for schedules and performance, and oversee subcontractor orientations and compliance.
Site Logistics: Develop and maintain site logistics and temporary facilities plans, including hoisting, access control, and site security.
Communication & Reporting: Conduct progress and safety meetings, maintain daily reports, and provide clear communication to all project stakeholders.
Closeout & Turnover: Ensure timely completion of punch lists, commissioning activities, and project documentation; manage site demobilization and final inspections.

Minimum Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent.
8+ years of commercial construction field leadership experience.
Strong understanding of structural, MEP, and architectural coordination.
Proven ability to manage site operations, safety, and schedules.
Excellent communication, leadership, and conflict-resolution skills.
Proficiency with construction software such as Procore, Bluebeam, or Primavera P6.

Preferred Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience managing ground-up, renovation, or adaptive reuse projects.
Demonstrated success leading diverse subcontractor teams.
OSHA 30 certification and advanced safety training.

title: Knowledge Mobilization and Community Engagement Specialist
description:

title: Sr. Data Scientist
description:
About Us

Aarden is a land intelligence platform that helps landowners, investors, and developers figure out what a piece of land can actually be used for, and how to market it. We turn messy parcel, infrastructure, market, community, and ecological data into clear, bankable answers for land-dependent assets. Our goal is to become the default decision layer for land: helping physical projects start in places where they can be built and supported for decades.

The Role

Aarden’s business is built around providing unique, highly trusted insights about land use, land value, and market dynamics to our customers. We are looking for a product-focused data scientist to help us maintain and develop several of the models and analytics that power those insights.

Today that work spans three primary areas. First, we score parcel-level suitability for specific development uses, so a given site gets assessed differently depending on whether someone is evaluating it for conservation, a data center, solar, wind, or residential development. Second, we run an automated valuation model and comparable transactions identification for bare land, where comps are often thin and estimating the value of land is contingent on how the land might be used. And third, we model current and historic community sentiment related to different development activities. You'd own meaningful pieces of these modeling efforts and help decide what analytical capabilities we build next.

What You'll Do

  • Build new models and analytics that surface insights from our ever-growing database of land and market attributes.
  • Extend and refine existing models to improve performance and support new use cases.
  • Source, evaluate, and curate datasets on land use, property characteristics, and market factors, both as model inputs and for validation.
  • Work with design, product, and engineering to deliver your work to customers. If you're interested, you'll also have the chance to build user-facing features yourself.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong data science and ML fundamentals, plus hands-on experience with geospatial data and tooling (GDAL/OGR, Postgres/PostGIS, Sedona, or similar).
  • Production-quality Python and fluent SQL, with willingness to pick up other languages as needed (e.g., TypeScript).
  • A track record of designing evaluation frameworks for geospatial, environmental, or socioeconomic models, where ground truth may be scarce, imbalanced, or contested.
  • Experience using LLMs as components in data pipelines or modeling.
  • Proven discipline for building data curation and model development workflows that are documented, reproducible, and versioned.
  • Good judgment about how your outputs impacts customers, including the ability to explain them to non-experts.

Additional Nice to Haves

  • Experience in one or more of the domains we model: renewable energy, land conservation, forestry, data center development, residential real estate, or commercial real estate.
  • Deep expertise in a technique or data type outside our current areas of focus (e.g., imagery, lidar, forecasting, simulation) paired with a view on how it could help our product strategy.
  • Comfort and an interest in supporting customer-facing demos, presentations, and discussions.

Working at Aarden

Aarden is a high-trust, high-output team. We’re striving to be intentional about our team growth. This allows us to test the outer boundaries of our individual capabilities, while also going deeper on developer tooling and support. You’ll work hard here, and we’ve got your back.

Practically, this means you’ll be asked to take on large projects, have a high bar of expectations to meet, and have a strong support system to help you meet that high bar. That support system includes:
  • At least 2 in-person days per week | We’ve found that while heads-down time at home is fantastic for task-related productivity, in-person time is magic for longer-form productivity and relationship building. You’ll be expected to work at least 2 in-person days at either our headquarters in Seattle or our regional hub in Boulder, CO. In the latter case, you’ll also be expected to travel to Seattle on a periodic basis to meet with our full team. Our in-person days are used to plan, troubleshoot, and check-in with each other on progress and questions. Expect team lunches and whiteboarding.
  • Focused ownership in your role | The rest of the team is here to help you and cares deeply about the long-term functionality of our applications. With that said, we’ll be looking to you to own your lane, go deep, and develop a strong stance on what it takes to make our applications best-in-class.
  • Dedicated monthly AI tooling budget | We’re in a golden era of AI-powered developer tooling. We strongly encourage augmenting your output with AI tools, and have a dedicated & flexible budget for every team member to support that setup. We care about what you ship, not how.

title: Director of Information Technology
description:
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Information Technology to lead, shape, and evolve the technology function across all three Kandor companies. This is a senior leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology excellence, business partnership, and operational delivery. You will be responsible for the overall IT strategy, infrastructure, cybersecurity posture, and service delivery for a geographically distributed organization undergoing meaningful systems change.
As the Director of IT, you will directly oversee two team members — an IT Service Lead and Technical Services Coordinator — who together manage our service desk and day-to-day technical support operations. You will provide strategic direction and technical oversight, while being the key technology partner to senior leadership and business stakeholders across all three operating companies.
This is not a role for someone who simply manages from a distance. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable in a boardroom presenting a technology roadmap and in a working session troubleshooting an API integration challenge. Strong business partnering, customer service orientation, and the ability to lead through change are foundational expectations of this position.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Technology Leadership

Own the IT strategy for Kandor Management, aligning technology investments and roadmaps with the operational needs of Guardteck, Everclean, and Kendrix.
Lead the technology transformation agenda — championing new platforms, integrations, and digital workflows — while establishing governance frameworks that manage risk, ensure compliance, and keep IT tightly aligned to business objectives.

People Leadership & Team Development

Lead and develop two direct reports and provide oversight to the broader service desk team. Foster a coaching-oriented culture grounded in accountability, continuous improvement, and customer service excellence.
Support direct reports through regular feedback, development planning, and stretch opportunities that build long-term IT team capability.

Service Delivery & Helpdesk Oversight

Provide strategic oversight of the Technology Service Desk (TSD), monitoring service levels, ticket trends, and escalation patterns to drive quality and consistency.
Own the escalation path for complex or high-impact technical issues, ensuring timely resolution and clear stakeholder communication.
Maintain robust TSD documentation, processes, and knowledge management practices that reduce single-points-of-failure.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

Serve as Kandor's senior authority on information security, establishing and maintaining a strong cybersecurity posture across all three companies — including policies, access controls, incident response, and user security awareness.
Lead IT risk management activities, stay ahead of the evolving threat landscape, and ensure compliance with applicable data protection standards.

Systems Architecture & API Integration

Own the technology stack across Kandor, including core business platforms, cloud services, and third-party tools.
Lead and oversee API integrations between business systems, ensuring reliable, secure, and well-documented cross-platform data flows.
Manage system upgrades, fixes, and feature rollouts in close partnership with business stakeholders to minimize disruption and drive adoption.

Business Partnering & Stakeholder Engagement

Act as the primary technology partner to senior leadership and operational teams across all three companies.
Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at every level, proactively identifying technology solutions that address business challenges.
Translate technical complexity into clear, business-relevant narratives for executive audiences and communicate openly throughout periods of system change.

Vendor & Budget Management

Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance across the IT ecosystem.
Own the IT budget — including planning, forecasting, and cost management across hardware, software, services, and staffing — making sound investment decisions that balance business capability with fiscal responsibility.

Qualifications
Required

7+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including at least 3 years in a senior IT management or director-level role
Demonstrated experience managing and developing IT teams, including service desk or helpdesk functions
Strong technical breadth across infrastructure, end-user computing, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications
Proven experience with API integrations and connecting disparate business systems
Solid cybersecurity knowledge, including risk assessment, policy development, incident response, and compliance frameworks
Experience delivering technology change in a multi-site, multi-entity, or distributed organization
Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and business partnering skills
Strong understanding of ITIL or equivalent IT service management frameworks
Proven ability to develop and execute IT strategy aligned to business objectives

Preferred / Assets

Experience in service industries (security, janitorial, facilities, or similar) is a strong asset
Familiarity with helpdesk ticketing systems (e.g., Monday.com) and remote support tools (e.g., TeamViewer, RDP)
Experience with Microsoft 365 ecosystem, Azure AD / Entra ID, and Windows/macOS environments
Working knowledge of mobile device management (MDM) solutions
Experience supporting or managing ERP, workforce management, or field operations platforms
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CompTIA Security+, ITIL Foundation, PMP, or similar
Experience managing IT through a period of significant system change, digital transformation, or platform migration
Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

What We're Looking For in You
Beyond the technical and functional requirements, Kandor Management is looking for a Director of IT who leads with a human-centered mindset — someone who recognizes that technology serves people, and that the best IT outcomes are achieved when the team feels trusted, supported, and clear on what matters.
You bring strategic thinking paired with practical execution — you can set a technology vision and also roll up your sleeves when the situation demands it. You are as comfortable having a strategic conversation with a senior executive as you are reviewing a security policy or guiding your team through a complex escalation.
You are a relationship builder and communicator who earns trust across every level of the organization. In a multi-company environment with diverse operational needs, your ability to listen, translate, and deliver will be your greatest asset.

Why Kandor Management
Kandor Management offers a unique opportunity to shape IT across three distinct, growing service companies from a single strategic seat. You will have real ownership, a committed team to lead, and the support of an organization that understands the value of getting technology right. This is a role with scope to grow — in people, systems, and impact.

title: Assistant Project Manager
description:
Summary

Balfour Beatty is seeking an Assistant Project Manager in Charlotte. The ideal candidate will be an organized and collaborative construction professional ready to take the next step in project management. This role builds on experience gained as a Senior Project Engineer, offering greater responsibility in financial management, scheduling, subcontractor relations, and leadership of project teams.

As an Assistant Project Manager, you’ll work closely with the Project Manager and Superintendent to plan, coordinate, and execute all phases of construction. You’ll take ownership of budgets, schedules, and documentation, ensuring that projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards of quality. This position provides an opportunity to develop strong client relationships and refine leadership and business skills while upholding Balfour Beatty’s Zero Harm® safety culture and commitment to excellence.

Essential Functions

Project Planning & Preconstruction: Assist in identifying project requirements, managing bid package development, and supporting constructability reviews. Coordinate project mobilization and demobilization activities.
Financial Management: Support the creation and maintenance of project budgets, financial reports, and revenue projections. Manage change orders, subcontractor payments, and cost tracking to ensure financial accuracy.
Scheduling & Coordination: Lead pull planning sessions with the Superintendent, assist in schedule development and time impact analyses, and ensure progress aligns with critical milestones.
Contract & Procurement Administration: Manage procurement of materials, supplies, and equipment. Oversee subcontractor scopes, contracts, and performance standards to ensure compliance with project requirements.
Quality & Compliance: Lead the development of the project quality control program and ensure compliance with specifications and contract documents.
Safety Leadership: Incorporate safety requirements into subcontract scopes, lead safety orientations, and promote adherence to Balfour Beatty’s Zero Harm® principles.
Communication & Reporting: Prepare monthly owner narratives, coordinate Owner, Architect, Contractor (OAC) meetings, and ensure timely communication between project stakeholders.
Closeout & Turnover: Manage project closeout documentation, including certificates of occupancy, warranties, and final financial reconciliation. Support the Project Engineer team through turnover and client transition.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
4–6 years of progressive experience in commercial construction project management.
Strong understanding of project scheduling, budgeting, and contract administration.
Proficiency with project management software (Procore, Primavera P6, Sage 300 CRE, or similar).
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.

Preferred Experience

Experience overseeing Project Engineers and Interns.
Proven ability to lead project meetings and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Strong client relationship and negotiation skills.
Demonstrated experience managing small to mid-size commercial projects.

title: Leerkracht middenbouw
description:
Jij ziet kansen waar anderen gedrag zien. Jij ontdekt talent waar een kind zelf nog aan twijfelt. Wil jij elke dag van betekenis zijn voor kinderen en werken op een school waar aandacht, vertrouwen en ontwikkeling centraal staan? Dan maken wij graag kennis met jou.

Voor schooljaar 2026-2027 zoeken wij een enthousiaste en betrokken leerkracht voor de middenbouw die samen met ons bouwt aan een veilige, stabiele en inspirerende leeromgeving. Een collega die verder kijkt dan de lesstof, oog heeft voor ieder kind en bijdraagt aan rust, structuur en kwaliteit binnen de school.

De Lichtboei is een protestants-christelijke basisschool waar kinderen iedere dag een nieuwe kans krijgen om te groeien. Vanuit respect, vertrouwen en persoonlijke aandacht creëren we een omgeving waarin kinderen zich gezien, veilig en gewaardeerd voelen. We geloven dat ieder kind uniek is en zich het beste ontwikkelt wanneer het zichzelf mag zijn.

Diezelfde aandacht hebben we voor onze collega's. Je komt terecht in een warm en betrokken team waarin samenwerking, werkplezier en professionele groei centraal staan. Samen verzorgen we betekenisvol onderwijs waarin kinderen leren voor het leven en waarin rust, eigenaarschap en vertrouwen de basis vormen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een warme en betrokken school waar kinderen en collega's zich gezien en gewaardeerd voelen.
  • Een enthousiast team dat samenwerkt, kennis deelt en voor elkaar klaarstaat.
  • Ruimte om jouw talenten in te zetten en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.
  • Een werkomgeving waarin rust, structuur en vertrouwen centraal staan.
  • Een goede werk-privébalans met aandacht voor jouw welzijn.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

  • Je hebt een PABO-diploma of rondt je opleiding binnenkort af.
  • Je creëert een veilige, positieve en gestructureerde leeromgeving.
  • Je hebt oog voor de ontwikkeling en behoeften van ieder kind.
  • Je werkt graag samen met ouders en collega's.

Samen maken we iedere dag het verschil voor kinderen. Word jij onze nieuwe collega?

Enthousiast?

Ben je nieuwsgierig geworden naar De Lichtboei en wil je ervaren hoe het is om bij ons te werken? Je bent van harte welkom voor een vrijblijvende kennismaking onder het genot van een kop koffie of thee. We laten je graag onze school zien en vertellen met trots waarom onze collega's zich hier zo thuis voelen.

Wil je meer informatie? Neem dan contact op met Cindy O'Brien, directeur van De Lichtboei, via 06-83236486. Of solliciteer direct via de sollicitatiebutton.

title: Junior Research Engineer - Ventilation
description:
Do you want to help develop the ventilation solutions of the future mining industry? We are now looking for a Junior Research Engineer in ventilation to join our operations in Kiruna. In this role, you will work closely with both operations and development, focusing on creating a safe, efficient, and sustainable mining environment.

The sustainable transformation begins with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally.

Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us?

Your role

In this role, you will work both practically and analytically with mine ventilation, contributing to a safe working environment both underground and on the surface. Your work will include conducting ventilation measurements such as airflow, pressure, temperature, humidity, and contaminants, followed by analysis and reporting of results. You will also work with ventilation modelling in Ventsim and take part in studies related to airflow distribution, heat, fire safety, and other environmental factors. In addition, you will participate in projects and contribute to the continuous development and improvement of our operations.

What you bring

You are a structured and analytical person with a strong commitment to health and safety. You enjoy a role where you can combine hands-on work with analytical tasks, and you collaborate effectively with different teams and functions.

In addition, we expect you to have:

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in mining engineering or another relevant field
  • Experience in mine ventilation, particularly related to underground measurements
  • Good knowledge of MS Office
  • Fluency in English, both spoken and written
  • A valid B driver´s license

It is considered a plus if you also have:

  • Experience with data analysis tools and ventilation modelling
  • Experience in working and studying in multicultural settings
  • Knowledge of Swedish

What we offer

In addition to the general benefits — which you can find a bit further down — we can also offer you, who currently do not live in Sweden, the following:

  • Relocation support for you and your family.
  • Excellent conditions for settling in. We guide you through the official procedures necessary to settle in the country if you come from outside Sweden. We also provide temporary accommodation for a reasonable period and help you find a permanent place to live according to your personal needs.
  • LKAB helps you learn Swedish, a tool for a better understanding of Swedish culture.
  • The Swedish vacation law entitles all employees to five weeks of vacation per year, and four consecutive weeks during June, July, or August. Your contract may include extra vacation days.

Additional information

We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we usually do not request cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your skills and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.

Type of Employment: Permanent, full-time

title: Radiographer - Site Lead
description:
Lumus Imaging is seeking an experienced and motivated Site Lead Radiographer to play a pivotal role in establishing our brand-new Golden Grove clinic and launching our first community-based MRI service in South Australia.
This is a rare and exciting career opportunity for a senior radiographer to lead and help shape a new service from the ground up. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by contributing to the development of a state-of-the-art imaging clinic, establishing workflows and service foundations, and helping build the culture that will support the clinic’s long-term success.
We are particularly seeking an experienced MRI Radiographer, ideally with leadership capability, to support the successful launch and growth of this new community-based MRI service. Senior CT Radiographers with strong leadership experience are also encouraged to apply, particularly those seeking a genuine career development opportunity and motivated to build their MRI capability while contributing to the growth of a new imaging business.
About the Role
As Site Lead Radiographer, you will:

Lead and support the day-to-day operations of a new imaging clinic.
Play a key role in the establishment and growth of Lumus Imaging's first MRI service in South Australia.
Develop and implement site processes and protocols aligned with Lumus national standards.
Drive quality, compliance, and audit activities at site level.
Help shape a positive, patient-focused culture from the ground up.
Work with advanced imaging technology including MRI, Cardiac MRI, CT, Cardiac CT, General X-ray, Bone Density and Ultrasound services.
Collaborate closely with specialist referrers, local GPs, the community and other stakeholders located nearby.

About You
To be successful in this role, you will bring:

Experience as a Senior MRI or CT Radiographer, MRI or CT Supervisor, or Manager.
Strong leadership experience, with confidence leading and supporting a team.

Demonstrated commitment to delivering exceptional patient care and customer service.

MRI radiography experience is preferred and will be highly regarded; however, senior CT Radiographers with proven leadership experience and a strong interest in MRI are also encouraged to apply.
Experience in cardiac MRI and cardiac CT will be viewed favourably but is not mandatory.
Confidence working autonomously while providing clear direction, support, and guidance to others.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong understanding of quality, compliance, and workplace health and safety practices.
Tertiary qualifications in Medical Imaging as well as

Certification and/or postgraduate qualifications will be highly regarded.

Current AHPRA registration and SA EPA Radiation Licence.

Experience leading a multidisciplinary team will be viewed favourably.

Why Join Lumus Imaging?
As a national organisation, Lumus Imaging fosters a strong culture of teamwork, collaboration, and support. You will be surrounded by leaders and peers who are committed to creating a positive work environment, while also having access to supported continuing professional development to help you build a rewarding long-term career with Lumus.
On offer at Lumus:

The opportunity to work within a national organisation with a wide range of career pathways.
Ongoing upskilling in specialist clinical areas and leadership.
The chance to work closely with leading Radiologists while using advanced imaging technology and systems to deliver high-quality services to patients.
A variety of work arrangements that support work-life balance, within an organisation guided by a clear mission and strong values.

Lumus Imaging looks forward to receiving your application. This is an outstanding opportunity for the right candidate to take ownership of a visible leadership role, contribute to the launch of a new MRI service, and help shape the future of community-based imaging in South Australia. Don’t miss the chance to be part of an organisation that values its people, supports professional growth, and is committed to making a lasting impact on healthcare in Australia.

title: Joint SOF Trainer (Operations and Planning) IV - Aviation
description:
CeLeen, an operating firm of Command Holdings, is currently seeking a Joint SOF Trainer for a high visibility program providing training and exercise support to U.S. Special Operations Command (USSOCOM). The Joint SOF Trainer will plan, direct, and coordinate the activities required to execute the various portions of the Joint Event Life Cycle (JELC). The Joint Event Life Cycle is all of the events and actions required to plan, execute, and evaluate major training events that prepare US Special Operations Forces (SOF) for operations in support of the nation’s strategic initiatives. Supported entities include, but are not limited to: USSOCOM Battle staff, Geographical Combatant Commands, Exercises, Theater Special Operations Command (TSOC) and Partner Nations.

Work Environment:

  • Ability to work in confined areas.
  • Ability to work in remote and rural environments.

    CeLeen's Affirmative Action Program is available to any employee or applicant for employment for inspection upon request, to the extent required by federal regulations. The Affirmative Action Program can be accessed during normal business hours by making an appointment with the Human Resources Team.

    Basic Qualifications

    • Bachelor’s degree with 8 years experience in SOF //OR// prior (E8+, CW4+) with 10 years experience working in SOF.
    • Current, active Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain SCI eligibility.

title: Technical Record Administrator
description:
Accelerate your career with the most awarded Air Cargo Airline in Canada!

Cargojet is Canada's leading provider of time-sensitive overnight air cargo services and carries over 1,300,000 pounds of cargo each business night. Cargojet operates its network across North America each business night, utilizing a fleet of all-cargo aircraft Cargojet has been awarded one of Canada’s 50 Best Managed Companies as well as being awarded the Shipper’s Choice Award for the best Air Cargo Carrier in Canada for the past number of

Job Summary

The Technical Records Administrator duties include maintaining and updating aircraft technical records, maintenance planning and work order control. Due to the legal requirements for data accuracy, significant diligence and attention to detail is required.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Maintain and administer the aircraft record keeping process in accordance with Canadian Aviation Regulations (CARS) into the aircraft software management program.
  • Maintain Aircraft computer records and the related aircraft technical records in a current and up-to-date manner.
  • Verify and correct Journey Log Page aircraft times.
  • Ensure the timely and accurate input of corrected times into various technical record forms.
  • Input aircraft component changes and completed aircraft inspections.
  • Input aircraft defects and corrective actions taken.
  • Audit and file completed aircraft maintenance paperwork.
  • Liaise with various departments to correct discrepancies in maintenance documentation.
  • Monitor and update aircraft archives.
  • Reception relief as required.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must be, detail oriented, accurate, neat, very well organized, ability to work with minimal supervision.

title: Industrial Painter
description:
As the Industrial Painter, you are responsible for the preparation and maintenance of paint coatings, spray booth equipment, and systems, as well as for the cleaning, sanding, priming, and painting of custom machined part surfaces. The Industrial Painter will ensure the proper adhesion of both paint and coatings that are designed to withstand the rugged and challenging terrain of the forestry industry.
Location: 141 Consolidated Drive, Paris, ON
Dedicated Afternoon Shift: 2:30pm - 1:00am, Monday – Thursday
Shift Premium: $3.00 per hour for afternoons

Job Duties

Use spray equipment to apply paint and other materials to parts
Clean and prep surfaces using processes such as sanding, scraping and grinding
Remove grease, dirt, paint, or rust in preparation for paint application, using abrasives, solvents, or sandblasters
Follow safety protocols and wear the prescribed personal protective equipment to prevent injuries
Pour paint into spray guns and adjust nozzles and paint mixtures for proper paint flow and coating thickness
Monitor and identify flaws, such as blisters or streaks, and correct their causes
Sand surfaces between coats of paint or primer to remove flaws and enhance adhesion for subsequent coats
Disassemble, clean, and reassemble sprayers and power equipment, using solvents, wire brushes, and cloths for cleaning
Ensure all paint-related waste is properly labelled, stored, and disposed of
Safely operate overhead cranes to move material to and from paint booths
Work collaboratively with other production team members to meet production goals and timelines

Skills and Experience

Adapt to a changing work environment, competing demands, and the ability to deal with frequent changes, delays or other unexpected events
Attention to detail to ensure precision in painting applications
Ability to troubleshoot and solve problems effectively and efficiently
Physical requirements include standing for long periods of time, lifting up to 50 pounds, and bending
Understanding of different coatings and their properties
Familiarity with spray guns, sanders and other industrial painting tools

Qualifications

Exposure to apprenticeship programs, classroom instruction or industrial painting experience an asset, or a willingness and desire to learn
