title: ANIOS Bedrijfsgeneeskunde | Rotterdam
description:
Wat jij gaat doen

Als ANIOS Bedrijfsgeneeskunde.

  • Advies
    Medisch-inhoudelijk verzuim- en inzetbaarheidsadvies geven aan werknemers en werkgevers.
  • Beleid & preventie
    Meewerken aan beleid, PAGO/PMO-programma’s en RI&E om gezondheidsproblemen te voorkomen.
  • Opleidingsmogelijkheid
    Mogelijkheid om te ontwikkelen richting bedrijfsarts: coaching, trainingen en NSPOH/SGBO-opleiding

Wat jij krijgt

Voor wat hoort wat.

  • Een uitstekende salaris. Wij bieden jou een salaris tussen de €4.325 – en €7.208,- bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur per week), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Bovendien zijn er bij Acture diverse doorgroeimogelijkheden, zowel verticaal als horizontaal.
  • Bonusregeling. Goede prestaties gaan niet onopgemerkt voorbij. Acture beloont goede financiële bedrijfsresultaten en persoonlijke resultaten met een jaarlijkse bonus. Deze bedraagt maximaal 8% van het basis bruto jaarsalaris en wordt afhankelijk van jouw persoonlijke resultaten en de resultaten op groepsniveau, geheel of gedeeltelijk uitgekeerd aan het eind van het jaar.
  • 30 vakantiedagen. Omdat wij tijd voor jezelf net zo belangrijk vinden.
  • Auto van de zaak. Vanwege jouw ambulante functie, kom je in aanmerking voor een 100% elektrische leaseauto.
  • Vakopleidingen, trainingen en coaching. Ons continu leren en verbeteren programma biedt training on-the-job en een breed aanbod van opleidingen waar collega’s via onze online trainingsbibliotheek – de Acture Academy – onbeperkt toegang tot hebben. Als jij bij ons aan de slag gaat als casemanager bieden we jou de hbo geaccrediteerde opleiding Regie op verzuim en Ziektewet aan in combinatie met individuele coaching.
  • Een goed inwerktraject, zeer regelmatige taakdelegatie-overleggen en de juiste opbouw van spreekuren. Dit allemaal om ervoor te zorgen dat jij jouw ontwikkeling kunt doormaken in de bedrijfsgeneeskunde. Wij faciliteren een fijne werksfeer en een goed opleidingsklimaat voor jou. Zo bieden we de mogelijkheid om door te ontwikkelen door het volgen van de wo geaccrediteerde opleiding tot Bedrijfsgeneeskundige bij NSPOH.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling. Geregeld via MijnDoenpensioen van a.s.r. Zo zit je er niet alleen nu, maar ook later nog warmpjes bij!
  • Een collectieve zorgverzekering. Bij Zilveren Kruis krijg jij een collectiviteitskorting van 5% op de premie van de aanvullende verzekering. Bovendien kom je in aanmerking voor extra vergoedingen.
  • We investeren in jouw (mentale) gezondheid. Naast een gezonde lunch en sportmogelijkheden bieden we via ons vitaliteitsplatform extra ondersteuning voor medewerkers. Dit platform is speciaal ontwikkeld om je te helpen lekker in je vel te zitten en te blijven. Je kunt hier gebruikmaken van persoonlijke begeleiding door een coach, maar ook inspirerende artikelen, video’s en events vinden over uiteenlopende onderwerpen die bijdragen aan jouw welzijn.

    Locatie & reistijd
    De gemiddelde reistijd naar een spreekuurlocatie bedraagt 30 minuten. In overleg met de arts kan ook op locatie bij de klant worden gewerkt, met een maximale reistijd van 1 uur en hooguit één keer per week. We streven er altijd naar om locaties binnen 30 minuten reistijd te houden.

    Wat wij vragen

    Naast die persoonlijke match.

    • Je bent in het bezit van een wo-diploma in (bedrijfs)geneeskunde en een BIG-registratie.
    • Je bent beschikbaar voor minimaal 32 uur per week.
    • Jij bent in staat om snel te schakelen tussen verschillende disciplines, bent proactief en kwaliteitsgericht.

    Bij Acture werk je in een omgeving waar eigenaarschap, korte lijnen en samenwerking centraal staan — en waar jouw expertise echt het verschil maakt.

title: Dagtilbudsområdet SYDØST i Kalundborg Kommune søger en pædagogmedhjælper til vuggestuen i Snertinge Børnehus - Kalundborg Kommune
description:
Vil du være en vigtig del af hverdagen for vores mindste børn?

Drømmer du om at være tæt på børns udvikling – og gøre en forskel i deres hverdag med nærvær, omsorg og leg? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en engageret pædagogmedhjælper til vores vuggestue, da vi oplever et øget børnetal. Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer, men vi er åbne for at tale om timetallet, så det passer dig og os.

Hos os bliver du en vigtig del af børnenes hverdag – både i leg, rutiner og de små øjeblikke, hvor relationer skabes.

Hvem er vi?

Snertinge Børnehus ligger i rolige omgivelser tæt på natur, marker og åbne områder – noget vi aktivt bruger i vores hverdag.

  • Åbningstid: mandag–torsdag kl. 06.00–17.00, fredag kl. 06.00–16.00
  • Vi holder aftenmøder én gang om måneden og har 1–2 arrangementer om året
  • Vi er en integreret institution med 24 vuggestuebørn og 55 børnehavebørn
  • Vi har eget multirum til motorik, musik og bevægelse – og korte ture til skov og strand

I vuggestuen er vi organiseret i to stuer med ca. 13 børn på hver. Du bliver en del af et team med både pædagoger og medhjælpere, hvor I sammen skaber trygge rammer for børnene.

Din hverdag hos os

Hos os bliver du ikke “bare en ekstra hånd” – du bliver en del af det pædagogiske arbejde. Du vil:

  • være sammen med børnene i både leg, læring og daglige rutiner
  • deltage i både stuefællesskab og mindre grupper
  • være med til at skabe gode læringsmiljøer – både ude og inde
  • bidrage med dine idéer og din energi i hverdagen

Vi arbejder med børns udvikling og trivsel og er i gang med en spændende udviklingsproces omkring vores læringsmiljøer – her får du mulighed for at sætte dit præg.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har lyst til at arbejde med små børn og være tæt på deres udvikling
  • er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og god til at skabe relationer
  • møder både børn, forældre og kolleger med imødekommenhed
  • har lyst til at lære og udvikle dig i praksis
  • kan tage ansvar og bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag
  • er en god holdspiller, men også kan arbejde selvstændigt
  • ser forældrene som vigtige samarbejdspartnere
  • har en grundlæggende IT-forståelse

title: Project Manager - Texas Solar
description:
Diamond Generating Corporation
POSITION DESCRIPTION
POSITION TITLE: Project Manager – Texas Solar
REPORTS TO: SVP - Engineering and Technology LOCATION: HOUSTON, TXREVISED: 5/26
PURPOSE:We are seeking a Utility Scale Project Manager who will be responsible for the execution and delivery of a utility-scale solar project located in Texas. This role manages the project from late-stage development (pre-FID) through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and commercial operation. The Project Manager will be responsible for schedule, budget, safety, quality, contract administration, stakeholder coordination, and overall project execution. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical knowledge, commercial awareness, leadership capability, and experience managing complex utility-scale energy projects.
ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
Project Development and Execution• Lead the project through all project lifecycle phases• Manage project execution from late-stage development through COD (Commercial Operation Date)• Work with Project Engineer to coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and startup activities• Work with Director of Scheduling to develop and maintain integrated project schedules• Work with DGC Accounting to manage project budgets, forecasts, and cost controls• Work with DGC Risk Group to identify and mitigate project risks• Ensure project compliance with contractual obligations and regulatory requirements• Monitor project progress and provide regular reporting to management and stakeholders Engineering and Technical Coordination• Coordinate with DGC Project Engineer who will be responsible for managing engineering teams, consultants, OEMs, and the EPC contractor• Participate in technical designs reviews, equipment selections, and construction packages• Work with DGC Project Engineer to support interconnection and transmission coordination activities• Review constructability and execution strategies• Support performance testing and commissioning activities

  • Work with DGC Project Engineer to ensure technical compliance with project specifications and industry standards Construction Management• Work with DGC Construction Manager and DGC Project Engineer to oversee:▪ Coordination of EPC contractors and field construction activities including construction safety performance▪ Track schedule milestones and construction progress▪ Manage change orders and scope modifications▪ Coordinate outage planning and energization activities▪ Ensure quality assurance and quality control requirements are met▪ Participate in site inspections and project meetings Commercial and Contract Management• Support contract negotiations and procurement activities• Work with DGC Project Engineer to administer EPC, equipment supply, and service contracts• Track project invoicing and payment applications• Coordinate insurance, warranties, and claims management• Support financing and lender due diligence activities Stakeholder Management• Serve as primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders• Coordinate with Oncor, ERCOT and regulatory agencies, landowners, and contractors• Support executive presentations and project updates• Maintain effective communication across cross-functional teams Safety and Compliance• Promote a strong safety culture across all project activities• Ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations• Support implementation of company safety programs and procedures• Monitor contractor compliance with safety standards• Work with DGC Project Engineer and internal compliance teams to ensure adherence to NERC, utility, and regulatory requirements where applicable

QUALIFICATIONS:
Education• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field required• PMP certification preferred• MBA or advanced technical degree considered a plus
Experience• 5–15+ years of project management experience in utility-scale energy infrastructure projects• Experience managing utility-scale solar or power generation projects

  • Experience with EPC contract administration and construction execution• Familiarity with utility interconnection processes and transmission systems• Experience managing multi-million-dollar capital projects• Experience working with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and regulatory agencies preferred Technical Skills• Strong understanding of utility-scale power generation systems• Familiarity with substations, transmission interconnections, and high-voltage systems• Understanding of project scheduling software (Primavera P6)• Knowledge of project controls, budgeting, and forecasting• Familiarity with construction management processes and field execution• Understanding of permitting and environmental compliance requirements• Familiarity with ERCOT power market structures preferred

Leadership Competencies• Strong leadership and organizational skills• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities• Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills• Ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments• Strong negotiation and conflict resolution capabilities• Detail-oriented with strong execution focus
Preferred ExperienceCandidates with experience in the following areas are strongly preferred:• Utility-scale solar projects• ERCOT market experience• Owner’s representative or independent engineer support• Due diligence and project finance support• Commissioning and startup management• Renewable energy integration
Work Environment• Combination of office, remote, and field-based work• Frequent travel to project sites and stakeholder meetings• Ability to work in active construction and industrial environments• Occasional extended work hours during critical project milestones

Salary Range: $150,000.00 - $200,000.00

title: Methods Engineer Technologist
location: Victoria, BC, CA; Calgary, AB, CA
description:
Job Summary
As a Methods Engineer Technologist, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining manufacturing documentation for the assembly processes for our aircraft, sub-assemblies, and parts in alignment with type design specifications. You will play a key role in researching and recommending engineering changes to enhance efficiency, quality, and compliance. Additionally, you will collaborate closely with Suppliers, Production, Quality, Procurement, and other internal teams to address technical challenges and optimize manufacturing workflows. Your expertise will directly support seamless operations and continuous improvement across the production environment.
This position would be located at our Calgary, Alberta or Victoria, British Columbia offices.
Direct Accountabilities

Create and revise Product Structures/Routings and Work Instructions (WI) to define parts, processes, sequence and special instruction required to purchase or build a part/assembly.
Define the condition of supply of detail parts and assemblies, create and revise Condition of Supply Documents.
Create Assembly Manuals to define assembly requirements and special instructions for structural, system and electrical installations and assemblies on the aircraft.
Define the tools required for manufacturing or assembly of aircraft components.
Create and revise supplemental planning documentation to fully define the build sequence of the aircraft assembly and sub-assemblies.
Record and submit Change requests for changes to build, design and tools required to improve efficiency and quality of builds including Make vs Buy decisions.
Investigate root cause of manufacturing problems and liaise with other functions to analyze potential solutions by evaluating cost, impacts and risks of a change in production.
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives including internal/external audits.
Assist Supply Chain and Suppliers to work through technical challenges in manufacturing.
Assist Planning in execution of Non-Conformance Management Tasks (i.e... Work order instructions).
Assist Area Managers in developing plans to increase efficiency including acquisition and implementation of new equipment.
Assist in developing and rolling out technical skills training for manufacturing and assembly personnel to support the QMS.
Assist training of Production, QC and Methods Engineering and co-op personnel.

Education Required

Degree or diploma in Engineering or Engineering Technology.

Experience, skills, and attitude
Required

5+ years of progressive hands-on experience in a large component manufacturing environment, preferably in the aerospace industry.
Previous experience in a Manufacturing Engineering, planning or Methods role.
Knowledge of the fabrication and assembly of aircraft parts.
Working knowledge of cost accounting and cost estimating.
Knowledge of Aerospace engineering and manufacturing principles and techniques.
Ability to apply sound engineering principles to operational and process design issues.
Ability to read and interpret aircraft engineering drawings.
Advanced knowledge in MS Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Familiar with computer aided design software such as CATIA, Envoia, etc.
Familiar with one or more Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software systems.
Ability to manage and act on multiple projects and priorities at one time.
Innovative thinking and have a good decision-making process.
Strong customer focus and good interpersonal skills.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Hela samhället ställer om mot en fossilfri framtid. Vi vill visa vägen i utvecklingen av vår bransch, så att fler kan ta sig fram, ta hand om sitt fordon och driva verksamheter med ett så lågt klimatavtryck som möjligt. Vill du vara med och bidra till hållbar utveckling, på riktigt? Välkommen att följa med på vår resa!

Vill du vara med och modernisera en komplex IT-infrastruktur och samtidigt bygga grunden för framtidens hybrid- och cloudplattform? Vi söker nu en erfaren Infrastructure Engineer som vill kombinera gedigen infrastrukturkompetens med automation, modernisering och platform engineering.

Om rollen

OKQ8 etablerar ett nytt Platform Engineering Team i Stockholm. Teamet ska lägga grunden för vår nya cloud- och infrastrukturstrategi och blir en central möjliggörare i OKQ8:s fortsatta transformation.

Teamet arbetar tvärfunktionellt och nära utvecklings-, cloud-, nätverks- och cybersäkerhetsteamen. Tillsammans ska ni skapa en standardiserad, säker och skalbar plattform som förenklar leveranser, ökar graden av automation och ger utvecklingsteamen bättre förutsättningar att arbeta effektivt.

Som Infrastructure Engineer får du en central roll med ansvar för att designa, implementera och förvalta vår infrastrukturplattform. Arbetet omfattar både traditionell datacenter-infrastruktur och integration med cloudbaserade lösningar. Rollen bidrar till att säkerställa att infrastrukturen är stabil, säker, skalbar och automatiserad.

Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Designa, implementera och förvalta server-, virtualiserings- och datacenterinfrastruktur.
  • Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet, prestanda och rätt kapacitet i plattformen.
  • Delta i och driva migreringar mellan datacenter och från datacenter till cloud.
  • Automatisera drift, konfiguration och livscykelhantering.
  • Utveckla standardiserade och återanvändbara infrastrukturlösningar.
  • Arbeta med patchning, uppgraderingar, kapacitetsplanering och teknisk refresh.
  • Utveckla plattformskapabiliteter som stödjer automation och self-service.
  • Arbeta aktivt med säkerhet, compliance, dokumentation och standardisering.
  • Felsöka komplexa problem inom compute, virtualisering, operativsystem och nätverk.
  • Samarbeta nära cloud-, nätverks-, applikations- och cybersäkerhetsteam.

Vi söker

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av avancerad IT-infrastruktur och som är van att arbeta i större, komplexa eller affärskritiska miljöer. Du har en bred teknisk grund men också förmåga att fördjupa dig, felsöka och ta tekniskt ansvar inom ditt område.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:

  • Djup förståelse för fysisk och virtuell serverarkitektur.
  • Erfarenhet av serverdrift, skalning, kapacitetsplanering och livscykelhantering.
  • Operativ erfarenhet av Windows Server och Linuxmiljöer.
  • Djup kompetens inom virtualisering, exempelvis VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V eller KVM.
  • Erfarenhet av att designa och implementera klusterlösningar och hög tillgänglighet.
  • Erfarenhet av migreringar, exempelvis P2V, datacenter till datacenter eller datacenter till cloud.
  • God förståelse för nätverk, inklusive routing, switching, VLAN, VPN och brandväggsarkitektur.
  • Erfarenhet från större enterprise-miljöer eller datacenterdrift.
  • God förståelse för IT-säkerhet och compliance.
  • Erfarenhet av skriptning och automation med exempelvis PowerShell, Bash eller Python.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

  • Red Hat Linux, Oracle Solaris eller Oracle SPARC.
  • Azure eller andra större cloudplattformar.
  • Hybrid cloud, landing zones och cloud governance.
  • Infrastructure as Code med Bicep, Terraform eller ARM.
  • Docker, Kubernetes eller andra containerteknologier.
  • Leaf-Spine, SDN eller VXLAN.
  • Automatiserade deployments och CI/CD.

Som person är du analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad. Du är självgående och trygg i att ta tekniskt ansvar, men trivs samtidigt i ett nära samarbete med andra specialister. Du kommunicerar tydligt med både tekniska och icke-tekniska intressenter och ser dokumentation och kunskapsdelning som viktiga delar av en stabil och hållbar plattform.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss på OKQ8 får du arbeta i en flexibel miljö med viktiga och varierande arbetsuppgifter. Vi uppmuntrar samarbete, innovation och utveckling – och vi tror på att vi tillsammans gör varandra bättre. Här blir du en del av en familjär kultur där vi stöttar varandra, har roligt tillsammans och där du ges möjlighet att växa och göra skillnad. Vi vill vara ett företag som speglar samhället, med en inkluderande kultur som minskar utanförskap och främjar mångfald.

I den här rollen får du dessutom:

  • Vara med och bygga upp ett nytt Platform Engineering Team.
  • Modernisera en komplex infrastruktur med automation och Infrastructure as Code.
  • Arbeta med både datacenter, hybridmiljöer och cloud.
  • Påverka tekniska standarder och framtida arbetssätt.
  • Samarbeta nära specialister inom cloud, nätverk, cybersäkerhet och utveckling.

Övrig information

Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen vänligen kontakta Talent Partner; Nabila Ur-Rehman, nabila.ur-rehman@okq8.se.

Placeringsort: Stockholm, Sveavägen.
Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning

För den här tjänsten behöver du vara medborgare i Sverige, ett annat nordiskt land eller ett EU/EES-land, ha permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige eller vara asylsökande med rätt att arbeta. Du ska kunna styrka ditt medborgarskap eller din rätt att arbeta i Sverige under rekryteringsprocessen.

I rekryteringsprocessen ingår både psykometriska tester och kompetensbaserade intervjuer, med syfte att främja en rättvis utvärdering för alla kandidater.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Aquatics and CYF Programs Director
description:
Salary Rate: $70,000 – Check out the YMCA’s total compensation package!

Location: Scarborough Health & Fitness YMCA Centre

Work Hours: 37.5 hours per week

Employment Type: Contract Full Time Salaried, 6 Months (Existing Vacancy)

Number of Vacancies: 1

Anticipated Start Date: October 16, 2026

Deadline to Apply: October 5, 2026 at 5:00 pm

Be the Spark! Join our passionate team and help us to achieve great things in our community!

The Aquatics and Child, Youth and Family (CYF) Programs Director leads the development, planning, and delivery of comprehensive Aquatics and CYF programs, ensuring quality, safety, and age-appropriate experiences across all facilities. The Director is responsible for ensuring safe and compliant daily operations in accordance with YMCA and public health standards. The role also oversees departmental operations, including budgeting, staffing, and volunteer engagement. Responsible for fostering professional growth, ongoing training, and certification for Supervisors, program staff and volunteers, while providing direct program support when required. The position ensures effective workforce management and promotes positive participant experiences through leadership and relationship building.

In this role, you will:

  • Provide leadership in developing, promoting, planning, and implementing all Aquatics programs offered by the Health Fitness facility, including lessons, aquafit, leadership courses, and lifeguarding.
  • Provide leadership in developing, promoting, planning, and implementing Child, Youth, and Family programming using YMCA standards, including but not limited to soccer, basketball, karate, dance, and leagues, ensuring quality, safety, and age-appropriate program offerings.
  • Provide leadership and support to seasonal programs by assisting the Child, Youth and Family Programs Supervisor with March Break and Winter Camps and the Aquatics Supervisor with summer camp aquatic programming.
  • Develop and monitor departmental budgets, ensuring accountability and control for fiscal goals; purchase equipment (safety, aquafit), uniforms, first aid supplies, and programming materials.
  • Recruit, hire, onboard, train, schedule, supervise, and evaluate Aquatics and Child, Youth and Family Programs staff; provide coaching, recognition, and performance management as required.
  • Recruit, train, and retain volunteers, providing guidance, support, and recognition to ensure meaningful engagement in programs.
  • Oversee scheduling and workforce management for Aquatics and Child, Youth and Family Programs staff, including approving timecards, managing vacation and time-off requests, and ensuring payroll accuracy within budget.
  • Conduct internal audits and regular safety checks of the pool and program areas to ensure compliance with Federal, Provincial, and YMCA standards; implement corrective actions and follow-up as needed.
  • Provide ongoing training, communication, and professional development for staff and volunteers, ensuring completion of all mandatory onboarding, quarterly, and annual training—both in-person and virtual—while creating clear pathways for certification and growth.
  • Ensure the department has qualified and trained staff to meet fiscal goals by ensuring Instructors, Examiners, and Coaches are certified, trained, and available.
  • Provide direct program support where needed, including teaching swim lessons, lifeguarding, leading aquafit classes, and coaching or instructing Child, Youth and Family programs.
  • Act as the Designated Pool Operator as outlined in the Ontario Health Regulations 565.
  • Support the staff team in the role of Service Leader, promoting positive member experiences using the Y Way framework and fostering relationships with participants and families, responding to feedback.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

You bring:

  • Post secondary education in Recreation Leadership, Kinesiology, Physical Education, or related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years' progressive experience in lifeguarding, swim instruction, teaching aquafit classes, and staff supervision.
  • NL, Standard First Aid with CPR-C, NL Instructor/Examiner, LSS Standard First Aid Instructor/Examiner, LSS Instructor, YMCA Swim Instructor, Aquatic Manager, and Aquafit Instructor certification preferred.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with attention to detail, and proficiency in computer applications and a willingness to learn new computer programs.
  • Demonstrates strong leadership skills to motivate, coach, and develop staff and volunteers, and acknowledge and appreciate contributions; fostering a positive and accountable team culture.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with ability to establish rapport with members, staff, and volunteers from diverse backgrounds.
  • Excellent written communication skills.
  • Flexibility regarding assigned working hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays.
  • Ability to speak multiple languages an asset.
  • Excellent understanding of diversity, inclusion, and equity, including the ability to identify and address barriers for seniors, work effectively with diverse stakeholders, and integrate equity into program design.

What you need to succeed:

  • Commitment to the YMCA’s Mission, Vision and Values
  • Focus on the health, safety and wellbeing of all children, youth, and vulnerable people in YMCA programs including understanding legal and moral obligations related to reporting suspected child abuse to Child Protection Services
  • YMCA Competencies: Accountable, Relationship-Builder, Improvement-Orientated, Team Player & Leader, Equity and Wellbeing Promoter

Why work for the YMCA?

The YMCA of Greater Toronto is a charity that ignites the potential in people, helping them grow, lead, and give back to their communities. We are committed to helping our employees reach their full potential and are recognized as a great place to work. We offer meaningful jobs and the opportunity to make a difference in the lives of individuals and the health of our communities. See what you can expect from the YMCA here.

Joining the Y means contributing to over 170 years of providing opportunities for people to shine through programs and services, such as health and fitness, licensed child care, camps, employment and immigrant services, education and training, and services for youth, families, and seniors. Learn more in our 2025–2030 strategic plan, Greater Together, which outlines how we are focused on building communities where people feel healthier and more connected to their neighbours.

The YMCA of Greater Toronto is committed to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging. We strive to remove barriers to employment and recognize that diverse staff who reflect the communities we work in enrich the experiences of our participants and our team. As an equal opportunity employer, we invite applications from all qualified candidates including racialized people/people of colour, Indigenous Peoples, disabled people/people with disabilities and members of 2SLGBTQIA+ communities.

If we can make the recruitment process more accessible for you, please let us know when we reach out about a job opportunity so we can work with you to accommodate your needs.

In keeping with our commitment to safety and child protection, job offers are contingent on the successful completion of a Police Records Check. Within the first four months and every three years thereafter, a Vulnerable Police Records Check is required. Learn more about these checks here.

The YMCA only considers applicants who are legally entitled to work in Canada. We thank all applicants for their interest, however, due to the volume of applications we receive, we can only contact candidates who are selected for an interview.

Check out the next steps in our recruitment process and see what others are saying about working at the YMCA.

title: Data Analyst (Information Technology - Analyst, IS ERP)
description:
#bh10400174

STRYKER

Title: Data Analyst (Information Technology - Analyst, IS ERP)
Location: Redmond, WA, 98052
Duration: 18 months
W2 Contract (No C2C)
Pay rate: Can go upto $60 per hour

GENERAL SUMMARY
Under the specific direction of a senior analyst, supervisor or manager; you will collect, process, map, and analyze data to support the loading of accurate data for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system implementation. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to determine how data will be transformed from the current PLM system to the new PLM system and verify and validate the data loads for accuracy to ensure a successful implementation of the PLM. In this role you will be involved with data clean-up in the PLM of data objects and the correction and maintenance of attributes and other information; you will partner with business users to implement data updates in accordance with existing business processes where applicable. You will review systems requirements and business processes, codes, tests, debugs and implement software solutions for the PLM system. You will be expected to operate in an individual contributor role that requires the use of judgment in applying expertise and is expected to work independently with minimal supervision.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the Project Lead/Work Stream Lead for Bills of Material, Parts and associated documentation
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs and business objectives
  • Complete validation and verification of data for multiple loads of data into the PLM tool.
  • Support and complete data clean-up by submitting requirements and collaborating with IT for PLM and ERP data clean-up and maintenance following the IT process for mass updates of data.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel
  • Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and insights
  • Translate complex data findings into clear, actionable insights
  • Analyze, define, and develop documentation control methodologies to support the PLM tool
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across systems
  • Automate data processes and improve reporting efficiency where possible
  • Pull data and analyze and make informed decisions and think critically
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree is required

PREFERRED/DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Proven experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role
  • 1-3 years of related experience in a business environment
  • Experience implementing and configuring PLM systems (Experience with Windchill is preferred but not required)
  • Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint)
  • Professional presentation and strong interpersonal communications skills
  • Strong proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, SQL)
  • Ability to interpret complex data and communicate insights clearly
  • Experience working in PLM or other collaborative environments
  • Proficient task management including prioritization skills
  • Self-motivated, organized, efficient and process oriented
  • Strong work ethic and Team player
  • Tactful, exercises independent judgment and discretion
  • Works well under pressure in a dynamic environment
  • Must show strong judgment and time management skills
  • Ability to independently write, review, and implement work instruction content in support of new systems and processes.

Job Description


Penguin Random House publishes more of the books people love than anyone else in the world and the Data Science team helps those books find their readers: recommendation systems that surface the right book for the right person, forecasting models that guide print runs and marketing spend, and AI-powered tools that support our publishing teams.

We're hiring a Senior AI Solutions Engineer to build the systems behind this next wave of AI work for improving operations: agentic applications, LLM-powered services, and the interfaces (e.g. MCP servers) that connect AI models and assistants to our internal data and tools. You'll work at the intersection of a world-class publishing business and the modern AI stack, and you'll own what you build all the way to production.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Design, build, and operate LLM-powered applications and services (e.g. agentic workflows, retrieval/RAG systems, classification pipelines) over our catalog, sales, and operational data
  • Stand up and maintain MCP servers and tool integrations that connect AI models and assistants to our internal data and systems safely and reliably
  • Own services end-to-end: architecture, implementation, deployment, evaluation, and monitoring in our AWS/Databricks environment

  • Raise the team's AI engineering capability: run working sessions and internal demos, pair program with scientists, and build internal tools to help accelerate AI usage across the team.

Qualifications


  • 3+ years building and shipping production-quality software, including hands-on work with machine learning or AI systems that include the following preferred qualifications:
    • Experience standing up MCP servers or comparable tool-integration layers for AI assistants
    • Experience with cloud ML platforms (AWS, Databricks), model APIs (Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI), and vector databases
    • Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in computer science, machine learning, or a related quantitative field
    • Experience applying AI/ML to commercial problems such as demand forecasting, pricing, sales and marketing optimization, recommendation, or search
    • Background in media, publishing, or other content-rich domains
  • Demonstrated fluency with the current LLM stack: retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic patterns, and rigorous evaluation of generative systems
  • Strong Python engineering skills with experience in version control, testing, and CI
  • Self-motivated, with strong communication skills and a demonstrated ability to teach and level up teammates.

title: AI Datacenter Infra engineer
description:
Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.

This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation.

Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference.

Role

Cerebras is looking for an AI Data Center Infrastructure Engineer to turn cluster architecture into precise, deployment-ready infrastructure designs.

You will own the critical step between a high-level system design and its implementation in a real data center. This includes defining rack layouts, equipment placement, bills of materials, power requirements, and port and cable mappings for compute, network, and storage systems.

Every deployment presents different constraints. You will adapt reference designs to the available space, power, cooling, connectivity, hardware, and logistics while preserving system performance, reliability, scalability, and serviceability.

You will also help automate this work. By building tools, validation checks, and reusable design frameworks, you will make each deployment faster, more accurate, and easier to operate at scale.

This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys detailed systems work, practical problem-solving, and collaborating across hardware, networking, software, and data center operations.

Responsibilities

  • Translate cluster architectures and technical requirements into complete, deployment-ready infrastructure designs.

  • Produce and maintain rack elevations, equipment layouts, bills of materials, power allocations, port maps, and cable maps.

  • Adapt reference designs to site-specific constraints involving space, power, cooling, network connectivity, logistics, and hardware availability.

  • Validate that compute, storage, networking, power, and cabling designs work together as an integrated system.

  • Evaluate design trade-offs and recommend practical solutions that balance performance, reliability, scalability, cost, serviceability, and deployment schedule.

  • Partner with systems, network, hardware, manufacturing, supply-chain, and data center operations teams throughout the design and deployment process.

  • Participate in design and deployment-readiness reviews, identifying risks, inconsistencies, and missing requirements before installation begins.

  • Support deployment teams by resolving physical integration issues and documenting approved design changes.

title: Operatør til kraftvarmeværk
description:
Har du teknisk snilde, og trives du bedst med en aktiv hverdag ude i produktionen frem for at sidde stille? Kan du bevare overblikket, når tempoet er højt? Så er du måske vores nye operatør.

Vi søger en operatør til et af landets største affaldsenergi- og biomassefyrede kraftvarmeværker – en stilling, hvor du er tæt på driften og spiller en vigtig rolle i at holde anlægget kørende døgnet rundt.

Bliv en del af en dynamisk hverdag

Aarhus skal være CO₂-neutral i 2030, og hos Kredsløb arbejder vi hver dag på løsninger, der gør det nemt at være grøn. Energi driver et af landets største affaldsenergi- og biomassefyrede kraftvarmeværker, hvor vi producerer el og fjernvarme til tusindvis af borgere.

Med reference til afdelingslederen for Driftssupport bliver du en del af et stærkt team på ca. 15 kolleger. Sammen driver vi anlægget, hvor vi årligt energiudnytter ca. 250.000 ton affald samt 230.000 ton halm og flis.

En praktisk hverdag – mest ude på anlægget

Som operatør foregår størstedelen af dit arbejde ude på selve anlægget. Ca. 90 % af din arbejdstid består af runderinger, inspektioner og praktisk drift, mens cirka 10 % foregår i kontrolrummet i samarbejde med driftsmestrene. Det betyder, at du får en alsidig og aktiv arbejdsdag, hvor du arbejder tæt på teknikken og hurtigt kan reagere på driftssituationer.

Dine opgaver

Du får en central rolle i at sikre stabil og effektiv drift. Opgaverne er varierede og kræver både overblik og handlekraft:

  • Rundering og tilsyn af anlægget
  • Betjening af halv- og helautomatiske procesanlæg (primært i samspil med driftsmesteren)
  • Fejlfinding samt medvirken til drift og vedligehold
  • Kvalitetskontrol
  • Rengøring og vedligehold af produktionsanlæg
  • Ad hoc-opgaver

Produktionen kører døgnet rundt, og du indgår derfor i 3-holdsskift som en del af en selvafløsende operatørgruppe.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

Trives i en rolle, hvor du er aktiv, og hvor opgaverne varierer fra dag til dag. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og bevarer roen, når der skal handles hurtigt.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har en uddannelse som industri- eller procesoperatør, og/eller håndværksmæssig baggrund
  • Har erfaring med tekniske anlæg i kontinuerlig drift
  • Er vant til skifteholdsarbejde
  • Har (eller vil tage) kedelpassercertifikat
  • Har (eller vil tage) kran- og truckcertifikat
  • Har kørekort (kategori B)
  • Har grundlæggende IT-kendskab (Outlook, Excel og nye systemer)
  • Vigtigt af alt, er nysgerrig på at lære noget nyt!

Da arbejdet foregår ude på anlægget, er det vigtigt, at du:

  • Er i god fysisk form
  • Trives med arbejde i højden
  • Kan arbejde i varme og til tider krævende omgivelser

Kredsløb som arbejdsplads

Hos os bliver du en del af en moderne forsyningsvirksomhed med høje ambitioner. Vi er stolte af vores rolle i den grønne omstilling og af at levere stabil energi til Aarhus.

Du får:

  • En aktiv og varieret arbejdsdag
  • Et stærkt fagligt miljø
  • Gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone
  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på udvikling og sikker drift

Praktisk information

Arbejdssted: Energivej 26, 8200 Aarhus N
Stillingen er fuldtid
Løn efter Industriens overenskomst
Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt – vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Jakob Koldborg Møller på 21204251

Hvem er Kredsløb?: Kredsløb arbejder for fremtidens bæredygtige løsninger inden for energi, varme og genbrug. Det er vores ansvar, at så meget affald fra 170.000 husstande som muligt bliver genanvendt, så vi sparer på klodens naturlige ressourcer og råstoffer. Vi leverer også fjernvarme til 95 % af indbyggerne i Aarhus. Fjernvarmen er klimavenlig og produceres af vedvarende energikilder som f.eks. havvand, overskudsvarme, halm og vind. Kredsløb er en selvstændig koncern på otte selskaber ejet af Aarhus Kommune, vi er mere end 500 medarbejdere og har en omsætning på over 2 milliarder kr. Læs mere på https://www.kredslob.dk

title: Quality Director
description:
Build Your Career with an Industry Leader
As the global leader of premium labels, MCC helps brands stand out in competitive markets and inspire positive consumer experiences. Backed by over a century of printing experience, MCC is focused on the future by developing consumer-driven innovations and sustainable packaging solutions. Working for our team, you can truly make a difference.
Quality Director
Role Summary:The primary responsibility is to provide leadership for assuring continuous quality improvement in the division. Develops and implements the organization's quality strategy and indirectly manages a staff of quality control and quality assurance professionals. Defines the appropriate and adequate procedures and measures of control for the process and satisfy client's expectation by meeting the quality standards. Performs all functions of personnel management of department employees in accordance with company policies.
Responsibilities:
Quality Improvement:

Champions continuous improvement efforts and defect reduction initiatives to establish and enforce an effective Quality Management System (QMS) and is the subject matter expert in the area of quality processes.
Utilizes Lean Sigma methodology (DMAIC, SPC, QFD, 3P, poka yoke, kaizen, etc.) to drive improvements in processes to reduce defects.
Supports supplier quality management including evaluation of supplier quality data to identify process improvements and opportunities.
Establishes and implements various training programs to drive cultural change and assure high levels of expertise, support, and compliance in areas related to quality system functions.
Coaches and develops plant Quality Managers in effective use of quality tools such as root cause countermeasure (RCCM), measurement systems analysis (MSA), statistical process control (SPC), and quality management systems (QMS).

Quality Administration:

Leads quality organization and defines areas of responsibility, personnel requirements, and operational procedures within the quality assurance program.
Establishes effective quality management systems by updating quality assurance manuals and procedures.
Reviews and standardizes control plans, closed-loop corrective action systems, and quality management systems across all plants.
Develops and administers audit plans to verify plant adherence to MCC quality management systems.
Assures supplier quality by enforcing quality assurance standards, policies, and industry/government requirements.
Collaborates with other members of management to develop new product and engineering designs and manufacturing and training methods.
Prepares product and process quality reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends. Provides cost of quality reporting.
Achieves overall financial objectives by making fiscally responsible business decisions; preparing and managing the quality assurance budget, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions.

Talent Management:

Provides performance management input for quality staff to support performance assessment, development planning, and acquisition of top talent.
Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, achieving certifications, establishing professional networks, and participating in professional societies.
Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Below are the minimum requirements of the education, experience, knowledge, and skills required to competently perform in this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Technology, Business Administration, or a related technical discipline required. Equivalent direct experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
Minimum of 10 years in a quality leadership role, including at least 5 years of multi-site quality leadership experience.
Demonstrated problem solver with direct experience coaching, teaching, and applying Lean Sigma, Six Sigma, and Lean Manufacturing techniques.
Advanced skills in Statistical Process Control (SPC), Change Management, and quality tools such as PDCA, FMEA, and Control Plans.
Certified Lean, Six Sigma, or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) required. ASQ or other recognized certifications preferred.
Required to travel up to 80%, including international travel as needed.

title: Radiographer - MRI Training Position
description:
Our Lumus Imaging department within the Northern Private Hospital offers a comprehensive range of diagnostic and interventional services including General X-ray, Fluoroscopy, Ultrasound, MRI, CT, Mobiles and Theatre, Cath Lab and Vascular procedures, and interventional procedures. This brand new hospital and imaging department opened in Feb 2024 and boasts state of the art equipment and a beautiful, clean, environmentally friendly working environment. The imaging department currently services mostly outpatient appointment bookings with some in-patient exams and interventional procedures from within the hospital which are expected to increase as the hospital increases their patient load and expands their services.

About the Role:
An exciting opportunity currently exists to join our amazing team and commence MRI training so that you can become a fully qualified MRI radiographer. As part of our team, you will be required to rotate throughout the different modalities in the department covering general Xray, CT, theatre, Cath Lab, and Vascular suite with training provided to ensure your success in all areas. You will be required to rotate through our different hospital, community centre, and medical centre sites in the local area giving you a broad spectrum of experience and work variety. Working hours for MRI once qualified are between 7am and 9pm, and there are some rostered on call shifts for our hospital site which we rotate through. We have a great friendly young team who all committed to helping and teaching each other and working collaboratively, and who have a shared vision of providing the best care to our patients in the community.

Role requirements:

Clinical experience in CT and general Xray duties, and good cross sectional anatomical knowledge
Commitment and desire to complete MRI training and achieve Level 1 AIR MRI qualification
High standards of imaging quality and patient care
Excellent communication and people skills
Flexibility to cover shift work and on call requirements
A focus on teamwork and working well with others.
University or equivalent qualifications in Medical Imaging Technology
Current AHPRA Registration and Vic radiation license
Driver’s license

If this sounds like the position for you, please submit your resume and cover letter through the Lumus Website. For more information please contact Simon Perryman, Chief Radiographer at Simon.Perryman@Lumusimaging.com

title: Integrated Health Coach (Fluent in Burmese) - Allen County, IN
description:
Integrated Health Coach - Allen County, IN

$25/hour | Full-Time | In-Person | M–F 9AM–5PM

Rate depends on language proficiency (Burmese fluency at $25/hr)

Start Date: November 2026

Location: Across Allen County, IN — wherever members need you most!

At Vanna Health, we believe that a sense of belonging and engagement in the community is the foundation for improving overall health and wellbeing for individuals with serious mental illness. We help people living with serious mental illness thrive by strengthening the community ecosystem around them. Through innovative payment models and technology, Vanna Health promotes collaboration across existing behavioral health and primary care providers, hospitals, payers, clubhouses and other community based organizations. Additionally, Vanna Health can deploy our own top quality providers and case managers, as needed, in areas where there may be a shortage of resources.

Vanna Health was founded in 2021 by a team of mission-driven entrepreneurs, working in close partnership with payers, providers, and community based organizations to promote collaboration and improve outcomes while driving down costs. We are committed to the goal of supporting all individuals with culturally competent care regardless of their race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity. With modern technology, extensive development opportunities, diverse careers paths, and a culture that values diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, we are redefining what it means to work in community health.

About the Role

Vanna is looking for a Coach with a passion for supporting individuals with behavioral health challenges to lead fulfilling lives within their communities. Vanna coaches are responsible for finding and engaging our members and then providing exceptional coaching and advocacy, partnering with our members to progress towards recovery and, ultimately, to thrive. This partnership starts with building a trusting relationship, understanding members’ personal goals, and connecting them to the best resources to achieve those goals. Coaches play a critical role in both physical and behavioral health coaching, working with clinicians and other specialists to ensure members have access to a high standard of care.

Vanna strongly believes in the power of human-to-human interaction. While accompanying members along their journey, coaches connect with members in person–within their communities and at their homes–as well as by phone, text, and email.

We deeply value the insight you will bring to the team. We are committed to helping our members flourish by improving the recovery experience, informed by our community members and those who support them.

Responsibilities

  • Engage and build trust: Responsible for successfully locating and engaging Vanna members in the community and then working with them to establish trusting, collaborative relationships with their care team.

  • Achieve enrollment goals: Reach member enrollment and engagement targets daily to support program growth and impact.

  • Support recovery and self-determination: Help community members create personal action plans and track progress toward their recovery and self-determined goals.

  • Role modeling and encouragement: Act as a positive role model for members, providing consistent support and encouragement at all stages of recovery.

  • Feedback for continuous improvement: Provide constructive feedback to Vanna technology and operations teams on existing processes and suggest improvements over time.

  • Wellness and coping strategies: Encourage and facilitate wellness strategies that enhance coping skills and support physical and behavioral health management as outlined in individual action plans.

  • Physical health coaching (training provided): Deliver physical health coaching as needed, following training provided by Vanna.

About You

Need to Have

  • Over two years of experience working directly with the people with a serious mental illness diagnosis in the field and in the community

  • Experience working in and around the communities of Allen County, IN.

  • A valid driver's license

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Fluent in the Burmese language

Nice to have:

  • Spanish fluency, or other languages

  • Certified Peer Specialist Training

  • Experience with Substance Abuse Disorders

Benefits

Vanna Health offers full health, dental, and vision benefits. 401k available.

As part of our hiring process, candidates being considered for employment will be required to complete a background check and a drug screening, in compliance with applicable laws. Because our work involves direct interaction with vulnerable populations, certain criminal convictions—including but not limited to violent crimes, abuse, and felonies involving significant risk or harm to public safety—may disqualify an applicant from employment. In addition, convictions of any kind occurring within the past five years may impact eligibility. Each candidate’s background will be evaluated in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, and any decisions will be made in compliance with those laws.

title: Associate Financial Consultant - McTavish
description:
Role Overview

Reporting to the Branch Manager, the Associate Financial Consultant plays a vital role in supporting members with their everyday banking needs while building and retaining meaningful relationships. This position focuses on delivering efficient, friendly, and knowledgeable service to help members manage their daily finances with confidence.

As part of a collaborative team of consultants within the credit union, the Associate Financial consultant offers clear, practical financial guidance at the introductory level. The role emphasizes assisting members with foundational financial matters—such as saving, spending, and managing routine transactions—while identifying opportunities to connect them with appropriate solutions and referring to internal experts when specialized advice is needed—ensuring each member's best interest remains the top priority.

The Associate Financial Consultant will also champions/ supports Assiniboine Credit Union/ Caisse Assiniboine (ACU)’s commitment to rural and agricultural communities, francophone services, values-based banking and ACU’s triple bottom line accountability to people, planet, and prosperity.

  • Support members with introductory investment needs, offering clear information and guidance on products such as term deposits and registered plans (e.g., RRSPs, TFSAs, FHSAs), and referring to specialists for more complex investment advice when appropriate.
  • Provide personalized guidance on everyday financial needs, helping members understand and access foundational solutions—including basic credit applications for personal loans, lines of credit, and credit cards
  • Support members with simple estate account processing, provide clear guidance while ensuring accurate documentation and timely handling; refer complex estate needs to appropriate experts for specialized support.
  • Responsible for opening business memberships, processing changes to signing authorities, and supporting simple business investment needs, while identifying and referring potential opportunities to specialist for more complex financial solutions.
  • Ensure all inquiries and requests for information is completed accurately and efficiently.
  • Achieve meeting personal and referral targets, as well as working in collaboration to successfully achieve overall branch targets.
  • Develop and maintain a working knowledge of processes, procedures, and industry trends—including competitor products and strategies—to ensure the consistent, high-quality delivery of sales and service to members.
  • Maintain professional confidentiality and privacy at all times.
  • Responsible for compliance and risk management, through the execution of internal policies and procedures, maintain ongoing compliance with regulatory and legislative requirements at all times.
  • Ensure that all programs, policies and process are implemented in a manner that supports ACU’s commitment to rural and agricultural communities, francophone services, values-based banking, respectful workplace and diversity, equity and inclusion.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and experience

The competencies for this position would require a minimum grade twelve diploma, plus two to three years job related experience in the financial industry or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Key Occupational Skills:

  • Strong interpersonal, verbal and presentation skills with the ability and passion to engage with others authentically, establish trust, and build long-lasting relationships
  • Strategic thinker with the demonstrated ability to understand and analyze member needs, develop and recommend appropriate products and services to support member’s financial success
  • Experience and comfort with a fast-paced, complex work environment, and the ability to manage multiple and shifting priorities simultaneously, with an orientation toward delivering results.
  • Self-starter with ability to work independently & in a team environment
  • Previous experience in a financial institution is required
  • Knowledge of Credit Union products and services is an asset
  • Knowledge of Credit Union policies, procedures and operations is an asset

Who we are

As a Certified B Corporation® and one of Manitoba’s Top Employers (2024), the culture at Assiniboine Credit Union / Caisse Assiniboine is supportive of the individual while focused on the greater community. With the widest geographic reach of any credit union in Manitoba, you’ll be motivated by shared values and encouraged to always think about how, through financial sustainability, we can do more for our members, our employees and our community.

Choosing to work at Assiniboine means that you’ll be working for a uniquely Manitoban credit union that…

  • puts people, planet and prosperity first,
  • values diversity and inclusion,
  • is committed to serving its urban, rural, agricultural, and Francophone communities,
  • supports employees through training programs and long-term career development,
  • offers a competitive total compensation program which includes bonuses, a matched pension program, and health and dental benefits.
  • is focused on social and environmental responsibility.

If doing things differently and doing more is part of who you are, join us on a rewarding journey where your personal aspirations and career goals can align. If you are interested in applying for the position, please submit your application by Monday, October 5th, 2026, at 4:00pm. We thank everyone who applies, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

We are committed to workforce diversity and actively recruit people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives reflecting the community in which we live and work. Applicants may request reasonable accommodation related to the materials and activities used throughout the selection process.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE
You'll join our design team – working alongside our Product Designer and Lead Product Designer – as a senior contributor across the patient mobile app and care-team desktop app, owning specific product surfaces end-to-end and raising the craft bar within your area.

You’ll report directly to the VP of Product, and partner closely with the Lead Product Designer on shared design system standards, growing our research practice, and raising the bar on the team’s design craft.

HATS YOU WEAR
Craft Contributor
Your work sets the example within your surface area, and raises the bar for the team around you.

Deliver high-quality, well-reasoned design from problem framing through shipped product.
Give structured critique that builds design taste and judgment in others.
Contribute to our evolving design system across web and mobile surfaces.

Researcher
You run and synthesize lean research, and share those learnings with peers.

Lead qualitative and quantitative research with care teams and Medicare patients.
Recognize when data or research is missing and go get it — designing the study, recruiting, and synthesizing findings.
Translate complex clinical workflows into clear, intuitive software interactions.

Discovery Partner
You bring a user-grounded point of view to the product decisions that shape your surface.

Participate in product decisions as a full voice, grounded in user insight.
Push back when a problem needs more framing before solutions are explored.
Frame recommendations in the language of outcomes and impact.

Communicator
You tell a crisp story that connects the design to the people it serves.

Confidently present design work to cross‑functional peers, innovation partners, and executives when needed.
Use story maps, journey maps, and similar tools so product, design, and engineering align on risks and priorities.
Bring patient and clinician voices into trade‑off discussions so core perspectives shape final decisions.

MUST HAVE

5–7+ years of experience in product design, with a portfolio showing end-to-end ownership from research through shipped product.
Strong research skills: able to run a usability study, synthesize findings quickly, and share what you learn with others.
Hands‑on with AI/ML‑powered product design. You have experimented with AI or ML features, and can explain what “good” looks like.
Experience contributing to and working within a shared design system (web + mobile), in partnership with other designers and engineers.
Solid accessibility practice baked into your work (keyboard and screen-reader flows, clear focus states, robust interaction patterns).
Familiarity with product analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude) to uncover usage patterns and inform design decisions.
Active use of AI design and research tooling (e.g., Claude, Figma Make or equivalents) to accelerate prototyping, synthesis, and research; teaches others to do the same.
Ability to craft compelling design stories that win buy-in from engineers and cross-functional stakeholders.
Comfort giving and receiving structured feedback, with genuine interest in helping other designers grow, even without a formal mentorship mandate.

NICE TO HAVE

Background in healthcare, clinical, or regulated software. You understand what HIPAA and clinical workflows mean for design decisions.
Behavioral science experience; designing for habit formation, engagement, or behavior change.
Familiarity with CCM, RPM, or chronic disease management platforms.
AI/ML product design experience in a healthcare or clinical context: conversational interfaces, clinical decision support, or data-heavy dashboards.
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility expertise in a regulated health context.

WHO YOU ARE

A builder. Most energized when you are crafting something new, not polishing something established.
Mission-driven. You care about patients and want your design work to have measurable impact on how chronic disease is managed.
Humble enough to listen deeply to a care coordinator, confident enough to challenge a product decision, and persuasive enough to translate both for executive stakeholders.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Fully remote: open to candidates in Canada or the United States. EST/CST overlap preferred for core collaboration hours.
Occasional in-person team meetings in Ottawa, London (Ontario) and Toronto, Canada areas (travel required on a quarterly basis at minimum).
Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, RSP matching, and professional development opportunities.

title: Planner
description:

Als Planner ben je verantwoordelijk voor het plannen van middelen, mensen en materialen binnen onze productieafdelingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat toegezegde levertijden worden behaald en stemt wijzigingen af met de Orderhandler.

title: Pensionskundechef med ansvar for danske og internationale virksomheder
description:
Er du vores nye kundechef med stærkt drive og kommercielt flair?

Vi søger en engageret og resultatorienteret kundechef, der brænder for at skabe værdi for virksomheder gennem attraktive pensions- og sundhedsløsninger. Er du motiveret af at opbygge stærke kunderelationer, identificere nye muligheder og levere rådgivning i topklasse, så er du måske vores næste kollega.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Som kundechef bliver du ansvarlig for din egen portefølje af danske og internationale virksomheder. Du fungerer som betroet rådgiver for virksomhedens beslutningstagere og hjælper dem med at finde de bedste pensions- og forsikringsløsninger til deres medarbejdere.

Rollen handler om mere end god service. Du evner også at spotte muligheder, udvikle eksisterende kunderelationer og skabe vækst gennem proaktiv rådgivning. Du trives med kundedialogen og motiveres af at gøre en forskel for både kunder og forretning.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Opbygge og udvikle langsigtede relationer med virksomheder og beslutningstagere
  • Rådgive om pensions-, sundheds- og forsikringsløsninger
  • Analysere virksomheders behov og omsætte dem til konkrete løsningsforslag
  • Identificere mersalgsmuligheder og bidrage til forretningsudvikling
  • Sikre en høj kundetilfredshed og en professionel kundeoplevelse
  • Deltage i kundemøder på tværs af landet og repræsentere virksomheden professionelt

Vores kunder er fordelt over hele landet, så en del af arbejdstiden foregår ude hos virksomhederne. Vi tror på, at de stærkeste relationer skabes gennem personlig kontakt, nærvær og tillid.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med rådgivning og relations skabende salg til virksomheder, både danske og internationale
  • Er stærk i dialogen med beslutningstagere og kan omsætte behov til værdiskabende løsninger
  • Har erfaring med pensions-, sundheds- eller forsikringsprodukter
  • Har et kommercielt mindset og motiveres af at udvikle kundeporteføljer og skabe resultater
  • Er proaktiv, initiativrig og god til at skabe tillid
  • Kommunikerer sikkert på alle organisatoriske niveauer
  • Trives i et team, hvor samarbejde og videndeling er en vigtig del af hverdagen
  • Behersker dansk og engelsk i både skrift og tale

Vi tilbyder

Et spændende og alsidigt fuldtidsjob, hvor du får stor kontaktflade, faglige udfordringer og mulighed for at præge udviklingen hos både kunder og virksomhed.

Du bliver en del af et uformelt og ambitiøst arbejdsmiljø med dygtige kollegaer, høj faglighed og fokus på både trivsel og resultater.

Derudover tilbyder vi:

  • Attraktiv lønpakke efter kvalifikationer
  • Pensionsordning
  • Sundhedsforsikring
  • Tandforsikring
  • En række attraktive personalegoder

Din daglige base bliver på vores kontor i Høje Taastrup.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV via den elektroniske ansøgningsformular.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Pensionsmægler og Leder for Kundechef teamet, Helle Østergaard på telefon 21204029 eller mail: helle.ostergaard@soderbergpartners.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Housing Focused Shelter Worker - Kamloops Yacht Club - Part -Time, Fixed term
description:
Walking alongside shelter guests who are utilizing the shelter and have experienced significant trauma and barriers to housing, food, and other basic needs, the Housing Focused Shelter Worker encourages them in their journey and connects them with programs and services so that they can achieve a positive, coordinated, and sustained exit from the shelter. The Housing Focused Shelter Worker will provide housing supports to shelter guests by connecting them with internal and external resources to divert them as soon as possible from the shelter and ensure they are sustainably housed. A Housing Focused Shelter Worker is on the front line and responds to participants’ needs on an ongoing basis. The Housing Focused Shelter Worker fulfills the mission of The Mustard Seed by maintaining a high level of professionalism, and respect for all who enter the building and neighborhood. Crisis intervention, meaningful conversations, case management and conflict resolution are daily occurrences for this role.

Position Type: Fixed-Term until March, 2027
Schedule: Friday - Monday - 11:00pm - 7:00am (Overnight)
Reporting to: Shelter Manager
Location: Kamloops, BC
Wage: 26.50 hourly

RFR#2268

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the first point of contact for shelter participants seeking support, providing excellent service that promotes dignity, kindness, and equity.
  • Respond promptly to individuals in crisis, addressing physical or mental health concerns, anger and aggression, and interpersonal crises. Utilize de-escalation skills to minimize harm and assist individuals in exploring healthy alternative options.
  • Enforce shelter rules, expectations, and suspensions when necessary.
  • Provide and maintain a safe, clean environment for shelter participants seeking respite.
  • Practice conflict resolution and facilitate reconciliatory conversations.
  • Assist with daily meal programs.
  • Ensure the daily operation of the shelter, including laundry, cleaning common areas, conducting security checks, and supervising shelter activities.
  • Perform various janitorial and maintenance tasks to uphold the cleanliness and functionality of the shelter.
  • Model healthy relationships with shelter participants through active listening, advising, providing appropriate referrals, and being open to spiritual conversations.
  • Be a supportive and proactive member of the team, including volunteers and other visitors.
  • Provide assistance to other shelter locations as needed, based on operational requirements and priorities.
  • Employ case management tools to help shelter participants set and achieve short-term and long-term housing goals, carrying a caseload between 7-8 clients.
  • Encouraging and supporting community participants, through a person-centered approach, to access resources and services that support them in achieving their goals.
  • Conduct housing-focused case management intake, schedule regular check-ins, and engage in daily intentional conversations with shelter participants in your caseload, ensuring thorough documentation of these interactions.
  • Collect data and maintain accurate client records in CCMS using FDARP.
  • Adhere to privacy and confidentiality standards as outlined by FOIPPA.
  • Respect and maintain proper boundaries with shelter participants.
  • Participate in staff training, attend staff meetings, and engage in one-on-one sessions with your supervisor.
  • Ensure compliance with all health and safety policies and procedures, promptly submitting incident reports through our safety software as required to help maintain a secure environment for all shelter participants and staff
  • Take initiative and use critical thinking to assess situations and make appropriate decisions to support participants.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • 1 year of experience working with marginalized populations.
  • Diploma and/or certificate in Human Services, Social Work, or a relevant field (preferred).
  • Demonstrated passion for ending homelessness in British Columbia.
  • Ability to follow organizational protocols of front-line programs to completion.
  • Experience in case management and advocacy (considered an asset).
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multi-task and adapt to shifting priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, as well as conflict resolution abilities.
  • Self-starter capable of working effectively within a cross-functional team.
  • Strong desire to work with marginalized and vulnerable populations.
  • Demonstrated teachability and a proactive attitude, with a willingness to take initiative
  • Integrity, discretion, and tact in handling confidential matters.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • This position involves working in a challenging and potentially volatile environment where you may encounter racial slurs, name-calling, and derogatory comments from community members. It requires resilience, conflict resolution skills, and the ability to maintain professionalism and composure in the face of adversity. Training and support will be provided to ensure your safety and well-being.
  • The working environment for this position requires moderate amounts of walking, climbing, standing, sitting, lifting, carrying, and daily interactions with colleagues and guests.
  • This position is often fast-paced and requires moderate amount of mental effort to analyze information and problem solve.
  • This position requires varied mental and emotional effort, must be able to respond appropriately to intense situations, provide conflict resolution, work directly with clients at risk.
  • This position requires the training in usage of a two-way radio communications; MS Office based computer programming, as well as the CCMS database system, FDARP, FOIPPA, First aid, NVCI, and SafeTALK
  • This position may be required to work out of other TMS locations based on the needs and direction of TMS.

Additional Requirements:

  • An Employment Background Check is required for all positions at The Mustard Seed.
  • As The Mustard Seed is a Christian ministry, we require our employees to agree to respect and not detract from The Mustard Seed’s Employment Values during their employment at The Mustard Seed.
  • Must have legal authorization to work in Canada on a full-time basis for anyone other than current employer.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • All Mustard Seed employees have access to the Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP), which provides support for maintaining a healthy work-life balance, addressing mental health concerns, and focusing on personal development in various areas.

Note:

  • Your privacy is important to us. The information we collect is used solely for consideration for employment.
  • We thank all candidates for their interest, however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. The Mustard Seed reserves the right to amend job advertisements. No phone calls please.
  • Please visit our careers page to see more job opportunities.
