description:
Purpose:

The Head of Safety Data Sciences provides strategic, scientific and operational leadership for the Safety Data Sciences function within Global Patient Safety. The role is designed for an accomplished signal detection and surveillance leader who combines deep pharmacovigilance expertise with a forward-thinking, technology-enabled mindset. The Head of SDS will advance modern, data-driven approaches to safety surveillance and signal management across the AbbVie portfolio, including the thoughtful and responsible use of automation, analytics and AI helping to drive AbbVie's mission to deliver compassionate and innovative treatments that enhance patients' quality of life.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead a global team of 40+ physicians, pharmacists and healthcare professionals accountable for signal detection, safety surveillance and aggregate safety data analysis across the AbbVie portfolio, fostering accountability, scientific rigor, curiosity and mutual commitment.

  • Set the strategic direction for signal detection and surveillance, ensuring approaches are proactive, scalable and scientifically robust across development and marketed products.

  • Bring deep expertise in diverse safety data sources, including clinical trial data, spontaneous adverse event reports, real-world data, literature, electronic health records and preclinical findings, and guide the team in integrating these sources to identify, evaluate and contextualize potential signals.

  • Champion forward-thinking methods for the analysis and interpretation of safety data, including exploratory analytics, advanced visualization, automation and AI-enabled capabilities, while ensuring that all approaches remain compliant with global pharmacovigilance regulations and AbbVie guardrails.

  • Continuously advance signal management capabilities through fit-for-purpose tools, technology, training and mentorship, building organizational confidence in responsible AI and digital transformation in safety surveillance.

  • Ensure strong understanding of fast-evolving global PV regulations and translate external expectations into effective internal processes, procedures and standards that maintain compliance and support high-quality safety decision-making.

  • Mentor and develop a diverse, multidisciplinary team, promoting professional growth, inclusive leadership, scientific excellence and a mindset of innovation.

  • Partner with TA Heads to ensure appropriate cross-functional Safety Data Sciences support for each therapeutic area within Global Patient Safety.

  • Partner with the Safety Data Architect team to deliver seamless, optimized and technology-enabled signal management approaches for development products, including aligned strategies, clear communication channels for ongoing monitoring and protocols for safety issue escalation and resolution.

  • Lead the SDS team in the development and execution of major pharmacovigilance deliverables, including safety assessments, regulatory responses, risk management plans, PSURs and PADERs, in alignment with TA safety physician strategy.

  • Drive continuous process improvement across surveillance, signal management and aggregate data analysis, using data, technology and stakeholder feedback to improve quality, efficiency and consistency.

  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) with 15+ years of experience in Pharmacovigilance and Drug Safety – in industry/academia and comprehensive expertise in product lifecycle from first-in-human studies to post-marketing preferred.

  • At least 8 years of leadership experience managing global teams, with demonstrated success in driving impactful change preferred.

  • Strong ability to lead diverse teams and influence senior leadership across global patient safety, R&D and Abbvie, fostering a culture of innovation and excellence in safety science and safety data analysis and interpretation.

  • Excellent skills in relationship management and communication, underpinned by emotional intelligence

  • Thorough understanding of global PV regulations, risk management, labelling and the interconnectedness of safety science, real world data and drug development.

  • Strong and seasoned leader able to lead, motivate and inspire a diverse and team located across multiple geographical locations.

title: Selger deltid - Megaflis Fredrikstad
description:
Hos oss i Megaflis trenger du ikke å kunne alt fra før, vi sørger for opplæring og kunnskapen du trenger! Det viktigste er at du er nysgjerrig, læringsvillig og ønsker å bidra til gode salgsopplevelser for våre kunder.

Det er medarbeiderne våre som gjør Megaflis til Megaflis. Her møter du engasjerte og dyktige kollegaer som støtter hverandre og skaper gode arbeidsdager sammen. Hverdagen er variert og til tider travel, og vi ser derfor etter deg som trives med tempo, samarbeid og kundekontakt. Vår visjon er «alltid fornøyde kunder».

Dette får du hos oss:

  • Et team hvor samarbeid og inkludering er avgjørende for gode dager
  • En variert hverdag med mestring og påvirkningskraft
  • God opplæring, produktkunnskap og jevnlig kursing
  • Utviklingsmuligheter og reell karrierevekst, vi ansetter ofte internt
  • Verdifull arbeidserfaring som du får bruk for videre i livet
  • Egne personalrabatter

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Synes salg er gøy og får energi av kundemøter
  • Er serviceinnstilt, positiv og løsningsorientert
  • Trives i en jobb med ulike oppgaver og til tider høyt tempo
  • Samarbeider godt og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Liker å ta ansvar, og evner å jobbe selvstendig når det trengs
  • Har lyst til å lære mer om produktene våre og bli skikkelig god
  • Er trygg på bruk av PC og systemer
  • Et sterkt ønske om å lykkes med salg
  • Ser verdien i et smil og "hei"
  • Er over 18 år

Litt om jobben:

Som selger i Megaflis er du den viktigste delen av kundenes butikkbesøk. Både førsteinntrykk og sisteinntrykk teller. Din jobb er å skape overraskende gode kundeopplevelser - du er aktiv i kundemøtene, tar initiativ og sørger for at kundene føler seg sett, hørt og trygge i kjøpet. Samtidig har du alltid fokus på mersalg, gode løsninger og et resultat som gagner både kunden og Megaflis.

Hos oss er salg hoveddrivkraften, samtidig som målet alltid er fornøyde kunder og gode samarbeid i teamet. Sammen er vi Megaflis, og det er du og teamet som skaper forskjellen i varehuset hver eneste dag.

Stillingen er en 20% deltidsstilling med skiftarbeid, inkludert arbeid annenhver lørdag. Det vil være mulighet for å ta på seg ekstravakter i høysesonger og ferier.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg og ønsker deg en Megafin dag!

Og du – hos oss er det valgfritt med CV og søknad. Bruk gjerne AI, men vær deg selv (det holder lenge). Vi vil bli kjent med deg, ikke en perfekt tekst.

Vil du lese mer om rollene og de ulike stillingene hos oss?

Sjekk ut megaflis.no/jobb-hos-oss/roller

title: Salgsassistent til Q8 København N, 12 timer
description:
Er du interesseret i en stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at tage ansvar, udvikle dig og gøre en reel forskel for kunderne? Så kan det være, at dit livs måske vigtigste job venter på dig her hos os. Seriøst!

Hos Q8 bliver du en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi passer på hinanden og sørger for, at du trives i dit arbejde. Når du har det godt, kan du give kunderne den bedste oplevelse – og det er præcis det, vi brænder for. Vores gode samarbejde internt er samtidig med til at drive den udvikling, vi som virksomhed er i fuld gang med. Q8 står nemlig midt i en spændende transformation, hvor vi arbejder aktivt med at reducere vores klimapåvirkning. Lyder det som noget for dig? Så bliv en del af Q8‑familien.

Hvad kommer du til at lave?

Som salgsassistent får du en hverdag, hvor ingen dage er ens. Du sørger for, at stationen altid er indbydende og klar til at tage imod kunderne. Det ene øjeblik hjælper du på forpladsen, det næste betjener du kunder ved kassen, tilbereder og serverer mad eller fylder varer op. Der er fart på – men også plads til grin med kollegaerne og tid til at give kunderne en god service.

Det praktiske

  • Ansættelsesform: timelønnet
  • Omfang: Ca. 12 timer pr. uge
  • Arbejdstid: Vagterne vil ligge i hverdagene, typisk i dagstimerne.
  • Start: Efter aftale
  • Løn: Grundløn for ufaglærte: 142,17 kr. Grundløn for faglærte: 151,53 kr. Derudover får du aften-, nat-, weekend- og helligdagstillæg i henhold til butiksoverenskomsten.
  • Pension: 10,7% firmabetalt pension gennem PFA. Gælder efter 3 måneders ansættelse og for medarbejdere over 20 år – med mindre du allerede er omfattet af en pensionsordning, så får du pension fra start.

OBS! Du skal kunne fremvise en straffeattest, hvis du går videre i processen.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

  • En arbejdsplads med alsidige opgaver og mulighed for at lære nyt hver dag
  • Et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det sjovt
  • En medarbejderapp med mulighed for fleksibel lønudbetaling, indflydelse gennem vores ungeministerium samt gode fordele og rabatter
  • En struktureret onboardingproces, der sikrer, at du kommer godt fra start – understøttet af vores medarbejderapp, hvor du finder guides, træning og nyttige værktøjer

Hvis du vil vide mere om, hvordan det er at være medarbejder i Q8, så læs mere på karrierestationen.

Hvem passer jobbet til?

Vi leder efter dig, der har lyst til at tage ansvar og give kunderne en god oplevelse. Erfaring er ikke afgørende – det vigtigste er din energi og dit engagement.

OBS! For at søge skal du være fyldt 18 år og tale flydende dansk, da kundekontakt er en stor del af jobbet.

Klar på at blive en del af Q8?

I ansøgningen har du flere muligheder, men for at vi kan lære dig bedre at kende, så skal du besvare nogle enkelte spørgsmål. Derudover skal du optage en kort video, hvor du fortæller om dig selv og hvorfor du gerne vil arbejde hos Q8. Vi ved godt, at det kan lyde lidt grænseoverskridende, men det behøver ikke at være perfekt eller professionelt, og du kan bare filme på mobilen.

Du kan også vedhæfte dit CV, hvis du har et, men det er helt frivilligt. Vi håber at høre fra dig!

Det kan være dit livs måske vigtigste ansøgning - seriøst.

title: Software Engineer,  Freight Control
description:
Want to be part of transforming road freight? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, autonomous and electric technologies. We build the technology that hauls freight efficiently, and we put it to work for the world's leading manufacturers, retailers, logistics providers and defense organizations, all working toward a future where moving goods costs less for our customers, and less for the planet.

Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a U.S. public road. In June 2026, Einride became a publicly listed company on Nasdaq, a milestone that reflects a decade of turning what once looked like science fiction into everyday reality. Today, our technology moves freight across North America, Europe, and the Middle East for some of the world's biggest shippers.

In this role, you will be joining one of the teams working on Saga, our freight management platform for electric transport. The platform includes systems for handling vehicle telematics, electric vehicle route planning, transport planning, and machine learning models for energy consumption. We are looking for an enthusiastic, humble and creative Software Engineer who is passionate about creating simple, beautiful and helpful solutions to empower the transport industry to go electric.

You will:

  • Use modern software technologies for software development including Go, gRPC, GCP, GraphQL, React and Typescript, For more information about Einride’s technology stack, see our Tech Radar.
  • Work in a modern organization of empowered product teams, who value fast flow of customer value, own what they build, and ship to production several times per day.
  • Contribute to enhancing our backend technology stack and architecture by having a good perception and anticipation of customer needs.
  • Design and implement integrations with Shipper TMS platforms, alongside broader platform work.
  • Understand and solve complex system requirements rooted in real-life business-to-business use cases in the transportation domain.

We expect you to:

  • Have several years of experience with backend development and you constantly push yourself to improve your skills and understand new concepts and domains.
  • Collaborate closely with product, design and stakeholders to help shape problems and not just implement solutions.
  • Have a high ownership mentality and be capable of driving initiatives from idea to delivery.
  • Stay up to date on the latest AI models and tools, understanding where they add value and how they can improve the way we work.
  • Experience with Go is not required but considered a strong plus.
  • Experience developing business systems, and translating complex business processes into effective system designs using techniques such as Domain Driven Design.

This is a full-time position based in Stockholm or Gothenburg. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.

Please note that as part of our standard recruitment process, we conduct a background control on the final candidate for this role. This may include verification of education, employment history, any relevant professional certifications or other information that may be of our interest.

title: AP Coordinator
description:

title: Myyjä, Jyväskylä Voionmaankatu 15
description:
Hymyiletkö vielä silloinkin, kun kiire painaa päälle? Sytytkö asiakaskohtaamisista ja haluat tehdä arjesta helpompaa – sekä itsellesi että muille? Jos nyökkäilit, saatat olla seuraava R‑kioskin myyjämme.

R‑kioskilla asiakkaamme tulevat hakemaan nopeutta, mutkattomuutta ja hyvää fiilistä. Myyjänä olet tämän kokemuksen ydin: palvelun ammattilainen, joka osaa ratkaista tilanteet tyynesti ja toimia omatoimisesti myös silloin, kun tehtäviä on monta.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

  • Palvelet asiakkaita ystävällisesti ja tehokkaasti – myös ruuhkahetkinä.
  • Hallitset kassatyöskentelyn, tuotteet, palvelut ja lisämyynnin tilanteet rennolla otteella.
  • Esittelet ja suosittelet rohkeasti uutuuksia sekä kampanjatuotteita.
  • Huolehdit, että kioski on siisti, viihtyisä ja hyllyt runsaat.
  • Osallistut arjen sujuvuuteen: asiakkaat, työkaverit ja sinä viihdytte kioskilla yhtä lailla.

Miksi juuri sinä sopisit meille?

  • Olet oma-aloitteinen ja rohkea tarttumaan tehtäviin.
  • Pystyt ratkomaan ongelmatilanteita nopeasti ja palveluasenteella.
  • Sykähdyt vauhdikkaasta työstä ja nautit siitä, että jokainen päivä on erilainen.
  • Haluat tehdä työtä vastuullisesti – meillä se näkyy sekä valikoimassa että arjen teoissa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen, jonka aikana opit työn perusteet ja käytännöt.
  • Mahdollisuuden kasvaa myynnin ja asiakaspalvelun ammattilaiseksi.
  • Halutessasi väylän kohti esihenkilö- tai yrittäjäpolkua: voit hakea Trainee‑valmennusohjelmaamme ja edetä aina oman R‑kioskin yrittäjäksi asti.

Haemme Jyväskylä Voionmaankatu 15 R-kioskille myyjää. Työsuhde on osa-aikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Toivomme että pystyt työskentelemään keskimäärin 28 h/vko ja pystyt aloittamaan työt mahdollisimman pian tai sopimuksen mukaan!

Arvostamme

• Aikaisempaa kokemusta asiakaspalvelutyöstä

• Kiinnostusta kahvila- ja delimaailmaan

• Kokemusta pelimyynnistä ja postitoiminnoista

Edellytämme

• Ystävällistä ja iloista asiakaspalveluasennetta

• Reipasta myyntihenkisyyttä

• Itsenäistä ja vastuullista otetta työhön

• Hygieniapassia (jos sinulla ei vielä passia ole, voit suorittaa sen koeajan puitteissa)

• Mahdollisuutta työskennellä kaksivuorotyössä

• Vähintään 18 vuoden ikää

• Tarkastamme luottotiedot osana rekrytointiprosessia

title: InfoSec Lead
description:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

The Role

Orbital has been scaling fast, and we’re scaling or security and compliance with it. We're hiring a senior, NYC-based InfoSec Lead to own our information security due diligence, compliance, and vendor risk end-to-end - bringing structure and consistency to work that's currently covered on a contractor basis.

Now is the time to bring this function in-house, focusing on automating manual tasks (such as customer DDQs), enhancing our compliance stance, and ultimately securing the Infosec function as a proactive enabler of our growth.

This is a full-time InfoSec role, working alongside our UK-based IT Manager. Whilst experience in IT operations or IT management is helpful, the Infosec Lead and IT Manager report independently to our Head of Operations and own separate (but naturally interconnected) remits.

You’ll also work closely with Engineering, Product, Legal and our external Infosec support, to keep security and compliance embedded in how the business runs, not bolted on after the fact.

Based in the US, with ideally some flexibility to come to the New York office.

What You'll Own

InfoSec & Compliance Delivery

You will:

  • Own our InfoSec strategy and roadmap: set the direction for how security and compliance scale with the business, not just an executor; identify control gaps and weaknesses, prioritize remediation, and track it through to completion.

  • Own our risk program: run risk identification, assessment and treatment, keep the risk register current. You're making the call on what's an acceptable risk.

  • Own third party risk assurance, in both directions: run vendor security reviews for vendors we bring on (or are renewing with) and own customer & vendor due diligence (DDQs) when we’re the ones being assessed.

    • Pull in support required from the rest of the business and jump on client calls when needed to resolve DDQs.

    • Drive automation on the DDQ side specifically, so it doesn’t eat a disproportionate share of your time as the function matures.

  • Own our existing and future compliance certifications: you’ll be responsible for maintaining compliance with existing standards (ISO 27001 and SOC2 Type 2) and pursuing future certifications relevant to us. Management of the compliance program will be end-to-end, and involve ISMS management reviews, quarterly access control reviews, audit evidence gathering, scheduling and remediation tracking.

    • This also includes keeping policy & public-facing security documentation (eg. our trust centre) current - so certification is a continuously-run capability rather than a periodic scramble.

  • Partner cross-functionally: work with Engineering, Product, and Legal to embed security and compliance requirements into how we build and sell, and stay close enough to product changes that customer-facing security information is always accurate.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant senior in-house or scale-up InfoSec leadership experience: you've owned due diligence, vendor review, and compliance work end-to-end inside a fast-moving business, not just advised from the outside.

  • Strong understanding of cloud & cloud security, and ideally previous technical background in IT Security or SWE / DevOps.

  • A track record of scaling due-diligence processes, not just running them manually, you know how to spot what can be templated, automated, or self-served, and you make that happen rather than just wishing for it.

  • Comfortable being close to engineering: you don't need to write code, but you're happy sitting in technical conversations, understanding product changes, and knowing enough about IT systems to weigh in sensibly on security-sensitive changes.

  • Pragmatic and delivery-focused: you know the difference between a genuine risk and a distraction, and you keep due diligence and audit work moving at commercial pace rather than becoming a bottleneck.

  • AI-literacy with working familiarity with AI governance (ISO 42001, EU AI Act etc).

  • Comfortable operating independently: this is an individual-contributor role to start, with real ownership of the roadmap rather than a narrow, audit-only remit.

  • Working knowledge of privacy law is important (GDPR/CCPA/US state privacy laws) to partner with our legal function.

Why This Might Not Be For You

  • You want to run day-to-day IT operations or manage IT staff. That sits with our IT Manager, not this role.

  • You prefer tasks defined and handed to you. This is a role for an independent decision maker... you're expected to identify what needs doing, set the plan, and drive it to closure yourself, not wait to be briefed.

  • You feel more comfortable with a narrowly-defined, audit-only remit. This role sits close to Engineering, Product, and Legal, and is expected to actively reduce manual DDQ overhead over time, not just process tickets.

Why Join Orbital

  • Shape how security and compliance scale with the business... the processes and playbooks here are still being built.

  • Genuine cross-functional influence: you'll be close to Engineering, Product, and Legal, not sitting outside them.

  • Genuine momentum: $60m Series B, doubling headcount, expanding across two continents.

  • Work alongside a leadership team that treats security as a business enabler, not just a risk function.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.

Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

Basic fabrication skills (working with tools in a shop setting to construct mounts/brackets).

You will also be responsible for maintaining our brand and sentiment measurement program, combining signals across channels to drive actions to improve our products.

  • Lead our end-to-end market research strategy, from identifying key questions and scoping research plans to conducting the work, synthesizing findings, and presenting actionable recommendations to stakeholders across the business.

  • Establish and run an impactful brand and sentiment measurement program, taking in multiple sources of data to synthesize, identify trends, and make recommendations across business organizations.

  • Drive a culture of research and user-centricity across the organization by evangelizing research findings and promoting a deep understanding of our customers.

Key Skills and Qualifications

  • Expertise in advanced quantitative market research methodologies.

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to turn complex data and observations into clear, compelling narratives.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with diverse teams.

title: Källskänka var 3e helg
description:
Om Ditt Café

Varumärket Ditt Café ägs och förvaltas av de fyra bolagen Stigs Café och Bageri AB, Agdas Café i Apladalen, Bernts Konditori AB och Bernards Konditori AB. Under varumärket samlas 9 caféer samt en produktionsanläggning/kontor som nu befinner sig i Gnosjö. Vi bedriver verksamhet på fem orter inom Jönköpings län och sysselsätter runt 70 medarbetare.

Vår affärsidé är att vara ledande på den lokala marknaden, erbjuda närproducerade bageri, konditori- och restaurangvaror i en attraktiv miljö med hög kvalitet, personligt bemötande och med kunden i fokus. Vi arbetar efter våra kärnvärden glädje, kvalitet och engagemang och vi är övertygade om att den största framgången nås genom ett välfungerande lagarbete.

Här på Dittcafe så jobbar vi tillsammans och stöttar varandra, för oss är det viktigt att vi hjälps åt och stöttar upp där det behövs, vilket då också skapar vår sanna laganda.

Bernts söker en kallskänka som vill bli en del av vårt team!

Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta med mat, är noggrann och gillar ett arbete där tempot kan variera. Tjänsten passar dig som vill ha ett återkommande schema, men också möjlighet att arbeta extra vid behov.

Om tjänsten

Vi söker i första hand en kallskänka som kan arbeta var tredje helg, natten mellan fredag och lördag. Arbetet innebär bland annat förberedelser och produktion av våra kalla produkter inför helgens försäljning och leveranser.

Utöver de schemalagda nätterna ser vi gärna att du är flexibel och kan hoppa in vid sjukdom och VAB när behov uppstår.

Vi söker även dig som vill arbeta extra vid behov under lov och ledigheter samt under perioder då vi har högre arbetsbelastning. Arbetspassen kan förekomma både dagtid och nattetid.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har erfarenhet av arbete som kallskänka eller liknande arbete inom café, restaurang eller livsmedel
  • Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och självgående
  • Trivs med att arbeta i ett högt tempo
  • Har känsla för kvalitet och presentation
  • Är flexibel och kan ställa upp när verksamheten behöver extra hjälp
  • Tycker om att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra
  • Är positiv och bidrar till en god stämning på arbetsplatsen


Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du arbeta i ett härligt team i en verksamhet där det händer mycket. Du får ett varierande arbete med möjlighet till återkommande arbetspass och extra timmar när behov finns.

Det finns möjlighet att kombinera de schemalagda nattpassen med extraarbete under dagtid, lov och vid arbetstoppar.

Arbetstid

  • Schemalagt arbete var tredje natt, fredag–lördag
  • Extra arbete vid sjukdom och VAB
  • Extraarbete vid behov under lov och ledigheter
  • Extra pass både dagtid och nattetid när vi har mycket att göra

Ansökan

Känner du att detta skulle passa dig? Då ser vi gärna att du skickar in din ansökan till oss!

Vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Cash Management Analyst
description:

We are seeking a Cash Management Analyst to join our Treasury team. In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management of the company's bank accounts, ensuring payments are executed accurately and on time, and that sufficient balances are maintained across all accounts.   • Previous experience from banking, treasury, accounting, or a similar operational finance environment.

Why Join Us?

  • Build a broad foundation in treasury and cash management with room to grow into more advanced areas.

title: Project Manager
description:
Summary
Balfour Beatty is seeking a Project Manager in Charlotte for upcoming large projects. The ideal candidate will be a results-driven construction professional with strong communication and leadership skills, capable of managing all phases of commercial construction projects from preconstruction through closeout.
As a Project Manager, you’ll lead a collaborative project team, overseeing budgets, schedules, contracts, and client relationships to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality project delivery. You’ll work closely with the Superintendent, Project Executive, and design partners to plan, execute, and deliver projects that align with Balfour Beatty’s standards of excellence and our Zero Harm® safety culture.
Essential Functions

Project Leadership: Manage all aspects of assigned projects, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, and reporting.

Client Relations: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, design partners, and stakeholders to maintain strong relationships and ensure project satisfaction.

Financial Management: Develop and maintain project budgets, financial reports, and revenue projections; review and approve subcontractor pay applications and change orders.

Preconstruction & Planning: Provide constructability input, coordinate project logistics, and develop staffing and resource plans.

Scheduling: Lead project scheduling in collaboration with the Superintendent, develop baselines in Primavera P6, and oversee regular updates and pull-planning sessions.

Procurement & Contracting: Manage subcontractor buyout, contract negotiations, and material purchasing to ensure cost control and timely delivery.

Safety & Quality: Promote and enforce Balfour Beatty’s Zero Harm® safety culture and lead quality control programs to maintain high construction standards.

Communication & Reporting: Chair Owner-Architect-Contractor (OAC) meetings, lead coordination sessions, and provide regular progress updates to clients and internal stakeholders.

Closeout: Direct project turnover and closeout documentation, ensuring all financial, safety, and quality obligations are met.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
6–8 years of progressive experience in commercial construction project management.
Proven ability to manage full project lifecycle from preconstruction through closeout.
Proficiency with project management and scheduling software (Procore, Primavera P6, Sage 300 CRE, or similar).
Strong leadership, organization, and communication skills.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing complex or large-scale commercial projects.
Demonstrated success building client relationships and leading diverse teams.
Experience in business development or early-stage project pursuits.

title: Site Management Lead
description:
At AbbVie, we are committed to transforming scientific discoveries into innovative medicines that improve the lives of patients worldwide.

We are seeking an experienced Site Management Lead (SML) to play a pivotal role in the delivery of global clinical trials. This is an opportunity to influence study strategy, lead site management activities across multiple countries, and partner with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality research that advances our global pipeline As a SML, you will act as the primary Clinical Site Management representative within global study teams, providing leadership, operational expertise, and strategic oversight from study start-up through close-out.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES

  • Accountable for driving study level global and/or area level CSM deliverables by targeted timelines with allocated resources for their assigned studies.
  • Analyze study timelines and overall study assumptions to confirm deliverables are feasible for CSM.
  • Support and communicate CSM resource needs with Country Leaders in alignment with study deliverables and milestones.
  • Accountable for study level site monitoring strategy, documented in Site Monitoring Plan.
  • Accountable to set and lead Site Engagement Strategy.
  • Ensure study-level and/or area-level timelines are maintained across the study lifecycle.
  • Provide timely and essential study information for country-level teams to execute milestones.
  • Drive site-level activities at study level and/or area level, including site selection, activation, site engagement, protocol adherence and close out.
  • Oversee monitoring activities at study and/or area level in collaboration with other assigned SMLs as applicable, ensuring quality deliverables, status tracking, and milestone adherence and acceleration if applicable.
  • Drives CSM deliverables during data snapshots and database locks, aligned to Data Cleaning Plan.
  • Ensure sites are closed per Site Closure Plan.
  • Proactively identify, evaluate, and mitigate risks, ensuring effective action plans; key contributor to Risk Assessment and Mitigation Plan (RAMP)
  • Collaborate with other assigned SMLs and stakeholders in the Clinical Study Team to address and manage risks to align with overall study execution.
  • Ensure site compliance, escalate issues, and analyze trends for continuous improvement.
  • Responsible for providing inputs on expected CSM documents at the study level and driving TMF completeness for CSM artifacts
  • Responsible from study start to close for ensuring that on-going CSM Inspection Readiness activities are completed at the study level
  • Report any adverse event within 24 hours as per AbbVie’s policies and procedures.
  • Proactively participate in AbbVie’s WHS programs, adhere to policies and promote a safe work environment at all times.
  • Adhere to AbbVie’s codes of conduct and compliance processes, including timely training and maintaining ethics and integrity.
  • Other ad hoc duties such as administrative duties, as requested.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Science or Medical fields
  • A minimum of 5 years + of industry clinical research experience including 2 year of monitoring or project management or equivalent experience on a global study.
  • Preferred exposure in study initiation through study completion in multiple phases of studies (Phase II and III, Phase I in patients). Experience in multiple therapeutic areas or disease state/indications highly desired.
  • Demonstrates a high level of core and technical competencies through management of various components of clinical trials.
  • Possesses good communication skills and demonstrated leadership abilities. Able to influence without authority in a matrix environment.
  • Competent in application of standard business procedures (Standard Operating Procedures, International Conference on Harmonization (ICH), Global Regulations, Ethics and Compliance).
  • Demonstrated good written and verbal communication skills including fluency in English. Excellent planning and organizational skills and the ability to work effectively and efficiently in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Able to work well within a team and autonomously. Thinks proactively with a strong ability to create and deliver presentations.

title: Clinical Product Lead
description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About the Role

At Headway, we're building the future of behavioral health — and increasingly, that means shipping products that providers and patients rely on every day. We're hiring a Clinical Product Lead to own the clinical judgment behind how risk gets detected, escalated, and closed out across our platform, and to make sure every product surface we build is connected to the safety systems behind it.

Headway already has real safety capability through risk detection, human triage, a 24/7 crisis partner, and more. However as our platform expands, particularly into AI tooling, so does our need for a single coherent system and point of ownership for patient safety across product surfaces.

This role sits on our Clinical Product team, partnering daily with engineering, product, and clinical operations. You'll also carry the clinical safety bar for our AI surfaces.

This is a first-of-its-kind role. You'll help define what "safe" means for a behavioral health platform operating at the scale of our network — and then build the products and systems that make it true rather than aspirational.

You will:

  • Own the clinical requirements for how patient risk is detected and mitigated through our platform surfaces including the patient portal, support chat and phone, clinical assessments, conversational intake, and more. Drive us toward one shared severity taxonomy and routing model.

  • Serve as the Clinical Product Patient Safety partner for product features that carry the potential for risk disclosure. Define safety requirements and safeguards, integrate the product into existing escalations structures, and red-team the failure points. Stay with the feature after launch to review how the safeguards performed.

  • Audit our product surfaces to identify patient safety gaps. Collaborate within the clinical team and with cross functional partners to close those gaps.

  • Support us in holding the clinical safety and quality bar for our AI surfaces such as AI-generated clinical notes, treatment planning, and conversational tools. Write rubrics, label the gold-standard cases our models learn from, and audit model output against your own clinical assessment.

  • Resolve risk-ownership questions and ensure that our policies and the platform clearly and accurately reflect that position.

  • Communicate tradeoffs clearly to non-clinical stakeholders — including when speed, scale, or automation must be balanced against clinical rigor — and push back constructively when product or technical decisions conflict with sound clinical judgment.

You will love this role if:

  • You are an Independently Licensed Therapist (LPC, LCSW, PhD, or PsyD) with 5+ years of post-graduate clinical experience.

  • You have worked inside a safety or quality system and feel extremely confident in risk assessment and safety planning, and crisis response.

  • You are a systems thinker. You can look at a set of disconnected escalation paths and see the single model underneath.

  • You thrive working quickly and cross-functionally with engineers, product partners, and operations teams. You're comfortable saying "what you’re proposing carries some risk, and here's the clinical reason why," and you know how to make that feedback actionable for people who don't share your clinical training.

  • You are a first-principles thinker who can break down fuzzy clinical concepts (therapeutic alliance, medical necessity, risk assessment, patient safety) into something concrete enough to label, evaluate, and ship against.

  • You have a working understanding of how AI models are evaluated — concepts like precision, recall, and false positive rates don't intimidate you, and you can connect them to real clinical consequences (e.g., what it means for a model to miss a safety concern vs. over-flag one).

  • You are flexible and energized by ambiguity. Headway's clinical AI roadmap will shift across the next year, and you're excited to flex across quality, safety, and product AI projects as our needs evolve.

  • You are motivated by the opportunity to improve access to high-quality behavioral healthcare at scale.

Compensation and Benefits:

The expected base pay range for this position is $127,840 - $188,000, based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.

Benefits offered include:

  • Equity Compensation

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

  • HSA / FSA

  • 401K

  • Work-from-Home Stipend

  • Therapy Reimbursement

  • 16-week parental leave for eligible employees

  • Carrot Fertility annual reimbursement and membership

  • 13 paid holidays each year as well as a Holiday Break during the week between December 25th and December 31st

  • Flexible PTO

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Training and professional development

Kalundborg Kommune er placeret i noget af Danmarks smukkeste natur – og er samtidig hjemsted for en række af de industrier der bidrager mest til den danske økonomi – med vægt på biotech- og energiproduktion.

Der bor cirka 48.000 mennesker i Kalundborg Kommune, som også er hjemsted for flere og flere uddannelser, der er med til at understøtte udviklingen i kommunen.

Du kan læse mere om Kalundborg Kommune som arbejdsplads Vores medarbejdere finde generelle oplysninger om Kalundborg Kommune Gotokalundborg lytte til vores podcast-serie Karriere på Kalundborgsk Podcast og vodcast

Vi opfordrer alle uanset baggrund, køn, religion mv. til at søge.

title: Cloud/Backend Engineer
description:
About Our Work

We are neuroscientists who build ground-breaking technology for the spatial computing era. We stimulate nerves to create artificial tactile sensations, creating new, more meaningful connections to the user for notifications, 3D digital content, physical AI, health information, and beyond. Our first products will be mobile, wearable devices that stream haptic data from multiple digital sources to create meaningful sensations of touch.

What You'll Be Doing

The Cloud/Backend Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and troubleshooting cloud-based software and database solutions, including interfaces with SDKs and middleware. This role works independently on complex technical objectives, provides technical leadership and problem-solving expertise, and collaborates with software, development, leadership, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, reliable solutions aligned with product and business goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, testing, and maintenance of cloud backend software and database solutions.

  • Develop and maintain interfaces between cloud backend systems, SDKs, middleware, and other software components.

  • Work independently on complex technical objectives with direction from the Director of Software.

  • Provide technical leadership and problem-solving expertise for cloud and backend development initiatives.

  • Design and implement data interfaces and infrastructure to support data analysis and application requirements.

  • Develop, implement, and improve testing, validation, and troubleshooting protocols for cloud-based software and databases.

  • Collaborate with software, development, firmware/SDK, and cross-functional teams to define requirements and deliver technical solutions aligned with company goals.

  • Troubleshoot complex cloud, backend, database, SDK, and middleware integration issues and drive them through root-cause analysis and resolution.

  • Partner with the Director of Software to identify and provide guidance on test protocols, technical approaches, and development strategies.

  • Evaluate technologies, tools, solutions, and vendors and support vendor evaluation and selection as needed.

  • Identify technical risks and develop solutions to minimize impacts to product quality, performance, cost, and schedule.

  • Maintain high standards for software quality, reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.

  • Communicate technical results, recommendations, risks, and timelines to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development team members as appropriate.

  • Other duties as assigned

What You'll Need for This Position

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on software, cloud, and/or backend development experience.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and supporting cloud-based backend applications, services, or platforms.

  • Strong understanding of backend software architecture, APIs, databases, testing, debugging, and troubleshooting.

  • Experience working with cloud platforms and services, such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or comparable technologies.

  • Experience designing, developing, and working with relational and/or NoSQL databases.

  • Experience developing interfaces and integrations between backend systems, SDKs, middleware, APIs, and other software components.

  • Strong programming skills in one or more relevant languages such as Python, Java, C#, C++, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.

  • Experience developing and executing software testing and validation protocols.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues.

  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of complex technical objectives and drive them through execution.

  • Ability to provide technical leadership and influence engineering decisions without direct people-management responsibility.

  • Strong understanding of data management, data interfaces, and systems supporting data analysis.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, logging, and performance optimization.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to software quality, reliability, scalability, and performance.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to work with software, development, leadership, and external vendors.

  • Ability to assess technical risks and understand the potential impact of engineering decisions on product schedules, costs, system performance, and business objectives.

  • Experience evaluating technologies, tools, development approaches, or external vendors is highly desirable.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and make sound technical decisions that support product and business objectives.

What's in It for You

Work closely with cutting-edge technology. You'll be hands-on with novel neural haptic technology that's defining the future of spatial computing and immersive experiences.

Work in a close-knit, startup environment. We strive to create an intellectually stimulating and collegial working environment. Our energy for inventing, creating, and learning spans work and play: we have regular happy hours, plan field trips, play games, play music, and generally have a good time.

An early employee experience. We are an early-stage deep tech startup company that requires all members to contribute across the entire business. On any given day, there will be new challenges and new demands to propel the business forward. We expect all employees to be able to dive into any new challenges that present themselves, even if they are beyond the job description above. If your are driven by the desire to see success and to create new tech not seen by the world previously, you will fit right in to the team's culture.

Compensation & Benefits

Afference is committed to providing the sense of touch for the evolution of the human connection to technology and the future of the digital experience. We are leading this effort through deep science and technology, which provides unique experiences compared to classical haptic technologies. Our lean team of experts demands a high level of excellence but can compensate with the commensurate upside potential of an early-growth startup in a high-growth sector of extended reality.

Compensation offers depend on skills, qualifications, and experience, and range between:

$147,000 to $165,000 per year at 100% FTE

Benefits include:

  • Medical, dental vision, life, STD, FSA, additional company perks

  • Equity incentive

  • Self-managed PTO

description:

Job Description

Division: Revenue Cycle

Job Title: CDI QA Reviewer & Educator

Job Code:

Position Summary

The CDI QA Reviewer and Educator strengthens clinical documentation quality across the organization through comprehensive audits, targeted education, and expert guidance. This role conducts detailed reviews of medical record documentation and CDI workups, ensuring compliance with ICD‑10‑CM/PCS, DRG methodology, and regulatory standards while supporting accurate and defensible documentation practices.

The position enhances physician documentation quality, promotes accurate DRG assignment, and improves clinical clarity by delivering focused education to CDI specialists and providers. As a subject matter expert, the CDI QA Reviewer and Educator advances documentation improvement efforts, supports coding integrity, and drives continuous organizational improvement.

title: Regional Climate & Data Analyst — MERIAM
description:
Position: Regional Climate & Data Analyst — MERIAM

Department: MERIAM(TECH)

Contract Duration: Nine Months
Reports to: MERIAM Regional Project Coordinator (Nairobi)

Location: Nairobi (HEARO)

Salary Grade: HEARO BG 5 / Officer

Last updated: August 15, 2026

Action Against Hunger leads the global movement to end hunger. We innovate solutions, advocate for change, and reach 28 million people every year with proven hunger prevention and treatment programs. As a nonprofit that works across 55 countries, our 8,990 dedicated staff members partner with communities to address the root causes of hunger, including climate change, conflict, inequity, and emergencies. We strive to create a world free from hunger, for everyone, for good.

Action Against Hunger USA is part of the Action Against Hunger International network. As an independent NGO, Action Against Hunger USA currently manages operations in 8 countries: Kenya, South Sudan, Somalia, Tanzania, Uganda, Ethiopia, Zambia and Haiti.

Job Summary

The Regional Climate and Data Analyst supports MERIAM through the acquisition, processing and management of climate, environmental and program data, and the production of analytical outputs and acute malnutrition forecasts to support early warning and anticipatory action across the Horn and East Africa region.

Purpose: To coordinate the gathering and lead the preparation and management of climate, environmental and program data and analytical outputs that support MERIAM’s acute malnutrition forecasting, early warning and anticipatory action.

Engagement: Works with regional and country teams to coordinate data and analytical processes, engages with government, technical, academic and other partners on data acquisition and quality, and supports information exchange and the dissemination of MERIAM outputs.

Delivery: Coordinates the acquisition of quality-assured and harmonized datasets and supports the generation of analytical outputs, dashboards and forecasting products for MERIAM modelling, early warning and anticipatory action.

Essential Job Duties

Climate and Environmental Data Acquisition and Processing – 40%

Acquire, process and quality-assure climate and environmental data, including rainfall, temperature, vegetation, floods and droughts.

Generate sub-national climate and environmental indicators across MERIAM countries.

Maintain and adapt geospatial data-processing pipelines for multi-country and country-specific use.

Analyze climate and environmental anomalies relevant to nutrition outcomes.

Maintain and update climate and environmental datasets according to agreed reporting cycles.

Data Management, Quality and Analytical Support – 40%

Coordinate data gathering, cleaning, validation and consolidation across MERIAM countries.

Conduct routine data quality checks and maintain harmonised, analysis-ready datasets.

Maintain organised and well-documented data repositories for modelling and analytical use.

Support the development of dashboards, data summaries, analytical reports and forecasting products.

Ensure appropriate data confidentiality, anonymisation and data-governance practices.

Documentation, Coordination and Project Support – 20%

Coordinate data submissions and follow up on data availability and quality with country teams.

Maintain documentation of data sources, methodologies, workflows and analytical processes.

Support technical coordination with country teams, regional colleagues, academic institutions and other partners.

Support the development and dissemination of analytical briefs, knowledge products and other MERIAM outputs.

Maintain project documentation, workplans, deliverable trackers and reporting requirements.

Support routine project coordination, reporting, procurement and related administrative processes.

Other duties as required

Perform other related duties as assigned.

III. Supervisory Responsibilities

N/A

IV. Fiscal Responsibility

N/A

V. Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to sit for long periods and to concentrate on work, including typing, and turn out heavy volumes of work accurately, within short time frames under stressful situations in the context of a moderately noisy office with interruptions.

To travel to the field, the employee must attest to a level of physical fitness capable of enduring physically difficult, highly stressful situations which may include the necessity to walk long distances, to eat a limited diet and/or to reside in potentially uncomfortable housing or tents.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

VI. Working Conditions, Travel and Environment

The duties of the job require regular job attendance at least five days per week. Must be available to work outside normal office hours or on the weekends as required by contact with the missions, mission security, or other obligations.

Must be able to travel as required for standard domestic and international business travel as well as to the missions if appropriate. While visiting the field, the employee may be exposed to precarious settings under high security risks and/or very basic living conditions and outside weather conditions, as well as infectious diseases.

VII. Gender Equality Commitments & Zero Tolerance to Abuse

Foster an environment that reinforces values of people of all genders equal access to information.

Provide a work environment where people of all genders must be evaluated and promoted based on their skills and performance.

Promote a safe, secure, and respectful environment for all stakeholders, particularly for children, beneficiaries, and members of staff.

Help to prevent any type of abuse including workplace harassment and sexual abuse and exploitation.

Respect beneficiaries’ women, men, children (boys and girls) regardless of gender, sex orientation, disability, religion, race, color, ancestry, national origin, age, or marital status.

Value and respect all cultures.

VIII. Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field related to Environmental or Climate Science, Geography/GIS, Remote Sensing, Statistics, Data Science, or a closely related quantitative discipline, with at least two (2) years of relevant experience in data analysis, environmental/geospatial data processing, or nutrition and food-security information systems.

IX. Required Skills & Experience

Minimum of 2 years’ experience in data analysis, climate/environmental or geospatial data processing, or related information systems.

Experience acquiring, processing and analysing satellite, climate and environmental data at sub-national level.

Experience in data cleaning, validation, transformation, analysis and preparation of analysis-ready datasets

Proficiency in R or equivalent analytical software, including raster and vector geospatial data processing

Experience with terra, sf, exactextractr or comparable geospatial tools is an advantage

Experience in data visualisation and dashboards using R Shiny or comparable tools is desirable

Ability to manage multiple tasks, work independently and collaborate effectively with regional and country teams

Verbal and written communication skills

Highly organized, detail-oriented and able to work under pressure.

IT skills and experience

Fluency in English is required

title: LOCAL CASE INTAKE ADVISOR
description:
Introduction to role

Are you ready to turn vigilance into real-world impact by ensuring every safety report is handled accurately and on time? In this role, you will safeguard patients by transforming safety data into compliant action, supporting local Marketing Companies and collaborating closely with our international patient safety network.

You will act as a key liaison between local teams and Global Business Services Patient Safety (GBS-PS). You will manage the intake, processing, and communication of Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs). Trusted to take ownership of routine activities and resolve problems of moderate scope and complexity, you will help strengthen compliance, improve processes, and enable timely, well-informed decisions. Can you see yourself guiding colleagues through complex safety questions and making the right call when it matters?

Accountabilities

  • ICSR Intake and Processing: Support the end-to-end intake, review, assessment, processing, tracking, and reporting of ICSRs from clinical, post-marketing, literature, and systematically gathered data sources, ensuring accurate data capture and compliant handling.
  • Regulatory Liaison: Support timely responses to Health Authority queries relating to ICSRs and patient safety, with clear documentation and traceability.
  • Quality Management and Compliance: Contribute to procedural document management, AE/PV training for internal teams and third-party suppliers, quality incident reporting, corrective and preventive actions, late-log processing, and continuous preparation for evaluations and examinations.
  • Data Reconciliation and Screening: Perform reconciliations with internal and external partners to ensure the accuracy of pharmacovigilance data; conduct periodic screening of regulatory authority databases for adverse events and, where required, literature searches for the local product portfolio.
  • Identify and route Product Quality Complaints and product security complaints. Ensure the information needed for adverse event reporting is collected and addressed accurately.
  • Collaborator Mentorship: Provide patient safety expertise and mentorship to local functions, including Marketing, Sales, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, and other collaborators, on issue management, risk management, action plans, data gathering, and monitoring outcomes.
  • External Partner Oversight: Support external service providers and collaboration partners in meeting AstraZeneca and local regulatory pharmacovigilance requirements, with clear expectations and effective working relationships.
  • Follow-up and Documentation: Undertake manual follow-up using approved call scripts and resources; maintain effective filing, archiving, and retrieval practices for patient safety documentation.
  • Training and Systems Enablement: Complete all required patient safety training and maintain access to relevant safety, regulatory, quality, HR, and commercial systems, as appropriate.
  • Knowledge Stewardship: Maintain current knowledge of Taiwan regulatory requirements, global and local procedures and guidance, marketed product status, reference documents, and conditions, obligations, or commitments relating to product safety and the safe use of AstraZeneca products.
  • Continuous Improvement and Projects: Contribute to pharmacovigilance activities for organised data collection programmes, digital and social media activities, licence partners, externally sponsored research, and other external collaborations; participate in ad-hoc local Marketing Company projects that enhance operational excellence.
  • Values and Standards: Conduct all activities in line with AstraZeneca values, the Code of Conduct, established pharmacovigilance guidelines, and the policies and standards relevant to the role.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • Degree or equivalent experience in Pharmacy, Medicine, Science, or a related field
  • Strong pharmacovigilance and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice knowledge
  • Knowledge of relevant Health Authority regulations, including Taiwan requirements
  • Cross-functional and collaborative approach
  • Effective and lateral thinking with strong problem-solving capability
  • Vendor and external service provider management experience
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Fluency in Chinese and English
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Join a distributed team committed to vigilance and precision in achieving meaningful outcomes for patients. You will work with colleagues across functions and borders, combining scientific rigour with digital tools to support smarter, faster decisions. Here, you are entrusted with responsibility, encouraged to challenge how things are done, and improve them, often alongside colleagues and partners who bring fresh perspectives. We value kindness alongside ambition and support your growth with opportunities to learn, contribute, and shape changes that matter.

title: Apothekersassistent backoffice ziekenhuisapotheek
description:
Ben jij een enthousiaste apothekersassistent met een scherp oog voor details? En vind je het leuk om een belangrijke schakel te zijn in de medicatiebegeleiding voor onze patiënten in een groeiende organisatie? Dan is deze vacature zeker iets voor jou!

Wat ga je doen?
Als apothekersassistent backoffice ben je verantwoordelijk voor farmaceutische patiëntenzorg op het gebied van geneesmiddelvoorziening voor zowel patiënten in het ziekenhuis als in verpleeghuizen. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de aseptische bereidingen. Je takenpakket bevat o.a. interne en externe leveringen van medicatie, baliewerkzaamheden voor de kliniek, medicatiebewaking voor verpleeghuizen, cytostatica en aseptische bereidingen, zoals cassettes en totaal parenterale voedingen. Je werkt in een enthousiast team van backoffice apothekersassistenten en farmaceutisch medewerkers. In de apotheek wordt gewerkt met 2 verschillende systemen; Chipsoft HIX voor het ziekenhuis en Medimo voor de verpleeghuizen.

Ons ziekenhuis kenmerkt zich door een kleinschalige en warme werkomgeving, waar collega’s elkaar écht kennen, waar collegialiteit vanzelfsprekend is en waar professionaliteit en betrokkenheid hand in hand gaan.

Wat bieden wij jou?
Wij bieden een jaarcontract met de mogelijkheid tot verlenging met een salaris volgens de cao Ziekenhuizen, afhankelijk van ervaring en opleiding. Daarnaast bieden wij onder andere:

  • Warm welkom & collegiale sfeer – Persoonlijke inwerkperiode, korte lijnen en sterke band met collega’s
  • Vitaliteit & balans – Fit@Work, gezonde werk-privébalans en energie in je werk
  • Ontwikkeling & groei – Leerhuis, leerplein en PIT-programma om je talenten te ontdekken
  • Aantrekkelijke voorwaarden – PLB-uren, fietskorting, bedrijfsfitness, 8.33% vakantietoeslag & eindejaarsuitkering
  • Makkelijk bereikbaar – Goede OV-verbindingen, fietsenstalling en parkeren op het terrein tegen gereduceerd tarief

Wat vragen wij van jou?

  • Aantal uur – Beschikbaar voor 24 uur per week met werktijden tussen 07.30 en 16.30 uur, waarbij de vrijdag een vaste en verplichte werkdag is
  • Opleiding – Je hebt het diploma apothekersassistent, bij voorkeur met enige jaren werkervaring in een (ziekenhuis)apotheek
  • Extra – Je hebt geen bezwaar tegen consignatiediensten in de avonden en weekeinden. Tijdens deze dienst ben je telefonisch bereikbaar van 23.00 tot 08.00 uur doordeweeks en in het weekend van 16.30 tot 08.00 uur. Deze vinden gemiddeld één keer per maand plaats en worden uiteraard extra vergoed.

Word jij onze nieuwe collega?
Maak van deze vacature jouw nieuwe baan bij IJsselland Ziekenhuis! Solliciteer direct via de sollicitatiebutton.

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de functie? Neem contact op met dhr. G. van der Leek, Teamleider bedrijfsvoering, staf en backoffice, telefoonnummer 010 - 258 51 36. Heb je vragen over het sollicitatieproces? Dan helpt onze recruiter je graag verder.

title: Myyjiä joulusesonkiin (20 h/vko) K-Citymarket Tornio
description:
Olet sitten kokenut asiakkaiden hurmaaja tai hyvällä palveluasenteella varustettu tulevaisuuden osaaja - Tervetuloa tekijöiden taloon!

Hae kausityöhön, josta saat palkan lisäksi arvokasta työkokemusta, hyvän fiiliksen ja mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi K-ryhmässä.

Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin?

Meillä on työporukka, jossa viihdytään oikeasti – ei vaan puheen tasolla vaan se myös näkyy arjessa ja henkilöstötutkimus osoittaa, että meillä on hyvä tehdä töitä. Yhdessä tuumin jaetaan onnistumiset ja ratkotaan haasteet. Me huolehdimme, että pääset porukkaan ja sujuvasti alkuun. Sinä tuot asenteen ja me perehdytämme. Esihenkilösi onkin aidosti arjessa läsnä. Hän sparraa, kuuntelee ja tukee kehittymistäsi.

Uskomme, että työn oppii parhaiten tekemällä. Siksi etsimme rohkeasti töihin tarttuvia, kaupan alasta aidosti innostuneita tekijöitä, joita yhdistää halu ylittää asiakkaidemme odotukset.

Olet asiakkaan päivän piristys

Kassalla sinä olet usein se viimeinen henkilö, jonka asiakas kohtaa. Siksi roolisi on erityisen tärkeä: varmistat, että asiakkaalle jää hyvä fiilis ja ilahduttava muistijälki. Pääset vaikuttamaan asiakkaidemme arkeen joka päivä!

Mitä työ sisältää?

Työhösi kuuluu asiakkaiden ystävällinen huomiointi ja tervehtiminen sekä ostosten ja maksutapahtumien sujuva ja huolellinen käsittely linja- tai itsepalvelukassalla. Huolehdit myös siitä, että asiakas saa kaikki edut, tuotteet ovat siististi esillä ja kaupassa on viihtyisää.

Meille on tärkeää, että teemme kaupassa tiivistä yhteistyötä yli osastorajojen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa sitä, että osastotyöstä riennetään apuun kassalle ruuhka-aikana ja kassalta autetaan taas osastotyötä tekeviä, jotta saamme pikaisesti upeat uutuudet esiin kuormasta ilahduttamaan asiakkaitamme.

Nämä taidot tukevat onnistumistasi

  • Sydämesi sykkii asiakaspalvelulle -haluat tarjota parhaan mahdollisen asiointikokemuksen jokaiselle asiakkaalle
  • Asiakasmäärämme ovat ajoittain suuria, joten arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, huolellisuutta ja reipasta työotetta
  • Työtä pelkäämätön ja joustava asenne
  • Pystyt työskentelemään kaupan aukioloaikoina ja olet vähintään 18 vuotta
  • Kykenet työskentelemään suomeksi

Voit näyttää meille, että olet valmis oppimaan ja tarttumaan uusiin mahdollisuuksiin. Suorita maksuton LET'S K! Duunitaidot -koulutus ja liitä suoritusmerkintä hakemukseesi. Koulutuksesta saat käytännön vinkkejä työnhakuun, oman suunnan löytämiseen ja työelämään. Koulutuksen löydät osoitteesta .

Mitä saat meiltä?

  • Mukavan ja osaavan työyhteisön, joka auttaa ja tukee arjessa
  • Kattavan perehdytyksen sekä oman kummi KAMU:n, joka auttaa sinua ja huolehtii, että pääset osaksi porukkaamme ja työssäsi hyvin alkuun
  • Monipuolisia kaupan eri tehtäviä. Meillä voit rakentaa pitkänkin uran ja tuemme sinua osaamisesi kehittämisessä
  • Kaupan TES:n mukaisen palkan + ilta- ja viikonloppulisät
  • Suomen Aktiivisimpana työpaikkana tarjoamme HeiaHeia-hyvinvointiapin ja erilaisia liikuntahaasteita
  • Tarjoamme henkilökunnan ostoedun omaan tavarataloosi.

Käy myös tutustumassa ammattilaistemme työskentelyyn Cittarissa: Töissä myyjänä K-Citymarketissa

Pääasiallisesti joulusesonkimme kestää marraskuun alusta tammikuun alkuun ja työsuhde sijoittuu tälle aikavälille joustavasti. Myymälätyö on vuorotyötä ja työvuorot ajoittuvat kaikille viikonpäiville kaupan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti.

Mikäli joulusesongin aikana huomaat, että kauppa on intohimosi, pyrimme tarjoamaan hyville, jatkosta kiinnostuneille työntekijöille mahdollisuuden työllistyä myöhemminkin tai jatkaa työsopimusta.

Luo oma urapolkusi K-Citymarketissa! Tehdään hyvä kauppa – tule K-ryhmään.

📅 Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 4.10.2026 oheisen linkin kautta. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana.

KCM Tornion aukioloajat sijoittuvat ma-la klo 8-21 ja su klo 10-20.

📱 Haluatko tutustua meihin lisää? Löydät meidät myös täältä: Instagram Facebook TikTok

Miten rekrytointi etenee?

Täytä hakemus järjestelmässämme hae tästä -painikkeen kautta ◾ Kutsumme esivalintavaiheessa hakijoita videohaastatteluun ◾ Mahdollinen haastattelu tai rekrytointipäivä tavaratalossa ◾ Olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin hakijoihin valintojen ja prosessin edetessä.

Huomioithan, että palkka määräytyy toimittamiesi työ- ja opintotodistusten perusteella. Varaudu toimittamaan ne prosessin aikana. Aloitamme hakemusten käsittelyn jo hakuaikana ja voimme täyttää paikan ennen hakuajan päättymistä. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Yhdenvertaisuus, syrjimättömyys ja oikeudenmukaisuus ovat keskeisiä periaatteitamme rekrytoinnissa, palkitsemisessa ja urakehityksessä.

title: Supply Chain Accelerated Learning Experience
description:
AbbVie's Supply Chain Accelerated Learning Experience (SCALE) is a unique opportunity designed to develop the next generation of Supply Chain leaders. As part of our broader Supply Chain Talent Strategy, SCALE provides early-career professionals with foundational experiences across key areas of the supply chain while building the business, technical, and leadership capabilities needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving global environment.

Through a series of rotational assignments, participants gain exposure to critical supply chain functions, work on meaningful business challenges, and develop the skills needed to accelerate readiness for future leadership opportunities.

Responsibilities:

As a participant in the Supply Chain Accelerated Learning Experience (SCALE), you will gain broad exposure to AbbVie's global supply chain while contributing to meaningful business initiatives and building the capabilities needed for future leadership opportunities.

  • Analyze supply, demand, inventory, logistics, and operational data to identify risks, opportunities, and solutions that improve business performance.
  • Support planning and execution activities across key supply chain functions, including demand planning, supply planning, logistics, manufacturing support, and inventory management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges and drive alignment across the end-to-end supply chain.
  • Develop data-driven insights and recommendations that improve service levels, operational efficiency, and supply chain effectiveness.
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives focused on digital transformation, analytics, process optimization, and operational excellence.
  • Apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify process improvements and implement innovative solutions that create business value.
  • Build foundational expertise in supply chain operations, business acumen, project management, and decision-making within a global healthcare organization.
  • Prepare and deliver presentations, project updates, and recommendations to stakeholders and business leaders.
  • Develop influential partnerships and strengthen communication, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities through collaboration across the organization.
  • Demonstrate continuous growth in supply chain knowledge, strategic thinking, and leadership potential while preparing for future manager-level opportunities within AbbVie's Supply Chain organization.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or closely related field.
  • Must graduate with a bachelor’s degree prior to the intended full-time start date.
  • Demonstrated leadership through academic, extracurricular, internship, or work experiences.
  • Ability to quickly gain knowledge, understanding, or skill and willingly absorb and comprehend AbbVie processes, policies, and methods.
  • Interacts well with diverse groups within engineering and maintains strong working relationship with internal and external collaborators.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in team-based environments.
  • Willingness to participate in rotational assignments and relocate based on business needs.

title: Research Analyst
location: Edwards Air Force Base, CA, US; Naval Air Station Point Mugu, CA, US
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION AND/OR DUTIES
1. With minimal or no guidance, meets CNA’s quality standards when working on well-structured pieces of a project. Demonstrates ability to develop sound analytic frameworks and associated analytic methodologies/ techniques for addressing both structured and unstructured problems. With direction and supervision, clearly defines, structures, and executes a piece of a complex study to meet quality standards. Demonstrates analytic creativity and curiosity.

2. Develops and maintains broad, general institutional knowledge of primary clients/sponsors; their culture, organization, and issues.

3. Contributes productively and harmoniously to the work of others; treats everyone respectfully, professionally and fairly. Keeps others informed. Proactively identifies and seeks out others working on similar topics. Works to identify opportunities for collaborations within team, division, and operating unit.

4. Supports business development efforts and/or marketing activities by maintaining strong client relationships through high quality work, increasing the visibility of our work, and other related activities such as proposal preparation.

5. Interacts with sponsors/clients under the supervision of an experienced colleague, and with study POCs independently.

2. Experience: Typical minimum requirements Ph.D. & 0+ years or Master’s & 2+ years of experience in research and analysis.

3. Skills: Ability to make significant contributions to projects/analyses; Strong analytic curiosity/ creativity; Ability to operate independently in the execution of assignments; Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary environment; Strong critical thinking skills; Knowledge of research techniques; Strong planning and organizational skills; Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills; Ability to interact positively and somewhat independently with clients.
