title: Retail Collections Associate
description:
Merchants Bank, Winona, is seeking a Retail Collections Associate. Hours for this position are generally Monday through Friday from 8am – 5pm.

Duties include contacting customers regarding consumer, mortgage, and credit card accounts that are delinquent, charged off, or experiencing other repayment issues. Will recommend possible loan modifications or other loss mitigation solutions. Follows established collection policies, procedures, and legal requirements. Also involves reporting, filing mortgage insurance claims, and working with collections software for updates and efficiency.

Bachelor's degree preferred or high school diploma combined with relevant comparable work experience required. Prior experience in bank collection practices and procedures preferred. Requires a well-organized individual with good communication skills and ability to make sound, independent judgments. Must enjoy dealing with and serving people and have good problem-solving skills. Customer confidentiality is critical.

Merchants Bank offers competitive wages and benefits for our full-time employees including health, dental, life, disability and vision insurance; flexible spending accounts, 401(k) and ESOP retirement plans; bonus plan; paid time off; tuition reimbursement; and a variety of voluntary supplemental insurance options.

Please click on Apply Now or apply in person at Merchants Bank, Winona (102 E 3rd Street). Questions can be emailed to hr@merchantsbank.com. Merchants Bank is an Equal Opportunity Employer of women, minorities, protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Job Summary:
This person will be responsible for collecting consumer, mortgage, and credit card accounts that are delinquent, charged off, or experiencing other repayment issues. Responsibility also includes assisting the Retail Collections Manager with planning, directing, and controlling the retail loan collection function to help ensure that established collection policies, procedures, and legal requirements are followed and periodically evaluated and modified as needed. Timely action is expected on routine early delinquencies in an effort to maintain low delinquency ratios. Also responsible for assisting with repossessions, foreclosures, and management of Other Real Estate Owned (OREO).

Requires a well-organized individual with good communication skills and ability to make sound, independent judgments. Must enjoy dealing with and serving people and have good problem-solving skills.

Essential Responsibilities:

Contact customers regarding delinquent consumer, mortgage, and credit card accounts according to bank, investor, and regulatory guidelines
Recommend possible loan modifications or other loss mitigation solutions, repossession, charge off, or foreclosure
Underwrite hardship packages in accordance with bank, investor, and mortgage insurance guidelines
Under manager direction, coordinate with attorneys for handling of court procedures for collection of loans
Under manager direction, manage bankruptcy filings for consumer, mortgage, and credit card accounts
Under manager direction, manage the handling of mortgages from delinquency through foreclosure and sale
Assist with facilitating the preservation and disposition of foreclosed and repossessed property
Monitor continuous overdrafts on retail accounts for potential account closure
Timely file mortgage insurance claims
Assist with management of FNMA/Freddie Mac reimbursements
Report delinquent mortgage loan activity to investors and mortgage insurance companies as required
Assist with preparation of all delinquency and collection area reports for management and the board
Assist with completion of quarterly liquidation reports for all loans on non-accrual

Assist manager with utilization and management of collection software, including periodic updates, training, and identification of opportunities for efficiency in delinquency monitoring and reporting
Maintain thorough knowledge and understanding of bank, investor, and PMI policies, procedures, and guidelines and ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations
Employee will be expected to contribute to a positive working environment through words and actions.
Employee will be expected to greet internal and external customers in a friendly and outgoing manner.
Employee will be expected to take responsibility to ensure that internal and external customers receive outstanding service.
Employee may be asked to perform other duties as required by business needs.
Employee will be expected to complete compliance and product knowledge assignments in a timely manner.
Regular and dependable attendance is an essential function for this job.
Adherence to compliance with laws concerning financial institutions.

Physical Working Conditions:
Primarily inside working environment. Low noise. Will have need for limited outside work when performing duties in the collection of collateral.

Physical Demands:
Primarily sitting desk work; secondary, will need ability to physically maneuver outside for limited periods of time. Will not require heavy lifting. Ability to use a computer is required.

Mental Demands/Skill Requirements/Competencies/Education:

Prior experience in bank collection practices and procedures preferred
Bachelor's degree preferred or high school diploma combined with relevant comparable work experience
Strong knowledge of and experience with Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, USDA, and Private Mortgage Insurance collections and reporting guidelines required
Forbearance, modification, loss mitigation, foreclosure, and repossession experience required
Strong verbal, written, and human relations skills and ability to deal tactfully with customers
Servant leadership and team building skills with the ability to train others
High level of attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines

Position requires above average aptitude in dealing with people; ability to communicate with clarity; ability or aptitude in the areas of reasoning, intelligence, and numerical perception. Position requires individual to be action-oriented, an excellent team player, ability to manage time and work effectively, manage self-development, possess strong oral and written communication skills, and leadership skills. Customer confidentiality is critical in this position.

Relationships:
Will have extensive customer and co-worker contact; must conduct self in a manner that will create a positive impression for the Bank. Responsible to the Retail Collections Manager for fulfillment of functions, responsibilities, and authority for their proper interpretation.

This job description may be modified based on the company needs at any time, may require employee to perform functions beyond those mentioned in this job description, and employee is an at-will employee.

title: Vocational Rehabilitation Specialist
description:
The Opportunity:
Vocational Rehabilitation Specialist - Skills Development & Employment (Rehabilitation Portfolio) - Ontario.
The Vocational Rehabilitation Specialist (VRS) provides direct vocational rehabilitation services to adults facing employment barriers. This role involves delivering a range of services including skills and interest assessments, confirmation of suitable employment options, individualized employment planning, active job search support, and follow-up to ensure successful employment outcomes. The VRS works closely with clients to support their career goals and facilitate workforce integration, contributing to high-quality rehabilitation outcomes.
Services are delivered under Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) and Canada Pension Plan – Disability (CPP‑D) agreements, ensuring alignment with contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements.
Reporting directly to the Program Manager, Skills Development and Employment (Rehabilitation Portfolio), the VRS ensures that services are delivered in alignment with program objectives, organizational policies, and applicable legislation, while promoting service excellence and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:
Key Responsibilities:

Accept referrals and review client plans/documentation from WSIB or CPPD.
Provide vocational rehabilitation services to adults facing employment barriers.
WSIB-focused activities:

Confirm suitable employment opportunities for return-to-work.
Advise and support clients in active job search strategies, including resume preparation, interview techniques, and employment planning.
Follow up on placements to ensure successful integration.

CPPD-focused activities:

Conduct vocational assessments and professional exploration to determine career pathways.
Document suitable employment and develop individualized rehabilitation plans.
Provide ongoing follow-up to support implementation of rehabilitation plans and program objectives.

Conduct labour market research and transferable skills analyses.
Collect and share information on labour market trends, professional requirements, and access conditions.
Negotiate employment opportunities with employers as needed.
Ensure client satisfaction and adherence to quality standards.

Qualifications and Experience:

Minimum of three years of recent, relevant experience in employment support services.

Minimum of a 2-year diploma in social sciences (e.g., Social Service Worker) combined with an applicable designation, or a 4-year degree in Vocational Rehabilitation or a related field.
Member or eligible for membership in a professional association (CVRP, VRA Canada, OCCOQ).
Strong knowledge of the labour market.
Bilingual (English/French) is highly valued.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Strong organizational, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Access to a vehicle and a valid driver’s license required.

Important Details:

Hybrid work arrangement (as applicable).
This role supports rehabilitation services within the Skills Development and Employment portfolio, with a focus on WSIB and CPP‑D funded programs.

Timing of Opportunities: We anticipate some service needs beginning in Fall 2026, while additional opportunities will be developed and assigned on an ongoing basis depending on organizational needs. Candidates who join our talent pool may be contacted as new assignments become available.

title: Pricing, Cost & Product Data Intern
description:
The Pricing, Cost & Product Data Intern reports to the Senior Director of Pricing & Profitability and supports pricing, profitability, and data management initiatives across the organization. This role assists with maintaining product, cost, pricing, and rebate data, while providing reporting and analytical support to improve business decision-making. The intern will collaborate with cross-functional teams and gain hands-on experience in pricing strategy, profitability analysis, data governance, and business analytics.

Key Responsibilities
  • Maintain and validate product master data, customer pricing records, cost data, and rebate program information across business systems.
  • Assist with maintenance of supplier cost changes.
  • Help maintain pricing accuracy by reviewing data, identifying discrepancies, and coordinating corrections with business partners.
  • Assist in analyzing product costs, pricing, margins, and profitability to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Prepare routine reports, dashboards, and performance metrics related to pricing, costs, rebates, contracts, customers, and product profitability.
  • Assist with business case development, profitability assessments, and pricing analysis projects.
  • Support data governance and data integrity efforts related to costs, pricing, contracts, rebates, and product information.
  • Document processes and identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and operational effectiveness.
  • Complete special projects and other duties as assigned.

Qualifications
  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Accounting, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and quality.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and basic analysis.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a collaborative environment.
  • Experience with ERP systems, Power BI, Tableau, or business intelligence tools is preferred but not required.

Learning Opportunities
Through this internship, the candidate will gain experience in:
  • Pricing and profitability management.
  • Cost analysis and margin evaluation.
  • Product and customer master data management.
  • Business reporting and dashboard development.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with commercial and operational teams.
  • Data governance, analytics, and decision-support processes.

This temporary position is not benefits eligible.

title: Project Estimator
description:
For more than 50 years, the building team has been giving life to countless construction projects, distinguishing itself by the high quality of its work, respecting the highest industry standards and aiming to obtain environmental certifications. Engineers, architects, and other building specialists work hard to meet deadlines and exceed client expectations, while improving the well-being of communities.

Office buildings, hospitals and research centers, educational institutions, residential buildings, hotels, shopping centers, factories, sports and cultural centers, our team excels at building these places using state-of-the-art tools and places people at the heart of its concerns by advocating an innovative collaborative approach.

Come build the future with us!

We are looking for a Project Estimator to work onsite on one of our important ICI projects in North York!

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for preparing Estimates for an ICI project.
  • Lead on hard bid pursuits;
  • Study plans and specifications;
  • Interpret the technical specifications of the tender documents;
  • Analyze and prepare tender documents;
  • Discuss the working methods to be applied, parts of the work to be subcontracted, risks and constraints of the call for tenders;
  • Perform quantity calculations;
  • Evaluate the costs of materials, labor, and necessary equipment;
  • Find prices from subcontractors and suppliers;
  • Communicate with subcontractors and suppliers to confirm pricing, coverage, and cover scope gaps;
  • Participate in mandatory visits and / or client meetings for relevant information;
  • Prepare the review of proposals and ensure that the scope of work is complete;
  • Conduct site visits, review and approve the preparation of drawings, specifications and other design documents and ensure integration between all disciplines;
  • Communicating with vendors to obtain bids for materials and services needed for construction projects;
  • Pre-qualifies new vendors for potential use;
  • Creates and issues tenders for sub-contracting pricing;
  • Reviewing bids from vendors to ensure compliance with contract requirements;
  • Maintains a costing database for future budgeting and estimates;
  • Participates in the identification of project risks, mitigating company exposure to them effectively;
  • Develop and consider the project schedule as well as construction challenges in all estimates;
  • Proactively follows up on RFIs and maintains information.




Requirements

  • Minimum 10 years experience in similar role
  • Full Building Division Experience
  • Diploma or Degree in Engineering, Architecture or Construction Management
  • Bilingual (an asset), but proficiency in English language with excellent communication skills (written and verbal) is required
  • Working knowledge of construction equipment and techniques, estimating, drawings and specifications, building material and required standards applicable to discipline.
  • Working knowledge of Site Development, Building Envelope and M&E Systems for ICI facilities.
  • Proficiency in the use of estimating software.
  • Ability to breakdown a project to elemental scopes of work with both complete sets of project documentation as well as from preliminary conceptual designs.
  • Ability to provide confident and personable service to clients and sub-contractors.
  • Ability to work on multiple estimates of varying size and complexity simultaneously.
  • Ability to estimate high level budgets as well as detailed line-item estimates.
  • Ability to communicate with Project Managers effectively and Site Superintendents to verify scope capture and project plan of the estimate.
  • Ability to communicate with engineers effectively and architects to ensure all scopes of work are considered.
  • Has successfully estimated completed projects ranging in cost from $10 million to $300 million.
  • Depth of experience with ICI type facilities ground up including site development.
  • Simultaneous management of multiple estimates of varying size and complexity.
  • Able to estimate high-level budgets as well as detailed line-item estimates.
  • Able to instigate action from Sub-Trades and Vendors/Suppliers.
  • Highly competent and effective negotiator.
  • Possesses effective writing and oral communication skills.

Skills and Attitudes Required

  • Attention to details;
  • Dynamic and organized;

title: Netwerkcoördinator Waddinxveen (14 uur)
description:
Vind jij het leuk om te netwerken, een verbindende rol te vervullen, veel te regelen en te organiseren én heb je affiniteit met o.a. de doelgroep jeugd? Dan is dit een hele leuke afwisselende baan voor jou!
Wij zijn op zoek naar een gedreven, enthousiaste en resultaatgerichte collega voor de functie van

Netwerkcoördinator Waddinxveen (14 uur)

KANSRIJK OPGROEIEN EN LEEFSTIJL

Werkdagen in overleg | Standplaats Waddinxveen

Wat ga je doen?

De functie valt binnen de afdeling Gezondheidsbevordering en Onderzoek (RVE GBO), onderdeel van Hecht-GGD Hollands Midden. Binnen deze afdeling werken, naast Adviseurs Publieke Gezondheid, ook epidemiologen, gezondheidsbevorderaars en diverse collega’s met taken op het gebied van preventie, en staat onder leiding van twee managers. De netwerkcoördinator werkt vanuit de afdeling GBO voor de gemeente Waddinxveen. Deze gemeente zet zich in voor de transitie naar informele zorg, preventie en vroegsignalering, de doorontwikkeling van de basisvoorzieningen zoals beschreven in het Aanvullend Zorg en Welzijnsakkoord (AZWA), het bevorderen van sociale cohesie en integrale, lokale en passende hulp en ondersteuning.

Naast inwoners en gezinnen van Waddinxveen staan professionals van diverse partijen in het sociaal domein die een rol spelen in hun leven. Denk aan onderwijs, kinderopvang, huisartsen, sport- en cultuurverenigingen en organisaties die ondersteuningen zorg bieden in de vorm van gespecialiseerde hulp.
Als netwerkcoördinator ben jij een belangrijke schakel in de samenwerking tussen de gemeente en relevante samenwerkingspartners. Je verbindt partijen uit het medische, sociale, fysieke en informele domein en zorgt dat zij vanuit een gezamenlijke aanpak werken aan gezond en kansrijk opgroeien en leven. Je bouwt netwerken rondom projecten als ‘Kansrijke Start’ en de netwerkaanpak ‘Kind naar Gezonder Gewicht’. Je hebt hierin naast een verbindende ook een signalerende rol. Je initieert samenwerking met de partijen en bouwt en onderhoudt netwerken om te zorgen voor een samenhangend, passend, laagdrempelig en preventief aanbod. Waar dit kan collectief, met als doel om preventie zo effectief mogelijk te laten zijn en zodoende de eerstelijnszorg te ontlasten.

JOUW TAKENPAKKET:

  • Je bouwt en versterkt het lokale netwerk en verbindt de partijen uit het zorg- (medisch, paramedisch en geboorte zorg), sociaal- en beweegdomein en andere relevante partners van Waddinxveen.
  • Je stimuleert en organiseert samenwerking en draagvlak en zorgt voor gezamenlijke urgentie, heldere rollen en goede onderlinge afspraken binnen een lokaal passende, integrale overlegstructuur.
  • Je brengt met de lokaal betrokken partijen lokaal aanbod, behoeften en hiaten in beeld en initieert waar nodig verbeteringen of aanvullend aanbod m.b.t. cursussen en bijeenkomsten en overige activiteiten.
  • Je signaleert relevante trends, knelpunten en bewegingen in het preventieve domein en vertaalt deze naar concrete acties en verbeteringen.
  • Je voert proces- en netwerkregie op de samenhangende aanpakken. Je stuurt lokale coalities of werkgroepen aan en bewaakt de voortgang, kwaliteit en aansluiting tussen het zorg, sociale, beweeg en informele domein.
  • Je fungeert als intermediair tussen de formele en informele zorgpartners en bent daarmee een schakel tussen de diverse betrokken partijen.
  • Je ontwikkelt en coördineert een lokaal actieplan, aansluitend op de regionale werkagenda AZWA Midden-Holland, en zorgt voor uitvoering en bijstelling waar nodig.
  • Je monitort en evalueert de voortgang en resultaten en zorgt in samenwerking met de gemeente voor duurzame borging van de aanpak in lokaal beleid, uitvoering en samenwerking.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent een klantgerichte en proactieve collega, en beschikt naast coördinerende vaardigheden ook over organiserende vaardigheden. Je bent communicatief sterk en bent in staat om de preventiepartners in verschillende omgevingen te vertegenwoordigen. Verder vragen wij van jou het volgende:

  • Je hebt een relevante opleiding op minimaal hbo-niveau afgerond (zoals bijv. SPH, MDW of SW).
  • Je beschikt over deskundigheid op het brede gebied van jeugd, gezin en welzijn. En bent bekend met het sociaal domein en landelijk programma en kaders zoals het AZWA.
  • Je hebt relevante werkervaring als projectmanager binnen complexe implementatieprojecten binnen de publieke gezondheid, zorg of welzijn. Een grote dosis doorzettingsvermogen en voldoende energie om tegen de stroom in te zwemmen wanneer dit nodig is. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen beleid en uitvoering.
  • Je bent in staat om behaalde resultaten, maar ook knelpunten te rapporteren, te analyseren en te verantwoorden.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een afwisselende baan binnen een informele en maatschappelijke organisatie die zich inzet voor de openbare gezondheidszorg.

description:
Job Summary
Responsible to the Member Services Supervisor for performing duties related to phone and electronic interactions with CORE members that include opening and handling member accounts, educating members on available programs, and addressing member complaints, inquiries, and requests.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Receives and resolves omni-channel member contacts, including phone and electronic inquiries, while maintaining consistent queue availability.
Completes account creation at existing locations, account updates, payment options, program enrollments, inquiries, and information requests accurately and efficiently in accordance with departmental procedures, regulations, and tariffs, routing contacts to other departments only when necessary.
Fields member complaints and concerns and offers reasonable solutions before escalating contacts or transferring to another department.
Verifies member identity according to department standards before releasing account-specific information.
Educates members on existing programs and solutions to best meet their specific needs. Tailors the member experience to each interaction.
Maintains complete and accurate documentation on all calls/contacts.
Actively promotes first contact resolution by proactively responding to member issues by clarifying the member’s issue, determining the cause of the issue, selecting the best solution, and implementing the solution themselves or contacting the correct department for completion.
Member inquiries vary in complexity. Task difficulty will progress as levels increase. Methods and procedures are defined but judgment may be required to apply them to work. Work is routine and tasks are directly related.
Performs other duties as directed by leadership.

Minimum Qualifications of Position

High school diploma or equivalent certificate required.
One or more years of practical equivalent experience in member/customer service is required. This could include answering phone calls, chat conversations, electronic correspondence and order creation, and handling member accounts.
Ability to work with a multi-screen, multi-application computer system.
Competent with Microsoft Office: Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams.
Proficient with general office equipment.

Level I
Applies basic skills while developing some advanced skills in the above tasks; generally works under close supervision; has limited experience and work is performed within specific limits of department procedures.

Level II
Applies advanced skills and job knowledge to the above tasks and or non-routine assigned tasks. Makes working decisions within area of knowledge or responsibility with minimal supervision. For career progression opportunities, has served as a MSR I for a minimum of one year and passed the Level II knowledge and competency assessment.

Level III
Regularly works on the above and assigned tasks that are varied and complex. Applies full range of specialized skills and job knowledge; adapts procedures to meet specialized needs; performs broad and/or focused tasks under general supervision; relies on experience and judgement to plan and accomplish assigned tasks. For career progression opportunities, has served as a MSR II for a minimum of one year and has passed the Level III knowledge and competency assessment.

Knowledge and Skills

Integrity: exhibiting a high degree of integrity and honesty.
Diplomacy: using appropriate diplomacy and tact with employees, members, and other contacts.
Communication: ability to effectively read, write and speak the English language to communicate in a clear, straight forward, and professional manner.
Critical Thinking: using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems.
Active Listening: giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.
Active Learning: understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.
Problem Solving: identifying problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.
Coordination: adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.
Instructing: teaching others how to do something.
Service Orientation: actively looking for ways to help people.
Monitoring: monitoring/assessing performance of oneself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.
Judgment and Decision Making: considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.
Time Management: managing one’s own time.
Troubleshooting: determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about it.
Social Perceptiveness: being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.
Learning Strategies: selecting and using training/instructional methods and procedures appropriate for the situation when learning or teaching new things.
Persuasion: persuading others to change their minds or behavior.
Negotiation: bringing others together and trying to reconcile differences.
Mathematics: using mathematics to solve problems.
Confidentiality: able to exercise appropriate discretion and confidentiality OR able to exercise discretion, confidentiality, and objectivity in complex and sensitive situations.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements
Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met. The worker is not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions.

Note: This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Other duties may be assigned.

description:

Competitive compensation

title: Clinician- OTP
description:
What We Offer:

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Make a meaningful impact in the lives of individuals, families, and communities throughout Western Massachusetts.
  • Professional Growth – Access ongoing training, mentorship, career development, and advancement opportunities across one of the region's largest behavioral health organizations.
  • Supportive Team Culture – Join a collaborative workplace guided by our HEART values: Humanity, Empowerment, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork.
  • Stability & Opportunity – Build your career with a well-established organization serving Western Massachusetts since 1938.
  • Comprehensive Benefits – Generous PTO, 403(b), educational assistance, medical, dental, vision, employee assistance programs, and more.
  • Certified Great Place to Work – Work for an organization recognized for creating a positive and engaging employee experience.

What You Will Do:

As a Licensed Clinician, you will provide evidence-based counseling and case management services to individuals receiving medication for opioid use disorder (MOUD). Working collaboratively with physicians, nurses, recovery coaches, and other behavioral health professionals, you will help develop individualized treatment plans that promote long-term recovery and wellness.

Responsibilities include:

  • Conduct comprehensive biopsychosocial assessments and ongoing clinical evaluations.
  • Develop, implement, and update individualized treatment plans.
  • Provide individual, group, and family counseling using evidence-based practices.
  • Complete timely and accurate clinical documentation in the electronic health record.
  • Monitor client progress and adjust treatment interventions as appropriate.
  • Collaborate with medical providers, nursing staff, recovery coaches, and community partners to coordinate care.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings, case conferences, and utilization reviews.
  • Provide crisis intervention and risk assessments when necessary.
  • Educate individuals and families on addiction, recovery, relapse prevention, and community resources.
  • Maintain compliance with all federal, state, accreditation, and organizational standards, including confidentiality requirements.

Who You Are:

  • Master's degree in Social Work, Mental Health Counseling, Psychology, Marriage and Family Therapy, or a related behavioral health field.
  • Current Massachusetts licensure as LICSW, LMHC, LADC I, or equivalent or license-eligible and actively working toward independent licensure.
  • Experience providing behavioral health or substance use disorder treatment preferred.
  • Knowledge of trauma-informed, person-centered, and recovery-oriented care.
  • Experience working in an Opioid Treatment Program (OTP), Medication for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD), or other substance use disorder treatment setting (preferred).

    PAY RANGE:

    Licensed Clinician: $75,000 - $81,000 per year

    Unlicensed (license eligible): $65,000 - $73,000 per year

title: B&A Specialist
description:

Employee healthcare

Learning & development opportunities and study support
Travel season ticket loans
Grab & Go Deli Café at our Crawley offices

Onsite gym

Social clubs and events

title: Reception - Washington, DC
description:

Job Title:

Reception

Location:

Washington, DC

Reception Manager

Whether it's a special celebration or a casual visit, you'll help make every guest feel like a VIP.

At F1 Arcade, we aim to impress-and your energy and enthusiasm will help make every visit one to remember.

Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Welcome Guests with Warmth: Be the friendly face that greets every guest, creating a positive and exciting first impression.
  • Support Smooth Check-Ins and Walk-Ins: Help manage reservations and walk-ins efficiently to keep the guest flow running smoothly.
  • Deliver Exceptional Guest Service: Provide attentive, professional, and friendly service that reflects the F1 Arcade experience.
  • Work as One Team: Communicate and collaborate with other departments to ensure every guest has a seamless visit.
  • Handle Guest Questions with Care: Respond to inquiries with confidence, making sure guests feel listened to and well taken care of.
  • Keep the Front of House Looking Sharp: Maintain a tidy and organized reception area, helping to create a welcoming and energetic environment.

Skills Required

  • Guest-Focused Experience: Previous experience in hospitality, entertainment, or a fast-paced guest-facing role is a plus.
  • Great Communicator & Problem-Solver: Friendly, clear communicator who can think on their feet and handle guest questions with confidence.
  • Organised & Proactive: Reliable and detail-oriented, with a can-do attitude and a hands-on approach.
  • Team Player with Positive Energy: Enjoys working with others and brings enthusiasm and professionalism to every shift.
  • Flexible Availability: Willing to work a variety of shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • Ability to consistently demonstrate F1 Arcade Core Values:

Pursuit of Excellence

Positive Energy

Integrity

Team Spirit


Basic Physical Requirements

When working at an F1 Arcade venue, Team Members must be able to perform the duties of that venue. The team member will frequently sit for short periods of time, talk via Cloud Based video conferencing and the phone often, and hear and manipulate objects constantly.

Additional requirements will include lifting up to 10 (ten) pounds constantly and up to 50 (fifty) pounds as required. Lifting from floor to shoulder constantly and overhead infrequently. Twisting and reaching frequently. Grasping objects to move or manipulate constantly. Working in hot then cold environments for extended periods of time. title: Inpatient Coding Specialist/Full time/Wallingford
description:
Gaylord Specialty Healthcare is a health system dedicated exclusively to medical rehabilitation. We provide inpatient and outpatient care for people at every point in their journey from illness or injury to the most advanced state of recovery they can achieve. Our Mission: To enhance health, maximize function, and transform lives. Our values: Integrity, Compassion, Accountability, Respect and Excellence. These values guide us in providing quality patient care and transforming the lives of our patients.

SUMMARY The Inpatient Coding Specialist reviews documentation in the electronic medical record and assigns ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes and ICD-10-PCS procedure codes in accordance with the Standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) and in compliance with the ICD-10 Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, regulatory requirements, and Gaylord Hospital policy. Inpatient Coding Specialist will perform physician queries, obtain documentation clarification, and provide education to clinical staff on documentation requirements and DRG assignment. Works in collaboration with Clinical Documentation Integrity Specialist. Participates in quality monitoring and annual education/training.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned:

Review inpatient medical record and assign appropriate principal and secondary diagnosis and procedure codes upon patient admission, concurrently throughout stay, and final code upon discharge in accordance with Official Coding Guidelines and regulatory requirements

  • Utilize knowledge of Anatomy & Physiology, Pharmacology, and medical terminology to analyze physician and other clinical documentation to determine and support appropriate ICD-10-CM diagnosis and ICD-10-PCS procedure.
  • Apply knowledge of Inpatient Prospective Payment System (PPS) to ensure accurate DRG assignment and appropriate reimbursement for inpatient admissions.
  • Communicate DRG assignment and changes to clinical staff.
  • Work in collaboration with the Utilization Management team to ensure timely code assignment to obtain working DRG.

Review clinical documentation in coordination with Clinical Documentation Integrity Specialist to ensure clinical documentation contains specificity, is accurate and complete

  • Formulate a physician query to send to the provider to obtain missing documentation, specificity and/or additional clarification necessary to complete the coding process.
  • Works collaboratively with Patient Financial Services to ensure accurate and timely claim submission.
  • Assist with payer requests for case review or DRG validation. Draft correspondence to payer to support code assignment and appeal DRG downgrade.

Provide education and feedback to physicians and clinical staff

  • Attend medical staff meetings or conduct physician in-service to provide training on coding or documentation requirements or changes.
  • Act as subject matter expert on ICD-10-CM code assignment and serves as a resource for the organization for questions related to ICD-10 diagnosis coding and DRG assignment.
  • Generate/complete monthly reports including Case Mix Index, Top DRG assignments, short-stays, DNFB, etc.
  • Track monthly data to analyze trends or changes throughout the year.
  • Perform internal quality assurance audits to verify accurate diagnosis code assignment for both inpatient and outpatient services. Assist with annual external coding compliance audits.

IT IS ICARE

  • Innovation: Embracing creativity and new ideas to improve processes and outcomes.
  • Teamwork: Collaborating effectively with others to achieve shared goals and objectives.
  • Inclusion: Fostering an environment where everyone feels valued and supported.
  • Safety: Prioritizing the well-being and security of patients, individuals and communities.
  • Integrity: Acting with honesty and transparency in all interactions and decisions.
  • Compassion: Showing empathy and kindness towards others, especially in challenging situations.
  • Accountability: Taking responsibility for actions and outcomes, ensuring reliability and trust.
  • Respect: Treating others with dignity and consideration, valuing their perspectives and contributions.
  • Excellence: Striving for the highest quality in performance and achievements.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Associate's degree or equivalent from a two-year College or technical school (Health Information Management), Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of direct inpatient hospital coding-related experience.
  • CCS (Certified Coding Specialist), CCS-P (Certified Coding Specialist), RHIT or RHIA through AHIMA preferred or CPC (Certified Coding Professional).
  • Expertise with ICD-10-CM / ICD-10-PCS code assignment and Official Coding Guidelines.
  • Current with official coding guidelines and attend continuing education necessary to maintain coding certification;
  • Proficient with electronic medical records and utilizing coding references and electronic software applications.
  • Must have an extensive knowledge of the CMS Hospital Prospective Payment System and DRG assignment.

HOURS:

Full time

Hybrid schedule (onsite and remote) after successful completion of the introductory period or at the manager’s discretion.

We Are An Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Teamleider Ruimtelijke ontwikkeling - Duurzaamheid
description:
Werk jij straks hier?

Werken voor Maatschappelijke en Ruimtelijke Ontwikkeling (MRO) is werken voor de afdeling die het dichtst bij het bestuur staat. Als teamleider geef je in eerste instantie richting aan de vakgroep duurzaamheid: een team professionals dat de duurzaamheidsopgaven van de gemeente vormgeeft en uitvoert. Duurzaamheid is tot nu toe grotendeels programmatisch georganiseerd. Jouw opdracht is om deze opgave de komende tijd steviger te beleggen in de lijnorganisatie, zodat de resultaten ook op de lange termijn geborgd zijn. Voor deze functie geldt uitdrukkelijk: we zoeken in de eerste plaats iemand die het vakgebied duurzaamheid en de energietransitie goed kent, en die vanuit die kennis kan sturen op inhoud, koers en kwaliteit.

Deze rol groeit mee met de organisatie: na verloop van tijd komen er andere vakgroepen bij, met een andere vakinhoud dan duurzaamheid. Je bouwt dus vanaf de start aan een teamleiderschap dat werkt over verschillende beleidsterreinen heen, niet aan diepgaande inhoudelijke kennis van één beleidsterrein.

Hoe doe jij ertoe:

Je bent niet alleen leidinggevende van het team, maar ook de sleutelfiguur in de overgang van een programmatische naar een lijngestuurde aanpak van duurzaamheid. Dat vraagt een nieuw samenspel tussen jou, als teamleider vanuit de lijn, en de programmamanager duurzaamheid: samen zorg je dat de opgave niet verwatert in de overgang, maar juist steviger verankerd raakt in het reguliere werk van de afdeling. Je geeft richting aan beleidsopgaven, stelt prioriteiten en zorgt dat opdrachten helder worden geformuleerd, uitgevoerd en gevolgd. Je helpt medewerkers om opdrachtgericht te werken: met duidelijke doelen, eigenaarschap en resultaat.

Je maakt als teamleider het verschil op 6 vlakken:

  • Met jouw inhoudelijke kennis van duurzaamheid en de energietransitie doorzie je de dossiers, herken je kansen en risico's, en kun je vanuit die kennis sturen op koers, kwaliteit en keuzes binnen de duurzaamheidsopgave.
  • Met jouw politiek-bestuurlijke sensitiviteit vertaal je bestuurlijke ambities rond duurzaamheid naar concrete opdrachten en teamopgaven. Als ambtelijk opdrachtgever vanuit de lijn stuur je op samenhang, kwaliteit, haalbaarheid en voortgang.
  • Met jouw transitiekracht bouw je de brug tussen programma en lijn: je zorgt dat de duurzaamheidsdoelen geborgd blijven terwijl de sturing verschuift, in nauwe en heldere samenwerking met de programmamanager duurzaamheid.
  • Met jouw zakelijkheid stuur je op een gezonde bedrijfsvoering: je bewaakt voortgang, capaciteit en budgetten en bent verantwoordelijk voor de P&C-cyclus en een realistische capaciteitsplanning.
  • Met jouw ontwikkeling als leidinggevende groei je in je rol als leidinggevende: je voert het goede gesprek over ontwikkeling, samenwerking, inzetbaarheid en resultaat, en bouwt aan een professioneel, veilig en aanspreekbaar teamklimaat. Heb je hier al ervaring in, dan is dat een pre.
  • Met jouw verbindend vermogen onderhoud je relaties met wethouders, de programmamanager, (regionale) partners en collega's binnen de organisatie, en draag je bij aan de doorontwikkeling van de afdeling als geheel.

Hoe ziet je dag er uit?

Je start de ochtend met een sturingsoverleg met de programmamanager duurzaamheid over de voortgang van de energietransitie. Daarna schuif je aan bij een overleg met de wethouder over het warmteplan. Vervolgens is er een kernteamoverleg, samen met de andere teamleiders, de strateeg en het afdelingshoofd. Tussendoor bereid je de voortgangsgesprekken voor rondom de P&C-cyclus: je kijkt kritisch naar budgetten, capaciteit en de voortgang van de duurzaamheidsopgaven, en stuurt bij waar nodig. 's Avonds ben je aanwezig bij een inloopavond over een lokaal energieproject waar bewoners vragen over hebben. Dan ga je naar huis, moe maar voldaan!

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt aantoonbare kennis van en ervaring met duurzaamheid en de energietransitie, bijvoorbeeld opgedaan als leidinggevende, projectleider of programmamanager duurzaamheid. Dit is een harde eis.
  • Je hebt hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau.•Je hebt ervaring bij een gemeente.
  • Je hebt ervaring met of een duidelijke visie op opdrachtgericht werken binnen een overheidsorganisatie.
  • Je bent bestuurlijk sensitief en beweegt soepel tussen inhoud, mensen, financiën en bestuur.
  • Ervaring met leidinggeven, bedrijfsvoering en de P&C-cyclus is een pre. Heb je die nog niet, dan begeleiden we je bij het ontwikkelen van die vaardigheden.

Ben je een (zeer) ervaren beleidsadviseur, projectleider of programmamanager duurzaamheid met de ambitie om door te groeien naar een leidinggevende positie, ook als je daarin nog beperkte ervaring hebt? Dan is deze functie voor jou gemaakt. Heb je daarnaast al ervaring als teamleider, dan heeft dat de voorkeur, maar het is niet doorslaggevend: we laten inhoudelijke kennis van duurzaamheid zwaarder wegen dan leidinggevende ervaring.

Wat doen we voor jou?

  • Salaris van minimaal €5.369 en maximaal €7.253 per maand op basis van een 36-urige werkweek (schaal 12).
  • Een aanloopschaal kan van toepassing zijn.
  • In deze vaste baan start je met een tijdelijke arbeidsovereenkomst van 12 maanden.
  • Individueel keuzebudget (IKB) ter waarde van 17,05% van het salaris (incl. vakantiegeld en eindejaarsuitkering).
  • Persoonlijke ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en studiefaciliteiten.
  • Thuiswerkmogelijkheden, een iPhone en laptop.

Goed om te weten

    • Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Christian de Kriek (afdelingshoofd a.i.) via cdkriek@leidschendam-voorburg.nl.
    • Je start als teamleider van de vakgroep duurzaamheid. In de nabije toekomst groeit deze rol uit naar een bredere teamleidersportefeuille binnen de afdeling, zodra de integratie van de vakgroep is afgerond.
    • Het opvragen van referenties of een ontwikkelassessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van de procedure.
    • Reageren kan tot en met zondag 4 oktober.
    • De gesprekken vinden plaats op dinsdagmiddag 6 oktober.

Voor de invulling van deze vacature werken wij niet samen met externe partijen. Acquisitie is daarom niet nodig.

title: Senior Director, Head of Translational AI Science (CVRM)
description:
Gothenburg, Sweden

Introduction
At AstraZeneca, we put patients first and strive to meet their unmet needs worldwide. Working here means being entrepreneurial, thinking big and working together to make the impossible a reality.


We're building a connected, end-to-end Enterprise AI engine - uniting data foundations, AI technology, process reinvention, and business-facing AI to accelerate results across the whole value chain. Success depends on being exceptional connectors: you'll actively leverage existing capabilities, celebrate and promote reuse, export breakthrough ideas across geographies and functions, and obsess over scaling impact rather than building in isolation. If you thrive in high-collaboration environments where your role is to turn complex, cross-functional problems into reusable, enterprise-wide capabilities - and where the measure of success is adoption and scale, not just innovation - you'll have the platform (and sponsorship) to make it real.


The role
The Head of Translational AI Science (CVRM) leads a small, high-impact team focused on advancing mechanistic understanding of cardiovascular, renal and metabolic diseases. The role operates at the intersection of biology, medicine and artificial intelligence, uncovering mechanism of disease (MoD), mechanism of action (MoA) and mechanism of resistance (MoR) with modern AI approaches in a way that significantly enhances and accelerates translational decision-making.


You will work side-by-side with senior leaders in Translational Medicine, deeply understanding needs at all levels, creating opportunities, influencing priorities, and balancing trade-offs. Through rigorous prioritisation you will develop and guide innovative, resource-aware strategies that combine cutting-edge AI techniques with domain expertise to create value tightly aligned to the therapy area portfolio.


You will manage a team of Translational AI Scientists and work in close partnership with the AI Center of Excellence to translate scientific questions into scalable AI solutions. Success will come from inclusive collaboration, scientific leadership, and an aptitude for people development.
You will bring hands-on understanding of current and emerging frontier AI capabilities to guide data strategy and implementation, model selection and development, ensuring biological insight is embedded into foundation models, causal frameworks and simulation approaches. You will collaborate across therapy areas to ensure outputs are aligned, valid, scientifically robust and actionable for R&D.


Why CVRM at AstraZeneca
Cardiovascular, renal and metabolic diseases remain among the leading causes of mortality globally, representing a significant unmet medical need. At AstraZeneca, CVRM is a core strategic priority, with a strong portfolio, deep scientific expertise, and access to rich, multimodal data.
This creates a unique environment to apply AI-first approaches to uncover new biological insights, accelerate decision-making, and ultimately deliver better outcomes for patients at scale.

Essential for the role
• Expertise in translational science and mechanistic thinking (MoD, MoA, MoR), ideally within CVRM
• Demonstrated experience applying modern AI in biomedical or translational settings (e.g. foundation models, causal inference, multimodal learning)
• Strong quantitative background in mathematical, statistical or computational methods
• Ability to translate scientific questions into implementable AI approaches
• Experience leading teams delivering AI-driven capabilities across multiple projects or portfolios
• Track record of delivering impact within complex R&D environments
• Proven ability to deliver at pace, balancing scientific rigor with speed and impact
• Strong communication skills and ability to influence senior stakeholders

Office Working Requirements
When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That’s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn’t mean we’re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Apply now to lead at the frontier of AI and translational science and help shape how AstraZeneca transforms drug development through Enterprise AI.

title: Suunnittelupäällikkö suuriin rakennushankkeisiin
description:
Oletko suunnittelun ohjauksen ammattilainen infra- tai talonrakentamisessa? Haluaisitko mukaan suuriin ja vaativiin hankkeisiin, joissa pääset vaikuttamaan suunnitteluratkaisuihin alusta loppuun? Tervetuloa Skanskaan!

Haemme kokenutta suunnittelupäällikköä infrarakentamisen suunnittelunohjaukseen

Tehtävä sijoittuu meillä Skanska Infra -yhtiöön, mutta joukkoomme sopii yhtä hyvin myös talonrakennustaustainen ammattilainen.

Skanska Infra pähkinänkuoressa

Meillä pääset osallistumaan monipuolisiin infrahankkeisiin, jotka voivat olla esimerkiksi väylä-, teollisuus- tai tunnelihankkeita.

Urakoimme useilla eri urakkamuodoilla. Sinua haemme ensisijaisesti yhteistoiminnallisiin hankkeisiin, kuten allianssi-, ST- ja KVR-hankkeisiin.

Viimeaikaisia kohteitamme ovat esimerkiksi Koskelan ja Ruskeasuon raitiovaunuvarikot, Vt12 Lahden eteläinen ohikulkutie sekä datakeskukset.

Miltä roolisi meillä näyttäisi?

Tuot meille vankkaa kokemustasi suurten yhteistoiminnallisten hankkeiden suunnittelun ohjaukseen.

Johdat suunnittelun ohjausta koko hankkeen elinkaaren ajan: tarjous-, kehitys- ja rakentamisvaiheessa. Toimit tärkeänä linkkinä suunnittelijoiden, rakentajien ja muiden osapuolten välillä sekä varmistat, että hankkeisiin löydetään parhaat suunnitteluratkaisut.

Tehtävän sisältöä on mahdollista muokata kokemuksesi, osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan.

Tiedot työsuhteesta

Työsuhteesi on vakituinen, ja aloitusajankohta on sovittavissa joustavasti.

Työpaikkasi sijaitsee projektilla, ja voit työskennellä osin myös etänä joustavin työajoin. Ensimmäinen projektisi sijaitsee Uudenmaan alueella ja toivomme sinulta jatkossa matkustusvalmiutta hankkeiden sijainnin mukaan.

Miksi harkita tätä tehtävää?

Tulet avainrooliin alan suurimpiin hankkeisiin, joissa pääset kehittämään edistyksellistä suunnittelun ohjausta ja suunnitteluratkaisuja.

Saat ympärillesi asiantuntevan työporukan, jossa tehdään sujuvaa yhteistyötä ja hyödynnetään kunkin erityisosaamista hankkeen hyväksi.

Tutustu myös henkilöstöetuihimme sivuillamme.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

  • soveltuvaa rakennusalan koulutusta (esimerkiksi rakennusinsinööri tai DI)
  • kokemusta suunnittelunohjauksesta urakoitsijan tai suunnittelijan puolelta

title: Designer, Signage and Packaging @ San Diego SSC
description:
Summary
The Graphic Designer, Signage & Packaging is a highly creative, production-minded designer responsible for bringing retail experiences to life through signage, packaging, environmental graphics, displays, and other physical branded touchpoints.

This role combines a strong design eye with deep attention to craft and production detail. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing an original creative concept and translating that concept into a beautifully executed, production-ready solution. They understand how two-dimensional design becomes a physical object or experience - from material, scale, color, and finish to fabrication, installation, and final presentation.

Beyond executing established creative direction, this designer is expected to bring a fresh, forward-thinking perspective to the work. They should actively explore new approaches to packaging, signage, materials, formats, finishes, and graphic applications, continually looking for opportunities to elevate the guest experience and push the creative expression of our brands and partner environments.

Working closely with the Director of Print & Graphics and cross-functional creative teams, this role helps ensure that every physical graphic touchpoint is visually compelling, brand-right, thoughtfully considered, and successfully executed from concept through production.

Key Responsibilities

Job duties include but are not limited to…

Creative Design & Development

Design signage, packaging, environmental graphics, and displays across a diverse portfolio of venues and brands.
Develop original layouts, concepts, and graphic solutions that balance strong visual storytelling with practical production requirements.
Bring a fresh and contemporary design perspective to projects, continually looking for ways to evolve how graphics and packaging show up within the retail experience.
Explore new materials, substrates, finishes, formats, printing techniques, and fabrication approaches that can elevate creative concepts and create more distinctive experiences.
Apply a keen design eye to typography, color, composition, scale, materiality, and detail.
Interpret established brand guidelines while identifying opportunities to create work that feels distinctive, relevant, and tailored to each partner or venue.
Adapt creative concepts across multiple sizes, formats, products, materials, and applications while maintaining visual consistency and design integrity.
Collaborate with Store Design, Product Design & Development, Visual Merchandising, and other internal partners to create cohesive physical brand experiences.

Production & Execution

Translate creative concepts and approved designs into accurate, production-ready files for print, fabrication, finishing, and installation.
Understand and account for substrates, coatings, laminations, mounting methods, hardware, dimensional elements, construction methods, and finishing techniques.
Prepare and review files for color, scale, bleeds, dielines, folds, trim, placement, resolution, tolerances, and other production specifications.
Collaborate directly with printers, fabricators, packaging vendors, installers, and other production partners to ensure design intent is maintained through execution.
Review proofs, prototypes, samples, and mockups for design accuracy, quality, color, materials, and overall execution.
Identify potential production challenges early and recommend creative, practical solutions.
Support quality control throughout the full process, from initial concept through final production and delivery.
Proofread copy and artwork carefully before files are released for print or fabrication.

Project & File Management

Organize and maintain design files, templates, specifications, dielines, production documentation, and other creative assets.
Manage revisions and version control across multiple concurrent projects.
Balance multiple deadlines, stakeholders, and project priorities while maintaining a high level of creative and technical quality.
Communicate proactively with internal teams and external production partners throughout the project lifecycle.
Help maintain consistency and quality across retail locations, product lines, branded environments, and physical graphic applications.
Manage partnership display systems and packages, ensuring consistency and brand integrity.

Print, Signage & Production Support

Provide coordination and execution support for the production and ordering of signage, display graphics, printed materials, and other physical creative assets as needed.
Coordinate requests with internal teams and approved print and signage partners.
Ensure approved creative files, specifications, quantities, locations, and deadlines are communicated accurately.

Skills / Qualifications

BA or BFA in Graphic Design, Production Design, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
3+ years of experience in graphic design, production design, print production, packaging, signage, environmental graphics, or a related field.
Strong portfolio demonstrating a sophisticated design eye alongside production-focused work.
Demonstrated ability to develop creative concepts as well as execute highly detailed production files.
Strong understanding of typography, composition, color, hierarchy, scale, and visual storytelling.
Experience preparing artwork and communicating with printers, fabricators, and production vendors.
Working knowledge of signage production, packaging construction, large-format printing, print manufacturing, and/or environmental graphics.
Understanding of substrates, materials, fabrication techniques, finishing processes, and installation considerations.
Solid understanding of prepress, color management, file preparation, bleeds, dielines, tolerances, and production specifications.
Excellent proofreading and communication skills with exceptional attention to detail.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, revisions, and stakeholders simultaneously.
Ability to move fluidly between conceptual design thinking, detailed production work, and administrative follow-through.
Advanced proficiency in

Adobe Illustrator
Photoshop
InDesign
Canva

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing and producing retail signage, packaging, displays, environmental graphics, or branded fixtures.
Experience with specialty substrates, dimensional signage, custom fabrication, structural packaging, or unusual print applications.
Experience reviewing physical samples, prototypes, proofs, and vendor mockups.
Experience taking projects from initial creative concept through production and final delivery.
Experience working across multiple brands or environments while maintaining distinct visual identities.

Travel Requirements
Travel is expected to be minimal. Occasional travel to print vendors, production facilities, retail locations, or installation sites may be required based on business needs.

Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

This role is primarily computer-based. The team member is frequently required to sit and use a computer keyboard and mouse. The role may occasionally require standing, walking, reaching, bending, stooping, kneeling, or crouching while reviewing samples, materials, proofs, mockups, or installations.

The team member must occasionally lift and/or move materials, packages, and production samples weighing up to 10 pounds.

Salary Range: $70,000-$75,000

title: Construction Management Team Lead
description:
Position Title: Construction Management Team Lead
Department: Project Development – Construction Management
Reports to: Director of Project Development
Direct Reports: Construction Managers (Office and Field Staff) and Site Managers
Classification: Exempt — Executive (Salary)
Compensation: Salary range $130,000 – $170,000; Commensurate to skills and experience.
Hours: Full-time: Monday through Friday, 8:30am to 5pm. Regular travel to project sites in multiple states is expected; an average of 6-8 days per month.
Benefits

Three weeks of paid vacation
Eight and a half paid holidays annually
Two paid flexible holidays annually
Paid sick time
ICHRA Health Insurance Reimbursement or Health Insurance Stipend
100% Employer Paid Dental & Vision Insurance
100% Employer Paid Life Insurance
100% Employer Paid Medical Clinic Membership or Cash Equivalent for employee & dependents
Other benefits accrue over the first 3-24 months, including additional paid vacation, 401k, 401k matching, and quarterly profit share.

Corporate Headquarters: 1730 South Street, Redding, CA 96001
Place of Work: Corporate Headquarters, Redding, CA, with regular travel to project sites
Company Overview
Maas Energy Works is the leading developer and operator of agricultural waste-to-energy systems in the United States. The Company designs, develops, constructs, and operates biogas powered renewable energy generation systems on dairy farms. Our projects include anaerobic digesters, biogas-powered electric generation, and renewable natural gas upgrading.
Position Description
Maas Energy Works (MEW) is seeking a Construction Management Team Lead to lead our Construction Management team and own delivery of the Company’s construction portfolio: a multi-state pipeline of dairy digester, biogas-to-electric, and renewable natural gas projects that are actively in construction or preparing to break ground. Project scopes include earthwork, covered lagoon and pond installation, pipelines, structures, concrete, mechanical, gas conditioning and upgrading equipment, and electrical.
The Team Lead directly manages the Construction Managers and Site Managers, and is accountable for the team’s performance: safe sites, projects delivered on schedule and within approved budget, disciplined change control, and clean handoffs to Operations. This is a working leader role. The Team Lead sets the standards, processes, and reporting the team runs on, coaches and develops the people on it, and steps in personally on the highest-risk projects, contractor disputes, and escalations. The Team Lead works daily with Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Safety, and is the single point of accountability to leadership for construction status across the portfolio.
We are looking for a builder who is experienced in running multiple concurrent industrial or agricultural construction projects, has led field and office teams, and can bring structure within a fast-moving environment.
Responsibilities
Team Leadership

Directly supervise, coach, and develop Construction Managers and Site Managers; set written performance expectations, hold regular one-on-ones, conduct performance reviews, and address performance issues promptly and constructively.
Own staffing for the construction team: forecast workload against the project pipeline, assign CMs and Site Managers to projects, balance field and office coverage, and lead hiring, onboarding, and training for new team members.
Build a culture of accountability, safety, and ownership; make expectations clear, follow through, and recognize strong performance.
Serve as the escalation point for the team on contractor disputes, dairy owner issues, schedule conflicts, and field problems that exceed a CM’s authority.

Construction Portfolio Delivery

Own construction status, schedule, and cost performance across all active projects; know where every project stands and what is at risk.
Review and approve construction schedules, monitor progress against baseline, and drive recovery plans when projects fall behind.
Oversee construction budgets and monthly cost forecasts; ensure cost commitments are tracked, forecast to complete is current, and budget variances are identified and escalated early with a proposed mitigation.

Contractors, Procurement, and Contracts

Manage contractor performance and relationships across the portfolio; hold contractors to contract terms, schedule, quality, and safety requirements.

Safety, Quality, and Compliance

Own jobsite safety performance for MEW-managed construction; ensure contractor safety programs, site orientations, and incident reporting are in place and followed on every site.
Set and enforce QA/QC standards for the team, including inspection and test plans, hold points, and documentation of installed work.
Ensure construction activity meets permit conditions, prevailing wage and apprenticeship documentation requirements where applicable, and multi-state contractor licensing requirements.

Commissioning, Handoff, and Reporting

Standardize construction reporting across the team and deliver clear, consistent portfolio-level construction reporting to the Director of Project Development and Company leadership.
Develop, document, and continuously improve construction management processes, templates, and lessons learned; capture root causes of cost and schedule variances and feed them back into estimating, design, and execution.

Qualifications & Skills

Seven or more years of construction or construction management experience on industrial, agricultural, energy, or heavy civil projects, including at least three years directly supervising construction staff.
Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent projects and a team of field and office personnel across multiple sites.
Strong command of construction budgets, cost forecasting, schedules, contracts, and change order management.
Ability to read and interpret construction plans, specifications, and P&IDs required; experience with mechanical, electrical, and gas process equipment strongly preferred.
Experience leading contractor bidding, selection, and performance management.
Working knowledge of jobsite safety programs (OSHA 30 preferred) and construction quality control.
Direct, clear, and professional written and verbal communication; able to deliver difficult messages to contractors, partners, and team members constructively.
Analytical, organized, and decisive; able to prioritize across a portfolio and act with limited supervision.
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel in particular) and project management software; experience with Wrike or similar tools is a plus.
Experience with anaerobic digesters, biogas, RNG, or dairy operations is a strong plus.
Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
Must be proficient in written and spoken English.
Must possess a valid US driver’s license and be able to pass a background check and a motor vehicle (DMV) background check to qualify for use of a company vehicle.

Other Duties
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
Physical Demands Requirements
Work Environment
This job operates in a professional office environment and on active construction sites. Office work routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and photocopiers. Site work involves outside conditions that include inclement weather, heat, cold, etc. Noise level may be loud at times and the role works around moving mechanical or construction equipment.
Physical Demands
This role combines sedentary office work with regular travel and site visits. Must be able to enter, travel in, and exit vehicles and airplanes; walk active construction sites on uneven terrain; and occasionally move objects of at least 50 lbs. Good manual dexterity, coordination, and stamina are required.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Support the Coffee Shop Manager in the efficient day-to-day running of our five-star coffee shop, leading the team to deliver consistently high standards of customer service, food quality, cleanliness and operational performance.

Delivery

Health & Safety

People

Across three centuries, our family-owned company has carefully sources cashmere and fine woollen fibres from around the world, applying the latest technology and highest quality craft expertise in our very own vertical Scottish mills. Employing over 1,000 staff, our valued employees and communities are at the heart of everything we do, producing unique, high-quality designs that are made to last. Our brand is focused on sustainability, working with natural, renewable, and biodegradable fibres and we are committed to maintaining a minimal environmental footprint.

Johnstons of Elgin is proud to be an equal opportunity employer wholeheartedly supporting the principles of equality and diversity to build an inclusive workforce. Our aim is to embed diversity and inclusion in everything we do to create an environment where our employees feel safe to be their whole authentic self without having to downplay or change parts of their identity. We celebrate diversity in all its forms, which goes beyond those characteristics protected by law to include everything that makes us unique, from our backgrounds and experiences to our personalities and ways of thinking.

We endeavour to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities and encourage any candidate who requires assistance to contact us at hr@johnstonsofelgin.com.

Don’t meet every requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single requirement or qualification. At Johnstons of Elgin, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you are excited about this role but think your experience doesn’t align perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
