title: Construction Supervisor - Controls/Automation
description:
Job Type: Full-Time | Location: Childress, TX | Department: Construction | Reporting to: Associate Director, Construction | Work Location Type: #remote

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

We are seeking a Construction Supervisor - Controls / Automation to lead the field installation, integration, and verification of advanced building management systems (BMS), programmable logic controllers (PLCs), direct digital controls (DDC), field instrumentation, control panels, and networks supporting mission-critical data center infrastructure. In this hands-on leadership role, you will direct field personnel and subcontractors, coordinate across mechanical, electrical, controls, and commissioning disciplines, lead point-to-point checkout and functional testing, and support final commissioning and integrated systems testing. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced controls professional ready to expand their leadership responsibilities, resolve complex integration challenges, and ensure systems are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project requirements.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and supervise controls technicians, integration specialists, and subcontractors while coordinating with vendor engineers performing automation work across the project.
  • Plan daily activities, assign crews, coordinate access with other trades, and monitor productivity to achieve project milestones safely and on schedule.
  • Oversee the installation, wiring, termination, and mounting of control panels, PLCs, DDC controllers, sensors, meters, valves, actuators, and network hardware.
  • Review control schematics, network architectures, point lists, sequences of operations, and approved submittals for constructability and field readiness; identify discrepancies and escalate them to controls engineering.
  • Coordinate with mechanical and electrical teams to verify that required preliminary testing, flushing, inspections, and system-readiness activities are complete before point-to-point checkout begins.
  • Direct and verify point-to-point checks, signal calibration, loop tuning, and functional testing of hardware and software control loops.
  • Ensure organized cable routing, proper wire labeling, shielding continuity, grounding compliance, and panel cleanliness.
  • Coordinate automation sequencing and physical interfaces with mechanical, piping, HVAC, liquid-cooling, electrical, fire-protection, structural, and other project disciplines.
  • Collaborate with controls engineers, software vendors, and commissioning authorities to resolve integration bottlenecks, network conflicts, and logic anomalies.
  • Support first-work inspections, mockups, Inspection and Test Plans, quality hold points, and routine field inspections to confirm compliance with approved drawings and sequences of operations.
  • Identify, document, and correct wiring errors, faulty hardware, communication failures, and nonconforming installation practices; manage punch-list items and verify closure before turnover.
  • Support final commissioning, integrated systems testing, and data center black-site testing by troubleshooting active control loops and monitoring real-time system data.
  • Coordinate controls material and hardware deliveries, secure storage, handling, and inventory to prevent damage, theft, or moisture exposure.
  • Track installed quantities, manpower, productivity, network completion, and progress against established milestones; provide accurate daily and weekly updates to construction management.
  • Enforce OSHA regulations, NFPA 70E requirements, and safe work practices around electrical panels, control circuits, scaffolds, ladders, and aerial lifts. Ensure energized work is performed only by qualified personnel under approved procedures.
  • Lead pre-task planning, Job Hazard Analyses, toolbox talks, and field safety observations; participate in incident and near-miss investigations and ensure assigned corrective actions are completed.
  • Maintain daily reports, calibration logs, network as-builts, redlines, and software backup documentation required for system turnover and facility handover.
  • Support vendor- and engineering-led training for site personnel and operations teams on approved panel troubleshooting, hardware layouts, system controls, and emergency override procedures.
  • Ensure approved automation sequences and control strategies are properly implemented to support system reliability, energy efficiency, power usage effectiveness, and high-density cooling performance.

Requirements

  • Journeyman Electrician License.
  • High school diploma or equivalent; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Construction Management, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in commercial or industrial building automation and controls, including at least 2 years of experience leading crews, coordinating field activities, or serving in a supervisory capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience supervising the installation and integration of controls and automation systems in commercial, industrial, or mission-critical environments. Experience with data centers, complex HVAC systems, liquid-cooling infrastructure, power distribution, or central utility plants is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of industrial control systems, network architecture, field instrumentation, and communication protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, Profibus, and EtherNet/IP.
  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting electrical schematics, P&IDs, control drawings, sequences of operations, input/output point lists, and manufacturer specifications.
  • Working knowledge of applicable industry codes and standards, including NEC, UL, ASHRAE, ISA, and NFPA requirements.
  • Strong understanding of loop tuning, signal calibration, point-to-point verification, network troubleshooting, and automated system integration.
  • Ability to plan daily manpower, coordinate access and work sequencing with mechanical and electrical trades, and manage daily and weekly production targets.
  • OSHA 30 certification required; First Aid/CPR, competent-person, fall-protection, and NFPA 70E electrical safety certifications are preferred.
  • Relevant controls certifications, such as Niagara 4 certification, PLC programming credentials, or equivalent manufacturer or trade qualifications, are preferred.
  • Strong leadership, communication, documentation, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to lead field personnel, coordinate subcontractors, and manage daily priorities in a fast-paced construction environment.
  • High attention to detail with a practical, solutions-oriented approach to field quality, software and hardware integration, and constructability issues.

Other Important Requirements:
  • Pre-employment screening, including background check and substance testing may be required according to company policies.
  • Must provide own steel-toed work boots; other PPE will be supplied.
  • Must be able to reliably commute to the work site daily or have plans to relocate before starting work.
  • Must be comfortable working a rotational schedule, which includes day and night shifts as well as weekend work, based on project needs.
  • Employees working night shifts will receive a 15% premium added to their hourly rate only for hours worked during night shifts.

Benefits

At IREN, we offer a comprehensive, market-competitive total rewards package designed to support employees’ well-being, career advancement, and financial wealth. Our offerings reflect our commitment to Proceed with Purpose while rewarding high performance and long-term growth.

Compensation
  • The expected hourly rate for this role starts at $59.00 USD.
    • Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications.
  • Per Diem amount of $180.00 and project allowance, when applicable
  • 15% night-shift premium for eligible roles, when applicable
  • Overtime compensation for non-exempt workers for hours worked over 40 per week
  • Relocation and Living-out-allowance (as applicable and based on successful candidate circumstances)

Health & Wellness

  • 100% company paid health insurance premiums (medical, dental, and vision) for employees, 75% company paid coverage for dependents
  • Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Voluntary life, critical illness, and accident coverage available
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) – when combined with the High-Deductible Health Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources
Retirement & Financial Wealth
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match

Time Off & Leave Programs

Growth & Development

Community & Culture

We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need!

title: Safari Tours Guide
description:
Hours: Up to 37.5, dependent on the needs of the business
Work pattern: Including weekends, bank holidays and evenings
Duration: Permanent – Zero Hour Contract

West Midlands Safari Park are currently recruiting for the position of Safari Tour Guide.
As part of this exciting role you will provide an interactive minibus tour experience around our Safari Animal Reserves, sharing knowledge and insight of our zoological collection and other onsite attractions and experiences with our guests.
The role will also include up-selling items such as Animal Food, Guidebooks and our VIP Experiences, daily vehicle checks including physical inspection and any follow up of vital maintenance.

About you
The ideal candidate will need to be highly motivated, have a strong customer focus and possess excellent communication skills as the role is a predominantly guest facing position.
Applicants must hold a full UK Driving Licence which includes the category D1 and ideally you will have previous driving experience in a professional capacity.
You will need to be flexible in your approach to work outside of standard business hours, including weekends and bank holidays.
This post is subject to a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. This disclosure, together with other selected information, will need to be satisfactory to the Company for employment to commence.

Benefits
As well as benefiting from working in a unique and beautiful setting, you’ll also receive a range of additional perks to employment including:

WMSP Annual Pass which gives you and your family and friends free admission and theme park wristbands, and free entry to our sister site Drayton Manor Park also Water World Stoke On Trent
20% Discount in our retail and catering outlets and off park special events.
24 Hour access to an online doctor and access to online prescriptions.
Counselling access.
Online retailer discount portal.

What we are
West Midlands Safari Park is an award-winning visitor attraction, located in Worcestershire in the heart of England. It is home to some of the world’s most beautiful and critically endangered species, with a four-mile safari drive-through, walk-through Discovery Trail, African Village and Lemur Woods, as well beautiful walking trails, allowing guests to experience up close encounters with hundreds of exotic animals. Guests can also choose from a wide range of catering and retail outlets, as well as enjoying a large amusement area with over 25 rides and attractions providing the ideal venue for family days out.
In 2021, the Park introduced Safari Lodges – luxury accommodation allowing guests to stay overnight for the first time. Guests can wake up to incredible sights of elephants, giraffe, rhino and red panda, or sleep just a ‘whisker’ away from lions, tigers and cheetahs.
In addition, the park is home to three incredible venues – Spring Grove House, Treetops Pavillion and Cellarz, which play host to weddings, corporate events and social celebrations.

What we do
Our mission is to bring people together to create unique wildlife experiences that exhilarate, educate and leave memories to last a lifetime.
Our 200-acre site allows us to do just that, whether you’re a day guest, wedding guest or overnight guest! We create experiences unlike no other, attracting visitors from across the Midlands and beyond.
Our brand and our team members live by our core values. We’re passionate and work with a sense of togetherness, always striving to be progressive, with preservation at the heart of everything we do, all while creating unforgettable experiences.
Through these principles we aspire to achieve our vision: to be the number one UK wildlife attraction through the creation of immersive animal habitats and unique visitor experiences.

title: Tuotantopäällikkö (ohutlevy)
description:
Haluatko johtaa vaativaa ohutlevytuotantoa ja kehittää sen toimintaa osana kasvavaa sopimusvalmistajaa? Laukamo etsii tuotantopäällikköä Somerolle.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Laukamo etsii tuotantopäällikköä vastaamaan Someron ohutlevytuotannon päivittäisestä johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä. Tässä roolissa vastaat noin 30 henkilön tuotanto-organisaatiosta sekä tuotannon tehokkuudesta, laadusta, toimitusvarmuudesta ja tuloksesta.

Työpäiväsi rakentuvat vahvasti tuotannon arjen ympärille. Johdat päivittäisiä tuotannon tilannepalavereita, seuraat toimitusvarmuutta ja tuotannon tunnuslukuja sekä varmistat, että tuotanto etenee suunnitellusti. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä työnjohdon, tuotannonsuunnittelun, projektipäälliköiden sekä myynnin, hankinnan ja suunnittelun kanssa.

Laukamon ohutlevytuotanto valmistaa pieniä tuotantosarjoja, joissa asiakaskohtaiset muutokset ja tuoteversiot ovat arkipäivää. Tuotantopäällikkönä ymmärrät valmistusprosessien mahdollisuudet ja rajoitteet sekä osallistut tarvittaessa myös valmistettavuuden arviointiin ja tarjouslaskennan tukemiseen.

Rooli on vahvasti käytännönläheinen. Tuotantopäällikön odotetaan olevan päivittäin tuotannon puolella, tukemassa henkilöstöä, ratkaisemassa haasteita ja varmistamassa, että tuotanto toimii sujuvasti.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?

Laukamo etsii kokenutta ohutlevytuotannon ammattilaista, joka haluaa ottaa kokonaisvastuun tuotantoyksikön johtamisesta. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää vahvaa substanssiosaamista ohutlevytuotannosta sekä kykyä johtaa ihmisiä määrätietoisella ja helposti lähestyttävällä tavalla.

Aiemman pitkän johtajauran sijaan tärkeämpää on, että tunnet tuotannon arjen, ymmärrät valmistusprosessit käytännössä ja viihdyt siellä, missä työ tehdään. Toimit nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissa, teet päätöksiä rohkeasti ja viet kehityshankkeita järjestelmällisesti eteenpäin.

Hakijalta odotetaan:

  • Soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta tai vastaavaa käytännön kautta hankittua osaamista
  • Vähintään 7–10 vuoden kokemusta ohutlevytuotannosta
  • Kokemusta tuotannon johtamisesta tai esihenkilötehtävistä valmistavassa teollisuudessa
  • Vahvaa ymmärrystä ohutlevytuotannon valmistusprosesseista ja niiden mahdollisuuksista
  • Ymmärrystä tuotannonohjausjärjestelmistä ja tuotannon tunnuslukujen seurannasta
  • Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:

  • Kokemus pulverimaalauksesta
  • Kokemus tarjouslaskennasta tai valmistettavuuden arvioinnista
  • Kokemus investointi- tai tuotannon kehitysprojekteista
  • Halu tuoda uusia toimintatapoja ja näkökulmia tuotannon kehittämiseen

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Vastuullisen roolin, jossa johdat yhtä Laukamon keskeisistä tuotantoyksiköistä ja vaikutat sen tulokselliseen toimintaan
  • Työympäristön, jossa pääset kehittämään tuotannon tehokkuutta, laatua ja toimintamalleja käytännössä
  • Ammattitaitoisen organisaation, jossa saat tueksesi kokeneet asiantuntijat ja tiiviin yhteistyön eri toimintojen kanssa
  • Monipuolisen tuotantoympäristön, jossa yhdistyvät teknologia, ihmiset ja jatkuva kehittäminen
  • Vakaan työnantajan, jossa pääset rakentamaan tuotannon tulevaisuutta osana pitkän linjan sopimusvalmistajaa
  • Kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten työterveyshuollon, ePassin ja vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen

Käytännön asiat:

Tässä vakituisessa ja kokoaikaisessa tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan Laukamon palvelukseen. Tehtävässä aloitusta toivotaan mahdollisimman pian. Tehtaan sijainti on Somerolla, ja tehtävä vaatii työskentelyä pääosin paikan päällä. Palkka tehtävässä on noin 6000-7000 €/kk välillä kokemuksestasi riippuen, ja neuvotellaan ehdokaskohtaisesti.

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, lähetä ansioluettelosi PDF-muodossa suomen kielellä kielellä viimeistään tiistaina 6.10. aTalentin hakujärjestelmän kautta. Motivaatiokirje on vapaaehtoinen, mutta voit tuoda siinä lisätietoa relevantista osaamisestasi ja siitä, miksi tämä rooli olisi sinulle mielenkiintoinen mahdollisuus.

Huomioithan, että käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuajalla niiden tulojärjestyksessä. Emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse, vaan käsittelemme ainoastaan hakujärjestelmän kautta saapuneet hakemukset. Haluamme varmistaa, että kaikki hakijat voivat osallistua prosessiin tasavertaisesti ja huomioimme tarvittaessa yksilölliset esteettömyystarpeet.

Laukamosta voit lukea lisää osoitteessa: . Tehtävää ja hakuprosessia koskeviin kysymyksiin vastaa aTalentin Recruitment Consultant Sofia Hyvärinen (0503613288, sofia.hyvarinen(at)atalent.fi). Jos en heti pääse vastaamaan puhelimeen, jätäthän tekstiviestin, niin soitan sinulle takaisin.

description:
Product Owner for Customer Capabilities Tribe

Do you thrive in a collaborative environment that values empowerment and responsibility? If so, you might be the perfect fit for our new Product Owner role in the Customer Capabilities Tribe.

**We are looking for a Product Owner to both lead a team responsible for both managing one of the Bank’s core systems as well as driving the migration to a modern cloud based solution. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills are essential, along with comprehensive knowledge of various business lines and customer types. You should be adept at translating business needs into technical specifications within a complex landscape.

Our team operates in a scaled agile setup, with squads across multiple geographies, including Business Functional Specialists, Developers, and Centres of Excellence. We strive to enhance our working methods to create value for our consumers and stakeholders. Fostering teamwork and engagement within the squad is crucial, as is collaborating with other Product Owners across the domain/tribe

You will be a system steward, responsible for preparing requirements, planning sprints, and managing stakeholders and consumers. Internally, you will plan and prioritise deliveries, ensuring contributions to the strategy and vision of the area/tribe/domain.

Overall, you will have the opportunity to significantly influence a foundational system within Danske Bank while directly impacting our technical solutions.

  • Experience as a Product Owner or Project Manager, with a strong track record of driving impactful change
  • Expertise in working on strategy, establishing agendas, and having the drive to reach goals

**

**Ready to take the next step?

If you have any questions about this opportunity, please reach out to the Cluster Lead, Michelle Prevost (mpr@danskebank.dk).

title: Persoonlijk begeleider BW Domselaerstraat (32 uur)
description:
Jouw profiel
Wil jij eraan bijdragen dat onze bewoners een stabiele en prettige woonomgeving ervaren? Kom dan tijdelijk ons team versterken.

Je richt je samen met je cliënten op het (terug) krijgen en behouden van eigen regie op hun leven en vooral alledaagse praktische zaken. Je helpt jouw cliënten om verschillende vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en/of te zorgen dat zij stabiel blijven functioneren, waarbij altijd rekening wordt gehouden met eigen regie en krachten van de cliënten. Wij gaan hierbij voor het maximaal haalbare. Het echte thuisgevoel waar wij met elkaar dagelijks aan bijdragen helpt hier enorm bij!

Als persoonlijk begeleider werk je methodisch en richt je je op het maken van onder andere begeleidingsplannen om het ondersteunen en begeleiden van bewoners op rolletjes te laten lopen.
Je monitort, evalueert en rapporteert de hele ontwikkeling van de bewoner op alle leefgebieden en ziet snel wat er nodig is. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor verschillende administratieve taken, intakes, beschikkingen en rapportages. Ook doe je verbetervoorstellen voor (team)processen.

Je hebt wekelijks overleg met collega's en met betrokkenen uit het (professionele) netwerk van de bewoners en stemt jouw begeleiding af op de behandeling door de psychiater. Je hebt hierin een belangrijke signalerende en observerende functie. In crisissituaties ben jij de eerste die actie onderneemt.

Locatie
Beschermd Wonen Domselaerstraat is een 24-uurs WLZ-woonvoorziening waar mensen wonen met een langdurig psychiatrische kwetsbaarheid, soms in combinatie met diverse somatische aandachtspunten. Alle bewoners krijgen intensieve begeleiding/verzorging of verpleging op maat. We hebben twee satellietwoningen en twee Volledig Pakket Thuis (VPT) woningen in de nabije omgeving.

Ons team bestaat uit een teammanager, een zorgcoördinator, ondersteunend begeleiders, persoonlijk begeleiders, regieverpleegkundigen, verzorgenden IG, een huishoudelijk ondersteuner en een kok. We werken volgens een 4-weeks rooster waarbij je ook in het weekend ingeroosterd wordt tussen 07:30 uur tot 22:30 uur.

Jouw profiel
Jij bent een optimistische en proactieve doener en ziet snel wat er nodig is om de meest passende begeleiding en zorg op maat te geven! Je communiceert positief en opbouwend, komt afspraken na en bent nauwkeurig in het bijhouden van rapportages en registraties. Empathisch, geduldig en om hulp kunnen vragen zijn herkenbare eigenschappen van jou. Je collega's feedback geven om onderlinge samenwerking te verbeteren, is één van jouw persoonlijke vaardigheden. Je durft beslissingen te nemen en er ook van te leren als ze niet optimaal uitpakken. Herken je jezelf ook in onderstaande wensen, dan maken we graag kennis met jou!

  • Je beschikt over aantoonbaar HBO werk- en denkniveau en hebt ervaring binnen de psychiatrie;
  • Zelfstandig werken, samenwerken en zelfreflectie zitten in je DNA;
  • Vanzelfsprekend denk je in mogelijkheden en oplossingen;
  • Het is een talent van jou om de regie en het overzicht te houden, ook als het eens flink anders loopt;
  • Je bent innovatief van geest en je durft te pionieren om de WLZ begeleiding -en zorg continue te verbeteren;
  • Je hebt affiniteit met de doelgroep of ervaringskennis die aansluit bij de doelgroep.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden en bijzonderheden

  • Een baan met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief;
  • Het betreft in eerste instantie een contract voor de duur van een jaar met uitzicht op verlenging;
  • Jouw salaris bedraagt minimaal € 3.560,- en maximaal € 4.716- bruto per maand (schaal 50, CAO GGZ) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek;
  • Een 2e klas mobiliteitskaart voor woon-werkverkeer en dienstreizen met OV of gebruik van OV-fiets;
  • Je ontvangt bij een 36-urige werkweek minimaal 23 verlofdagen per jaar. Door feestdagencompensatie en LFB-uren (levensfasebudget) kan dit oplopen tot ongeveer 34 verlofdagen. Daarnaast kun je extra verlofuren kopen vanuit je vakantiegeld, balansbudget en/of 13e maand.
  • Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform CAO GGZ. Denk hierbij aan vakantiegeld, pensioen, fietsplan en een eindejaarsuitkering. We vinden vitaliteit belangrijk en bieden jou daarom jaarlijks een sportvergoeding van €100,-;
  • Een jaarlijks balansbudget van € 500 (op basis van een fulltime dienstverband). Voor de besteding hiervan kun je kiezen uit de drie opties zoals beschreven in de CAO GGZ;
  • Je hebt ruime keuze uit opleidingen en cursussen;
  • Een referentiecheck en verklaring omtrent gedrag maken onderdeel uit van deze procedure. Tijdens de onboarding vragen we je om een online competentievragenlijst in te vullen;
  • Met een interactief onboardingsprogramma bieden we jou een warm welkom en een goede start.

HVO-Querido heeft de ambitie om een inclusieve en gelijkwaardige organisatie te zijn waar alle cliënten en medewerkers zichzelf kunnen zijn en zich thuis voelen, met als doel om betere kwaliteit van zorg te leveren aan onze cliënten en een veilige en inspirerende werkplek te bieden voor onze medewerkers. Bij HVO-Querido werken we vanuit drie kennisbronnen: ervaringskennis, praktijkkennis en wetenschappelijke inzichten.

Meer informatie?
Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Feliza Santana Toledo, zorgcoördinator, via 06-44294145. Als je vragen hebt over de procedure, kun je bellen met junior recruiter Sana Pinto Silva via 06-15365021.

Direct solliciteren?
Graag ontvangen we je digitale reactie vóór 6 oktober a.s.

title: Loss Prevention Officer Overnight
description:
Loss Prevention Officer Overnight

Overview:

The Overnight Loss Prevention Officer ensures the safety and tranquil stay of hotel guests and employees, to enforce the policies and procedures of the hotel and to record in writing any assigned task. Prepare incident and accident reports accurately and in the format specified by the Director of Loss Prevention.

Responsibilities:

To observe and report on all assignments
Able to keep accurate records and communicate using radio equipment.
Record and report any unsafe conditions while patrolling hotel property.
To ensure protection and preservation of hotel, guest, and employee property.
Maintain professional attitude and appearance.
Patrol hotel property to ensure the safety of guests and employees and to protect all hotel assets.
Answer house calls to assist both guests and associates with respect to safety, security and hotel operations.
Initiate and follow-up with all investigations of crimes committed against property and persons.
Assist sick/injured guests or associates ensuring all documentation, reporting and witness statements have been completed within a timely manner.
Initiate investigations, write incident and accident reports, monitor investigations to their timely conclusion and ensure appropriate follow-up with guests, visitors and employees, documenting all contacts.
Maintain accurate records while performing basic duties including, but not limited to, camera monitoring, shift activity log, codebook and employee/guest interactions.
Monitor/distribute visitor and vendor access to the property by distributing visitor badges.
Perform frequent bag checks for associates leaving the property.
Escort and interact with special guests that need privacy when entering/exiting the hotel through heart of the house areas.
Maintain confidentiality when dealing with sensitive guest or associate issues.
Assist supervisor or director in checking alarm systems, safety and fire alarm systems and closely monitoring security of building doors, service areas, delivery areas and grounds.
Assist hotel management in emergency situations by knowing all hotel safety procedures and leading/directing guests and associates to safety.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Previous experience as a Loss Prevention Officer is strongly preferred.
Must be able to stand and walk for entire shift.
Must be able to communicate effectively by telephone, email, radio and reporting.
Must have basic computer knowledge.
Must be able to reach various areas of the hotel/resort at a rapid pace if necessary.
First Aid/CPR Certification is preferred.
Must be able to stand & walk for up to 4 hours in length.
Must be able to bend, stoop, squat and stretch to daily task
Must be able to lift items weighing in excess of 15 lbs. routinely.
Must be able to push and pull carts and equipment weighing up to 250 lbs
Must be able to exert well-paced ability in limited space and to reach other departments and locations of the hotel and outside the hotel on hotel grounds on a timely basis.
Requires grasping, writing, standing, sitting, walking, repetitive motions, bending, climbing, listening and hearing ability and visual acuity.
Must be able to remain calm and professional during stressful situations.
Must be able to work overnight shifts, weekends and holidays
Requires manual dexterity to use and operate all necessary equipment.
Must have finger dexterity to be able to operate office equipment such as computers, printers, 10-key adding machine, electric typewriter, multi-line touch tone phone, filing cabinets, FAX machines, photocopiers, dolly and other office equipment as needed.

title: Medical Writing Coordinator/Publisher I
description:
The Medical Writing Coordinator/Publisher I part of the Strategic Medical Writing Operations Team is dedicated to delivering high-quality, scientifically accurate, and strategically aligned clinical and regulatory documentation that supports AbbVie's mission to transform the standard of care. Our team serves as a critical link between research, development, and regulatory submissions, ensuring clarity and compliance in all clinical and regulatory documents. We strive to innovate and enhance the processes of medical writing through cross-functional collaboration, agile methodologies, and the integration of cutting-edge technology, driving forward AbbVie's commitment to improving patient outcomes worldwide.

Responsibilities:

  • Defines scope of formatting, report publishing and Clinical Study Reports (CSR) Appendices activities with the document author. Coordinate and track activities and perform detailed quality reviews. Import and route documents in the regulatory information management systems (RIMS).
  • Ensure document format and styles are consistent with the defined in RIMS and are consistent with the clinical and regulatory templates. Ensure document properties and naming conventions are used. Maintain strong knowledge of RIMS styes and formatting standards.
  • Ensures all documents are published in RIMS content management system meet required timelines. Maintain strong knowledge of RIMS and publishing tools/software.
  • Confirm completeness of documents (e.g. Casebooks, Literature References) by obtaining, compiling, and organizing in the regulatory information management system (RIMS). Maintain strong knowledge of CSR and CSR Appendices and CTD structure.
  • Contributes to the development, implementation, and maintenance of medical writing operations business processes. Acts as subject matter expert (SME) for the master file system and formatting, report publishing, or Clinical Study Reports (CSR) Appendices to the medical writing stakeholders.
  • Effectively communicates deliverables needed to stakeholders. Must demonstrate good interpersonal and organizational communication skills, including conflict management skills.
  • Assists in the management of the centralized mailbox. Tracks and maintains metrics and assists in the preparation and maintenance of training documents.
  • Mentors and provides guidance and training to less senior medical writing operations staff members.

Significant Work Activities: Continuous sitting for prolonged periods (more than 2 consecutive hours in an 8 hr day) is required.

  • High School diploma required. Note: Higher education may compensate for years of experience. Years of experience may also compensate for lower education.
  • A minimum of 2 years of relevant industry experience within medical writing in a global pharma, biotech, life science, federal agency organization delivering medicines/ therapies to a broad market across various therapeutic areas.
  • Background of organization and content of clinical documents and eCTD structure. Knowledge of drug development and experience with Common Technical Document (CTD) content templates.
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills, with a comprehensive knowledge of medical and scientific terminology across multiple therapeutic areas.
  • Detail oriented with a commitment to delivering high quality, accurate and compliant documentation.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficient skills and knowledge in Microsoft Office Products (Excel, OneNote, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project, SharePoint, Visio, Word) and Adobe in Windows operating system environment required. Proficient skills and knowledge in Microsoft document file formats (DocX) or other style file format tools, publishing software, and content management archival system(s) for eTMF/eSubmissions (Veeva Vault, CARA). Proficient skills and knowledge in reference management software (e.g., EndNote).

title: Summer 2027 Internship in Digital Signal Processing & Machine Learning - R148
description:
Expedition Technology (EXP) leads the way in combining machine learning with digital signal processing. Spend your summer immersing yourself in the fascinating world of digital signal processing and deep learning alongside top-tier engineers. Join our mission to tackle the unsolved challenges in the thrilling new field of Radio Frequency Machine Learning.

What will you do as a Signal Processing and Machine Learning Intern?
· Learn & Develop: Delve into real-time machine learning systems operating on streaming, real-world RF data. Craft novel algorithms for GPU-accelerated digital signal analysis across diverse RF domains like communications and radar.
· Implement: Leverage Python to execute core digital signal processing tasks – from filtering and spectral analysis to waveform generation. Work with the team to integrate your solutions to run in real systems to demonstrate their effectiveness. Utilize and deploy modern DevOps and MLOps tools.
· Collaborate: Engage in data processing pipelines, training ML systems, analyzing outcomes, working alongside a team of developers, and tackling real-world issues alongside our esteemed teams.

Key Details:

  • Location: Onsite at Expedition Technology HQ, Herndon, VA.
  • Compensation: $35.00/hr
  • Duration: Full-time (40 hours/week) Summer 2027

Is an EXP summer internship right for you?
Eligible candidates should meet the following criteria:

  • United States citizenship is required for security clearance purposes
  • Currently enrolled student pursuing a college degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, data science, AI/ML or related major with an emphasis in Digital Signal Processing
  • Entering final year of an undergraduate or graduate program with an anticipated graduation date of December 2027 or May 2028
  • Proficiency in modern programming languages (Python preferred)
  • Familiarity with command line and version control (Git) experience
  • Interest in signal processing (courses, clubs, projects, etc.)
  • Interest in machine learning (RF, audio, computer-vision, LLMs)
  • Interest in working in defense and intelligence post-graduation
  • Must be willing to undergo background investigation for a US-government issued security clearance if not already cleared
  • Experience creating and delivering technical presentations

Extra bonus points if you:
  • Have an active Secret, Top Secret, or Top Secret/SCI security clearance

About Expedition Technology (EXP)
Expedition Technology (EXP) designs, develops, and delivers innovative solutions with national impact for the defense and intelligence communities. We use machine learning, artificial intelligence, and other advanced algorithms, platforms, and technologies to solve our customers' most complex, demanding and urgent C4ISR challenges. Our culture promotes individual growth and opportunity, prioritizes a collaborative team spirit, and invites the intellectually curious to solve challenging problems creatively. Headquarted in Northern Virginia's high-tech corrdor, EXP is a rapidly growing, privately held company that pushes the boundaries of what is possible every day.

title: Myyjä, Lappeenranta Suonionkatu 18
description:
Hymyiletkö vielä silloinkin, kun kiire painaa päälle? Sytytkö asiakaskohtaamisista ja haluat tehdä arjesta helpompaa – sekä itsellesi että muille? Jos nyökkäilit, saatat olla seuraava R‑kioskin myyjämme.

R‑kioskilla asiakkaamme tulevat hakemaan nopeutta, mutkattomuutta ja hyvää fiilistä. Myyjänä olet tämän kokemuksen ydin: palvelun ammattilainen, joka osaa ratkaista tilanteet tyynesti ja toimia omatoimisesti myös silloin, kun tehtäviä on monta.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

  • Palvelet asiakkaita ystävällisesti ja tehokkaasti – myös ruuhkahetkinä.
  • Hallitset kassatyöskentelyn, tuotteet, palvelut ja lisämyynnin tilanteet rennolla otteella.
  • Esittelet ja suosittelet rohkeasti uutuuksia sekä kampanjatuotteita.
  • Huolehdit, että kioski on siisti, viihtyisä ja hyllyt runsaat.
  • Osallistut arjen sujuvuuteen: asiakkaat, työkaverit ja sinä viihdytte kioskilla yhtä lailla.

Miksi juuri sinä sopisit meille?

  • Olet oma-aloitteinen ja rohkea tarttumaan tehtäviin.
  • Pystyt ratkomaan ongelmatilanteita nopeasti ja palveluasenteella.
  • Sykähdyt vauhdikkaasta työstä ja nautit siitä, että jokainen päivä on erilainen.
  • Haluat tehdä työtä vastuullisesti – meillä se näkyy sekä valikoimassa että arjen teoissa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen, jonka aikana opit työn perusteet ja käytännöt.
  • Mahdollisuuden kasvaa myynnin ja asiakaspalvelun ammattilaiseksi.
  • Halutessasi väylän kohti esihenkilö- tai yrittäjäpolkua: voit hakea Trainee‑valmennusohjelmaamme ja edetä aina oman R‑kioskin yrittäjäksi asti.

Haemme Lappeenranta Suonionkatu 18 R-kioskille myyjää. Työsuhde on osa-aikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Toivomme että pystyt työskentelemään keskimäärin 15 h/vko ja pystyt aloittamaan työt mahdollisimman pian tai sopimuksen mukaan!

Arvostamme

• Aikaisempaa kokemusta asiakaspalvelutyöstä

• Kiinnostusta kahvila- ja delimaailmaan

• Kokemusta pelimyynnistä ja postitoiminnoista

Edellytämme

• Ystävällistä ja iloista asiakaspalveluasennetta

• Reipasta myyntihenkisyyttä

• Itsenäistä ja vastuullista otetta työhön

• Hygieniapassia (jos sinulla ei vielä passia ole, voit suorittaa sen koeajan puitteissa)

• Mahdollisuutta työskennellä kaksivuorotyössä

• Vähintään 18 vuoden ikää

• Tarkastamme luottotiedot osana rekrytointiprosessia

Dedicated to innovation, timeliness and exceptional delivery of care, a dynamic, diverse, and challenging career in Aviation excellence awaits.

Looking to be a part of meaningful, impactful, and inspiring work?

Meet our requirements? Interview guaranteed. We’ve got you covered from competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and premium pension program so what are you waiting for? Apply today.

Position Summary:

Rotor Wing Pilots are responsible for all aspects of aircraft operation, must be able to fly in varying conditions, handle pressure well and be flexible and adaptable. Ornge aircraft are province wide resources and aviation personnel may be required to provide flight support at bases other than the home base where demand arises. All Ornge pilots are required to complete the company’s training program and successfully pass a Transport Canada PPC. They are responsible for following all applicable policies and Standard Operating Procedures. The Second-in-Command (SIC) assists the Pilot-in-Command with the flight planning and Aircraft preparation as directed by the Pilot-in-Command. They are responsible to the Pilot-in-Command for carrying out specific duties in connection with the operation of the aircraft assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Completion of secondary school and graduation from a certified flying or aviation school.
  • Valid Air Transport Pilot’s Licence (ATPL) (Helicopter) issued by Transport Canada.
  • A minimum of 2000 hours of Rotary-wing flight experience.
  • A minimum of 500 hours of experience as a Pilot-In-Command (PIC) of a multi-engine aircraft.
  • 2 years of experience in Instrument Flight Operations.
  • Valid Group 4 Instrument Rating.
  • Valid Class 1 Medical.
  • Experience flying multi-engine helicopters is desirable.
  • Experience using Night Vision Goggles (NVG) and flying for Emergency Medical Service (EMS) or equivalent is desirable.
  • Ability to successfully complete the Controlled Goods Security Assessment Application for Night Vision Goggle (NVG) purposes.
  • Valid Canadian Passport or ability to work in Canada and ability to travel to the USA.
  • Required: A satisfactory criminal record search and Immunization records with required vaccinations.

Hours and Location of Work:

  • Pilots are required to work various shifts (standard 12 hours) and overtime, including day and night shifts and weekends in a 24/7 environment, including days, afternoons and nights on weekdays, weekends, and statutory holidays.
  • During the course of their shift duties, Pilots will be required to overnight away from their home base.
  • Successful candidates must live or be willing to relocate within close proximity to the assigned base location, and reside or have a location that permits compliance with the CARs rest requirements between shifts and allows arrival at their assigned base within one- and one-half hour of callout when on an on-call shift; and
  • Employees may be required to use respiratory protective equipment and they shall co-operate in attaining an effective fit of the equipment and in particular, be clean shaven to ensure an effective facial seal to provide for the health and safety of all employees.

Total Rewards:

  • Uniform Provided.
  • Defined Contribution Plan.
  • Three Paid Personal Days.
  • 24/7 Employee and Family Assistance Program.
  • Accrued vacation time starting at three weeks per year.
  • PERKS! Employee Promotional Programs relating to personal phone plans, furniture, home/car insurance, travel, fitness, attractions and more!

At Ornge, we are:

  • Community connectors.
  • Equity in healthcare.
  • Strong in our convictions.
  • Proud of the services we provide.
  • Uplifting in our mission, values, and services.

You can expect us to be:

  • Competitive in pay, benefits, vacation time and more.
  • Promoters of diversity.
  • Champions of inclusivity and accessibility.
  • Committed to your career advancement.
  • A tight-knit, supportive culture.

A bit about you:

  • You are driven by our collective desire to make a difference.
  • Excited by problem solving and excels at in-the-moment decision making.
  • Teamwork has always been where you thrive.
  • You are ready to put your skills into action in a fast-paced environment.

What’s next:

title: Technical Helpdesk Engineer
description:
Dometic is a global market leader in the mobile living industry. Millions of people around the world use Dometic products in outdoor, residential, and professional applications. We are on a growth journey – now looking for a Technical Helpdesk Engineer to support our clients from technical point of view.

About the position

Are you technically skilled, customer-focused, and energized by solving challenging issues? Then this is your opportunity to make an impact within an international brand with strong products and a close-knit local team.

At Dometic, everything revolves around smart, reliable solutions for life on the move. Our customers count on quality, expert advice, and service that goes beyond simply providing an answer. You will become part of a dedicated team within Dometic Benelux, report to the Service Manager, and make a visible contribution every day to satisfied customers, strong service, and lasting relationships.

As a Technical Helpdesk Engineer, you are the specialist who supports customers by phone and email with product questions, malfunctions, and technical challenges. You actively think along, ask the right questions, and provide clear, practical solutions. Where needed, you quickly coordinate with colleagues or service partners, ensuring that customers feel well supported.

In this role, you will enjoy plenty of variety and responsibility.

Your Main Responsibility

  • Helping customers quickly, professionally, and in a friendly manner with technical questions by phone and email.
  • Supporting internal and external sales teams with your technical knowledge and practical advice.
  • Clearly analyzing complex issues, taking a solution-oriented approach, and carefully escalating when necessary.
  • Diagnosing and repairing products in the Service Center, continuously expanding your product knowledge and keeping it directly applicable.
  • Handling complaints and warranty requests in a professional, customer-focused, and careful manner.
  • Contributing to a strong service experience by identifying and sharing opportunities for improvement.

What do we offer?

At Dometic, you will have the opportunity to further develop your technical knowledge, take responsibility, and work with colleagues who take pride in their profession. You will join an international organization with strong brands, short lines of communication, and a pleasant working atmosphere.

  • A suitable salary that matches your knowledge, experience, and added value.

  • MBO/HBO level in Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable field.

You are someone who understands technology and can guide customers toward a solution in a pleasant and clear way. You think in possibilities, remain calm when dealing with complex questions, and enjoy applying your knowledge in practice every day.

title: AI Product Design Engineer, Interface & Experience
description:
About Us

ISMG is a global intelligence firm and media powerhouse, leading the way in cybersecurity, enterprise IT, and digital transformation. With 10+ brands, 38 digital media properties, and over 400 premier events annually—ISMG connects a network of over 2M executives, decision-makers, and innovators with the insights and opportunities they need to stay ahead.

Apollo is the proprietary creation of ISMG's AI & Innovation team. It's an internal hub of AI-powered applications and workflows, custom-built for our various business units (Editorial, Marketing, Events, Sales, HR, etc.). It streamlines operations with intelligent automation and data-driven insights, and transforms how teams access critical cybersecurity insights by exclusively leveraging ISMG-verified sources—so teams move faster with confidence.

The Opportunity

ISMG is building a portfolio of AI-native intelligence products — audience analytics reporting, an AI-generated daily cybersecurity newscast, and a sourced Q&A system built on our conference archive. Every one of them is currently limited by the same thing: the interface.

We have the pipelines, the data warehouse, and the models. What we do not have is anyone who owns what a CISO actually sees. You would be that person.

This is a founding design-engineering role on a small team, with unusual latitude and unusual visibility. What you ship goes in front of security executives, ISMG’s editorial organization, and enterprise clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the front-end and interaction design for the team’s AI products end to end — from stakeholder conversation to deployed application.

  • Conduct lightweight user research, prototype workflows, and validate designs with clients and internal users before and after release.

  • Translate complex AI and reporting workflows into clear information architecture and task-oriented experiences.

  • Solve the interaction problems specific to AI output: how confidence is communicated, how citations surface, how a reviewer approves or rejects a machine-generated draft, and how uncertainty reads without eroding trust.

  • Build quickly with AI-assisted development tooling, then rehome that output into ISMG’s Azure environment — Microsoft Entra ID authentication, App Service or Static Web Apps, and Azure DevOps pipelines.

  • Establish the design system this team does not currently have: components, states, data visualization patterns, and an accessibility baseline.

  • Build and maintain Figma libraries, design tokens, and a practical design-to-code handoff process.

  • Design for enterprise realities: role-based access, dense data, audit trails, exports, responsive behavior, and accessible interaction patterns.

  • Instrument everything through Application Insights and bring adoption and usage data back into the roadmap.

  • Partner directly with the AI Innovation Manager on API contracts and data access, and with business units across editorial, marketing, and sales on what they actually need.

What You Bring to the Table

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in a UI/UX role building production web interfaces, or a relevant level of skills displayed through a personal project portfolio.

  • Enterprise Applications Design: Experience designing B2B applications with complex permissions, data-heavy workflows, and high expectations around trust, clarity, and reliability.

  • UI/UX: Strong understanding of user flows, interaction patterns, responsive UX, and intuitive interface design.

  • User-Centered Discovery: Experience interviewing users, testing prototypes, synthesizing feedback, and changing direction when evidence warrants it.

  • Frontend: Advanced proficiency in Next.js, React, TypeScript, and semantic HTML/CSS.

  • Design Systems: Strong expertise in Tailwind CSS, design tokens, themes, and dark mode.

  • Design Judgment: Can articulate why a layout works, not simply reproduce one you have seen.

  • AI Workflow: Experience using Claude for prototyping and Claude Code with VS Code/Cursor to turn UI/UX requirements into production-ready frontend code.

  • Azure Deployment: Prior work experience or clear evidence in the ability to quickly learn. Microsoft Entra ID and MSAL authentication is a meaningful plus.

  • Data Visualization: Report building capability using Recharts, D3, Plotly, or similar.

  • Accessibility & Performance: Strong knowledge of WCAG, ARIA, and Core Web Vitals.

  • Attention to Detail: Strong eye for spacing, typography, motion, responsiveness, and visual issues AI-generated code may miss.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for streaming or long-running AI responses.

  • Human-in-the-loop review interfaces.

  • Audio or podcast product UI.

  • B2B media or intelligence products.

🎯 Why ISMG?

  • Join a high-growth, global intelligence organization with clear momentum and market leadership in the cybersecurity space.

  • Combine hands-on AI systems work with clear storytelling that drives adoption—turning insights into measurable business results.

  • Thrive in a collaborative environment with a team that values excellence and offers continuous learning and professional development opportunity.

👉 Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now or visit to learn more!

title: Production Washroom Operator
description:
Overview
Performs work as part of a team in an industrial laundry facility. Responsible for the safe, expeditious, and accurate handling of merchandise into and/or out of the laundry facility.
Responsibilities / Essential Functions

Checks all machine safety devices before operating equipment and records and signs the appropriate equipment safety form. If machine does not pass safety inspection, operator will not operate unit, and notifies supervisor.
When loading washer, retrieve sling from storage and maneuvers sling to the washer’s rails and in front of the washer. If loading a dryer, obtain an extracted sling from the overhead feed rail and verifies each batch ticket to avoid mixing lots and batches. Stages similar batches together for maximum product/wash utilization.
Positions washer/dryer in proper loading position (tilted up), removes batch ticket, loads the washer/dryer by untying the bottom cord of sling, forces the items into the washer/dryer cylinder, closes washer/dryer doors, lowers washer/dryer to the horizontal position, selects the appropriate washer/dryer formula, and starts the machine.
Takes the batch ticket and writes the ticket information on the washer/dryer form visually displayed by the machine.
For washer, enters the weight off of the batch ticket into SOFTROL. For dryer, re-ties the sling and transports to hoist staging area.
Unloads washer: opens washer door, tilts washer forward, moves lined cart with clean sling, and removes items from the washer into the cart, places batch tickets on top of items, moves cart to sling raise area, and tilts washer back into load position.
Unloads dryer: opens the front door, ensures items are at the proper moisture levels (if not, re-dry), raises the front-end of the dryer, moves to the rear of the machine, opens the rear door, places the appropriate tub at the dryer opening, removes items from dryer, places batch ticket on top of items, stores in appropriate area, closes rear door, and leaves dryer in tilted position to aid in loading process.
Verifies proper moisture retention of items, carts/tubs are not overload, load items are at proper temperature, all extracted slings are free of excessive water, and all items are properly cooled down.
Identifies any slings with rips or tears and removes them from the system.
Maintains safe and clean work environment, and observes best practices in all production activities.
Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

Ability to understand all required training, written, and verbal instructions.
Working knowledge of basic math skills.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to meet attendance schedule.

Working Environment / Safety Requirements

Work is performed in a warehouse setting and regularly exposed to outside weather conditions, extreme heat and cold conditions as well as dust and noise.
Work is based on a shift schedule, and may include weekends.
Overtime required as needed.

Physical Requirements
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Requires the ability to move or maneuver slings or carriers weighing up to 220 lbs.
Requires the ability to move, lift, carry, push, or pull product weighing up to 50 lbs.
Requires bending, reaching, pulling, and pressing at shoulder level and below waist area.
Requires the use of hands for grasping and other manipulations.
Requires standing and walking for long periods of time.

Education
High school degree or equivalent preferred.

title: Integrated Master Scheduler
description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Job Overview

The Integrated Master Scheduler is responsible for the day-to-day development,

maintenance, analysis, and publication of the shipyard's Integrated Master Schedule (IMS)

across all active and planned vessels. The IMS provides the portfolio-level forecast for

major vessel milestones, vessel sequencing, shared resources, production capacity,

facility constraints, and conflicts across the orderbook. The Scheduling & Planning

Manager retains overall accountability and approval authority for the portfolio schedule.

Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule covering all active and

planned new-construction vessels at the Franklin, Louisiana shipyard location.

• Integrate major hull milestones from detailed vessel schedules into a consistent

portfolio-level forecast.

• Maintain common WBS, activity coding, calendars, milestone definitions, data

dates, and schedule interfaces across the portfolio.

• Ensure vessel schedules and the IMS reconcile each update-cycle and that hull-

level milestone movement is visible in the site forecast.

• Model vessel sequencing through major production stages, facilities, and

constrained resources.

• Maintain logic for shared facilities and resources such as jigs, cranes, paint areas,

launch positions, test equipment, specialist labor, and other capacity-limited

assets.

• Identify conflicts between vessels, trade stacking, workspace congestion, resource

contention, and unachievable capacity assumptions.

• Evaluate portfolio scenarios and what-if alternatives for vessel starts, phase

transitions, facility occupancy, and resource allocation.

• Support management decisions on production priorities, vessel sequencing,

recovery strategies, and capacity requirements.

• Serve as day-to-day custodian of configuration, schedule logic, calendars,

baselines, data dates, forecasting, and schedule calculations.

• Perform portfolio-level critical and near-critical path analysis, float review,

milestone variance analysis, and schedule performance trending.

• Execute schedule variance and Schedule Performance Index (SPI) analysis where

applicable and develop milestone bar charts, S-curves, progress curves, and

exception reports.

• Review open ends, invalid logic, negative float, excessive float, lags, constraints,

out-of-sequence progress, and calendar assignments each update cycle.

• Allow valid logic and remaining duration to drive forecast dates rather than manually

moving activities to preserve desired milestones.

• Develop weekly and monthly portfolio schedule reports, milestone dashboards,

critical-path summaries, executive summaries, and recovery-option analyses.

• Present schedule exceptions requiring priorities, resources, or management

decisions.

• Maintain schedule change, delay/risk, decision/action, and milestone-variance

records in accordance with established controls.

• Maintain the standard vessel schedule architecture, common milestone definitions,

interface points, coding, and duration-history framework.

• Incorporate approved lessons learned from completed and repeat hulls into

standard planning templates.

• Support development of historical schedule and productivity data for future

estimating, capacity planning, and production forecasting.

• Partner with Vessel Planners to improve forecast quality without taking ownership

away from the detailed hull schedules.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • [5–8]+ years of planning/scheduling or project controls experience, including integrated or master schedule ownership, preferably in shipbuilding, marine, or complex fabrication environments.

  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 or similar scheduling software, including multi-project integration and resource- and/or cost-loaded schedules.

  • Strong command of critical path method (CPM) scheduling, earned value concepts, and schedule performance metrics (SV, SPI).

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, for reporting and data analysis.

  • Experience maintaining an integrated master schedule across multiple concurrent new construction vessels or similarly complex programs.

  • Familiarity with capacity planning, facility/berth constraints, and shared-resource management across a portfolio.

  • PMI-SP, AACE PSP, or similar scheduling/project controls certification.

Physical Demands

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

  • Occasional standing and walking within the office

  • Manual dexterity to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment

  • Visual acuity to read screens, documents, and reports

  • Occasional reaching, bending, or stooping to access file drawers, cabinets, or office supplies

  • Lifting and carrying items up to 20 pounds occasionally (e.g., office supplies, packages)

Benefits

Medical Insurance: Comprehensive health insurance plans covering a range of services

Saronic pays 100% of the premium for employees and 80% for dependents

Dental and Vision Insurance: Coverage for routine dental check-ups, orthodontics, and vision care

Saronic pays 100% of the premium under the basic plan for employees and 80% for dependents

title: TerraFirma - Career Fair
description:
At TerraFirma, we’re redefining how the world moves earth for construction. Founded by former SpaceX engineers and backed by Kleiner Perkins and Bain Capital Ventures, TerraFirma is automating construction to make it faster, cheaper, and safer.

Our Story & Mission

At SpaceX, we were part of the teams that built the largest rocket in human history, launched the largest constellation of satellites ever made, and delivered connectivity to millions of people worldwide. What we learned was simple: infrastructure is everything.

At Starbase, the biggest barrier to launching missions to Mars was not building the rocket. It was how slow, expensive, and complex it was to build the infrastructure around it. We lacked buildings, roads, water, power, communications, and waste management, and constructing them took far more time and resources than it should have.

From a first-principles perspective, that doesn't make sense. It shouldn't be this hard or costly to create the foundations for progress. That’s when we realized something important: the same engineering mindset that enabled us to tackle space exploration and mass manufacturing could be applied to infrastructure. By bringing the principles of simplification, iteration, acceleration, and automation to construction, we can unlock a new era in how the world builds.

Accelerating infrastructure unlocks progress across every domain, creating a self-sustaining engine for tackling humanity’s toughest challenges. The innovations we develop on Earth will lay the groundwork for the technologies that one day make settlement on Mars possible.

Why TerraFirma

We're a small, fast-moving team building autonomous heavy equipment from the ground up — hardware, perception, embedded systems, and the software that lets humans control robots doing real physical work in the real world. If you want your work to show up on an actual job site, not just in a demo, this is that kind of company.

What We're Hiring For

We're growing across engineering and are especially interested in students and new grads with backgrounds in:

  • Software Engineering (full-stack, real-time systems, robotics control interfaces)

  • Perception & Machine Learning (computer vision, sensor fusion, autonomy)

  • Embedded Systems (firmware, real-time control, hardware integration)

  • Electrical Engineering (PCB design, power electronics, hardware bring-up)

  • Mechanical Engineering (design, DFMA, manufacturing)

  • Robotics & Autonomy (broadly — if you've built something that moves in the real world, we want to talk)

What We're Looking For

  • A genuine builder mentality — comfortable in ambiguity, wants ownership, not looking for a narrow lane

  • Strong technical fundamentals in your area, whether from coursework, research, or personal projects

  • Real interest in hard, physical engineering problems, not just software in the abstract

  • Open to relocating to Austin, TX

Internships & Full-Time

We're hiring for both internships and full-time roles. Tell us which you're interested in and what you're excited to work on.

title: Seniorutvikler
description:
Hos Entur gjør vi det enkelt å reise kollektivt i hele Norge. Mer enn 30 produktteam utvikler tjenester som gjør det enkelt å planlegge og kjøpe reiser på tvers av alle kollektivoperatørene i hele Norge.

I Team Bedrift bygger vi en tjeneste der organisasjoner kan distribuere billetter til ulike grupper. Hver person henter så ut sin billett i Entur-appen eller en annen reiseapp.

Første bruksområde var skoleskyss. Til skolestart i august fikk 5.000 elever skoleskyssbilletten på mobilen for første gang. Nå bygger vi bedriftsløsninger på samme plattform, først for arbeidsplasser og etter hvert for flere typer organisasjoner: NAV, flyktningmottak, sykehus, ideelle organisasjoner og kriminalomsorgen. Felles for dem er at de vil gjøre det enklere og rimeligere for grupper å reise kollektivt.

Teamet består i dag av en techlead og to utviklere, og en designer og produktleder. Vi jobber som et lite produktteam med stor grad av autonomi, samtidig som vi har tryggheten og kompetansen til hele Entur i ryggen. Det vi lager går raskt fra idé til produksjon og brukes av tusenvis av mennesker. Som utvikler får du være med på hele prosessen, og du har gode muligheter til å påvirke både teknologivalg, produktutvikling og hvordan teamet jobber.

Nå ser vi etter en fullstack-utvikler som er sterk på React og moderne webutvikling. Du liker å jobbe tett med produkt og design, tar initiativ og ønsker å påvirke både produktet vi bygger og hvordan teamet jobber.

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du

  • har erfaring med moderne webutvikling, gjerne React og
  • samarbeider godt med andre og har lyst til å påvirke og bidra også utenfor selve kodearbeidet
  • har noen års erfaring fra tverrfaglig produktutviklingsteam
  • deler kunnskap og bidrar til et godt fagmiljø
  • har utdanning på høyskolenivå, eller annen relevant erfaring som gir tilsvarende kompetanse

Norsk er arbeidsspråket i Entur, så det er viktig at du behersker norsk godt, både muntlig og skriftlig.

Du trenger ikke kunne alt dette, men det er en fordel om du har erfaring med eller interesse for

  • å bruke data og innsikt for å forstå brukernes behov og prioritere riktig
  • universell utforming, sikkerhet og personvern
  • distribuerte systemer, mikrotjenester og skybaserte tjenester
  • Teknologier vi bruker i dag, som TypeScript, Next.js, React, Google Cloud Platform, Apigee, Firebase, GitHub Actions, Grafana, Terraform og Auth0, PostHog og Grafana.

Vi tilbyr

  • En plass i et lite team med stor påvirkningskraft, der du får være med på å forme et nytt satsingsområde og bygge tjenester med stor verdi for hele kollektiv-Norge.
  • En dynamisk og mangfoldig arbeidsplass med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
  • Stort fagmiljø og mulighet for personlig utvikling
  • God lunsj og kaffe
  • Rabatterte togbilletter i Norge og Europa.
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn, god pensjonsordning og fleksibel arbeidshverdag med mulighet for hjemmekontor.
  • Moderne lokaler sentralt i Oslo sentrum (Rådhusgata)

Som offentlig eid selskap er vi pålagt å ha offentlige søkerlister. Dersom du ønsker å reservere deg fra oppføring må dette begrunnes. Du vil bli varslet om reservasjon ikke tas til følge.

title: Tendermanager Energieprojecten
description:
Uitdagende tenders, grote projecten, impact op de toekomst – iets voor jou?

WAAROM HANAB?

Wij zijn Hanab. Wij bouwen we al meer dan 150 jaar mee aan de vooruitgang van Nederland. Met zes divisies gespecialiseerd in energie, techniek en connectiviteit werken we samen onder de naam Hanab. Met een sterke basis in Nederland en een internationaal werkterrein is Hanab dé partner in een wereld die volop in beweging is.

Duurzame energie heeft de toekomst. En die maken wij vandaag. Want als marktleider in complexe midden- en hoogspanning loopt Hanab Energy Solutions voorop in de energietransitie. Met uitdagende projecten over de volle breedte, en onder de krachtige vlag van Hanab, maak je impact om de transitie naar duurzame energie te realiseren. Zo werken we samen aan een duurzame toekomst, voor de generaties van vandaag en morgen.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Als Tendermanager speel jij een cruciale rol in het winnen van strategische projecten. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het volledige tenderproces: van strategische analyse tot het indienen van een winnend voorstel. Dit doe je door slimme strategieën te ontwikkelen en je team functioneel aan te sturen. Jij begrijpt wat opdrachtgevers écht nodig hebben en vertaalt dit naar onderscheidende oplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met engineers, projectmanagers, calculatie en directie om tot de beste aanbieding te komen. Zowel voor ons kantoor in Rotterdam als voor ons kantoor in Zwolle zoeken we een Tender Manager!

Je verantwoordelijkheden omvatten:

  • Ontwikkelen van een commerciële en vooruitstrevende tenderstrategie: Jij vertaalt de klantvraag naar een innovatieve aanpak en zet Hanab Energy Solutions krachtig in de markt.
  • Analyseren van klantbehoeften en latente vragen ontrafelen: Jij begrijpt wat een opdrachtgever zoekt en zorgt ervoor dat je team een unieke en passende aanbieding opstelt.
  • Coördineren en aansturen van een tenderteam (2-5 medewerkers of meer): Jij brengt experts samen en zorgt voor een optimaal tenderproces.
  • Onderhandelen en klantcontact onderhouden: Jij vertegenwoordigt Hanab Energy Solutions en voert zelfstandig gesprekken met opdrachtgevers om de tender tot een succes te maken.
  • Opstellen en beheren van de contract- en aanbestedingsfase: Je zorgt voor een optimale contractvorming en aanbestedingsstrategie, inclusief prijsvorming en optimalisatie.
  • Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor EMVI, plan van aanpak en optimalisaties: Jij bewaakt de kwaliteit en inhoud van tenderdocumenten en streeft naar de beste prijs-kwaliteitverhouding.
  • Evalueren en verbeteren van tenderprocessen: Jij borgt kennis, leert van eerdere tenders en draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering van bidmanagement binnen Hanab.
  • Samenwerken met andere disciplines: Jij stemt af met afdelingen zoals QHSE, Finance, Inkoop en Planning om ervoor te zorgen dat alle technische en kostenaspecten correct zijn geïntegreerd.
  • Werken aan tenders met een omvang van €100K tot meer dan €100 miljoen: Jij schakelt moeiteloos tussen kleine en zeer complexe projecten.

WAT BRENG JE MEE?

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Tender Manager, Bid Manager of vergelijkbare rol.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in de energiesector, bijvoorbeeld in ondergrondse infrastructuur, energietechniek of duurzame energieprojecten.
  • Sterke kennis van aanbestedingsprocedures (o.a. UAV‑GC, RAW, Aanbestedingswet).
  • Uitstekende schrijfvaardigheid en het vermogen om complexe materie helder te verwoorden.
  • Ervaring met UAV-GC en EMVI-methodieken.
  • Strategisch denker met een hands‑on mentaliteit.
  • Communicatief sterk, overtuigend en in staat om teams te verbinden.
  • Proactief, analytisch en resultaatgericht.

WAT HEBBEN WE JE TE BIEDEN?

  • Een sleutelrol binnen een toekomstgerichte organisatie met maatschappelijke impact
  • Bruto maandsalaris: tussen € 4.260,- en € 8.133,- afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
  • Bovenop je bruto maandsalaris ontvang je een flexbudget van 18%, dat je bruto kunt laten uitbetalen, gebruiken om extra verlof mee te kopen of een combinatie daarvan.
  • Auto van de zaak die je ook prive kunt gebruiken.
  • Deelname aan de cao NWb, een goede pensioen regeling, een laptop en een smartphone en fijne collega's. Kortom; alles om jouw functie goed uit te kunnen oefenen.
  • Daarnaast bieden wij nog diverse collectieve Hanab kortingen op verzekeringen en abonnementen.
  • Een sleutelpositie binnen een dynamisch en toekomstgericht bedrijf.
  • Interessante projecten die ertoe doen in de energietransitie.
  • Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid.

LATEN WE KENNISMAKEN!

Klik op de ‘ik ben geïnteresseerd’ button en upload jouw cv met evt. een motivatiebrief. Wij kijken uit naar jouw reactie! Voor vragen of meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Jeroen Boere, Corporate Recruiter, via recruitment-ES@hanab.nl of via +31 644477952.

Acquisitie

Voor deze vacature zoeken wij rechtstreeks contact met de sollicitant zelf, zonder tussenkomst van werving- en selectiebureaus of intermediairs. Heb jij zelf interesse? Laat het ons weten!

title: Senior Cloud Engineer- Azure
description:
Hela samhället ställer om mot en fossilfri framtid. Vi vill visa vägen i utvecklingen av vår bransch, så att fler kan ta sig fram, ta hand om sitt fordon och driva verksamheter med ett så lågt klimatavtryck som möjligt. Vill du vara med och bidra till hållbar utveckling, på riktigt? Välkommen att följa med på vår resa!

Vill du vara med och bygga den cloudplattform som ska lägga grunden för OKQ8:s fortsatta transformation? Vi söker nu en Senior Cloud Engineer med djup kompetens inom Microsoft Azure som vill kombinera hands-on engineering med tekniskt ledarskap, automation och utveckling av moderna plattformstjänster.

Om rollen

OKQ8 etablerar ett nytt Platform Engineering Team i Stockholm. Teamet blir en central del av vår fortsatta transformationsresa och ska skapa det tekniska fundament som gör det möjligt för organisationen att arbeta snabbare, säkrare och mer skalbart.

Teamet kommer att arbeta tvärfunktionellt och nära våra utvecklings-, infrastruktur-, nätverks- och cybersäkerhetsteam. Tillsammans ska ni omsätta vår nya cloud- och infrastrukturstrategi till moderna, standardiserade och automatiserade plattformskapabiliteter. Arbetet bedrivs enligt DevOps-principer med fokus på automation, Infrastructure as Code, återanvändbarhet och self-service.

Som Senior Cloud Engineer får du en senior teknisk nyckelroll med ansvar för att designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla vår Azure-plattform. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt och bidrar till att omsätta målarkitektur och cloudstrategi till fungerande, säkra och skalbara lösningar.

Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Designa och vidareutveckla Azure-plattformen, inklusive landing zones och gemensam foundation.
  • Omsätta arkitekturprinciper, målarkitektur och standarder till implementerade lösningar.
  • Utveckla och underhålla referensarkitekturer, designmönster och tekniska best practices.
  • Designa och implementera Infrastructure as Code med exempelvis Bicep eller Terraform.
  • Standardisera deploymentmönster, templates och CI/CD-pipelines.
  • Utveckla plattformskapabiliteter som möjliggör self-service för utvecklingsteamen.
  • Leda tekniskt arbete kopplat till migrering, modernisering och optimering av workloads.
  • Vidareutveckla säkerhet och governance genom bland annat Azure Policy, RBAC och Zero Trust-principer.
  • Förbättra monitorering, loggning, incidenthantering, resiliens och plattformens kostnadseffektivitet.
  • Coacha och stötta andra Cloud Engineers och utvecklingsteam i tekniska vägval och arbetssätt.

Vi söker

Vi söker dig som har djup erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure och som trivs med att både designa och själv implementera tekniska lösningar. Du har ett tydligt platform engineering-perspektiv och ser automation, standardisering och säkerhet som naturliga delar av en modern cloudplattform.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:

  • Djup erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure inom plattform, nätverk och säkerhet.
  • Stark kompetens inom Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Bicep, Terraform eller ARM.
  • Erfarenhet av Azure Landing Zones och Cloud Adoption Framework.
  • Erfarenhet av DevOps, CI/CD och automatiserade deployments.
  • God förståelse för identitet och behörighetsstyrning, exempelvis Entra ID och RBAC.
  • Erfarenhet av cloud governance, säkerhet och Zero Trust.
  • Förståelse för hybrid IT och integration mellan cloud- och on-prem-miljöer.
  • Förmåga att ta tekniskt ledarskap och vägleda andra i design- och implementeringsfrågor.
  • God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

  • AKS, Kubernetes eller andra containerplattformar.
  • API Management, eventdrivna lösningar eller microservices.
  • Komplexa cloudmigreringar och moderniseringsinitiativ.
  • FinOps och kostnadsoptimering i Azure.
  • Att etablera eller vidareutveckla ett platform engineering-team.

Som person är du strukturerad, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad. Du har förmåga att se helheten samtidigt som du gärna arbetar hands-on. Du är trygg i att påverka tekniska beslut, samarbetar väl över teamgränser och drivs av att skapa lösningar som är användbara, hållbara och enkla för andra team att använda.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss på OKQ8 får du arbeta i en flexibel miljö med viktiga och varierande arbetsuppgifter. Vi uppmuntrar samarbete, innovation och utveckling – och vi tror på att vi tillsammans gör varandra bättre. Här blir du en del av en familjär kultur där vi stöttar varandra, har roligt tillsammans och där du ges möjlighet att växa och göra skillnad. Vi vill vara ett företag som speglar samhället, med en inkluderande kultur som minskar utanförskap och främjar mångfald.

Övrig information

Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen vänligen kontakta Talent Partner Nabila Ur-Rehman; nabila.ur-rehman@okq8.se

Placeringsort: Stockholm, Sveavägen.
Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning

För den här tjänsten behöver du vara medborgare i Sverige, ett annat nordiskt land eller ett EU/EES-land, ha permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige eller vara asylsökande med rätt att arbeta. Du ska kunna styrka ditt medborgarskap eller din rätt att arbeta i Sverige under rekryteringsprocessen.

I rekryteringsprocessen ingår både psykometriska tester och kompetensbaserade intervjuer, med syfte att främja en rättvis utvärdering för alla kandidater.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Studerande kundtjänstmedarbetare till Handelsbanken Åmål

Nu söker vi på kontoret i Åmål en kollega till vår kundtjänst! Ditt team
Du kommer att vara en del av ett team bestående av privatrådgivare, företagsrådgivare och kontorschef som tillsammans har ett nära samarbete. Vår målsättning är att, genom vår goda service och affärsmannaskap, ha nöjda kunder och på så vis utveckla vår verksamhet.

Din roll
Som kundtjänstmedarbetare hos oss kommer du att spela en central roll i att leverera god kundservice till våra kunder. Kundmötet sker i huvudsak i det personliga mötet, både spontant och inbokat men kan även ske via telefon och mejl. Att arbeta på ett bankkontor som kundtjänstmedarbetare är ett ypperligt sätt att lära känna det specifika kontoret och banken i stort och på så sätt påverka din egna utveckling på lång sikt.

Din profil
Vi söker dig som trivs med att möta kunder och har ett intresse för ekonomi. För att trivas i rollen är du som person trygg i dig själv och kan behålla lugnet även när oväntade situationer uppstår. Du har en god kommunikationsförmåga och kan anpassa kommunikationen efter målgrupp och mötesform. Du är också lösningsorienterad genom att ha ett proaktivt förhållningssätt och ser möjliga lösningar framåt för kunden. Vidare tar du hänsyn och lyssnar in kunden i hens känsla och behov.

  • Du har en pågående universitetsutbildning inom ekonomi eller liknande inriktning.
  • Du har god kunskap i svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift. Andra språkkunskaper är meriterande.
  • Meriterande om du innehar Swedseclicens för bolån och/eller rådgivning.
  • Meriterande om du har arbetslivserfarenhet av kundservice och kundbemötande.

Välkommen med din ansökan!
